//! Claimed names (nfsu2-claims) in the Online host: the lobby gives a claimed name to its keyphrase only, and takes it
//! back for it from anyone else; EA Messenger keeps lists only for a claimed name, with its keyphrase (a player's
//! report, 2026-10-28: players who kept the same name saw one another's friends and blocked lists).

use std::sync::Arc;

use nfsu2_claims::{Claims, owner_of_token};

use super::world::{C, Opts, World};

/// a keyphrase's token (43 characters of base64url)
fn token(c: char) -> String {
    c.to_string().repeat(43)
}

fn world_with(claims: &Arc<Claims>, dir: Option<std::path::PathBuf>) -> World {
    World::new(Opts { claims: Some(claims.clone()), state_dir: dir, ..Default::default() })
}

/// the persona the lobby gave a login
fn persona(w: &World, l: C) -> String {
    w.c(l).l("pers").g("PERS").to_string()
}

/// a player whose page plays with keyphrase `key` (None: no keyphrase): its lobby login and EA Messenger connection
fn player(w: &mut World, vip: &str, name: &str, key: Option<char>) -> (C, C) {
    let g = w.client(vip);
    if let Some(k) = key {
        w.set_owner(g, &token(k));
    }
    let l = w.login(g, name);
    let k = w.lkey(l);
    (l, w.buddy(g, &k))
}

fn roster(w: &mut World, b: C) -> Vec<String> {
    let n = w.c(b).msgs.len();
    w.send(b, "RGET", fields![("LRSC", "PC"), ("LIST", "B"), ("PRES", "Y"), ("PEND", "Y"), ("ID", 1)]);
    w.c(b).msgs[n..].iter().filter(|m| m.kind == "ROST").map(|m| m.g("USER").to_string()).collect()
}

fn befriend(w: &mut World, a: C, b: C, name_b: &str, name_a: &str) {
    w.send(a, "RADM", fields![("LRSC", "PC"), ("USER", name_b), ("ID", 5), ("PRES", "Y")]);
    w.send(b, "RRSP", fields![("LRSC", "PC"), ("USER", name_a), ("ANSW", "Y"), ("ID", 6), ("PRES", "Y")]);
}

fn now(w: &World) -> i64 {
    w.t.get() as i64
}

#[test]
fn a_claimed_name_is_its_owners() {
    let claims = Arc::new(Claims::in_memory());
    let mut w = world_with(&claims, None);
    claims.claim("Alex", &owner_of_token(&token('A')).unwrap(), now(&w)).unwrap();
    // without the keyphrase: the name with digits, and the log says why
    let (l, _) = player(&mut w, "10.77.0.2", "Alex", None);
    let p = persona(&w, l);
    assert!(p.starts_with("Alex") && p.len() == 8 && p[4..].bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_digit()), "{p}");
    assert!(w.logged("(\"Alex\" is claimed)"), "{:?}", w.text());
    // another keyphrase too
    let (l, _) = player(&mut w, "10.77.0.3", "alex", Some('B'));
    assert_ne!(persona(&w, l).to_lowercase(), "alex");
    // the owner gets it
    let (l, _) = player(&mut w, "10.77.0.4", "Alex", Some('A'));
    assert_eq!(persona(&w, l), "Alex");
    // a claim's digits are never another claimed name
    claims.claim("Alex4821", &owner_of_token(&token('C')).unwrap(), now(&w)).unwrap();
    for i in 5..12 {
        let (l, _) = player(&mut w, &format!("10.77.0.{i}"), "Alex", None);
        assert_ne!(persona(&w, l), "Alex4821");
    }
}

#[test]
fn the_owner_takes_its_name_back() {
    let claims = Arc::new(Claims::in_memory());
    let mut w = world_with(&claims, None);
    // someone plays as Speedy before it is claimed
    let (other, _) = player(&mut w, "10.77.0.2", "Speedy", None);
    assert_eq!(persona(&w, other), "Speedy");
    claims.claim("Speedy", &owner_of_token(&token('A')).unwrap(), now(&w)).unwrap();
    // its owner comes: the name is the owner's, the other session leaves the lobby
    let (l, _) = player(&mut w, "10.77.0.3", "Speedy", Some('A'));
    assert_eq!(persona(&w, l), "Speedy");
    assert!(w.c(other).fin || w.c(other).reset, "the other session dropped");
    assert!(w.logged("the name's owner logged in"), "{:?}", w.text());
    // playing holds the claim HOLD_DAYS from now
    w.advance(10.0 * 86_400_000.0);
    let (_, _) = player(&mut w, "10.77.0.3", "Speedy", Some('A'));
    let m = claims.mine(&owner_of_token(&token('A')).unwrap(), now(&w)).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(m.until, now(&w) + nfsu2_claims::HOLD_DAYS * nfsu2_claims::DAY_MS);
}

// lists for claimed names only, with their keyphrase; a name nobody claimed has lists for its session only
#[test]
fn messenger_lists_follow_the_claim() {
    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let dir = tmp.path().join("online");
    let claims = Arc::new(Claims::in_memory());
    let mut w = world_with(&claims, Some(dir.clone()));
    let (a, b) = (owner_of_token(&token('A')).unwrap(), owner_of_token(&token('B')).unwrap());
    claims.claim("Alpha", &a, now(&w)).unwrap();
    claims.claim("Bravo", &b, now(&w)).unwrap();
    // two owners become friends: kept, each with its keyphrase
    let (_, ma) = player(&mut w, "10.77.0.2", "Alpha", Some('A'));
    let (_, mb) = player(&mut w, "10.77.0.3", "Bravo", Some('B'));
    befriend(&mut w, ma, mb, "Bravo", "Alpha");
    assert_eq!(roster(&mut w, ma), ["Bravo"]);
    let l = w.core.buddies.list("Alpha").unwrap();
    assert!(!l.temp && l.owner.as_deref() == Some(&*a));
    // a name nobody claimed: lists for the session, never written, gone with it
    let (_, mc) = player(&mut w, "10.77.0.4", "Charlie", None);
    befriend(&mut w, mc, ma, "Alpha", "Charlie");
    assert_eq!(roster(&mut w, mc), ["Alpha"]);
    assert!(w.core.buddies.list("Charlie").unwrap().temp);
    w.core.buddy_save();
    let text = crate::buddy::shelf_texts(&dir).join("\n");
    assert!(!text.contains("{\"name\":\"Charlie\""), "{text}");
    assert!(text.contains(&format!("\"owner\":\"{a}\"")), "{text}");
    w.send(mc, "DISC", vec![]);
    assert!(w.core.buddies.list("Charlie").is_none(), "gone with its session");
    // the next player under that name sees nothing of it
    let (_, mc2) = player(&mut w, "10.77.0.5", "Charlie", None);
    assert!(roster(&mut w, mc2).is_empty());
    // over a restart: the owners' lists are theirs again (Alpha's names Charlie, whoever plays under it)
    w.core.stop();
    let mut w = world_with(&claims, Some(dir.clone()));
    let (_, ma) = player(&mut w, "10.77.0.2", "Alpha", Some('A'));
    assert_eq!(roster(&mut w, ma), ["Bravo", "Charlie"]);
    // a claim that ended: its lists go, and the next player under the name finds none
    claims.release(&b);
    let (_, mb) = player(&mut w, "10.77.0.6", "Bravo", None);
    assert!(roster(&mut w, mb).is_empty(), "the ended claim's list is nobody's");
}

// the lists of before claims: NAME's and Player's go, the others wait for their name's first keyphrase, and nobody
// else sees them meanwhile
#[test]
fn lists_of_before_go_to_the_first_claim() {
    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let dir = tmp.path().join("online");
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();
    std::fs::write(
        dir.join("buddies.json"),
        r#"{"v":3,"personas":[
            {"name":"NAME","seen":"2026-10","B":["Someone","Other"],"I":["Pest"]},
            {"name":"Player","seen":"2026-10","B":["Someone"]},
            {"name":"Delta","seen":"2026-10","B":["Echo"],"I":["Pest"]}
        ]}"#,
    )
    .unwrap();
    let claims = Arc::new(Claims::in_memory());
    let mut w = world_with(&claims, Some(dir.clone()));
    // nobody claimed Delta: its list is not shown to whoever plays under it
    let (_, m) = player(&mut w, "10.77.0.2", "Delta", None);
    assert!(roster(&mut w, m).is_empty());
    let (_, n) = player(&mut w, "10.77.0.3", "NAME", None);
    assert!(roster(&mut w, n).is_empty(), "NAME's shared list went");
    w.send(m, "DISC", vec![]);
    w.core.buddy_save();
    let text = crate::buddy::shelf_texts(&dir).join("\n");
    assert!(text.contains("\"Delta\"") && !text.contains("\"NAME\"") && !text.contains("\"Player\""), "{text}");
    // its first keyphrase gets it, with its blocked list
    claims.claim("Delta", &owner_of_token(&token('D')).unwrap(), now(&w)).unwrap();
    let (_, m) = player(&mut w, "10.77.0.4", "Delta", Some('D'));
    assert_eq!(roster(&mut w, m), ["Echo"]);
    assert!(w.core.buddies.blocks("delta", "pest"));
}

// a name change: the lists move to the new name, and the friends' lists name it so
#[test]
fn a_name_change_takes_the_lists_along() {
    let claims = Arc::new(Claims::in_memory());
    let mut w = world_with(&claims, None);
    let (a, b) = (owner_of_token(&token('A')).unwrap(), owner_of_token(&token('B')).unwrap());
    claims.claim("Alpha", &a, now(&w)).unwrap();
    claims.claim("Bravo", &b, now(&w)).unwrap();
    let (_, ma) = player(&mut w, "10.77.0.2", "Alpha", Some('A'));
    let (_, mb) = player(&mut w, "10.77.0.3", "Bravo", Some('B'));
    befriend(&mut w, ma, mb, "Bravo", "Alpha");
    w.send(ma, "DISC", vec![]);
    claims.claim("Speedy", &a, now(&w)).unwrap();
    let (_, ms) = player(&mut w, "10.77.0.2", "Speedy", Some('A'));
    assert_eq!(roster(&mut w, ms), ["Bravo"]);
    assert!(w.core.buddies.list("Alpha").is_none());
    assert_eq!(roster(&mut w, mb), ["Speedy"]);
    assert!(w.logged("lists moved from \"alpha\""), "{:?}", w.text());
}

// a name changed on the start page, the Messenger never opened: the page's next look at its lists moves them, into
// the list the new name got meanwhile (a request to it), and the friend's list names it so, over a restart too
#[test]
fn a_name_change_on_the_page_takes_the_lists_along() {
    use crate::buddy::FriendAsk::{Ask, List};
    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let dir = tmp.path().join("online");
    let claims = Arc::new(Claims::in_memory());
    let mut w = world_with(&claims, Some(dir.clone()));
    let [a, b, c] = ['A', 'B', 'C'].map(|k| owner_of_token(&token(k)).unwrap());
    for (n, o) in [("Alpha", &a), ("Bravo", &b), ("Charlie", &c)] {
        claims.claim(n, o, now(&w)).unwrap();
    }
    let g: Arc<str> = Arc::from("g1");
    let names = |r: &crate::buddy::FriendReply| r.friends.iter().map(|f| f.name.clone()).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&a, &g, Ask("Bravo".into())).done, "asked");
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&b, &g, Ask("Alpha".into())).done, "friends");
    w.core.buddy_save();
    claims.claim("Speedy", &a, now(&w)).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&c, &g, Ask("Speedy".into())).done, "asked");
    let r = w.core.friends(&a, &g, List);
    assert_eq!((r.me.as_deref(), names(&r), r.asks.clone()), (Some("Speedy"), vec!["Bravo".to_string()], vec!["Charlie".to_string()]));
    assert_eq!(names(&w.core.friends(&b, &g, List)), ["Speedy"]);
    assert!(w.core.buddies.list("Alpha").is_none());
    assert!(w.logged("lists moved from \"alpha\""), "{:?}", w.text());
    // once only: the next look finds nothing left under the old name
    let moves = |w: &World| w.text().iter().filter(|l| l.contains("lists moved")).count();
    let n = moves(&w);
    assert_eq!(names(&w.core.friends(&a, &g, List)), ["Bravo"]);
    assert_eq!(moves(&w), n);
    w.core.stop();
    let text = crate::buddy::shelf_texts(&dir).join("\n");
    assert!(!text.contains("\"Alpha\""), "{text}");
    let mut w = world_with(&claims, Some(dir.clone()));
    assert_eq!(names(&w.core.friends(&a, &g, List)), ["Bravo"]);
    assert_eq!(names(&w.core.friends(&b, &g, List)), ["Speedy"]);
}

// the two lists in one stay within a list's limits, on both sides: requests to the old name and to the new one, more
// than a list keeps, leave the newest; the askers whose request went no longer have it as sent
#[test]
fn a_name_change_keeps_both_sides_within_the_limits() {
    use crate::buddy::FriendAsk::{Ask, List};
    let claims = Arc::new(Claims::in_memory());
    let mut w = world_with(&claims, None);
    let a = owner_of_token(&token('A')).unwrap();
    claims.claim("Alpha", &a, now(&w)).unwrap();
    let askers: Vec<(String, Arc<str>)> = (0..30)
        .map(|i| {
            let o = owner_of_token(&format!("{i:0>43}")).unwrap();
            let n = format!("Fan{i}");
            claims.claim(&n, &o, now(&w)).unwrap();
            (n, o)
        })
        .collect();
    let g: Arc<str> = Arc::from("g1");
    for (i, (_, o)) in askers.iter().enumerate() {
        if i == 15 {
            claims.claim("Speedy", &a, now(&w)).unwrap();
        }
        w.advance(1000.0);
        // (each from its own network: a network makes only so many lists)
        let gi: Arc<str> = Arc::from(format!("g{i}"));
        assert_eq!(w.core.friends(o, &gi, Ask(if i < 15 { "Alpha" } else { "Speedy" }.into())).done, "asked", "{i}");
    }
    let r = w.core.friends(&a, &g, List);
    assert_eq!(r.me.as_deref(), Some("Speedy"));
    assert_eq!(r.asks.len(), 20, "{:?}", r.asks);
    for (n, o) in &askers {
        let sent = w.core.friends(o, &g, List).sent;
        let kept = r.asks.contains(n);
        assert_eq!(sent, if kept { vec!["Speedy".to_string()] } else { vec![] }, "{n}: kept {kept}");
    }
    assert!(r.asks.contains(&"Fan29".to_string()), "the newest stay");
}

// a list of another keyphrase's claim on the new name, ended (its cloud saves deleted) while the list stayed in
// memory, is not taken in: the player who claims that name next gets its own friends only
#[test]
fn a_name_change_takes_no_one_elses_list() {
    use crate::buddy::FriendAsk::{Ask, List};
    let claims = Arc::new(Claims::in_memory());
    let mut w = world_with(&claims, None);
    let [a, b, c, x] = ['A', 'B', 'C', 'X'].map(|k| owner_of_token(&token(k)).unwrap());
    for (n, o) in [("Alpha", &a), ("Bravo", &b), ("Charlie", &c), ("Speedy", &x)] {
        claims.claim(n, o, now(&w)).unwrap();
    }
    let g: Arc<str> = Arc::from("g1");
    let names = |r: &crate::buddy::FriendReply| r.friends.iter().map(|f| f.name.clone()).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&x, &g, Ask("Bravo".into())).done, "asked");
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&b, &g, Ask("Speedy".into())).done, "friends");
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&a, &g, Ask("Charlie".into())).done, "asked");
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&c, &g, Ask("Alpha".into())).done, "friends");
    assert_eq!(claims.release(&x), 1);
    claims.claim("Speedy", &a, now(&w)).unwrap();
    let r = w.core.friends(&a, &g, List);
    assert_eq!((r.me.as_deref(), names(&r)), (Some("Speedy"), vec!["Charlie".to_string()]));
}

// free roam's pages befriend through the Messenger's lists, as their keyphrase's claimed name: a request waits on
// both lists, a request back makes friends, and the Messenger hears of it; names nobody claimed take no part
#[test]
fn pages_befriend_through_the_messenger_lists() {
    use crate::buddy::FriendAsk::{Answer, Ask, Block, List, Remove};
    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let dir = tmp.path().join("online");
    let claims = Arc::new(Claims::in_memory());
    let mut w = world_with(&claims, Some(dir.clone()));
    let [a, b, c] = ['A', 'B', 'C'].map(|k| owner_of_token(&token(k)).unwrap());
    for (n, o) in [("Alpha", &a), ("Bravo", &b), ("Charlie", &c)] {
        claims.claim(n, o, now(&w)).unwrap();
    }
    let g: Arc<str> = Arc::from("g1");
    let names = |r: &crate::buddy::FriendReply| r.friends.iter().map(|f| f.name.clone()).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    // Alpha's Messenger is open: it hears of Bravo's request
    let (_, ma) = player(&mut w, "10.77.0.2", "Alpha", Some('A'));
    let r = w.core.friends(&b, &g, Ask("Alpha".into()));
    assert_eq!((r.me.as_deref(), r.done, r.sent.clone()), (Some("Bravo"), "asked", vec!["Alpha".to_string()]));
    w.deliver();
    assert_eq!(w.c(ma).l("RNOT").g("ATTR"), "R");
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&a, &g, List).asks, ["Bravo"]);
    // asked back: friends, each on the other's list, the Messenger told
    let r = w.core.friends(&a, &g, Ask("Bravo".into()));
    assert_eq!((r.done, names(&r), r.asks.len()), ("friends", vec!["Bravo".to_string()], 0));
    assert_eq!(roster(&mut w, ma), ["Bravo"]);
    let r = w.core.friends(&b, &g, List);
    assert_eq!(r.friends, [crate::buddy::FriendRow { name: "Alpha".into(), mutual: true, online: true, contact: None }]);
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&b, &g, Ask("Alpha".into())).done, "friends", "already");
    // what takes no part: oneself, a name nobody claimed, a keyphrase without a name
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&a, &g, Ask("alpha".into())).done, "self");
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&a, &g, Ask("Delta".into())).done, "claim");
    let r = w.core.friends(&owner_of_token(&token('D')).unwrap(), &g, List);
    assert_eq!((r.me, r.done), (None, "claim"));
    // a request declined goes from both lists
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&c, &g, Ask("Alpha".into())).done, "asked");
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&a, &g, Answer("Charlie".into(), false)).done, "ok");
    assert!(w.core.friends(&c, &g, List).sent.is_empty() && w.core.friends(&a, &g, List).asks.is_empty());
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&a, &g, Answer("Charlie".into(), true)).done, "none", "nothing to answer");
    // blocked: its requests never arrive
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&a, &g, Block("Charlie".into())).done, "ok");
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&c, &g, Ask("Alpha".into())).done, "asked");
    assert!(w.core.friends(&a, &g, List).asks.is_empty());
    // over a restart: the friends are kept
    w.core.stop();
    let mut w = world_with(&claims, Some(dir.clone()));
    assert_eq!(names(&w.core.friends(&a, &g, List)), ["Bravo"]);
    // friends no more, on neither list
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&b, &g, Remove("Alpha".into())).done, "ok");
    assert!(w.core.friends(&a, &g, List).friends.is_empty() && w.core.friends(&b, &g, List).friends.is_empty());
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&b, &g, Remove("Alpha".into())).done, "none");
}

// friends message each other from their pages: to the Messenger of a friend logged in there, else to its pages (the
// server's hook), else the message waits and the friend's page takes it with its list; the Messenger's own messages
// to a friend who is away reach its pages too; strangers, empty messages and slurs reach no one
#[test]
fn pages_message_friends() {
    use crate::buddy::FriendAsk::{Ask, List, ListMail, Send};
    use crate::buddy::PageMail;
    use std::sync::Mutex;
    use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};
    let claims = Arc::new(Claims::in_memory());
    let mut w = world_with(&claims, None);
    let [a, b, c] = ['A', 'B', 'C'].map(|k| owner_of_token(&token(k)).unwrap());
    for (n, o) in [("Alpha", &a), ("Bravo", &b), ("Charlie", &c)] {
        claims.claim(n, o, now(&w)).unwrap();
    }
    let g: Arc<str> = Arc::from("g1");
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&a, &g, Ask("Bravo".into())).done, "asked");
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&b, &g, Ask("Alpha".into())).done, "friends");
    // the pages: what they took, and whether one is open
    let got: Arc<Mutex<Vec<(String, PageMail)>>> = Arc::default();
    let open = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(true));
    let (got2, open2) = (got.clone(), open.clone());
    w.core.set_page_mail(Box::new(move |to, m| {
        let on = open2.load(Ordering::SeqCst);
        if on {
            got2.lock().unwrap().push((to.to_string(), m.clone()));
        }
        on
    }));
    // Bravo's page is open: it gets the message now, cut to 120 characters
    let long = "x".repeat(200);
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&a, &g, Send("bravo".into(), format!("  hi\u{0007} there  {long}"))).done, "sent");
    {
        let got = got.lock().unwrap();
        assert_eq!((got.len(), got[0].0.as_str(), got[0].1.from.as_str()), (1, "Bravo", "Alpha"));
        assert!(got[0].1.body.starts_with("hi there xxx") && got[0].1.body.chars().count() == 120, "{:?}", got[0].1.body);
    }
    assert!(w.logged("\"Alpha\" sent \"Bravo\" a message (got it)"), "{:?}", w.text());
    // no page open: it waits, and Bravo's page takes it with its list, once
    open.store(false, Ordering::SeqCst);
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&a, &g, Send("Bravo".into(), "race later?".into())).done, "kept");
    assert!(w.core.friends(&b, &g, List).mail.is_empty(), "a plain list leaves them");
    let r = w.core.friends(&b, &g, ListMail);
    assert_eq!(r.mail.iter().map(|m| (m.from.as_str(), m.body.as_str())).collect::<Vec<_>>(), [("Alpha", "race later?")]);
    assert!(w.core.friends(&b, &g, ListMail).mail.is_empty());
    // Bravo's Messenger is open: the message goes there (RECV), not to the pages
    open.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
    let (_, mb) = player(&mut w, "10.77.0.3", "Bravo", Some('B'));
    w.deliver();
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&a, &g, Send("Bravo".into(), "on my way".into())).done, "sent");
    w.deliver();
    let m = w.c(mb).l("RECV");
    assert_eq!((m.g("USER"), m.g("BODY")), ("Alpha", "on my way"));
    assert_eq!(got.lock().unwrap().len(), 1);
    // the Messenger's own message to Alpha, who is not in it: to Alpha's pages
    w.send(mb, "SEND", fields![("USER", "Alpha"), ("BODY", "see you"), ("SUBJ", ""), ("TYPE", "C")]);
    {
        let got = got.lock().unwrap();
        assert_eq!((got.len(), got[1].0.as_str(), got[1].1.from.as_str(), got[1].1.body.as_str()), (2, "Alpha", "Bravo", "see you"));
    }
    // what reaches no one: a stranger's, an empty one, one without a claimed name
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&c, &g, Send("Alpha".into(), "hey".into())).done, "none");
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&a, &g, Send("Bravo".into(), " \u{0007} ".into())).done, "empty");
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&owner_of_token(&token('D')).unwrap(), &g, Send("Alpha".into(), "hey".into())).done, "claim");
    // one that reads as a slur goes to no one (its sender sees it go); the third in the window turns them off
    let n = got.lock().unwrap().len();
    for _ in 0..3 {
        assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&b, &g, Send("Alpha".into(), "SIEG HEIL".into())).done, "sent");
    }
    assert_eq!(got.lock().unwrap().len(), n);
    assert!(w.logged("\"Bravo\": a message with \"SIEG HEIL\" in it, sent to no one; messages off for 600 s"), "{:?}", w.text());
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&b, &g, Send("Alpha".into(), "sorry".into())).done, "off");
    // the Messenger's too
    w.send(mb, "SEND", fields![("USER", "Alpha"), ("BODY", "sorry"), ("SUBJ", ""), ("TYPE", "C")]);
    assert_eq!(got.lock().unwrap().len(), n);
    w.advance(600_001.0);
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&b, &g, Send("Alpha".into(), "sorry".into())).done, "sent");
    assert_eq!(got.lock().unwrap().len(), n + 1);
}

// The 2026-11-05 security audit's one-sided friend: the Messenger's RADD LIST=B (the game sends none) put the victim
// on the adder's list at once, unasked, and the free-roam hub then linked the two anywhere and told the adder where
// the victim played.  Now it is a friend request, as RADM: on neither list until the victim accepts it.
#[test]
fn a_messenger_radd_is_a_friend_request() {
    use crate::buddy::FriendAsk::List;
    let claims = Arc::new(Claims::in_memory());
    let mut w = world_with(&claims, None);
    let (a, v) = (owner_of_token(&token('A')).unwrap(), owner_of_token(&token('V')).unwrap());
    claims.claim("Mallory", &a, now(&w)).unwrap();
    claims.claim("Victim", &v, now(&w)).unwrap();
    let (_, mv) = player(&mut w, "10.77.0.3", "Victim", Some('V'));
    let (_, ma) = player(&mut w, "10.77.0.2", "Mallory", Some('A'));
    w.send(ma, "RADD", fields![("USER", "Victim"), ("LIST", "B"), ("ID", 1)]);
    assert_eq!(w.c(ma).l("RADD").code, "");
    w.deliver();
    assert_eq!(w.c(mv).l("RNOT").g("ATTR"), "R", "the victim's Messenger: a request to answer");
    let g: Arc<str> = Arc::from("g1");
    let names = |r: &crate::buddy::FriendReply| r.friends.iter().map(|f| f.name.clone()).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let r = w.core.friends(&a, &g, List);
    assert!(names(&r).is_empty(), "no friend unasked: {:?}", names(&r));
    assert_eq!(r.sent, ["Victim"]);
    let r = w.core.friends(&v, &g, List);
    assert!(names(&r).is_empty());
    assert_eq!(r.asks, ["Mallory"]);
    // accepted: friends both ways
    w.send(mv, "RRSP", fields![("USER", "Mallory"), ("ANSW", "Y"), ("ID", 2)]);
    let r = w.core.friends(&a, &g, List);
    assert_eq!(r.friends, [crate::buddy::FriendRow { name: "Victim".into(), mutual: true, online: true, contact: None }]);
}

// A one-way entry on a list (one of before RADD stopped making them, or a friend's name that its keyphrase let go and
// another one claimed since) is a name on the list only: no friendship both ways, so the pages are told nothing of
// where it is (not even whether it is online) and the hub links nothing first (the server's friends.rs)
#[test]
fn a_one_way_friend_is_told_nothing() {
    use crate::buddy::FriendAsk::{Answer, Ask, List};
    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let claims = Arc::new(Claims::in_memory());
    let mut w = world_with(&claims, Some(tmp.path().join("online")));
    let [a, v, b, c] = ['A', 'V', 'B', 'C'].map(|k| owner_of_token(&token(k)).unwrap());
    for (n, o) in [("Mallory", &a), ("Victim", &v), ("Bravo", &b)] {
        claims.claim(n, o, now(&w)).unwrap();
    }
    let (_, ma) = player(&mut w, "10.77.0.2", "Mallory", Some('A'));
    let (_, mv) = player(&mut w, "10.77.0.3", "Victim", Some('V'));
    let (_, mb) = player(&mut w, "10.77.0.4", "Bravo", Some('B'));
    befriend(&mut w, ma, mv, "Victim", "Mallory");
    befriend(&mut w, ma, mb, "Bravo", "Mallory");
    let g: Arc<str> = Arc::from("g1");
    let row = |name: &str, mutual: bool| crate::buddy::FriendRow { name: name.into(), mutual, online: mutual, contact: None };
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&a, &g, List).friends, [row("Victim", true), row("Bravo", true)]);
    // Victim's list no longer names Mallory (as a list of before RADD's would not)
    w.core.buddies.lists.get_mut("victim").unwrap().b.shift_remove("mallory");
    // Bravo's keyphrase let its name go, and another claimed it: Bravo's old list, still in memory, is not the new
    // claimer's
    claims.release(&b);
    claims.claim("Bravo", &c, now(&w)).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&a, &g, List).friends, [row("Victim", false), row("Bravo", false)]);
    assert!(w.core.friends(&v, &g, List).friends.is_empty());
    // a one-way entry is asked as anyone: a request that waits for its answer, then friends both ways
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&a, &g, Ask("Victim".into())).done, "asked");
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&v, &g, List).asks, ["Mallory"]);
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&v, &g, Answer("Mallory".into(), true)).done, "friends");
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&a, &g, List).friends, [row("Victim", true), row("Bravo", false)]);
}

// a page's Discord username: Discord's form only (taken as typed, with a leading @ and capitals let go), not one the
// name filter refuses; its friends both ways see it on their lists, nobody else; "" takes it away; kept over a
// restart; the log says it changed, never what it is
#[test]
fn pages_give_friends_a_discord_name() {
    use crate::buddy::FriendAsk::{Ask, Discord, List, Remove};
    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let dir = tmp.path().join("online");
    let claims = Arc::new(Claims::in_memory());
    let mut w = world_with(&claims, Some(dir.clone()));
    let [a, b, c] = ['A', 'B', 'C'].map(|k| owner_of_token(&token(k)).unwrap());
    for (n, o) in [("Alpha", &a), ("Bravo", &b), ("Charlie", &c)] {
        claims.claim(n, o, now(&w)).unwrap();
    }
    let g: Arc<str> = Arc::from("g1");
    let seen = |w: &mut World, o: &str, name: &str| {
        w.core.friends(o, &g, List).friends.into_iter().find(|f| f.name == name).and_then(|f| f.contact)
    };
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&a, &g, Ask("Bravo".into())).done, "asked");
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&b, &g, Ask("Alpha".into())).done, "friends");
    // Charlie asked Alpha, who did not answer: no friend
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&c, &g, Ask("Alpha".into())).done, "asked");
    let r = w.core.friends(&a, &g, Discord("  @Alpha.Drives_9 ".into()));
    assert_eq!((r.done, r.contact.as_deref()), ("ok", Some("alpha.drives_9")));
    assert_eq!(seen(&mut w, &b, "Alpha").as_deref(), Some("alpha.drives_9"));
    assert!(w.core.friends(&c, &g, List).friends.is_empty(), "a request is no friendship");
    assert!(w.logged("\"Alpha\" set a Discord name") && !w.logged("alpha.drives_9"));
    // not Discord's form, or a name the filter refuses: refused, the one before kept
    for bad in ["a", "a..b", "ann drives", "ann-drives", "ännchen", "#1234", &"x".repeat(33), "hitler.fan"] {
        let r = w.core.friends(&a, &g, Discord(bad.into()));
        assert_eq!((r.done, r.contact.as_deref()), ("name", Some("alpha.drives_9")), "{bad}");
    }
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&a, &g, Discord("._.".into())).contact.as_deref(), Some("._."), "Discord allows it");
    // over a restart
    w.core.buddy_save();
    w.core.stop();
    let mut w = world_with(&claims, Some(dir.clone()));
    assert_eq!(seen(&mut w, &b, "Alpha").as_deref(), Some("._."));
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&a, &g, List).contact.as_deref(), Some("._."));
    // a player without friends gives one too (its list made for it), and takes it away again
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&c, &g, Discord("charlie".into())).contact.as_deref(), Some("charlie"));
    let r = w.core.friends(&c, &g, Discord(" ".into()));
    assert_eq!((r.done, r.contact), ("ok", None));
    assert!(w.logged("\"Charlie\" took its Discord name away"));
    // friends no more: Bravo sees it no more
    assert_eq!(w.core.friends(&b, &g, Remove("Alpha".into())).done, "ok");
    w.core.friends(&b, &g, Ask("Alpha".into()));
    assert_eq!(seen(&mut w, &b, "Alpha"), None, "a request again is no friendship");
}

//! What a client can send, and what can happen to the host, that the other tests do not try: numbers at the ends of
//! their range, and the like (each found where the Rust host could differ from the Node server: a panic, a resource
//! held).

use super::world::{Opts, World};

// a ranking asked for on the channel of the lowest 32-bit number (CHAN=2147483648 is -2^31 for `| 0`): the answer is
// an empty ranking; `chan - 6` overflowed here once (a panic in a build with overflow checks: the stream went as a
// "service error")
#[test]
fn snap_on_the_channel_at_the_end_of_the_range() {
    let mut w = World::new(Opts::default());
    let g = w.client("10.77.0.2");
    let a = w.login(g, "Alpha");
    for chan in ["2147483648", "-2147483648", "-2147483643", "2147483647", "4294967295"] {
        w.send(a, "snap", fields![("INDEX", 1), ("CHAN", chan), ("RANGE", 10)]);
        let m = w.c(a).l("snap");
        assert_eq!((m.g("COUNT"), m.g("TOTAL")), ("0", "0"), "CHAN={chan}");
        w.send(a, "snap", fields![("INDEX", 1), ("CHAN", chan), ("FIND", "$")]);
        assert_eq!(w.c(a).l("snap").g("COUNT"), "0", "CHAN={chan} FIND=$");
    }
    assert_eq!(w.c(a).l("snap").g("CHAN"), "-1", "the channel as JavaScript's `| 0` makes it");
    assert!(!w.c(a).reset, "the session stays");
}

// streams opened and reset as fast as a client may (its budget is 2500 frames a second a connection): each sets a
// time-out (EA Messenger's 60 s for a login, the redirector's 30 s, the web pages' 15 s) that its reset clears.  A
// cleared timer is gone as Node's clearTimeout makes it, not held in the queue until its time (before: 100,000 of
// them were, 40 s of one connection's budget)
#[test]
fn cleared_timers_leave_the_queue() {
    use crate::vhost::{RST, SYN, lan_frame};
    use crate::{PORT_BUDDY, PORT_HTTP, PORT_REDIRECTOR, VHOST_VIP};
    let mut w = World::new(Opts::default());
    w.mute = true;
    let g = w.client("10.77.0.2");
    let before = w.core.timers.queued();
    for k in 0..100_000u32 {
        let port = [PORT_BUDDY, PORT_REDIRECTOR, PORT_HTTP][k as usize % 3];
        let sport = 1000 + (k % 50_000) as u16;
        w.raw(g, &lan_frame(4, g, VHOST_VIP, sport, port, SYN, k, &[]));
        w.raw(g, &lan_frame(4, g, VHOST_VIP, sport, port, RST, k, &[]));
    }
    assert_eq!(w.core.vh.conns.len(), 0);
    let queued = w.core.timers.queued();
    assert!(queued < before + 2048, "{queued} places in the timer queue for {before} live timers");
}

//! A rough measure of the host's own cost (ignored by default; `cargo test -p nfsu2-online --release load --
//! --ignored --nocapture`): 900 lobby sessions in rooms of 50 chatting, with EA Messenger and presence.

use std::time::Instant;

use super::world::{C, Opts, World};

#[test]
#[ignore]
fn lobby_load() {
    let mut w = World::new(Opts::default());
    let t = Instant::now();
    let mut lobby: Vec<C> = Vec::new();
    let mut buddies: Vec<C> = Vec::new();
    for i in 0..900u32 {
        let g = w.client_of(&format!("10.77.{}.{}", 1 + i / 200, 2 + i % 200), &format!("client {i}"));
        let c = w.login(g, &format!("Player{i}"));
        let k = w.lkey(c);
        buddies.push(w.buddy(g, &k));
        lobby.push(c);
    }
    let login = t.elapsed();
    let rooms = ["Lounge", "Circuit", "Sprint", "Drift", "Drag", "StreetX", "URL"];
    for (i, c) in lobby.iter().enumerate().take(7 * 50) {
        w.send(*c, "move", fields![("NAME", rooms[i % 7])]);
    }
    let frames0 = w.core.info()["framesOut"].as_u64().unwrap();
    w.mute = true;
    let t = Instant::now();
    let mut msgs = 0;
    for round in 0..20 {
        for (i, c) in lobby.iter().enumerate().take(7 * 50) {
            if i % 10 == round % 10 {
                w.send(*c, "mesg", fields![("TEXT", format!("hello {round}"))]);
                msgs += 1;
            }
        }
        for (i, b) in buddies.iter().enumerate().take(300) {
            w.send(*b, "PSET", fields![("SHOW", "CHAT"), ("PROD", format!("p{}", (round + i) % 3))]);
        }
        w.advance(1100.0);
    }
    let el = t.elapsed();
    let frames = w.core.info()["framesOut"].as_u64().unwrap() - frames0;
    eprintln!(
        "900 logins with Messenger: {login:?}; {msgs} chat lines to rooms of 50 and 6000 presences: {el:?}, {frames} frames out ({:.0} frames/s)",
        frames as f64 / el.as_secs_f64()
    );
}

/// What one frame of a client costs the host where the lobby is full of others (1000 sessions): a lobby connection
/// refused (the sessions of its browser, client and site counted) and a Messenger login with a key of nobody's
/// (looked for among the sessions, then tried again 6 times, 500 ms apart).
#[test]
#[ignore]
fn costly_frames() {
    use crate::vhost::{RST, SYN, lan_frame};
    use crate::{PORT_BUDDY, PORT_LOBBY, VHOST_VIP};

    let mut w = World::new(Opts::default());
    for i in 0..1000u32 {
        let g = w.client_of(&format!("10.77.{}.{}", 1 + i / 200, 2 + i % 200), &format!("client {i}"));
        w.login(g, &format!("Player{i}"));
    }
    w.mute = true;
    let g = w.client_of("10.77.9.2", "client 0");
    // a browser of a client that holds its share: each lobby connection refused
    let n = 20_000u32;
    let t = Instant::now();
    for k in 0..n {
        w.raw(g, &lan_frame(4, g, VHOST_VIP, 1000 + (k % 60000) as u16, PORT_LOBBY, SYN, k, &[]));
    }
    let syn = t.elapsed();
    // a Messenger login with a key of nobody's, and the time for its tries again
    let t = Instant::now();
    for k in 0..n {
        let port = 1000 + (k % 60000) as u16;
        w.raw(g, &lan_frame(4, g, VHOST_VIP, port, PORT_BUDDY, SYN, k, &[]));
        let auth = crate::aries::encode_frame("AUTH", "", &fields![("LKEY", "0123456789abcdef01234567")]).unwrap();
        w.raw(g, &lan_frame(4, g, VHOST_VIP, port, PORT_BUDDY, crate::vhost::DATA, k, &auth));
        w.raw(g, &lan_frame(4, g, VHOST_VIP, port, PORT_BUDDY, RST, k, &[]));
        if k % 1000 == 999 {
            w.sleep(3500.0);
        }
    }
    w.sleep(3500.0);
    let auth = t.elapsed();
    eprintln!(
        "with 1000 sessions: a refused lobby connection {:.2} us, a Messenger login with nobody's key (and its 6 tries again) {:.2} us",
        syn.as_secs_f64() * 1e6 / n as f64,
        auth.as_secs_f64() * 1e6 / n as f64
    );
}

/// How many frames a second the host's own thread takes from the switch (the queue between them has no bound of its
/// own: what bounds it is the switch's budgets, charged before a frame is posted, 10,000 frames a second for one
/// site): four threads post the cheapest frames there are (a UDP datagram, answered "port unreachable"; a stream
/// segment for no stream, answered RST; an echo request), the host answers through a switch that only counts.
#[test]
#[ignore]
fn frame_flood() {
    use std::sync::Arc;
    use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering};

    use bytes::Bytes;
    use nfsu2_util::{FrameCtx, Host, SendResult};

    use crate::vhost::{DATA, lan_frame};
    use crate::{OnlineHost, OnlineOptions, VHOST_VIP};

    let host = OnlineHost::spawn(OnlineOptions {
        state_dir: None,
        log: Arc::new(|_: &str, _: Option<&str>| {}),
        tap: None,
        claims: None,
        deny: None,
    });
    let out = Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0));
    let o2 = out.clone();
    host.attach_switch(Arc::new(move |_, _, _| {
        o2.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
        SendResult::Sent
    }));
    let per_thread = 250_000;
    for (what, kind, op) in [("UDP", 3u8, 0u8), ("TCP for no stream", 4, DATA), ("ICMP echo", 5, 0)] {
        let before = out.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
        let t = Instant::now();
        std::thread::scope(|sc| {
            for k in 0..4u32 {
                let host = host.clone();
                sc.spawn(move || {
                    let vip = 0x0A4D_0100 + k;
                    let payload: &[u8] = if kind == 5 { &[8, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1] } else { b"x" };
                    let f = Bytes::from(lan_frame(kind, vip, VHOST_VIP, 3658, 3658, op, 1, payload));
                    let ctx =
                        FrameCtx { group: format!("client {k}").into(), site: None, cause: None, slot: None, owner: None, no_races: false };
                    for _ in 0..per_thread {
                        host.frame(vip, f.clone(), ctx.clone());
                    }
                });
            }
        });
        let posted = t.elapsed();
        let _ = host.info().blocking_recv();
        let el = t.elapsed();
        let n = 4 * per_thread;
        eprintln!(
            "{what}: {n} frames posted in {posted:?}, taken in {el:?} ({:.0} frames/s), {} answers",
            n as f64 / el.as_secs_f64(),
            out.load(Ordering::Relaxed) - before
        );
    }
    host.stop();
}

//! The online host's services, driven by fake game clients that speak the switch's frames, as the browsers' runtime
//! does.  The redirector (@dir to the lobby; no answer to @tic), the login (any name; the reply within the game's 122
//! bytes; PASS, REGKEY and PSES never kept), personas (one holder per name, the LKEY the buddy login gets), the config

use super::world::{C, Opts, World, ip};

    World::new(Opts::default())
