//! Scripted random sessions of the whole online host (a fixed seed each): six browsers (two of them one client) log
//! in, chat, make and join and start games, report races, use EA Messenger, go and come back, fall behind (the switch
//! refuses their frames) and leave; the lobby's clock moves.  After every step the lobby's counts agree with its
//! sessions (`Lobby::check_counts`), nothing panics, and the files the host writes at its stop read back to the same
//! bytes.  The script's LKEY and AUTH values are the ones the host gave (`{"lkey": conn}`, `{"ses": [conn, key]}`).

use serde_json::{Value, json};

use super::world::{C, Opts, World, ip};
use crate::aries::{Fields, V};
use crate::{PORT_BUDDY, PORT_HTTP, PORT_LOBBY, PORT_REDIRECTOR};

const T0: f64 = 1_792_411_200_000.0; // Date.UTC(2026, 9, 19, 12)

/// xorshift64*: the same session for the same seed
struct Rng(u64);

impl Rng {
    fn new(seed: u64) -> Rng {
        Rng(seed.wrapping_mul(0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15) | 1)
    }
    fn next(&mut self) -> u64 {
        self.0 ^= self.0 >> 12;
        self.0 ^= self.0 << 25;
        self.0 ^= self.0 >> 27;
        self.0.wrapping_mul(0x2545_F491_4F6C_DD1D)
    }
    fn below(&mut self, n: usize) -> usize {
        (self.next() % n as u64) as usize
    }
    fn pick<'a, T>(&mut self, xs: &'a [T]) -> &'a T {
        &xs[self.below(xs.len())]
    }
    fn chance(&mut self, p: f64) -> bool {
        (self.next() >> 11) as f64 / (1u64 << 53) as f64 <= p
    }
}

fn unhex(s: &str) -> Vec<u8> {
    (0..s.len()).step_by(2).map(|i| u8::from_str_radix(&s[i..i + 2], 16).unwrap()).collect()
}

/// a latin1 string as the script keeps one (hex of its bytes)
fn hs(s: &str) -> String {
    let mut b = Vec::new();
    crate::jsx::latin1_encode(s, &mut b);
    crate::jsx::hex(&b)
}

/// a race report for n players, the places and times from the seed
fn resu(n: usize, seed: u64) -> String {
    let mut b = vec![0u8; 8 + 55 * n];
    b[0] = 3;
    b[1] = n as u8;
    b[2] = (seed % 7) as u8;
    b[4..6].copy_from_slice(&4014u16.to_be_bytes());
    b[7] = 2;
    for i in 0..n {
        let o = 8 + 55 * i;
        b[o] = i as u8;
        b[o + 1] = ((i as u64 + seed) % n as u64) as u8 + 1;
        b[o + 2] = if (seed + i as u64).is_multiple_of(5) { 0x0c } else { 1 };
        let t = (25.0 + i as f64 * 1.5 + (seed % 7) as f64 * 10.25) as f32;
        b[o + 8..o + 12].copy_from_slice(&t.to_be_bytes());
    }
    use base64::Engine;
    base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD.encode(b)
}

pub struct Session {
    pub steps: Vec<Value>,
}

struct P {
    vip: &'static str,
    group: &'static str,
    name: &'static str,
    lobby: Option<usize>,
    buddy: Option<usize>,
}

struct Gen {
    r: Rng,
    steps: Vec<Value>,
    conns: usize,
    port: u16,
    ps: Vec<P>,
    races: Vec<(Vec<usize>, Vec<usize>, u64)>,
    games: usize,
    /// odd frames and the timers too (`generate_ext`)
    ext: bool,
}

const NAMES: [&str; 6] = ["Alpha", "Bravo", "Charlie", "Delta", "Echo", "Foxtrot"];
const TEXTS: [&str; 10] = [
    "hello",
    "two words",
    "\u{7}bell",
    "caf\u{e9} \u{ff}",
    "",
    "   ",
    "x=y \"q\" %20",
    "a\tb\nc",
    "\u{9b}\u{ad}soft",
    "long long long long long long text",
];

fn s(x: &str) -> Value {
    json!(hs(x))
}

impl Gen {
    fn step(&mut self, v: Value) {
        self.steps.push(v);
    }
    fn connect(&mut self, p: usize, dport: u16) -> usize {
        let i = self.conns;
        self.conns += 1;
        self.port += 1;
        let (vip, group) = (self.ps[p].vip, self.ps[p].group);
        self.step(json!({ "op": "connect", "vip": vip, "group": group, "port": self.port, "dport": dport, "cid": 7000 + i }));
        i
    }
    fn send(&mut self, c: usize, kind: &str, fields: Vec<(&str, Value)>) {
        let f: Vec<Value> = fields.into_iter().map(|(k, v)| json!([hs(k), v])).collect();
        self.step(json!({ "op": "send", "conn": c, "kind": hs(kind), "fields": f }));
    }
    fn login(&mut self, p: usize, persona: &str) {
        let c = self.connect(p, PORT_LOBBY);
        self.send(c, "addr", vec![("ADDR", s("10.77.0.99")), ("PORT", json!(50000 + c))]);
        self.send(c, "skey", vec![("SKEY", s("$5075626c6963204b6579"))]);
        self.send(c, "news", vec![("NAME", json!(7))]);
        self.send(c, "sele", vec![("MYGAME", json!(1)), ("STATS", json!(5000))]);
        let name = self.ps[p].name;
        self.send(c, "auth", vec![("NAME", s(name)), ("PASS", s("secret")), ("REGKEY", s("AAAA"))]);
        if persona != name {
            self.send(c, "cper", vec![("PERS", s(persona))]);
        }
        self.send(c, "pers", vec![("PERS", s(persona))]);
        self.ps[p].lobby = Some(c);
    }
    fn buddy(&mut self, p: usize) {
        let Some(l) = self.ps[p].lobby else { return };
        let c = self.connect(p, PORT_BUDDY);
        self.send(c, "AUTH", vec![("PROD", s("NFS-CONSOLE-2005")), ("LKEY", json!({ "lkey": l }))]);
        self.ps[p].buddy = Some(c);
    }
    fn some_name(&mut self) -> String {
        let n = *self.r.pick(&NAMES);
        match self.r.below(5) {
            0 => n.to_lowercase(),
            1 => format!("{n}@ea.com"),
            2 => "Nobody".into(),
            _ => n.into(),
        }
    }
    fn maybe(&mut self, f: &mut Vec<(&'static str, Value)>, k: &'static str, pool: &[Value]) {
        if self.r.chance(0.6) {
            f.push((k, self.r.pick(pool).clone()));
        }
    }

    fn lobby_message(&mut self, p: usize) {
        let Some(c) = self.ps[p].lobby else { return };
        let mut f: Vec<(&'static str, Value)> = Vec::new();
        let games = ["Race1", "Race2", "Race 3", "\u{1}"];
        let kind = *self.r.pick(&[
            "mesg", "mesg", "move", "move", "auxi", "gsea", "gsea", "gcre", "gjoi", "gjoi", "gset", "gset", "gsta", "gdel", "glea", "user",
            "onln", "snap", "snap", "rept", "lost", "sele", "news", "auth", "cper", "dper", "pers", "zzzz", "~png", "skey",
        ]);
        match kind {
            "mesg" => {
                f.push(("TEXT", s(self.r.pick(&TEXTS))));
                if self.r.chance(0.3) {
                    let n = self.some_name();
                    f.push(("PRIV", s(&n)));
                }
                self.maybe(&mut f, "ATTR", &[s(""), s("G"), s("X"), s("GGGGGGGGGGGG")]);
            }
            "move" => f.push(("NAME", s(self.r.pick(&["Lounge", "Circuit", "sprint", "URL", "nowhere", ""])))),
            "auxi" => f.push(("TEXT", s(self.r.pick(&TEXTS)))),
            "gsea" => {
                self.maybe(&mut f, "START", &[json!(0), json!(1), json!(-1), s("x")]);
                self.maybe(&mut f, "COUNT", &[json!(0), json!(2), json!(20), json!(99)]);
                self.maybe(&mut f, "CUSTFLAGS", &[json!(0), json!(0x40000f3), json!(0x100)]);
                self.maybe(&mut f, "CUSTMASK", &[json!(0), json!(0x40001f3), json!(-1)]);
                self.maybe(&mut f, "SYSFLAGS", &[json!(0), json!(1 << 18)]);
                self.maybe(&mut f, "SYSMASK", &[json!(0), json!(0xc0000)]);
            }
            "gcre" => {
                f.push(("NAME", s(self.r.pick(&games))));
                self.maybe(&mut f, "MAXSIZE", &[json!(0), json!(2), json!(4), json!(9), s("x")]);
                self.maybe(&mut f, "MINSIZE", &[json!(0), json!(3), json!(7)]);
                self.maybe(&mut f, "CUSTFLAGS", &[json!(0), json!(0x40000f3), json!(0x100), json!(4294967295u32)]);
                self.maybe(&mut f, "SYSFLAGS", &[json!(0), json!(1 << 18), json!((1 << 16) | (1 << 19)), json!(-1)]);
                self.maybe(&mut f, "PARAMS", &[s("TRACK=4014"), s("TRACK=1\nLAPS=2"), s(&"P".repeat(300))]);
            }
            "gjoi" => {
                if self.r.chance(0.7) {
                    f.push(("NAME", s(self.r.pick(&games))));
                } else {
                    f.push(("IDENT", self.r.pick(&[json!(1), json!(2), json!(3), s("x"), s("1.0")]).clone()));
                }
            }
            "gset" => {
                self.maybe(&mut f, "USERFLAGS", &[json!(0), json!(1 << 27), s("x"), json!(-1)]);
                self.maybe(&mut f, "PARAMS", &[s("TRACK=2"), s("TRACK=4014")]);
                self.maybe(&mut f, "MAXSIZE", &[json!(2), json!(6), json!(1)]);
                self.maybe(&mut f, "MINSIZE", &[json!(2), json!(5)]);
                self.maybe(&mut f, "SYSFLAGS", &[json!(0), json!(1 << 12), json!(4294967295u32)]);
                if self.r.chance(0.3) {
                    let k = format!("{}, {} ,{}", self.some_name(), self.some_name(), self.some_name());
                    f.push(("KICK", s(&k)));
                }
            }
            "user" | "onln" | "rept" => {
                let n = self.some_name();
                f.push(("PERS", s(&n)));
            }
            "snap" => {
                f.push(("INDEX", json!(self.r.below(9))));
                f.push((
                    "CHAN",
                    self.r
                        .pick(&[
                            json!(0),
                            json!(6),
                            json!(7),
                            json!(11),
                            json!(12),
                            json!(13),
                            json!(18),
                            json!(24),
                            json!(29),
                            json!(30),
                            s("x"),
                        ])
                        .clone(),
                ));
                self.maybe(&mut f, "START", &[json!(0), json!(1), json!(-1)]);
                self.maybe(&mut f, "RANGE", &[json!(0), json!(1), json!(10), json!(200)]);
                if self.r.chance(0.3) {
                    let find = self.r.pick(&["$", "$Alpha", "bravo", ""]).to_string();
                    f.push(("FIND", s(&find)));
                }
            }
            "sele" => self.maybe(&mut f, "STATS", &[json!(5000), s("x"), json!(99999), json!(-3)]),
            "news" => f.push(("NAME", json!(*self.r.pick(&[6, 7])))),
            "auth" => f.push(("NAME", s(self.ps[p].name))),
            "cper" | "dper" | "pers" => {
                let x = self.r.pick(&["Second", "Third", "x y", "Sp1cs", self.ps[p].name]).to_string();
                f.push(("PERS", s(&x)));
            }
            _ => {}
        }
        self.send(c, kind, f);
    }

    fn buddy_message(&mut self, p: usize) {
        let Some(c) = self.ps[p].buddy else { return };
        let kind = *self.r.pick(&[
            "RGET", "RADD", "RADD", "RDEL", "RADM", "RADM", "RRSP", "PADD", "PDEL", "USCH", "PSET", "PSET", "SEND", "GINV", "GRSP", "EPGT",
            "PING", "DISC", "AUTH", "ZZZZ",
        ]);
        let mut f: Vec<(&'static str, Value)> = Vec::new();
        self.maybe(&mut f, "ID", &[json!(1), json!(7), s("x")]);
        match kind {
            "RGET" => self.maybe(&mut f, "LIST", &[s("B"), s("I"), s("i"), s("x")]),
            "RADD" | "RDEL" | "RADM" | "PADD" | "PDEL" => {
                let n = self.some_name();
                f.push(("USER", s(&n)));
                self.maybe(&mut f, "LIST", &[s("B"), s("I")]);
            }
            "RRSP" => {
                let n = self.some_name();
                f.push(("USER", s(&n)));
                self.maybe(&mut f, "ANSW", &[s("Y"), s("N"), s("no"), s("FALSE"), s("0"), s("yes"), s("")]);
            }
            "USCH" => {
                f.push(("USER", s(self.r.pick(&["a", "b", "al", "zz", "", "CH", "d@x"]))));
                self.maybe(&mut f, "MAXR", &[json!(0), json!(1), json!(5), json!(30)]);
            }
            "PSET" => {
                self.maybe(&mut f, "SHOW", &[s("CHAT"), s("AWAY"), s("XA-VERY-LONG")]);
                self.maybe(&mut f, "STAT", &[s(""), s("EX=0\nP=nfs5\n")]);
                self.maybe(&mut f, "PROD", &[s("racing"), s("in the lobby"), s("\u{7}x")]);
            }
            "SEND" | "GINV" | "GRSP" => {
                let n = self.some_name();
                f.push(("USER", s(&n)));
                f.push(("BODY", s(self.r.pick(&TEXTS))));
                self.maybe(&mut f, "SUBJ", &[s("hi"), s("")]);
                self.maybe(&mut f, "TYPE", &[s("C"), s("GAMEINVITE")]);
                self.maybe(&mut f, "LKEY", &[s("x")]);
                if kind != "SEND" && self.r.chance(0.2) {
                    // a field name the server cannot pass on (its own encoder refuses it): the body as text
                    f.push(("A-B", s("bad key")));
                    let mut text = Vec::new();
                    for (k, v) in &f {
                        text.extend_from_slice(k.as_bytes());
                        text.push(b'=');
                        let v = match v {
                            Value::String(x) => V::S(latin1(&json!(x))),
                            Value::Number(n) => V::N(n.as_f64().unwrap()),
                            _ => unreachable!(),
                        };
                        crate::aries::encode_value(&v, &mut text);
                        text.push(b'\n');
                    }
                    let t = crate::jsx::latin1_decode(&text);
                    self.step(json!({ "op": "text", "conn": c, "kind": hs(kind), "text": hs(&t) }));
                    return;
                }
            }
            "AUTH" => f.push(("LKEY", json!({ "lkey": self.ps[p].lobby.unwrap_or(0) }))),
            _ => {}
        }
        self.send(c, kind, f);
    }

    fn race(&mut self) {
        let mut who: Vec<usize> = (0..self.ps.len()).filter(|p| self.ps[*p].lobby.is_some()).collect();
        if who.len() < 2 {
            return;
        }
        let n = 2 + self.r.below(2.min(who.len() - 1));
        let mut ps = Vec::new();
        for _ in 0..n {
            ps.push(who.remove(self.r.below(who.len())));
        }
        self.games += 1;
        let name = format!("R{}", self.games);
        let conns: Vec<usize> = ps.iter().map(|p| self.ps[*p].lobby.unwrap()).collect();
        self.send(conns[0], "gcre", vec![("NAME", s(&name)), ("PARAMS", s("TRACK=4014"))]);
        for c in &conns[1..] {
            self.send(*c, "gjoi", vec![("NAME", s(&name))]);
        }
        self.send(conns[0], "gsta", vec![("NAME", s(&name))]);
        let seed = self.r.next() % 1000;
        self.races.push((ps, conns, seed));
    }

    /// a friend request between two players with Messenger, answered (yes, no, or a request back)
    fn friends(&mut self) {
        let who: Vec<usize> = (0..self.ps.len()).filter(|p| self.ps[*p].buddy.is_some()).collect();
        if who.len() < 2 {
            return;
        }
        let a = *self.r.pick(&who);
        let b = *self.r.pick(&who);
        let (ca, cb) = (self.ps[a].buddy.unwrap(), self.ps[b].buddy.unwrap());
        let (na, nb) = (self.ps[a].name, self.ps[b].name);
        if self.r.chance(0.3) {
            self.send(ca, "RADD", vec![("USER", s(nb)), ("LIST", s("B"))]);
        }
        self.send(ca, "RADM", vec![("USER", s(nb)), ("ID", json!(3))]);
        match self.r.below(3) {
            0 => self.send(cb, "RADM", vec![("USER", s(na))]),
            1 => self.send(cb, "RRSP", vec![("USER", s(na)), ("ANSW", s("N"))]),
            _ => self.send(cb, "RRSP", vec![("USER", s(&na.to_lowercase())), ("ANSW", s("Y")), ("ID", json!(4))]),
        }
        if self.r.chance(0.5) {
            self.send(cb, "RGET", vec![("LIST", s("B"))]);
        }
    }

    /// a game whose creator kicks some players (the countdown's end), then starts or deletes it
    fn kick(&mut self) {
        let mut who: Vec<usize> = (0..self.ps.len()).filter(|p| self.ps[*p].lobby.is_some()).collect();
        if who.len() < 3 {
            return;
        }
        let mut ps = Vec::new();
        for _ in 0..3 {
            ps.push(who.remove(self.r.below(who.len())));
        }
        self.games += 1;
        let name = format!("K{}", self.games);
        let conns: Vec<usize> = ps.iter().map(|p| self.ps[*p].lobby.unwrap()).collect();
        self.send(conns[0], "gcre", vec![("NAME", s(&name)), ("MAXSIZE", json!(4)), ("PARAMS", s("TRACK=4011"))]);
        for c in &conns[1..] {
            self.send(*c, "gjoi", vec![("NAME", s(&name))]);
        }
        self.send(conns[1], "gset", vec![("USERFLAGS", json!(1 << 27))]);
        self.send(conns[0], "gset", vec![("SYSFLAGS", json!(1 << 12)), ("USERFLAGS", json!(1 << 27))]);
        let kicked = format!(" {} ,{}", self.ps[ps[2]].name.to_uppercase(), self.ps[ps[0]].name);
        self.send(conns[0], "gset", vec![("KICK", s(&kicked))]);
        let last = if self.r.chance(0.5) { "gsta" } else { "gdel" };
        self.send(conns[0], last, vec![]);
    }

    fn report(&mut self) {
        if self.races.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        let (ps, conns, seed) = self.races.remove(self.r.below(self.races.len()));
        for (p, old) in ps.iter().zip(&conns) {
            if self.r.chance(0.8) {
                let name = self.ps[*p].name;
                if let Some(l) = self.ps[*p].lobby {
                    self.step(json!({ "op": "fin", "conn": l }));
                }
                self.login(*p, name);
            }
            let Some(l) = self.ps[*p].lobby else { continue };
            let agree = if self.r.chance(0.85) { seed } else { seed + 1 };
            let f = vec![
                json!([hs("AUTH"), { "ses": [old, "AUTH"] }]),
                json!([hs("RESU"), { "resu": [old, agree] }]),
                json!([hs("VENUE"), hs("NFSUG2")]),
            ];
            self.step(json!({ "op": "send", "conn": l, "kind": hs("rank"), "fields": f, "names": old }));
        }
    }

    /// a whole switch frame from player p's browser: short ones, other kinds and ops, streams that are not there
    fn odd_frame(&mut self, p: usize) {
        use crate::vhost::lan_frame;
        let (vip, group) = (ip(self.ps[p].vip), self.ps[p].group);
        let host = crate::VHOST_VIP;
        let port = *self.r.pick(&[PORT_LOBBY, PORT_BUDDY, PORT_HTTP, PORT_REDIRECTOR, 9]);
        // a stream of this player's (its port and id), or one that is not
        let (sport, cid) = match self.ps[p].lobby.filter(|_| self.r.chance(0.5)) {
            Some(c) => (40000 + c as u16 + 1, 7000 + c as u32),
            None => (39999, 1),
        };
        let kind = self.r.below(10);
        let f = match kind {
            0 => unhex(self.r.pick(&["", "04", "040000000a4d0002", "04000000000000000000000000000000000000"])),
            1 => lan_frame(4, vip, host, sport, port, *self.r.pick(&[0, 2, 6, 255]), cid, b"x"),
            2 => lan_frame(4, vip, host, sport, port, crate::vhost::SYNACK, cid, &[]),
            3 => lan_frame(4, vip, host, sport, port, crate::vhost::DATA, cid, &[]),
            4 => lan_frame(4, vip, host, sport, port, crate::vhost::FIN, cid, &[]),
            5 => lan_frame(*self.r.pick(&[0, 1, 2, 6, 9]), vip, host, sport, port, 1, cid, b"abc"),
            6 => {
                let echo = unhex(self.r.pick(&["0800aabb00010002", "08", "0000aabb00010002", "0800000000000000ff"]));
                lan_frame(5, vip, host, 0, 0, 0, 0, &echo)
            }
            7 => lan_frame(3, vip, host, 3658, *self.r.pick(&[3658, 53]), *self.r.pick(&[0, 1]), 0, b"udp"),
            // a duplicate SYN of a stream that is there
            8 => lan_frame(4, vip, host, sport, PORT_LOBBY, crate::vhost::SYN, cid, &[]),
            // the middle of a message, then nothing: its stream resets
            _ => {
                let part = &crate::aries::encode_frame("mesg", "", &fields![("TEXT", "cut short")]).unwrap()[..15];
                lan_frame(4, vip, host, sport, PORT_LOBBY, crate::vhost::DATA, cid, part)
            }
        };
        self.step(json!({ "op": "frame", "vip": self.ps[p].vip, "group": group, "hex": crate::jsx::hex(&f) }));
        // (a stream left in the middle of a message always resets: what came after it would be read from the middle
        // of a message, and each side's own random values would be taken for its length)
        if kind == 9 || self.r.chance(0.3) {
            let rst = lan_frame(4, vip, host, sport, PORT_LOBBY, crate::vhost::RST, cid, &[]);
            self.step(json!({ "op": "frame", "vip": self.ps[p].vip, "group": group, "hex": crate::jsx::hex(&rst) }));
        }
    }

    /// what the timers do: streams that never say anything (the redirector's, the web pages', a Messenger that never
    /// logs in), a Messenger login before its lobby login is done (tried again), presence held back, a second lobby
    /// session of one browser, then time passes
    fn timed(&mut self, p: usize) {
        match self.r.below(6) {
            0 => {
                let port = *self.r.pick(&[PORT_REDIRECTOR, PORT_HTTP, PORT_BUDDY]);
                self.connect(p, port);
            }
            1 => {
                let c = self.connect(p, PORT_BUDDY);
                let key = self.r.pick(&["", "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef", "short"]).to_string();
                self.send(c, "AUTH", vec![("LKEY", s(&key))]);
            }
            2 => {
                if let Some(b) = self.ps[p].buddy {
                    for prod in ["a", "b", "c"] {
                        self.send(b, "PSET", vec![("SHOW", s("CHAT")), ("PROD", s(prod))]);
                    }
                }
            }
            3 => {
                // a reconnect that overlaps the old session (the old one is not closed first)
                let name = self.ps[p].name;
                self.login(p, name);
            }
            _ => {}
        }
        let ms = *self.r.pick(&[1.0, 300.0, 499.0, 500.0, 999.0, 1000.0, 1001.0, 3000.0, 5000.0, 10_000.0, 15_000.0, 30_001.0, 61_000.0]);
        self.step(json!({ "op": "sleep", "ms": ms }));
    }

    fn action(&mut self) {
        let p = self.r.below(self.ps.len());
        if self.ext && self.r.chance(0.25) {
            return if self.r.chance(0.5) { self.odd_frame(p) } else { self.timed(p) };
        }
        match self.r.below(100) {
            0..=29 => self.lobby_message(p),
            30..=54 => self.buddy_message(p),
            55..=57 => {
                if let Some(l) = self.ps[p].lobby {
                    self.step(json!({ "op": "fin", "conn": l }));
                }
                let persona = if self.r.chance(0.2) { self.r.pick(&NAMES).to_string() } else { self.ps[p].name.to_string() };
                self.login(p, &persona);
            }
            58..=64 => {
                let ms = *self.r.pick(&[0.0, 500.0, 1000.0, 5000.0, 30_000.0, 130_000.0]);
                self.step(json!({ "op": "advance", "ms": ms }));
            }
            65..=66 => {
                let vip = self.ps[p].vip;
                self.step(json!({ "op": "gone", "vip": vip }));
                self.ps[p].lobby = None;
                self.ps[p].buddy = None;
            }
            67..=68 => {
                let (vip, on) = (self.ps[p].vip, self.r.chance(0.5));
                self.step(json!({ "op": "slow", "vip": vip, "on": on }));
            }
            69..=71 => self.buddy(p),
            72..=73 => self.step(json!({ "op": "info" })),
            74..=75 => {
                let c = self.connect(p, PORT_REDIRECTOR);
                self.step(json!({ "op": "text", "conn": c, "kind": hs("@tic"), "text": hs("RC4") }));
                self.send(c, "@dir", vec![("PROD", s("nfs-pc-2005"))]);
                if self.r.chance(0.5) {
                    self.step(json!({ "op": "fin", "conn": c }));
                }
            }
            76..=77 => {
                let c = self.connect(p, PORT_HTTP);
                let req = *self.r.pick(&[
                    "GET /news HTTP/1.0\r\n\r\n",
                    "HEAD /TOS?x HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n",
                    "GET /x HTTP/1.0\r\n\r\n",
                    "BAD\r\n\r\n",
                    "GET /news",
                ]);
                self.step(json!({ "op": "raw", "conn": c, "hex": hs(req) }));
                if self.r.chance(0.5) {
                    self.step(json!({ "op": "fin", "conn": c }));
                }
            }
            78..=83 => self.race(),
            84..=86 => {
                if self.r.chance(0.5) {
                    self.friends()
                } else {
                    self.kick()
                }
            }
            87..=91 => self.report(),
            92..=94 => {
                if let Some(l) = self.ps[p].lobby {
                    let junk =
                        self.r.pick(&["61016263000000000000000d00", "6d657367000000000000000c", "6d657367000000000000ffff00"]).to_string();
                    self.step(json!({ "op": "raw", "conn": l, "hex": junk }));
                }
            }
            95..=96 => {
                if let Some(b) = self.ps[p].buddy {
                    let op = if self.r.chance(0.5) { "fin" } else { "rst" };
                    self.step(json!({ "op": op, "conn": b }));
                }
            }
            _ => {
                if let Some(l) = self.ps[p].lobby {
                    self.step(json!({ "op": "fin", "conn": l }));
                    self.ps[p].lobby = None;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

/// a session of `n` actions from `seed`
pub fn generate(seed: u64, n: usize) -> Session {
    generate_with(seed, n, false)
}

/// the same with odd switch frames and time passing on the timers' clock (`World::sleep`)
pub fn generate_ext(seed: u64, n: usize) -> Session {
    generate_with(seed, n, true)
}

fn generate_with(seed: u64, n: usize, ext: bool) -> Session {
    let vips = ["10.77.0.2", "10.77.0.3", "10.77.0.4", "10.77.0.5", "10.77.0.6", "10.77.0.7"];
    let groups = ["g2", "g3", "g4", "g5", "g6", "g6"];
    let ps = (0..6).map(|i| P { vip: vips[i], group: groups[i], name: NAMES[i], lobby: None, buddy: None }).collect();
    let mut g = Gen { r: Rng::new(seed), steps: Vec::new(), conns: 0, port: 40000, ps, races: Vec::new(), games: 0, ext };
    for (p, name) in NAMES.iter().enumerate() {
        g.login(p, name);
        g.buddy(p);
    }
    for _ in 0..n {
        g.action();
    }
    g.step(json!({ "op": "info" }));
    g.step(json!({ "op": "stop" }));
    Session { steps: g.steps }
}

fn latin1(v: &Value) -> String {
    crate::jsx::latin1_decode(&unhex(v.as_str().unwrap()))
}

/// What a session did: the frames the host sent, the lines it logged, the files its stop left (stats.json and the
/// friends lists' shelf), and the lobby's clock at the end
struct Run {
    frames: usize,
    lines: Vec<String>,
    stats: Option<String>,
    buddies: Vec<String>,
    t: f64,
}

/// the session on one online host, the lobby's counts checked after every step
fn run(s: &Session, dir: &std::path::Path) -> Run {
    let mut w = World::new(Opts { state_dir: Some(dir.to_path_buf()), ..Default::default() });
    w.t.set(T0);
    let mut conns: Vec<C> = Vec::new();
    for st in &s.steps {
        let conn = st.get("conn").and_then(Value::as_u64).map(|i| conns[i as usize]);
        let value = |w: &World, v: &Value| -> V {
            match v {
                Value::Number(n) => V::N(n.as_f64().unwrap()),
                Value::String(_) => V::S(latin1(v)),
                Value::Object(o) => {
                    let last = |i: &Value, kind: &str, k: &str| -> String {
                        w.c(conns[i.as_u64().unwrap() as usize]).last(kind).and_then(|m| m.get(k)).unwrap_or("").to_string()
                    };
                    if let Some(i) = o.get("lkey") {
                        V::S(last(i, "pers", "LKEY"))
                    } else if let Some(a) = o.get("ses") {
                        V::S(last(&a[0], "+ses", a[1].as_str().unwrap()))
                    } else if let Some(a) = o.get("resu") {
                        let n = crate::jsx::to_number(&last(&a[0], "+ses", "COUNT"));
                        let n = if w.c(conns[a[0].as_u64().unwrap() as usize]).last("+ses").is_some() { n as usize } else { 2 };
                        V::S(resu(n, a[1].as_u64().unwrap()))
                    } else {
                        panic!("a value: {v}")
                    }
                }
                _ => panic!("a value: {v}"),
            }
        };
        match st["op"].as_str().unwrap() {
            "connect" => {
                let vs = st["vip"].as_str().unwrap();
                let vip = ip(vs);
                if !w.clients.contains_key(&vip) {
                    w.client_of(vs, st["group"].as_str().unwrap());
                }
                let c = w.connect_as(
                    vip,
                    st["dport"].as_u64().unwrap() as u16,
                    st["port"].as_u64().unwrap() as u16,
                    st["cid"].as_u64().unwrap() as u32,
                );
                conns.push(c);
            }
            "send" => {
                let mut f: Fields = st["fields"].as_array().unwrap().iter().map(|p| (latin1(&p[0]).into(), value(&w, &p[1]))).collect();
                if let Some(i) = st.get("names").and_then(Value::as_u64)
                    && let Some(ses) = w.c(conns[i as usize]).last("+ses")
                {
                    let n = crate::jsx::to_number(ses.get("COUNT").unwrap_or("0")) as usize;
                    for k in 0..n {
                        f.push((format!("NAME{k}").into(), V::from(ses.get(&format!("OPPO{k}")))));
                    }
                }
                w.send(conn.unwrap(), &latin1(&st["kind"]), f);
            }
            "text" => w.send_text(conn.unwrap(), &latin1(&st["kind"]), &latin1(&st["text"])),
            "raw" => w.send_raw(conn.unwrap(), &unhex(st["hex"].as_str().unwrap())),
            "frame" => {
                let vs = st["vip"].as_str().unwrap();
                if !w.clients.contains_key(&ip(vs)) {
                    w.client_of(vs, st["group"].as_str().unwrap());
                }
                w.raw(ip(vs), &unhex(st["hex"].as_str().unwrap()));
            }
            "fin" => w.close(conn.unwrap()),
            "rst" => w.rst(conn.unwrap()),
            "advance" => w.advance(st["ms"].as_f64().unwrap()),
            "sleep" => w.sleep(st["ms"].as_f64().unwrap()),
            "gone" => w.peer_gone(ip(st["vip"].as_str().unwrap())),
            "slow" => {
                let vip = ip(st["vip"].as_str().unwrap());
                if st["on"].as_bool().unwrap() {
                    w.slow.lock().insert(vip);
                } else {
                    w.slow.lock().remove(&vip);
                }
            }
            "info" => {
                // (what /players and the console read of the host)
                let _ = (w.core.info(), w.core.vips());
            }
            "stop" => {
                w.core.stop();
                w.deliver();
            }
            op => panic!("a step: {op}"),
        }
        w.core.lobby.check_counts();
    }
    let read = |f: &str| std::fs::read_to_string(dir.join(f)).ok();
    let lines = w.lines.borrow().iter().map(|(l, _)| l.clone()).collect();
    let frames = w.sent.lock().len();
    Run { frames, lines, stats: read("stats.json"), buddies: crate::buddy::shelf_texts(dir), t: w.t.get() }
}

/// a session from its seed: consistent after every step, and its files read back as they were written
fn check(s: &Session, seed: u64) {
    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let r = run(s, tmp.path());
    let clock = std::rc::Rc::new(std::cell::Cell::new(r.t));
    let quiet: crate::LogFn = std::rc::Rc::new(|_: &str, _: Option<&str>| {});
    let dir = Some(tmp.path().to_path_buf());
    if let Some(text) = &r.stats {
        let back = crate::stats::Stats::new(crate::stats::StatsOptions::new(dir.clone(), crate::stats::tests::clocks(clock), quiet));
        assert_eq!(*text, back.serialize(), "seed {seed}: stats.json read back");
    }
    assert_eq!(r.buddies, crate::buddy::shelf_reread(tmp.path()), "seed {seed}: the friends lists read back");
    // what the session went through (each seed's share of the rules)
    let n = |p: &str| r.lines.iter().filter(|l| l.contains(p)).count();
    eprintln!(
        "session {seed}: {} steps, {} frames, {} lines; results {}, not taken {}, differs {}, friends {}, asked {}, kicked {}, \
         ended {}, dropped {}, slow {}, refused {}, races {}",
        s.steps.len(),
        r.frames,
        r.lines.len(),
        n("ranked)") + n("ranked):"),
        n("not taken"),
        n("differs"),
        n("are friends"),
        n("to be friends"),
        n("kicked out"),
        n("ended:"),
        n("dropped:"),
        n("does not keep up"),
        n("refused"),
        n("the race starts"),
    );
}

#[test]
fn random_sessions_keep_the_lobby_consistent() {
    // (NFSU2_SESSIONS=<n>: n of them; 8 by default)
    let n: u64 = std::env::var("NFSU2_SESSIONS").ok().and_then(|v| v.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(8);
    for seed in 11..11 + n {
        check(&generate(seed, 900), seed);
    }
}

//! The host on its own thread, as the server runs it: frames posted through `Host`, its answers through the
//! `SwitchSend` it was given (with the frame's budgets), info() and vips() after what was posted before them, an
//! overspent client's stream closed, stop() writing the files.

use std::sync::Arc;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

use bytes::Bytes;
use nfsu2_util::{Charge, FrameCtx, Host, SendResult};
use parking_lot::Mutex;

use super::world::ip;
use crate::aries::{FrameReader, encode_frame};
use crate::vhost::{DATA, RST, SYN, SYNACK, lan_frame};
use crate::{OnlineHost, OnlineOptions, PORT_LOBBY, VHOST_VIP};

type Line = (String, Option<String>);

/// a client's budgets: overspent once `over` is set
struct Budget {
    spent: Mutex<usize>,
    over: AtomicBool,
}
impl Charge for Budget {
    fn spend(&self, _frames: u32, bytes: usize) {
        *self.spent.lock() += bytes;
    }
    fn overspent(&self) -> bool {
        self.over.load(Ordering::Relaxed)
    }
}

fn wait_for(what: &str, f: impl Fn() -> bool) {
    let end = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(5);
    while !f() {
        assert!(Instant::now() < end, "timed out waiting for {what}");
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(5));
    }
}

#[test]
fn on_its_own_thread() {
    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let dir = tmp.path().join("online");
    let lines: Arc<Mutex<Vec<Line>>> = Arc::default();
    let l2 = lines.clone();
    let host = OnlineHost::spawn(OnlineOptions {
        state_dir: Some(dir.clone()),
        log: Arc::new(move |s: &str, k: Option<&str>| l2.lock().push((s.to_string(), k.map(str::to_string)))),
        tap: None,
        claims: None,
        deny: None,
    });
    let out: Arc<Mutex<Vec<(u32, Bytes)>>> = Arc::default();
    let o2 = out.clone();
    host.attach_switch(Arc::new(move |vip, f, cause| {
        if let Some(c) = cause {
            c.spend(1, f.len());
        }
        o2.lock().push((vip, f));
        SendResult::Sent
    }));
    let a = ip("10.77.0.2");
    let budget = Arc::new(Budget { spent: Mutex::new(0), over: AtomicBool::new(false) });
    let ctx = |b: &Arc<Budget>| FrameCtx {
        group: "client a".into(),
        site: None,
        cause: Some(b.clone() as Arc<dyn Charge>),
        slot: None,
        owner: None,
        no_races: false,
    };
    let send = |op: u8, data: &[u8]| Bytes::from(lan_frame(4, a, VHOST_VIP, 50000, PORT_LOBBY, op, 7, data));
    host.frame(a, send(SYN, &[]), ctx(&budget));
    for (kind, f) in
        [("auth", fields![("NAME", "Alpha"), ("PASS", "x")]), ("pers", fields![("PERS", "Alpha")]), ("move", fields![("NAME", "Lounge")])]
    {
        host.frame(a, send(DATA, &encode_frame(kind, "", &f).unwrap()), ctx(&budget));
    }
    let info = host.info().blocking_recv().unwrap();
    assert_eq!((info["sessions"].as_u64(), info["personas"].as_u64(), info["logins"].as_u64()), (Some(1), Some(1), Some(1)));
    assert_eq!(host.vips().blocking_recv().unwrap().into_iter().collect::<Vec<_>>(), [a]);
    assert!(*budget.spent.lock() > 0, "the answers were charged to the client");
    assert!(out.lock().iter().any(|(v, f)| *v == a && f[16] == SYNACK));
    let mut r = FrameReader::new(1 << 16);
    let kinds: Vec<String> = out.lock().iter().filter(|(_, f)| f[16] == DATA).flat_map(|(_, f)| r.push(&f[24..])).map(|m| m.kind).collect();
    assert!(kinds.contains(&"pers".to_string()) && kinds.contains(&"move".to_string()), "{kinds:?}");
    assert!(lines.lock().iter().any(|(s, k)| s.contains("logged in as \"Alpha\"") && k.as_deref() == Some("client a")));
    // the client spent more than its share on a frame: the stream it came on goes, uncharged
    budget.over.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
    host.frame(a, send(DATA, &encode_frame("mesg", "", &fields![("TEXT", "hi")]).unwrap()), ctx(&budget));
    wait_for("the stream to go", || out.lock().iter().any(|(_, f)| f[16] == RST));
    let info = host.info().blocking_recv().unwrap();
    assert_eq!((info["overrun"].as_u64(), info["sessions"].as_u64()), (Some(1), Some(0)));
    // a browser that left; the server stops: the files are there when stop() returns
    host.peer_gone(a);
    host.stop();
    assert!(!dir.join("stats.json").exists() && !dir.join("friends").exists(), "nothing to keep: no file");
}

#[test]
fn stop_writes_what_is_kept() {
    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let dir = tmp.path().join("online");
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();
    std::fs::write(dir.join("buddies.json"), r#"{"personas":[{"name":"Alpha","seen":"2025-01","B":["Bravo"]}]}"#).unwrap();
    let host = OnlineHost::spawn(OnlineOptions {
        state_dir: Some(dir.clone()),
        log: Arc::new(|_: &str, _: Option<&str>| {}),
        tap: None,
        claims: None,
        deny: None,
    });
    let out: Arc<Mutex<Vec<Bytes>>> = Arc::default();
    let o2 = out.clone();
    host.attach_switch(Arc::new(move |_, f, _| {
        o2.lock().push(f);
        SendResult::Sent
    }));
    let a = ip("10.77.0.2");
    let ctx = FrameCtx { group: "g".into(), site: None, cause: None, slot: None, owner: None, no_races: false };
    let send = |op: u8, port: u16, cid: u32, data: &[u8]| Bytes::from(lan_frame(4, a, VHOST_VIP, 50000 + cid as u16, port, op, cid, data));
    host.frame(a, send(SYN, PORT_LOBBY, 1, &[]), ctx.clone());
    host.frame(a, send(DATA, PORT_LOBBY, 1, &encode_frame("auth", "", &fields![("NAME", "Alpha")]).unwrap()), ctx.clone());
    host.frame(a, send(DATA, PORT_LOBBY, 1, &encode_frame("pers", "", &fields![("PERS", "Alpha")]).unwrap()), ctx.clone());
    let _ = host.info().blocking_recv().unwrap();
    let mut r = FrameReader::new(1 << 16);
    let msgs: Vec<_> = out.lock().iter().filter(|f| f[16] == DATA).flat_map(|f| r.push(&f[24..])).collect();
    let pers = msgs.iter().find(|m| m.kind == "pers").expect("the pers answer");
    let lkey = crate::aries::FieldMap::parse(&pers.body).get("LKEY").unwrap().to_string();
    // the Messenger login: the persona is seen this month, its list is written at the stop
    host.frame(a, send(SYN, crate::PORT_BUDDY, 2, &[]), ctx.clone());
    host.frame(a, send(DATA, crate::PORT_BUDDY, 2, &encode_frame("AUTH", "", &fields![("LKEY", lkey)]).unwrap()), ctx.clone());
    let _ = host.info().blocking_recv().unwrap();
    host.stop();
    let month = crate::jsx::month_of(nfsu2_util::now_ms() as f64);
    assert_eq!(crate::buddy::shelf_texts(&dir), [format!(r#"{{"v":4,"name":"Alpha","seen":"{month}","B":["Bravo"]}}"#)]);
}

//! The server's own host on the virtual LAN, 10.77.0.1.  TCP as runtime/web/net_lan.c speaks it (SYN -> SYNACK or RST,
//! DATA in frames of at most 1464 bytes, FIN both ways, RST, a browser that leaves), the per-browser connection limit,
//! ICMP echo answered with a correct checksum, UDP answered with "port unreachable".  (The switch carrying the online
//! host needs nfsu2-lan: the integration's.)

use std::cell::Cell;
use std::rc::Rc;
use std::sync::Arc;

use nfsu2_util::{FrameCtx, SendResult};
use parking_lot::Mutex;

use super::world::ip;
use crate::core::{Core, CoreOptions};
use crate::vhost::{DATA, FIN, Listener, RST, SYN, SYNACK, TCP_CHUNK, VhostLimits, lan_frame};
use crate::{Clocks, VHOST_VIP};

struct F {
    vip: u32,
    kind: u8,
    src: u32,
    dst: u32,
    sport: u16,
    dport: u16,
    op: u8,
    cid: u32,
    data: Vec<u8>,
}

fn parse(vip: u32, f: &[u8]) -> F {
    F {
        vip,
        kind: f[0],
        src: u32::from_be_bytes([f[4], f[5], f[6], f[7]]),
        dst: u32::from_be_bytes([f[8], f[9], f[10], f[11]]),
        sport: u16::from_be_bytes([f[12], f[13]]),
        dport: u16::from_be_bytes([f[14], f[15]]),
        op: f[16],
        cid: u32::from_le_bytes([f[20], f[21], f[22], f[23]]),
        data: f[24..].to_vec(),
    }
}

/// a virtual host on its own: no services but the tests', every frame out kept
fn host(o: VhostLimits) -> (Core, Arc<Mutex<Vec<F>>>) {
    let t = Rc::new(Cell::new(0.0));
    let t2 = t.clone();
    let mut core = Core::new(CoreOptions {
        state_dir: None,
        log: Rc::new(|_: &str, _: Option<&str>| {}),
        tap: None,
        claims: None,
        deny: None,
        clocks: Rc::new(Clocks { now: Box::new(move || t.get()), timer: Box::new(move || t2.get()) }),
        limits: Default::default(),
        buddy_limits: Default::default(),
        vhost: o,
    });
    core.vh.listeners.clear();
    let out: Arc<Mutex<Vec<F>>> = Arc::default();
    let o2 = out.clone();
    core.attach(Arc::new(move |vip, f, _| {
        o2.lock().push(parse(vip, &f));
        SendResult::Sent
    }));
    (core, out)
}

fn frame(h: &mut Core, from: u32, f: &[u8]) {
    h.frame(from, f, &FrameCtx { group: format!("vip {from}").into(), site: None, cause: None, slot: None, owner: None, no_races: false });
}

// TCP: refused, accepted, data both ways, FIN, RST, a browser that leaves
#[test]
fn tcp() {
    let (a, b) = (ip("10.77.0.2"), ip("10.77.0.3"));
    let (mut h, out) = host(VhostLimits::default());
    frame(&mut h, a, &lan_frame(4, a, VHOST_VIP, 50000, 20920, SYN, 7, &[]));
    {
        let o = out.lock();
        assert_eq!((o[0].op, o[0].dport, o[0].sport, o[0].cid), (RST, 50000, 20920, 7), "no listener: RST");
    }
    h.vh.listen(20920, Listener::Probe);
    out.lock().clear();
    frame(&mut h, a, &lan_frame(4, a, VHOST_VIP, 50001, 20920, SYN, 9, &[]));
    assert_eq!(out.lock()[0].op, SYNACK);
    let (&id, conn) = h.vh.conns.iter().next().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(conn.peer(), "10.77.0.2");
    frame(&mut h, a, &lan_frame(4, a, VHOST_VIP, 50001, 20920, SYN, 9, &[]));
    assert_eq!(out.lock().len(), 1, "a duplicate SYN is ignored");
    frame(&mut h, a, &lan_frame(4, a, VHOST_VIP, 50001, 20920, DATA, 9, b"hello"));
    assert_eq!(h.probe, ["data hello"]);
    h.conn_write(id, &vec![0x41; TCP_CHUNK * 2 + 10]);
    {
        let o = out.lock();
        let data: Vec<&F> = o.iter().filter(|f| f.op == DATA).collect();
        assert_eq!(data.iter().map(|f| f.data.len()).collect::<Vec<_>>(), [TCP_CHUNK, TCP_CHUNK, 10]);
        assert!(data.iter().all(|f| f.src == VHOST_VIP && f.dst == a && f.vip == a && f.sport == 20920 && f.dport == 50001 && f.cid == 9));
    }
    frame(&mut h, a, &lan_frame(4, a, VHOST_VIP, 50001, 20920, FIN, 9, &[]));
    assert_eq!(h.probe, ["data hello", "end", "close closed"]);
    assert_eq!(out.lock().last().unwrap().op, FIN);
    assert_eq!(h.info()["conns"], 0);
    out.lock().clear();
    frame(&mut h, a, &lan_frame(4, a, VHOST_VIP, 50001, 20920, DATA, 9, b"late"));
    assert_eq!(out.lock()[0].op, RST, "data for an unknown connection: RST");
    // the browser resets; another one leaves the switch
    frame(&mut h, a, &lan_frame(4, a, VHOST_VIP, 50002, 20920, SYN, 10, &[]));
    frame(&mut h, a, &lan_frame(4, a, VHOST_VIP, 50002, 20920, RST, 10, &[]));
    assert_eq!(h.probe.last().unwrap(), "close reset by the game");
    frame(&mut h, b, &lan_frame(4, b, VHOST_VIP, 50003, 20920, SYN, 11, &[]));
    h.peer_gone(b);
    assert_eq!(h.probe.last().unwrap(), "close the browser left");
    assert_eq!(h.info()["conns"], 0);
}

// TCP: at most `per_vip` connections per browser
#[test]
fn per_vip() {
    let (a, b) = (ip("10.77.0.2"), ip("10.77.0.3"));
    let (mut h, out) = host(VhostLimits { per_vip: 2, ..Default::default() });
    h.vh.listen(20922, Listener::Silent);
    for i in 0..3 {
        frame(&mut h, a, &lan_frame(4, a, VHOST_VIP, 50010 + i, 20922, SYN, 100 + i as u32, &[]));
    }
    assert_eq!(out.lock().iter().map(|f| f.op).collect::<Vec<_>>(), [SYNACK, SYNACK, RST]);
    frame(&mut h, b, &lan_frame(4, b, VHOST_VIP, 50020, 20922, SYN, 200, &[]));
    assert_eq!(out.lock().last().unwrap().op, SYNACK, "another browser has its own budget");
}

// ICMP echo and UDP
#[test]
fn icmp_and_udp() {
    let a = ip("10.77.0.2");
    let (mut h, out) = host(VhostLimits::default());
    let req = [8u8, 0, 0, 0, 0x12, 0x34, 0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5];
    frame(&mut h, a, &lan_frame(5, a, VHOST_VIP, 0, 0, 0, 0, &req));
    {
        let o = out.lock();
        let r = &o[0];
        assert_eq!(r.kind, 5);
        assert_eq!(r.data[0], 0);
        assert_eq!(r.data[4..], req[4..]);
        let mut sum: u32 = 0;
        let mut i = 0;
        while i + 1 < r.data.len() {
            sum += ((r.data[i] as u32) << 8) | r.data[i + 1] as u32;
            i += 2;
        }
        sum += (r.data[r.data.len() - 1] as u32) << 8;
        while sum >> 16 != 0 {
            sum = (sum & 0xffff) + (sum >> 16);
        }
        assert_eq!(sum, 0xffff, "the reply checksum is right");
    }
    frame(&mut h, a, &lan_frame(5, a, VHOST_VIP, 0, 0, 0, 0, &[0; 8]));
    assert_eq!(out.lock().len(), 1, "only echo requests are answered");
    frame(&mut h, a, &lan_frame(3, a, VHOST_VIP, 3658, 3658, 0, 0, b"x"));
    let o = out.lock();
    assert_eq!((o[1].kind, o[1].op, o[1].sport, o[1].dport), (3, 1, 3658, 3658));
}

//! The tests' `World`: one online host and its browsers, frames out routed to fake games by address (lobby.rs,
//! audit.rs and the others).  Two manual clocks: `advance` moves the lobby's `now()` and runs its tick, `sleep` moves

use std::cell::{Cell, RefCell};

use std::rc::Rc;
use std::sync::Arc;

use nfsu2_util::{FrameCtx, SendResult};
use parking_lot::Mutex;

use crate::aries::{FieldMap, Fields, FrameReader, encode_frame, encode_frame_text};
use crate::buddy::BuddyLimits;
use crate::core::{Core, CoreOptions};
use crate::lobby::Limits;
use crate::vhost::{DATA, FIN, RST, SYN, SYNACK, VhostLimits, lan_frame};
use crate::{Clocks, PORT_BUDDY, PORT_LOBBY, VHOST_VIP};

pub fn ip(s: &str) -> u32 {
    s.split('.').fold(0u32, |a, b| (a << 8) | b.parse::<u32>().unwrap())
}

/// a message a fake game got
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct M {
    pub kind: String,
    pub code: String,
    pub f: FieldMap,
}

impl M {
    pub fn get(&self, k: &str) -> Option<&str> {
        self.f.get(k)
    }
    pub fn g(&self, k: &str) -> &str {
        self.f.get(k).unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("{} has no {k}: {:?}", self.kind, self.f))
    }
}

/// one stream of a fake game
pub struct Conn {
    pub cid: u32,
    pub dport: u16,
    r: FrameReader,
    /// the bytes as they came (a test that reads a reply that is not lobby messages)
    pub raw: Vec<u8>,
    pub msgs: Vec<M>,
    pub open: bool,
    pub reset: bool,
    pub fin: bool,
    pub lkey: Option<String>,
}

impl Conn {
    pub fn last(&self, kind: &str) -> Option<&M> {
        self.msgs.iter().rev().find(|m| m.kind == kind)
    }
    pub fn l(&self, kind: &str) -> &M {
        self.last(kind).unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("no {kind} among {:?}", self.msgs.iter().map(|m| &m.kind).collect::<Vec<_>>()))
    }
    pub fn count(&self, kind: &str) -> usize {
        self.msgs.iter().filter(|m| m.kind == kind).count()
    }
    pub fn take(&mut self) -> Vec<M> {
        std::mem::take(&mut self.msgs)
    }
}

pub struct Client {
    pub group: Arc<str>,
    pub conns: HashMap<u16, Conn>,
    /// the keyphrase its page's hello named (FrameCtx::owner)
    pub owner: Option<Arc<str>>,
    /// its player races nobody (FrameCtx::no_races: the operator's race ban)
    pub no_races: bool,
}

/// a stream: its browser and its port
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct C(pub u32, pub u16);

/// the lines logged: (line, key)
pub type Lines = Rc<RefCell<Vec<(String, Option<String>)>>>;
/// frames out: (browser, frame)
type Outbox = Arc<Mutex<Vec<(u32, Vec<u8>)>>>;
/// every frame the host sent: (browser, frame, refused)
pub type Sent = Arc<Mutex<Vec<(u32, Vec<u8>, bool)>>>;

pub struct World {
    pub core: Core,
    pub t: Rc<Cell<f64>>,
    pub tt: Rc<Cell<f64>>,
    pub lines: Lines,
    outbox: Outbox,
    /// browsers the fake switch refuses frames for (Full)
    pub slow: Arc<Mutex<HashSet<u32>>>,
    /// every frame the host sent, and whether the switch refused it
    pub sent: Sent,
    pub clients: HashMap<u32, Client>,
    /// the streams of a browser's fake game that a new one replaced: they keep what they got, and get no more
    orphans: HashMap<(u32, u16), Conn>,
    /// (the load measure) frames out are dropped, not read by the fake games
    pub mute: bool,
    next_port: u16,
    next_cid: u32,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct Opts {
    pub limits: Limits,
    pub buddy: BuddyLimits,
    pub state_dir: Option<std::path::PathBuf>,
    /// the lobby's clock at the start (ms; None: 1,000,000)
    pub t0: Option<f64>,
    /// the claimed names (nfsu2-claims)
    pub claims: Option<Arc<nfsu2_claims::Claims>>,
    /// the names taken away (nfsu2-bans `rename`)
    pub deny: Option<Arc<nfsu2_names::Deny>>,
}

impl World {
    pub fn new(o: Opts) -> World {
        let t = Rc::new(Cell::new(o.t0.unwrap_or(1_000_000.0)));
        let tt = Rc::new(Cell::new(0.0));
        let lines = Rc::new(RefCell::new(Vec::new()));
        let (t2, tt2, l2) = (t.clone(), tt.clone(), lines.clone());
        let mut core = Core::new(CoreOptions {
            state_dir: o.state_dir,
            log: Rc::new(move |s: &str, k: Option<&str>| l2.borrow_mut().push((s.to_string(), k.map(str::to_string)))),
            tap: None,
            claims: o.claims,
            deny: o.deny,
            clocks: Rc::new(Clocks { now: Box::new(move || t2.get()), timer: Box::new(move || tt2.get()) }),
            limits: o.limits,
            buddy_limits: o.buddy,
            vhost: VhostLimits::default(),
        });
        let outbox: Outbox = Arc::default();
        let slow: Arc<Mutex<HashSet<u32>>> = Arc::default();
        let sent: Sent = Arc::default();
        let (ob, sl, se) = (outbox.clone(), slow.clone(), sent.clone());
        core.attach(Arc::new(move |vip, f, _| {
            let refused = sl.lock().contains(&vip);
            se.lock().push((vip, f.to_vec(), refused));
            if refused {
                return SendResult::Full;
            }
            ob.lock().push((vip, f.to_vec()));
            SendResult::Sent
        }));
        World {
            core,
            t,
            tt,
            lines,
            outbox,
            slow,
            sent,
            clients: HashMap::new(),
            orphans: HashMap::new(),
            mute: false,
            next_port: 50000,
            next_cid: 1,
        }
    }

    /// the lines logged so far
    pub fn text(&self) -> Vec<String> {
        self.lines.borrow().iter().map(|(s, _)| s.clone()).collect()
    }
    pub fn logged(&self, part: &str) -> bool {
        self.lines.borrow().iter().any(|(s, _)| s.contains(part))
    }

    /// frames the host sent: to their fake games
    pub fn deliver(&mut self) {
        let frames = std::mem::take(&mut *self.outbox.lock());
        if self.mute {
            self.sent.lock().clear();
            return;
        }
        for (vip, f) in frames {
            let Some(c) = self.clients.get_mut(&vip) else { continue };
            let port = u16::from_be_bytes([f[14], f[15]]);
            let Some(conn) = c.conns.get_mut(&port) else { continue };
            match f[16] {
                SYNACK => conn.open = true,
                RST => conn.reset = true,
                FIN => conn.fin = true,
                DATA => {
                    conn.raw.extend_from_slice(&f[24..]);
                    for m in conn.r.push(&f[24..]) {
                        let parsed = FieldMap::parse_with(&m.body, |_| false);
                        conn.msgs.push(M { kind: m.kind, code: m.code, f: parsed });
                    }
                }
                _ => {}
            }
        }
    }

    /// `w.advance(ms)`: the lobby's clock moves, its tick runs
    pub fn advance(&mut self, ms: f64) {
        self.t.set(self.t.get() + ms);
        self.core.tick();
        self.deliver();
    }

    /// real time passes (on the timer clock): the timers due run
    pub fn sleep(&mut self, ms: f64) {
        let end = self.tt.get() + ms;
        // the clock stops at each timer's time (a timer set by one counts from then, as on a real clock)
        while let Some(due) = self.core.next_due().filter(|d| *d <= end) {
            self.tt.set(due.max(self.tt.get()));
            self.core.run_due(self.tt.get());
            self.deliver();
        }
        self.tt.set(end);
    }

    /// a browser at `vip` of client `group` (the lobby tests: the browser's own address stands for its client)
    pub fn client_of(&mut self, vip: &str, group: &str) -> u32 {
        let v = ip(vip);
        if let Some(old) = self.clients.insert(v, Client { group: group.into(), conns: HashMap::new(), owner: None, no_races: false }) {
            for (port, c) in old.conns {
                self.orphans.insert((v, port), c);
            }
        }
        v
    }
    pub fn client(&mut self, vip: &str) -> u32 {
        let v = ip(vip);
        self.client_of(vip, &format!("vip {v}"))
    }

    /// the browser's page plays with this keyphrase's token (its hello's "claim") from its next connection on
    pub fn set_owner(&mut self, vip: u32, token: &str) {
        self.clients.get_mut(&vip).expect("a client").owner = nfsu2_claims::owner_of_token(token);
    }

    pub fn raw(&mut self, vip: u32, frame: &[u8]) {
        let (group, owner) = (self.clients[&vip].group.clone(), self.clients[&vip].owner.clone());
        let no_races = self.clients[&vip].no_races;
        self.core.frame(vip, frame, &FrameCtx { group, site: None, cause: None, slot: None, owner, no_races });
        self.deliver();
    }

    fn out(&mut self, c: C, op: u8, data: &[u8]) {
        let (cid, dport) = {
            let k = self.c(c);
            (k.cid, k.dport)
        };
        self.raw(c.0, &lan_frame(4, c.0, VHOST_VIP, c.1, dport, op, cid, data));
    }

    pub fn connect(&mut self, vip: u32, dport: u16) -> C {
        let (port, cid) = (self.next_port, self.next_cid);
        self.next_port += 1;
        self.next_cid += 1;
        self.connect_as(vip, dport, port, cid)
    }

    /// a stream from a given port, with a given connection id
    pub fn connect_as(&mut self, vip: u32, dport: u16, port: u16, cid: u32) -> C {
        self.clients.get_mut(&vip).expect("a client").conns.insert(
            port,
            Conn {
                cid,
                dport,
                r: FrameReader::new(1 << 16),
                raw: Vec::new(),
                msgs: Vec::new(),
                open: false,
                reset: false,
                fin: false,
                lkey: None,
            },
        );
        let c = C(vip, port);
        self.out(c, SYN, &[]);
        c
    }

    pub fn send(&mut self, c: C, kind: &str, fields: Fields) {
        let f = encode_frame(kind, "", &fields).unwrap();
        self.out(c, DATA, &f);
    }
    pub fn send_text(&mut self, c: C, kind: &str, text: &str) {
        let f = encode_frame_text(kind, "", text).unwrap();
        self.out(c, DATA, &f);
    }
    pub fn send_raw(&mut self, c: C, data: &[u8]) {
        self.out(c, DATA, data);
    }
    pub fn close(&mut self, c: C) {
        self.out(c, FIN, &[]);
    }
    pub fn rst(&mut self, c: C) {
        self.out(c, RST, &[]);
    }

    pub fn c(&self, c: C) -> &Conn {
        self.clients.get(&c.0).and_then(|x| x.conns.get(&c.1)).or_else(|| self.orphans.get(&(c.0, c.1))).expect("a stream")
    }
    pub fn cm(&mut self, c: C) -> &mut Conn {
        match self.clients.get_mut(&c.0).and_then(|x| x.conns.get_mut(&c.1)) {
            Some(k) => k,
            None => self.orphans.get_mut(&(c.0, c.1)).expect("a stream"),
        }
    }

    /// a lobby session up to a persona (what the game does from the account screen to the Online Main Menu)
    pub fn login_as(&mut self, vip: u32, name: &str, persona: &str, pass: &str) -> C {
        let c = self.connect(vip, PORT_LOBBY);
        self.send(c, "addr", fields![("ADDR", "10.77.0.99"), ("PORT", c.1)]);
        self.send(c, "skey", fields![("SKEY", "$5075626c6963204b6579")]);
        self.send(c, "news", fields![("NAME", 7)]);
        self.send(c, "sele", fields![("MYGAME", 1), ("STATS", 5000), ("ASYNC", 1), ("MESGS", 1)]);
        self.send(
            c,
            "auth",
            fields![("NAME", name), ("PASS", pass), ("REGKEY", "AAAA-BBBB-CCCC"), ("PSES", "0123456789abcdef"), ("MID", "$024e564c0002")],
        );
        if persona != name {
            self.send(c, "cper", fields![("PERS", persona)]);
        }
        self.send(c, "pers", fields![("PERS", persona), ("MID", "$024e564c0002")]);
        let lkey = self.c(c).last("pers").and_then(|m| m.get("LKEY")).map(str::to_string);
        self.cm(c).lkey = lkey;
        c
    }
    pub fn login(&mut self, vip: u32, name: &str) -> C {
        self.login_as(vip, name, name, "secret")
    }

    /// an EA Messenger connection, logged in with a lobby session's key
    pub fn buddy(&mut self, vip: u32, lkey: &str) -> C {
        let c = self.connect(vip, PORT_BUDDY);
        self.send(
            c,
            "AUTH",
            fields![("PROD", "NFS-CONSOLE-2005"), ("VERS", "0.1"), ("PRES", 20920), ("USER", "/PC/NFS-CONSOLE-2005"), ("LKEY", lkey)],
        );
        c
    }
    pub fn lkey(&self, c: C) -> String {
        self.c(c).lkey.clone().unwrap_or_default()
    }

    pub fn peer_gone(&mut self, vip: u32) {
        self.core.peer_gone(vip);
        self.deliver();
    }

    /// the lobby's sessions as (persona) for the tests that count them
    pub fn personas(&self) -> Vec<Option<String>> {
        self.core.lobby.sessions.iter().map(|s| self.core.lobby.s(*s).persona.clone()).collect()
    }
}

{"id": "AT001621", "source": "archive:A028!/nfsu2-web-public/web/server-rs/crates/online/src/timers.rs", "originalBytes": 3868, "originalSha256": "17c62f566e6c553bac11f9283638b42a1415f0052388a1b911745bace7fb5d77", "originalEncoding": "utf-8", "utf8RangeStart": 0, "utf8RangeEnd": 3868, "utf8TotalBytes": 3868}

//! The host's own timers, as a queue on the host's thread.  Each is an [`Action`] naming what to do and for which
//! session or connection (by id: the handler checks that it still exists when the timer fires).  Times are on the
//! timer clock (`Clocks::timer`: monotonic in the server, a test's own in the tests), not on the lobby's `now()`,
//! the wall clock its rules read: the timers run on real time whatever `now` says, and a test moves each on its own.

use std::cmp::Reverse;
use std::collections::{BinaryHeap, HashMap};

use crate::aries::FieldMap;
use crate::lobby::LaterKey;
use crate::vhost::ConnId;

pub type TimerId = u64;

/// what a timer does when it fires
pub enum Action {
    /// the lobby's tick, every 5 s
    LobbyTick,
    /// a game's record to the game list, or a room's population (lobby.rs `later`)
    Later(LaterKey),
    /// the redirector's 30 s for its request
    RedirectorIdle(ConnId),
    /// the web pages' 15 s for a request
    HttpIdle(ConnId),
    /// EA Messenger's 60 s for a login
    BuddyLogin(u64),
    /// EA Messenger's AUTH tried again (the lobby login may finish a moment later)
    BuddyRetry(u64, FieldMap),
    /// a presence held back to at most one a second
    Presence(u64),
    /// the messages that waited for a persona, a moment after its friends list
    BuddyMail(u64),
    /// the friends lists' debounced save
    BuddySave,
}

/// a time in ms that orders (the queue never holds a NaN)
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct At(f64);
impl PartialEq for At {
    fn eq(&self, o: &Self) -> bool {
        self.cmp(o).is_eq()
    }
}
impl Eq for At {}
impl PartialOrd for At {
    fn partial_cmp(&self, o: &Self) -> Option<std::cmp::Ordering> {
        Some(self.cmp(o))
    }
}
impl Ord for At {
    fn cmp(&self, o: &Self) -> std::cmp::Ordering {
        self.0.total_cmp(&o.0)
    }
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct Timers {
    heap: BinaryHeap<Reverse<(At, TimerId)>>,
    live: HashMap<TimerId, Action>,
    next: TimerId,
}

impl Timers {
    /// a timer: `a` at time `at`; timers of the same time fire in the order they were set
    pub fn set(&mut self, at: f64, a: Action) -> TimerId {
        self.next += 1;
        let id = self.next;
        let at = if at.is_nan() { 0.0 } else { at };
        self.heap.push(Reverse((At(at), id)));
        self.live.insert(id, a);
        id
    }
    /// a timer ends.  A cleared timer's place in the queue goes once the queue is mostly such places: a client that
    /// opens and resets streams as fast as its budget lets it leaves one a stream (the Messenger's 60 s for a login,
    /// the redirector's 30 s), each until its time.  (Each compaction follows as many clears as there are live
    /// timers: O(1) a clear, all told.)
    pub fn clear(&mut self, id: TimerId) {
        if self.live.remove(&id).is_some() && self.heap.len() > 1024 && self.heap.len() > 2 * self.live.len() {
            let live = &self.live;
            self.heap.retain(|Reverse((_, id))| live.contains_key(id));
            self.heap.shrink_to(2 * self.heap.len().max(512));
        }
    }
    /// (tests) the places in the queue, the cleared timers' among them
    #[cfg(test)]
    pub fn queued(&self) -> usize {
        self.heap.len()
    }
    /// when the next live timer is due
    pub fn next_due(&mut self) -> Option<f64> {
        while let Some(Reverse((at, id))) = self.heap.peek() {
            if self.live.contains_key(id) {
                return Some(at.0);
            }
            self.heap.pop();
        }
        None
    }
    /// the next timer due by `now`, taken off the queue
    pub fn pop_due(&mut self, now: f64) -> Option<(TimerId, Action)> {
        let due = self.next_due()?;
        if due > now {
            return None;
        }
        let Reverse((_, id)) = self.heap.pop()?;
        self.live.remove(&id).map(|a| (id, a))
    }
}

//! A test aid (server option --online-trace <file>, only with --dev): the lobby protocol's messages,
//! decoded, one line each, for the TCP streams on the lobby ports between browsers (LAN play: EA's server.dll in the
//! hosting browser, port 9900 and its redirector 10901) and to the server's own online host (vhost.rs).  The online
//! mode's reference transcripts were recorded with it.
//!
//! Off unless asked for.  Every value that could be a secret (PASS..., REGKEY, PSES, and LKEY, the key of a
//! persona's Messenger login) is written as <redacted>, without ever being decoded (aries.rs `redact_body`); the
//! addresses are virtual (10.77.x.x).  Raw frames are never written.  The file is the server user's alone (0600): it
//! holds chat and private messages.  At most MAX_STREAMS streams are followed at once, the oldest going first.
//!
//! The tap is called by the switch's threads and the online host's: it copies the frames it follows (with the time
//! it saw them) to a thread of the trace's own, which decodes and writes them.

use std::fs::OpenOptions;
use std::io::{self, BufWriter, Write};
use std::path::Path;
use std::sync::{Arc, mpsc};
use std::thread::JoinHandle;

use indexmap::IndexMap;
use nfsu2_util::{Tap, js, now_ms, vip_str};
use parking_lot::Mutex;

use crate::aries::{FrameReader, redact_body};

pub const TRACE_PORTS: [u16; 6] = [9900, 10901, 20920, 20921, 20922, 13505];
const MAX_STREAMS: usize = 256;

/// the trace's decoding and its lines, on any writer (the file, on [`LobbyTrace`]'s thread; a test's own)
pub struct TraceState<W: Write> {
    out: W,
    t0: i64,
    /// src, sport, dst, dport, cid -> the stream's messages so far, the oldest first
    pub streams: IndexMap<(u32, u16, u32, u16, u32), FrameReader>,
}

fn traced(p: u16) -> bool {
    TRACE_PORTS.contains(&p)
}

impl<W: Write> TraceState<W> {
    pub fn new(out: W, t0: i64) -> Self {
        TraceState { out, t0, streams: IndexMap::new() }
    }

    fn line(&mut self, now: i64, s: &str) {
        let _ = writeln!(self.out, "{} {s}", js::to_fixed((now - self.t0) as f64 / 1000.0, 3));
    }

    /// one switch frame (any kind; only TCP on a traced port is looked at), seen at `now`
    pub fn frame(&mut self, now: i64, data: &[u8]) {
        if data.len() < 24 || data[0] != 4 {
            return;
        }
        let src = u32::from_be_bytes([data[4], data[5], data[6], data[7]]);
        let dst = u32::from_be_bytes([data[8], data[9], data[10], data[11]]);
        let sp = u16::from_be_bytes([data[12], data[13]]);
        let dp = u16::from_be_bytes([data[14], data[15]]);
        if !traced(sp) && !traced(dp) {
            return;
        }
        let op = data[16];
        let cid = u32::from_le_bytes([data[20], data[21], data[22], data[23]]);
        let key = (src, sp, dst, dp, cid);
        let name = format!("{}:{sp} > {}:{dp}", vip_str(src), vip_str(dst));
        match op {
            1 => return self.line(now, &format!("{name} SYN")),
            2 => return self.line(now, &format!("{name} SYNACK")),
            3 | 5 => {
                self.line(now, &format!("{name} {}", if op == 3 { "RST" } else { "FIN" }));
                self.streams.shift_remove(&key);
                if op == 3 {
                    self.streams.shift_remove(&(dst, dp, src, sp, cid));
                }
                return;
            }
            4 => {}
            _ => return,
        }
        if !self.streams.contains_key(&key) {
            if self.streams.len() >= MAX_STREAMS {
                self.streams.shift_remove_index(0);
            }
            self.streams.insert(key, FrameReader::new(1 << 16));
        }
        let r = self.streams.get_mut(&key).expect("just made");
        let msgs = r.push(&data[24..]);
        let error = r.error.clone();
        for m in msgs {
            // the separator after the first field (the replies of server.dll and EA's servers differ: tabs or
            // newlines)
            let b = &m.body;
            let sep = b.iter().position(|&c| c == 0x3d).and_then(|eq| b.iter().enumerate().position(|(i, &c)| i > eq && c <= 0x20));
            let sp = match sep.map(|i| b[i]) {
                None | Some(0) => String::new(),
                Some(9) => " [tab]".into(),
                Some(10) => " [nl]".into(),
                Some(32) => " [sp]".into(),
                Some(c) => format!(" [{c}]"),
            };
            let code = if m.code.is_empty() { "0" } else { &m.code };
            let text = format!("{name} {}/{code} ({}){sp} {}", m.kind, b.len() + 12, redact_body(b));
            self.line(now, &text);
        }
        if let Some(e) = error {
            self.line(now, &format!("{name} not the lobby protocol: {e}"));
            self.streams.shift_remove(&key);
        }
    }

    pub fn flush(&mut self) {
        let _ = self.out.flush();
    }
}

enum Msg {
    Frame(i64, Vec<u8>),
    Close,
}

/// The dev trace (--online-trace): the lobby protocol's messages, decoded, secrets redacted,
/// one line each, into a file of the server user's alone; written on a thread of its own.
pub struct LobbyTrace {
    tx: mpsc::Sender<Msg>,
    thread: Mutex<Option<JoinHandle<()>>>,
}

impl LobbyTrace {
    pub fn open(file: &Path) -> io::Result<Arc<LobbyTrace>> {
        let mut o = OpenOptions::new();
        o.append(true).create(true);
        #[cfg(unix)]
        {
            use std::os::unix::fs::OpenOptionsExt;
            o.mode(0o600);
        }
        let f = o.open(file)?;
        // a file that was there already becomes the server user's alone too
        #[cfg(unix)]
        {
            use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
            let _ = std::fs::set_permissions(file, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600));
        }
        let t0 = now_ms();
        let mut st = TraceState::new(BufWriter::new(f), t0);
        st.line(t0, &format!("--- trace started {}", js::iso_string(t0)));
        st.flush();
        let (tx, rx) = mpsc::channel::<Msg>();
        let thread = std::thread::Builder::new().name("online-trace".into()).spawn(move || {
            while let Ok(m) = rx.recv() {
                let mut next = Some(m);
                // what came in a burst, then one flush
                while let Some(m) = next.take() {
                    match m {
                        Msg::Frame(t, f) => st.frame(t, &f),
                        Msg::Close => {
                            st.flush();
                            return;
                        }
                    }
                    next = rx.try_recv().ok();
                }
                st.flush();
            }
            st.flush();
        })?;
        Ok(Arc::new(LobbyTrace { tx, thread: Mutex::new(Some(thread)) }))
    }

    /// the tap the switch and the Online host are given
    pub fn tap(self: &Arc<Self>) -> Tap {
        let tx = self.tx.clone();
        Arc::new(move |data: &[u8]| {
            // what the trace would look at, copied with the time it was seen; the rest is not
            if data.len() < 24 || data[0] != 4 {
                return;
            }
            let (sp, dp) = (u16::from_be_bytes([data[12], data[13]]), u16::from_be_bytes([data[14], data[15]]));
            if !traced(sp) && !traced(dp) {
                return;
            }
            let _ = tx.send(Msg::Frame(now_ms(), data.to_vec()));
        })
    }

    /// the file is written out and closed (what was traced before this is in it)
    pub fn close(&self) {
        let _ = self.tx.send(Msg::Close);
        if let Some(t) = self.thread.lock().take() {
            let _ = t.join();
        }
    }
}

impl Drop for LobbyTrace {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        let _ = self.tx.send(Msg::Close);
    }
}
