/// a car of bench_near's: where it is, where it points, its speed and how fast it turns (each changed now and then)
struct Car {
    p: [f64; 2],
    h: f64,
    s: f64,
    w: f64,
}

/// The minimap's questions (NEARREQ, roam_game.c near_*): `players` in one room of `area` m square, `crowd` of them in
/// 300 m square in its middle (a car park everyone drives to); 30 % standing, the rest at 5 to 30 m/s (15 in the
/// crowd) turning now and then; each one's SNAP to the hub every `snap_ms`, its question every `ask_ms` for the 64
/// nearest within `radius` m.  What a question costs the hub's thread (its answer made and sent), an answer's bytes and what
/// it placed, and the thread's time a second for questions, SNAPs and ticks.
fn bench_near(what: &str, players: u32, crowd: u32, area: f64, snap_ms: f64, ask_ms: f64, radius: u16) {
    let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions { max_players: 16384, ..RoamOptions::default() });
    let mut r = Lcg(11);
    let vip = |i: u32| 0x0A4D_0100 + i;
    let mut cars: Vec<Car> = (0..players)
        .map(|i| {
            let side = if i < crowd { 300.0 } else { area };
            let fast = if i < crowd { 15.0 } else { 30.0 };
            let s = if r.unit() < 0.3 { 0.0 } else { 5.0 + r.unit() * (fast - 5.0) };
            Car { p: [r.unit() * side - side / 2.0, r.unit() * side - side / 2.0], h: r.unit() * std::f64::consts::TAU, s, w: 0.0 }
        })
        .collect();
    let hellos: Vec<Vec<u8>> =
        (0..players).map(|i| frame(vip(i), &hello_with(1000 + i, &HelloOpts { core: 9, ..Default::default() }))).collect();
    let (step, secs, warm) = (50.0, 16.0, 4.0);
    let (mut asked, mut answered, mut bytes, mut placed, mut gone, mut near) = (0u64, 0u64, 0u64, 0u64, 0u64, 0u64);
    let (mut ask_s, mut snap_s, mut tick_s, mut snaps, mut ticks) = (0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0u64, 0u64);
    let mut held: Vec<u16> = vec![0; players as usize];
    let mut req: Vec<u16> = vec![0; players as usize];
    let n = (secs * 1000.0 / step) as u64;
    for t in 0..n {
        let ms = t as f64 * step;
        let counting = ms >= warm * 1000.0;
        for c in cars.iter_mut() {
            if r.unit() < step / 4000.0 {
                c.w = if r.unit() < 0.5 { 0.0 } else { (r.unit() * 2.0 - 1.0) * 0.5 };
            }
            c.h += c.w * step / 1000.0;
            c.p[0] += c.s * c.h.cos() * step / 1000.0;
            c.p[1] += c.s * c.h.sin() * step / 1000.0;
            if c.p[0].abs() > area / 2.0 || c.p[1].abs() > area / 2.0 {
                c.h += std::f64::consts::PI;
            }
        }
        // each player's HELLO every second, SNAP every snap_ms, question every ask_ms, at a phase of its own
        let t0 = Instant::now();
        for i in 0..players {
            let phase = (i as f64 * 7.0) % 1000.0;
            if ((ms + phase) % 1000.0) < step {
                k.hub.frame(vip(i), &hellos[i as usize]);
            }
            if ((ms + phase) % snap_ms) < step {
                let c = &cars[i as usize];
                let v = [c.s * c.h.cos(), c.s * c.h.sin(), 0.0];
                k.hub.frame(vip(i), &frame(vip(i), &snap_moving(1000 + i, [c.p[0], c.p[1], 0.0], v, c.h, 2)));
                snaps += counting as u64;
            }
        }
        if counting {
            snap_s += t0.elapsed().as_secs_f64();
        }
        if t % (500.0 / step) as u64 == 0 {
            let t0 = Instant::now();
            k.hub.tick();
            if counting {
                tick_s += t0.elapsed().as_secs_f64();
                ticks += 1;
            }
        }
        k.clear();
        let mut askers = Vec::new();
        let t0 = Instant::now();
        for i in 0..players {
            let phase = (i as f64 * 13.0) % ask_ms;
            if ((ms + phase) % ask_ms) < step {
                let q = &mut req[i as usize];
                *q = q.wrapping_add(1).max(1);
                k.hub.frame(vip(i), &frame(vip(i), &nearreq(1000 + i, *q, 64, held[i as usize], radius)));
                askers.push(i);
            }
        }
        if counting {
            ask_s += t0.elapsed().as_secs_f64();
            asked += askers.len() as u64;
        }
        for (to, f) in k.sent.lock().iter() {
            let Some(m) = neard_of(f) else { continue };
            let i = to - vip(0);
            held[i as usize] = m.0;
            if counting {
                answered += 1;
                bytes += (f.len() - 16) as u64;
                placed += m.5.iter().filter(|e| e.1.is_some()).count() as u64;
                gone += m.5.iter().filter(|e| e.1.is_none()).count() as u64;
                near += m.4 as u64;
            }
        }
        k.step(step);
    }
    let a = answered.max(1) as f64;
    let span = secs - warm;
    println!(
        "{what}: a question {:.0} ns, {answered} answers of {asked}: {:.0} B each ({:.1} placed, {:.1} gone, {:.0} near); \
         a SNAP {:.0} ns, a tick {:.2} ms; the hub's thread a second: questions {:.1} ms, SNAPs and HELLOs {:.1} ms, ticks {:.1} ms; \
         answers {:.0} kB/s",
        ask_s * 1e9 / asked.max(1) as f64,
        bytes as f64 / a,
        placed as f64 / a,
        gone as f64 / a,
        near as f64 / a,
        snap_s * 1e9 / snaps.max(1) as f64,
        tick_s * 1e3 / ticks.max(1) as f64,
        ask_s * 1e3 / span,
        snap_s * 1e3 / span,
        tick_s * 1e3 / span,
        bytes as f64 / span / 1000.0
    );
}

/// The world map's questions (MAPREQ, roam_core.c rc_ask_map): `players` in one room `area` m across driving about (30 %
/// standing), `open` of them with the map open, each asking every 250 ms (roam_game.c WM_LIVE_US) for 4096 with `flags`
/// from the answer it holds (1: who is parked, and heights, in 16 datagrams at most, as a page before; 3: in 48).  What
/// a question costs the hub's thread (its answer made and sent), an answer's bytes and what it placed, the first
/// answer's (from nothing), the thread's time a second for the questions, and the bytes a second to the open maps.
fn bench_map(what: &str, players: u32, open: u32, area: f64, flags: u16) {
    let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions { max_players: 16384, ..RoamOptions::default() });
    let mut r = Lcg(13);
    let vip = |i: u32| 0x0A4D_0100 + i;
    let mut cars: Vec<Car> = (0..players)
        .map(|_| {
            let s = if r.unit() < 0.3 { 0.0 } else { 5.0 + r.unit() * 25.0 };
            Car { p: [r.unit() * area - area / 2.0, r.unit() * area - area / 2.0], h: r.unit() * std::f64::consts::TAU, s, w: 0.0 }
        })
        .collect();
    let hellos: Vec<Vec<u8>> = (0..players).map(|i| frame(vip(i), &hello(1000 + i))).collect();
    // (the maps open once everyone is in, at `opens` s; counted from `warm` s)
    let (step, secs, opens, warm, ask_ms) = (50.0, 18.0, 2.0, 6.0, 250.0);
    let (mut asked, mut answered, mut bytes, mut placed, mut gone) = (0u64, 0u64, 0u64, 0u64, 0u64);
    let (mut first_b, mut firsts, mut ask_s) = (0u64, 0u64, 0.0);
    let mut held: Vec<u16> = vec![0; open as usize];
    let mut req: Vec<u16> = vec![0; open as usize];
    let n = (secs * 1000.0 / step) as u64;
    for t in 0..n {
        let ms = t as f64 * step;
        let (counting, asking) = (ms >= warm * 1000.0, ms >= opens * 1000.0);
        for c in cars.iter_mut() {
            if r.unit() < step / 4000.0 {
                c.w = if r.unit() < 0.5 { 0.0 } else { (r.unit() * 2.0 - 1.0) * 0.5 };
            }
            c.h += c.w * step / 1000.0;
            c.p[0] += c.s * c.h.cos() * step / 1000.0;
            c.p[1] += c.s * c.h.sin() * step / 1000.0;
            if c.p[0].abs() > area / 2.0 || c.p[1].abs() > area / 2.0 {
                c.h += std::f64::consts::PI;
            }
        }
        for i in 0..players {
            let phase = (i as f64 * 7.0) % 1000.0;
            if ((ms + phase) % 1000.0) < step {
                k.hub.frame(vip(i), &hellos[i as usize]);
            }
            if ((ms + phase) % 500.0) < step {
                let c = &cars[i as usize];
                let v = [c.s * c.h.cos(), c.s * c.h.sin(), 0.0];
                k.hub.frame(vip(i), &frame(vip(i), &snap_moving(1000 + i, [c.p[0], c.p[1], 0.0], v, c.h, 2)));
            }
        }
        if t % (500.0 / step) as u64 == 0 {
            k.hub.tick();
        }
        k.clear();
        let t0 = Instant::now();
        let mut now_asked = 0;
        for i in 0..open {
            let phase = (i as f64 * 13.0) % ask_ms;
            if asking && ((ms + phase) % ask_ms) < step {
                let q = &mut req[i as usize];
                *q = q.wrapping_add(1).max(1);
                k.hub.frame(vip(i), &frame(vip(i), &mapreq_flags(1000 + i, *q, 4096, held[i as usize], flags)));
                now_asked += 1;
            }
        }
        if counting {
            ask_s += t0.elapsed().as_secs_f64();
            asked += now_asked;
        }
        // (the answers from nothing, at any time: the map as it opens; the others after the warm-up)
        for (to, f) in k.sent.lock().iter() {
            let Some(m) = mapd_of(f) else { continue };
            if m.2 + 1 == m.3 {
                held[(to - vip(0)) as usize] = m.0;
            }
            if m.1 == 0 {
                firsts += (m.2 == 0) as u64;
                first_b += (f.len() - 16) as u64;
            } else if counting {
                answered += (m.2 == 0) as u64;
                bytes += (f.len() - 16) as u64;
                placed += m.5.iter().filter(|e| e.1.is_some()).count() as u64;
                gone += m.5.iter().filter(|e| e.1.is_none()).count() as u64;
            }
        }
        k.step(step);
    }
    let a = answered.max(1) as f64;
    let span = secs - warm;
    println!(
        "{what}: the first answer {:.1} kB; then a question {:.0} µs, {answered} answers of {asked}: {:.0} B each \
         ({:.1} placed, {:.1} gone); the hub's thread {:.1} ms a second; to the open maps {:.0} kB/s, {:.2} kB/s each",
        first_b as f64 / firsts.max(1) as f64 / 1000.0,
        ask_s * 1e6 / asked.max(1) as f64,
        bytes as f64 / a,
        placed as f64 / a,
        gone as f64 / a,
        ask_s * 1e3 / span,
        bytes as f64 / span / 1000.0,
        bytes as f64 / span / 1000.0 / open as f64,
    );
}

//! `hypot` against node's own Math.hypot, bit for bit (skipped with a message without node): differences small and
//! large, a zero or two among them, and the odd ones (subnormals, the largest double, infinities, NaN).  The links
//! are the nearest pairs, and where two pairs are as near the players' order decides: a distance a bit off would
//! link other players than the Node server's hub did.

use std::io::Write;
use std::process::{Command, Stdio};

use nfsu2_roam::hypot;

/// splitmix64: the same cases on every run
struct Rng(u64);

impl Rng {
    fn next(&mut self) -> u64 {
        self.0 = self.0.wrapping_add(0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15);
        let mut z = self.0;
        z = (z ^ (z >> 30)).wrapping_mul(0xBF58_476D_1CE4_E5B9);
        z = (z ^ (z >> 27)).wrapping_mul(0x94D0_49BB_1331_11EB);
        z ^ (z >> 31)
    }
    fn unit(&mut self) -> f64 {
        (self.next() >> 11) as f64 / (1u64 << 53) as f64
    }
    fn below(&mut self, n: usize) -> usize {
        ((self.unit() * n as f64) as usize).min(n.saturating_sub(1))
    }
}

/// the cases: differences of positions as the game has them (float32), of nearby ones, tiny ones, whole numbers and
/// zeros, and every pair of the odd values
fn hypots() -> Vec<[f64; 3]> {
    let mut r = Rng(99);
    let mut v: Vec<[f64; 3]> = (0..20_000)
        .map(|_| {
            let mut s = || match r.below(5) {
                0 => r.unit() * 40000.0 - 20000.0,
                1 => r.unit() * 2.0 - 1.0,
                2 => (r.unit() - 0.5) * 1e-6,
                3 => (r.unit() * 40000.0 - 20000.0) as f32 as f64 - (r.unit() * 40000.0 - 20000.0) as f32 as f64,
                _ => {
                    if r.below(5) == 0 {
                        0.0
                    } else {
                        r.below(1000) as f64 - 500.0
                    }
                }
            };
            [s(), s(), s()]
        })
        .collect();
    let odd = [0.0, -0.0, 1e-310, 5e-324, 1e300, 1.7976931348623157e308, f64::INFINITY, f64::NEG_INFINITY, f64::NAN, 3.0, 4.0, 12.0];
    for &x in &odd {
        for &y in &odd {
            v.push([x, y, 4.0]);
            v.push([x, 3.0, y]);
        }
    }
    v
}

#[test]
fn hypot_is_math_hypot() {
    if Command::new("node").arg("--version").output().is_err() {
        println!("skipped: no node");
        return;
    }
    let hyp = hypots();
    // the doubles as they are (little-endian), three a case in, one out
    let input: Vec<u8> = hyp.iter().flatten().flat_map(|x| x.to_le_bytes()).collect();
    let script = "const c = []; process.stdin.on('data', d => c.push(d)); process.stdin.on('end', () => {\n\
        const b = Buffer.concat(c), n = b.length / 24, out = Buffer.alloc(8 * n);\n\
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) out.writeDoubleLE(Math.hypot(b.readDoubleLE(24 * i), b.readDoubleLE(24 * i + 8), b.readDoubleLE(24 * i + 16)), 8 * i);\n\
        process.stdout.write(out); });";
    let mut child = Command::new("node")
        .args(["-e", script])
        .stdin(Stdio::piped())
        .stdout(Stdio::piped())
        .stderr(Stdio::inherit())
        .spawn()
        .expect("node");
    let mut stdin = child.stdin.take().expect("stdin");
    let writer = std::thread::spawn(move || stdin.write_all(&input));
    let out = child.wait_with_output().expect("node's answer");
    writer.join().expect("writer").expect("node's input");
    assert!(out.status.success(), "node failed");
    assert_eq!(out.stdout.len(), 8 * hyp.len(), "an answer for each case");
    let bad: Vec<String> = hyp
        .iter()
        .zip(out.stdout.as_chunks::<8>().0)
        .filter_map(|(h, b)| {
            let (a, b) = (hypot(h[0], h[1], h[2]), f64::from_le_bytes(*b));
            (a.to_bits() != b.to_bits()).then(|| format!("hypot({}, {}, {}): rust {a:e}, node {b:e}", h[0], h[1], h[2]))
        })
        .collect();
    println!("hypot: {} cases, {} differ", hyp.len(), bad.len());
    assert!(bad.is_empty(), "{} of {} differ, e.g.\n{}", bad.len(), hyp.len(), bad[..bad.len().min(10)].join("\n"));
}

//! What the hub's tests share: a player's datagrams as roam_core.c lays them out, the switch's frame around them, the
//! lists out of the hub's frames, and a hub with a clock of its own.
#![allow(dead_code)]

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::Arc;

use bytes::Bytes;
use nfsu2_roam::{Hub, PeerEntry, ROAM_HUB_VIP, RoamOptions};
use parking_lot::Mutex;

/// "10.77.0.5" as a number
pub fn ip(s: &str) -> u32 {
    s.split('.').fold(0u32, |a, b| (a << 8) | b.parse::<u32>().unwrap_or(0))
}

/// roam_core's room hash (FNV-1a of the room's name, 0 for none, never 0 for one)
pub fn fnv1a(s: &str) -> u32 {
    if s.is_empty() {
        return 0;
    }
    let mut h: u32 = 0x811C_9DC5;
    for c in s.chars() {
        h ^= c as u32 & 0xff;
        h = h.wrapping_mul(0x0100_0193);
    }
    if h == 0 { 1 } else { h }
}

/// roam_core.c's rc_room_hash of an ASCII name, a Room's or a crew's (the page's players.ts roomHash is the same; both also fold
/// capitals past A to Z and Unicode's blanks, which these tests' names never have): FNV-1a of the name's
/// UTF-8 without its blanks (space, \t to \r), A to Z made small; 0 for a name of blanks only, never 0 for another
/// (`fnv1a` is the same for a name of small letters without blanks)
pub fn room_hash(s: &str) -> u32 {
    let (mut h, mut kept) = (0x811C_9DC5u32, 0);
    for b in s.bytes().filter(|&b| b != b' ' && !(b'\t'..=b'\r').contains(&b)) {
        h ^= b.to_ascii_lowercase() as u32;
        h = h.wrapping_mul(0x0100_0193);
        kept += 1;
    }
    if kept == 0 { 0 } else { h.max(1) }
}

/// a datagram: the header, the payload, the CRC
pub fn dgram(kind: u8, sender: u32, payload: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
    dgram_flags(kind, sender, 0, payload)
}

/// a datagram with these header flags
pub fn dgram_flags(kind: u8, sender: u32, flags: u16, payload: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
    let len = 16 + payload.len() + 4;
    let mut b = vec![0u8; len];
    b[..4].copy_from_slice(b"N2FR");
    b[4] = 1;
    b[5] = kind;
    b[6..8].copy_from_slice(&(len as u16).to_le_bytes());
    b[8..12].copy_from_slice(&sender.to_le_bytes());
    b[12..14].copy_from_slice(&7u16.to_le_bytes());
    b[14..16].copy_from_slice(&flags.to_le_bytes());
    b[16..16 + payload.len()].copy_from_slice(payload);
    let crc = crc32fast::hash(&b[..len - 4]);
    b[len - 4..].copy_from_slice(&crc.to_le_bytes());
    b
}

/// the HELLO flag of a player that reads crews (roam_core.h RC_HF_CREW)
pub const HF_CREW: u16 = 0x0200;
/// ...and of one that reads the hub's crew marks (roam_core.h RC_HF_HUBCREW: every core of now)
pub const HF_HUBCREW: u16 = 0x0400;
/// a crew mark's bit for a friend (roam_core.h RC_MARK_FRIEND)
pub const MARK_FRIEND: u8 = 0x80;

pub struct HelloOpts<'a> {
    pub room: u32,
    pub status: u8,
    pub name: &'a [u8],
    pub seen: &'a [u32],
    pub cfg_rev: u16,
    pub core: u16,
    /// its crews: with them the HELLO has the crew flag and ends with them (a count, the hashes); None, a HELLO of
    /// before
    pub crews: Option<&'a [u32]>,
    /// flags besides the crew flag (HF_HUBCREW)
    pub flags: u16,
    /// the links it wants (core version 10): a byte after the crews (with none, a count of 0 and the crew flag); 0
    /// none
    pub links: u8,
    /// the other player of its outrun (core version 11): its id after the links byte (that byte 0 if no links are
    /// said); 0 none
    pub duel: u32,
}

impl Default for HelloOpts<'_> {
    fn default() -> Self {
        HelloOpts { room: 0, status: 2, name: b"p", seen: &[], cfg_rev: 3, core: 9, crews: None, flags: 0, links: 0, duel: 0 }
    }
}

pub fn hello_with(sender: u32, o: &HelloOpts) -> Vec<u8> {
    let nl = o.name.len();
    let mut p = vec![0u8; 13 + nl + 1 + 4 * o.seen.len()];
    p[0..2].copy_from_slice(&o.core.to_le_bytes());
    p[2] = 1;
    p[3] = o.status;
    p[4..6].copy_from_slice(&47210u16.to_le_bytes());
    p[6..8].copy_from_slice(&o.cfg_rev.to_le_bytes());
    p[8..12].copy_from_slice(&o.room.to_le_bytes());
    p[12] = nl as u8;
    p[13..13 + nl].copy_from_slice(o.name);
    p[13 + nl] = o.seen.len() as u8;
    for (i, s) in o.seen.iter().enumerate() {
        let at = 14 + nl + 4 * i;
        p[at..at + 4].copy_from_slice(&s.to_le_bytes());
    }
    let crews = match o.crews {
        Some(c) => c,
        None if o.links > 0 || o.duel != 0 => &[],
        None => return dgram_flags(1, sender, o.flags, &p),
    };
    p.push(crews.len() as u8);
    for c in crews {
        p.extend_from_slice(&c.to_le_bytes());
    }
    if o.links > 0 || o.duel != 0 {
        p.push(o.links);
    }
    if o.duel != 0 {
        p.extend_from_slice(&o.duel.to_le_bytes());
    }
    dgram_flags(1, sender, HF_CREW | o.flags, &p)
}

pub fn hello(sender: u32) -> Vec<u8> {
    hello_with(sender, &HelloOpts::default())
}

/// a SNAP of `n` states (the newest one's position first)
pub fn snap_n(sender: u32, pos: [f64; 3], status: u8, n: u8) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut p = vec![0u8; 6 + 52 * n as usize];
    p[0] = status;
    p[4] = n;
    p[10..14].copy_from_slice(&(pos[0] as f32).to_le_bytes());
    p[14..18].copy_from_slice(&(pos[1] as f32).to_le_bytes());
    p[18..22].copy_from_slice(&(pos[2] as f32).to_le_bytes());
    // q.w (a valid quaternion)
    p[6 + 34..6 + 36].copy_from_slice(&32767i16.to_le_bytes());
    dgram(3, sender, &p)
}

pub fn snap(sender: u32, pos: [f64; 3]) -> Vec<u8> {
    snap_n(sender, pos, 2, 1)
}

/// a SNAP of one state with a velocity, a heading (radians, 0 = +x, a turn about z) and its nose `slope` up (a
/// tangent: 0.1 for 10 %)
pub fn snap_pose(sender: u32, pos: [f64; 3], v: [f64; 3], heading: f64, slope: f64, status: u8) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut d = snap_moving(sender, pos, v, heading, status);
    // the turn about z, then the nose up about the car's left (y): q = yaw * pitch
    let (sz, cz) = ((heading / 2.0).sin(), (heading / 2.0).cos());
    let (sy, cy) = ((-slope.atan() / 2.0).sin(), (-slope.atan() / 2.0).cos());
    let q = [-sz * sy, cz * sy, sz * cy, cz * cy];
    let p = &mut d[16..];
    for (k, x) in q.iter().enumerate() {
        p[34 + 2 * k..36 + 2 * k].copy_from_slice(&((x * 32767.0).round() as i16).to_le_bytes());
    }
    let len = d.len();
    let crc = crc32fast::hash(&d[..len - 4]);
    d[len - 4..].copy_from_slice(&crc.to_le_bytes());
    d
}

/// a SNAP of one state with a velocity and a heading (radians, 0 = +x, a turn about z)
pub fn snap_moving(sender: u32, pos: [f64; 3], v: [f64; 3], heading: f64, status: u8) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut d = snap_n(sender, pos, status, 1);
    let p = &mut d[16..];
    for k in 0..3 {
        p[22 + 4 * k..26 + 4 * k].copy_from_slice(&(v[k] as f32).to_le_bytes());
    }
    let (z, w) = ((heading / 2.0).sin(), (heading / 2.0).cos());
    p[34..36].copy_from_slice(&0i16.to_le_bytes());
    p[38..40].copy_from_slice(&((z * 32767.0).round() as i16).to_le_bytes());
    p[40..42].copy_from_slice(&((w * 32767.0).round() as i16).to_le_bytes());
    let len = d.len();
    let crc = crc32fast::hash(&d[..len - 4]);
    d[len - 4..].copy_from_slice(&crc.to_le_bytes());
    d
}

/// the world map's question (MAPREQ): for max players at most, what changed since its answer base (0: none)
pub fn mapreq_base(sender: u32, req: u16, max: u16, base: u16) -> Vec<u8> {
    dgram(10, sender, &[req.to_le_bytes(), max.to_le_bytes(), base.to_le_bytes()].concat())
}

/// ...with flags (1: the players parked a minute have 0x4000 in their keys)
pub fn mapreq_flags(sender: u32, req: u16, max: u16, base: u16, flags: u16) -> Vec<u8> {
    dgram(10, sender, &[req.to_le_bytes(), max.to_le_bytes(), base.to_le_bytes(), flags.to_le_bytes()].concat())
}

/// the minimap's question (NEARREQ): for max players at most within radius m, what changed since its answer base
pub fn nearreq(sender: u32, req: u16, max: u16, base: u16, radius: u16) -> Vec<u8> {
    dgram(18, sender, &[req.to_le_bytes(), max.to_le_bytes(), base.to_le_bytes(), radius.to_le_bytes()].concat())
}

/// the minimap's answer (NEARD) in a frame of the hub's, read as a MAPD's
pub fn neard_of(f: &[u8]) -> Option<Mapd> {
    if f[16 + 5] != 19 {
        return None;
    }
    let mut g = f.to_vec();
    g[16 + 5] = 17;
    mapd_of(&g)
}

/// a MAPD entry: the player's key, and where it is placed (x, y, heading, vx, vy), or None: gone
pub type MapdEntry = (u16, Option<(i16, i16, u8, i8, i8)>);
/// a MAPD datagram: (req, base, part, nparts, total, entries)
pub type Mapd = (u16, u16, u8, u8, u16, Vec<MapdEntry>);

/// the MAPD datagram in a frame of the hub's
pub fn mapd_of(f: &[u8]) -> Option<Mapd> {
    let d = &f[16..];
    if d[5] != 17 {
        return None;
    }
    let (mut o, mut e) = (25, Vec::new());
    let place = if u16::from_le_bytes([d[14], d[15]]) & 0x0800 != 0 { 11 } else { 9 }; // (with heights)
    for _ in 0..d[24] {
        let key = u16::from_le_bytes([d[o], d[o + 1]]);
        if key & 0x8000 != 0 {
            e.push((key & 0x7fff, None));
            o += 2;
        } else {
            let i = |k: usize| i16::from_le_bytes([d[o + k], d[o + k + 1]]);
            e.push((key, Some((i(2), i(4), d[o + 6], d[o + 7] as i8, d[o + 8] as i8))));
            o += place;
        }
    }
    assert_eq!(o + 4, d.len(), "MAPD entries fill the datagram");
    let u = |k: usize| u16::from_le_bytes([d[k], d[k + 1]]);
    Some((u(16), u(18), d[20], d[21], u(22), e))
}

pub fn bye(sender: u32) -> Vec<u8> {
    dgram(8, sender, &[0])
}

/// the switch's frame around a datagram (kind 1: [12..14] source port, [14..16] destination port)
pub fn frame_ports(from: u32, d: &[u8], sport: u16, dport: u16) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut f = vec![0u8; 16 + d.len()];
    f[0] = 1;
    f[4..8].copy_from_slice(&from.to_be_bytes());
    f[8..12].copy_from_slice(&ROAM_HUB_VIP.to_be_bytes());
    f[12..14].copy_from_slice(&sport.to_be_bytes());
    f[14..16].copy_from_slice(&dport.to_be_bytes());
    f[16..].copy_from_slice(d);
    f
}

pub fn frame(from: u32, d: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
    frame_ports(from, d, 47210, 47210)
}

/// the PEERS list in a frame of the hub's
pub fn peers_of(f: &[u8]) -> Vec<PeerEntry> {
    let d = &f[16..];
    (0..d[16] as usize)
        .map(|i| {
            let o = 17 + 10 * i;
            PeerEntry {
                vip: u32::from_be_bytes(d[o..o + 4].try_into().unwrap()),
                port: u16::from_le_bytes(d[o + 4..o + 6].try_into().unwrap()),
                id: u32::from_le_bytes(d[o + 6..o + 10].try_into().unwrap()),
            }
        })
        .collect()
}

/// the crew marks a PEERS list in a frame of the hub's ends in (roam_core.h RC_HF_CREW on a PEERS): the receiver's
/// crews and a mark an entry (bit c: in its crew c too); None for a list without them
pub fn crew_marks(f: &[u8]) -> Option<(Vec<u32>, Vec<u8>)> {
    let d = &f[16..];
    if u16::from_le_bytes([d[14], d[15]]) & HF_CREW == 0 {
        return None;
    }
    let n = d[16] as usize;
    let o = 17 + 10 * n;
    let k = d[o] as usize;
    let mine = (0..k).map(|c| u32::from_le_bytes(d[o + 1 + 4 * c..o + 5 + 4 * c].try_into().unwrap())).collect();
    Some((mine, d[o + 1 + 4 * k..o + 1 + 4 * k + n].to_vec()))
}

/// the PEERS lists out of the hub's frames to the browsers, by `vip:port`, without the players who only get the
/// receiver's car (one-way links, roam_core.h RC_MARK_TXONLY): the ones whose cars the receiver gets
pub fn lists_in(sent: &[(u32, Bytes)]) -> HashMap<String, Vec<PeerEntry>> {
    sent.iter()
        .map(|(vip, f)| {
            let marks = crew_marks(f).map(|m| m.1);
            let list = peers_of(f).into_iter().enumerate().filter(|(i, _)| marks.as_ref().is_none_or(|m| m[*i] & 0x40 == 0)).map(|e| e.1);
            (format!("{vip}:{}", u16::from_be_bytes([f[14], f[15]])), list.collect())
        })
        .collect()
}

/// the PEERS lists out of the hub's frames to the browsers, by `vip:port`
pub fn lists(sent: &[(u32, Bytes)]) -> HashMap<String, Vec<PeerEntry>> {
    sent.iter().map(|(vip, f)| (format!("{vip}:{}", u16::from_be_bytes([f[14], f[15]])), peers_of(f))).collect()
}

/// a hub with a clock of its own (1,000,000 ms at the start), an idle server unless a test says otherwise (the tests
/// tick back to back: a real measure would look busy), every list sent
pub struct Kit {
    pub hub: Hub,
    pub sent: Arc<Mutex<Vec<(u32, Bytes)>>>,
    pub t: Arc<Mutex<f64>>,
    pub busy: Arc<Mutex<f64>>,
    pub lines: Arc<Mutex<Vec<String>>>,
}

impl Kit {
    pub fn new(o: RoamOptions) -> Kit {
        let sent = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Vec::new()));
        let t = Arc::new(Mutex::new(1_000_000.0));
        let busy = Arc::new(Mutex::new(0.0));
        let lines = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Vec::new()));
        let (s, tt, b, l) = (sent.clone(), t.clone(), busy.clone(), lines.clone());
        let hub = Hub::new(
            o,
            Box::new(move || *tt.lock()),
            Box::new(move || *b.lock()),
            Box::new(move |line: &str| l.lock().push(line.to_string())),
            Box::new(move |vip, f| {
                s.lock().push((vip, f));
                true
            }),
            0xB0B,
        );
        Kit { hub, sent, t, busy, lines }
    }
    pub fn step(&self, ms: f64) {
        *self.t.lock() += ms;
    }
    pub fn lists(&self) -> HashMap<String, Vec<PeerEntry>> {
        lists(&self.sent.lock())
    }
    pub fn lists_in(&self) -> HashMap<String, Vec<PeerEntry>> {
        lists_in(&self.sent.lock())
    }
    pub fn clear(&self) {
        self.sent.lock().clear();
    }
    /// a datagram from browser `vip` (port 47210)
    pub fn from(&mut self, vip: u32, d: &[u8]) {
        self.hub.frame(vip, &frame(vip, d));
    }
    pub fn info(&self, k: &str) -> f64 {
        self.hub.info()[k].as_f64().unwrap_or(f64::NAN)
    }
}

/// the links of a room: every pair weighed (a room of at most exactRoom players), or the grid's nearest (a larger one);
/// without view points (the tests' cars point along x: theirs are roam_ahead.rs's), so by the distances (and speeds)
pub fn ways() -> [(&'static str, RoamOptions); 2] {
    let o = RoamOptions { view_m: 1e-9, ..RoamOptions::default() };
    [("every pair", o.clone()), ("the grid", RoamOptions { exact_room: 1, ..o })]
}

/// browser i's address: 10.77.0.(10 + i)
#[allow(non_snake_case)]
pub fn V(i: u32) -> u32 {
    ip(&format!("10.77.0.{}", 10 + i))
}

//! Roads above roads, simulated: free roam's links from the hub and the cars the game shows for them, on a map with a
//! highway 10 m over a street (a meet on each, one straight over the other), a hill of 45 m, and cars hopping over
//! bumps (up to 8 m), with and without the hub's rule for gaps in height (RoamOptions level_*).  Not a test: run it in
//! release,
//!   web/server-rs/cargo.sh roam test --release -p nfsu2-roam --test levels -- --ignored --nocapture
//!
//! Each SNAP has the car's nose on the slope of the ground where it points.  The game is popin.rs's model (slots, handshake, load, the hub's grace, the game's own rank in x and y, as roam_game.c
//! has it).  Measured for each kind of player (driving the highway, driving the streets, parked at the highway's meet,
//! parked at the street's meet under it): of the cars in sight in front of a driver (within 250 m, 40 degrees) and of
//! the ones around anyone (within 100 m), how many show, where a car on the other level within 60 m across is out of
//! sight (the deck is in the way); how many of the cars shown are out of sight; cars in sight that show within 100 m
//! (pop-ins) and that go while within 100 m (pop-outs), a minute a player; and the links made a second a player.

mod kit;

use std::collections::HashMap;

use kit::*;
use nfsu2_roam::RoamOptions;

struct Lcg(u64);

impl Lcg {
    fn unit(&mut self) -> f64 {
        self.0 = self.0.wrapping_mul(6364136223846793005).wrapping_add(1442695040888963407);
        (self.0 >> 11) as f64 / (1u64 << 53) as f64
    }
}

/// the simulation's step (s)
const STEP: f64 = 0.1;
/// from a list to a peer (s), from a slot to the car shown (s), roam_core.c T_HUB_GRACE (s)
const HANDSHAKE: f64 = 0.4;
const LOAD: f64 = 1.0;
const GRACE: f64 = 2.5;
/// "in front": this near, and within 40 degrees of where the car drives; "around": this near
const FRONT_M: f64 = 250.0;
const FRONT_COS: f64 = 0.766;
const NEAR_M: f64 = 100.0;
/// out of sight: on the other level, and within this across
const HIDE_M: f64 = 60.0;
/// the map: x and y within HALF; the highway along y = 0, DECK m up, its lanes at y = +-5; streets every 100 m
const HALF: f64 = 800.0;
const DECK: f64 = 10.0;
const BLOCK: f64 = 100.0;
const G: f64 = 9.81;

/// the ground's height: flat, but for a hill of 45 m around (450, 450) (up to 15 % steep)
fn ground(x: f64, y: f64) -> f64 {
    45.0 * (-((x - 450.0).powi(2) + (y - 450.0).powi(2)) / (250.0f64 * 250.0)).exp()
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum Kind {
    Highway,
    Street,
    HighwayMeet,
    StreetMeet,
    Shop,
}

const KINDS: [(&str, Kind); 4] =
    [("highway", Kind::Highway), ("streets", Kind::Street), ("highway meet", Kind::HighwayMeet), ("street meet", Kind::StreetMeet)];

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct Car {
    kind: Kind,
    p: [f64; 3],
    v: [f64; 3],
    /// where it points (radians)
    h: f64,
    /// on the streets: along x (0) or y (1), which way (1, -1), how fast; on the highway: which way, how fast
    axis: usize,
    dir: f64,
    speed: f64,
    /// a hop over a bump: since when, and its speed up at the start (0: none)
    hop_at: f64,
    hop_v: f64,
    status: u8,
    next_snap: f64,
}

impl Car {
    fn deck(&self) -> bool {
        matches!(self.kind, Kind::Highway | Kind::HighwayMeet)
    }
    fn drives(&self) -> bool {
        self.status == 2 && (self.v[0] * self.v[0] + self.v[1] * self.v[1]) > 100.0
    }
}

/// across (x and y) between two cars, and whether the one is out of the other's sight
fn across(a: &Car, b: &Car) -> f64 {
    ((a.p[0] - b.p[0]).powi(2) + (a.p[1] - b.p[1]).powi(2)).sqrt()
}
fn hidden(a: &Car, b: &Car) -> bool {
    a.deck() != b.deck() && across(a, b) < HIDE_M
}

/// a peer in a player's game
struct Peer {
    listed: f64,
    first: f64,
    slot: Option<f64>,
    shown: bool,
}

/// the game's rank for its slots (roam_game.c PeerView.rank: x and y only)
fn rank(a: &Car, b: &Car) -> f64 {
    let (dx, dy) = (b.p[0] - a.p[0], b.p[1] - a.p[1]);
    let (ux, uy) = (b.v[0] - a.v[0], b.v[1] - a.v[1]);
    let at = |t: f64| ((dx + ux * t).powi(2) + (dy + uy * t).powi(2)).sqrt();
    let (sx, sy) = (dx + ux - a.h.cos() * 150.0, dy + uy - a.h.sin() * 150.0);
    let view = if a.status == 2 { (sx * sx + sy * sy).sqrt() } else { f64::INFINITY };
    at(1.0).min(at(4.0)).min(view)
}

struct Scene {
    name: &'static str,
    highway: usize,
    street: usize,
    meets: usize,
    shops: usize,
    /// the links (and the game's slots) each player has
    links: usize,
}

#[derive(Default, Clone)]
struct Tally {
    front: u64,
    front_shown: u64,
    around: u64,
    around_shown: u64,
    shown: u64,
    shown_hidden: u64,
    pops: u64,
    outs: u64,
    hop_outs: u64,
    minutes: f64,
}

fn run(scene: &Scene, way: &str, o: &RoamOptions) {
    let mut r = Lcg(1234);
    let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions { max_players: 8192, ..o.clone() });
    let vip = |i: usize| 0x0A4D_0100 + i as u32;
    let line = |r: &mut Lcg| ((r.unit() * 2.0 - 1.0) * (HALF / BLOCK - 1.0)).round() * BLOCK;
    let mut cars: Vec<Car> = Vec::new();
    let blank = Car {
        kind: Kind::Street,
        p: [0.0; 3],
        v: [0.0; 3],
        h: 0.0,
        axis: 0,
        dir: 1.0,
        speed: 0.0,
        hop_at: 0.0,
        hop_v: 0.0,
        status: 2,
        next_snap: 0.0,
    };
    for _ in 0..scene.highway {
        let dir = if r.unit() < 0.5 { 1.0 } else { -1.0 };
        let x = (r.unit() * 2.0 - 1.0) * (HALF - 30.0);
        cars.push(Car { kind: Kind::Highway, p: [x, 5.0 * dir, DECK], dir, speed: 30.0 + r.unit() * 20.0, ..blank });
    }
    for _ in 0..scene.street {
        let axis = (r.unit() < 0.5) as usize;
        let mut p = [0.0; 3];
        p[axis] = (r.unit() * 2.0 - 1.0) * HALF;
        p[1 - axis] = line(&mut r);
        let dir = if r.unit() < 0.5 { 1.0 } else { -1.0 };
        cars.push(Car { kind: Kind::Street, p, axis, dir, speed: 10.0 + r.unit() * 15.0, ..blank });
    }
    // the meets: one on the highway's deck, one on the street under it (when there is a highway), each 120 by 18 m
    for kind in [Kind::HighwayMeet, Kind::StreetMeet] {
        if kind == Kind::HighwayMeet && scene.highway == 0 {
            continue;
        }
        for _ in 0..scene.meets {
            let p = [(r.unit() - 0.5) * 120.0, (r.unit() - 0.5) * 18.0, if kind == Kind::HighwayMeet { DECK } else { 0.0 }];
            cars.push(Car { kind, p, h: r.unit() * std::f64::consts::TAU, ..blank });
        }
    }
    for _ in 0..scene.shops {
        let p = [line(&mut r), (r.unit() * 2.0 - 1.0) * HALF, 0.0];
        cars.push(Car { kind: Kind::Shop, p, status: 4, ..blank });
    }
    let n = cars.len();
    for c in cars.iter_mut() {
        c.next_snap = r.unit() * 0.5;
        if !c.deck() {
            c.p[2] += ground(c.p[0], c.p[1]);
        }
    }
    for i in 0..n {
        k.from(vip(i), &hello_with(1000 + i as u32, &HelloOpts { core: 10, links: scene.links as u8, ..Default::default() }));
    }
    let mut games: Vec<HashMap<usize, Peer>> = (0..n).map(|_| HashMap::new()).collect();
    let mut last_list = vec![f64::NEG_INFINITY; n];
    let (warm, end) = (30.0, 150.0);
    let mut tally: Vec<Tally> = vec![Tally::default(); KINDS.len()];
    let class = |c: &Car| KINDS.iter().position(|e| e.1 == c.kind);
    let mut links_made = 0u64;
    let (mut next_tick, mut t, mut step_no) = (0.0, 0.0, 0u64);
    while t < end {
        for c in cars.iter_mut() {
            match c.kind {
                Kind::Highway => {
                    c.p[0] += c.dir * c.speed * STEP;
                    if c.p[0].abs() > HALF - 20.0 {
                        c.dir = -c.dir;
                        c.p[1] = 5.0 * c.dir;
                    }
                    c.v = [c.dir * c.speed, 0.0, 0.0];
                }
                Kind::Street => {
                    let a = c.axis;
                    let old = c.p[a];
                    c.p[a] += c.dir * c.speed * STEP;
                    // a crossing passed: on, or a turn
                    let (b0, b1) = ((old / BLOCK).floor(), (c.p[a] / BLOCK).floor());
                    if b0 != b1 && r.unit() < 0.5 {
                        c.p[a] = b0.max(b1) * BLOCK;
                        c.axis = 1 - a;
                        c.dir = if r.unit() < 0.5 { 1.0 } else { -1.0 };
                    }
                    if c.p[c.axis].abs() > HALF {
                        c.p[c.axis] = c.p[c.axis].signum() * HALF;
                        c.dir = -c.dir;
                    }
                    let mut v = [0.0; 3];
                    v[c.axis] = c.dir * c.speed;
                    // over a bump now and then: up to 8 m, most of them low
                    if c.hop_v == 0.0 && r.unit() < STEP / 20.0 {
                        let apex = 1.0 + 7.0 * r.unit().powi(2);
                        c.hop_v = (2.0 * G * apex).sqrt();
                        c.hop_at = t;
                    }
                    let mut up = 0.0;
                    if c.hop_v > 0.0 {
                        let s = t - c.hop_at;
                        up = c.hop_v * s - G / 2.0 * s * s;
                        if up < 0.0 {
                            (up, c.hop_v) = (0.0, 0.0);
                        }
                    }
                    // its speed up or down: the hill's and the hop's
                    let z = ground(c.p[0], c.p[1]) + up;
                    v[2] = (z - c.p[2]) / STEP;
                    c.p[2] = z;
                    c.v = v;
                }
                _ => {}
            }
            if c.drives() {
                c.h = c.v[1].atan2(c.v[0]);
            }
        }
        for (i, c) in cars.iter_mut().enumerate() {
            if t >= c.next_snap {
                c.next_snap += 0.5;
                // its nose: the ground's slope where it points (on the highway, flat)
                let slope = if c.deck() { 0.0 } else { ground(c.p[0] + c.h.cos(), c.p[1] + c.h.sin()) - ground(c.p[0], c.p[1]) };
                k.from(vip(i), &snap_pose(1000 + i as u32, c.p, c.v, c.h, slope, c.status));
            }
        }
        if t >= next_tick {
            next_tick += o.tick_ms as f64 / 1000.0;
            k.clear();
            k.hub.tick();
            for (key, list) in k.lists() {
                let me = (key.split(':').next().unwrap().parse::<u32>().unwrap() - vip(0)) as usize;
                last_list[me] = t;
                for e in list {
                    let q = (e.vip - vip(0)) as usize;
                    let p = games[me].entry(q).or_insert_with(|| {
                        if t >= warm {
                            links_made += 1;
                        }
                        Peer { listed: t, first: t, slot: None, shown: false }
                    });
                    p.listed = t;
                }
            }
        }
        // each game: peers gone, slots (popin.rs's way: a peer the hub left out gives its slot to one it lists, else
        // the farthest shown gives way to a much nearer one), cars shown
        let measure = t >= warm;
        for me in 0..n {
            let a = cars[me];
            let ll = last_list[me];
            let g = &mut games[me];
            let mut gone = Vec::new();
            g.retain(|&q, p| {
                let keep = t - p.listed <= GRACE;
                if !keep && p.shown {
                    gone.push(q);
                }
                keep
            });
            let mut used = g.values().filter(|p| p.slot.is_some()).count();
            let mut cands: Vec<(f64, usize)> = g
                .iter()
                .filter(|(q, p)| p.slot.is_none() && cars[**q].status == 2 && t >= p.first + HANDSHAKE && p.listed == ll)
                .map(|(&q, _)| (rank(&a, &cars[q]), q))
                .collect();
            cands.sort_by(|x, y| x.0.total_cmp(&y.0).then(x.1.cmp(&y.1)));
            for (d, q) in cands {
                if used < scene.links {
                    g.get_mut(&q).unwrap().slot = Some(t);
                    used += 1;
                    continue;
                }
                let mut out: Option<(f64, usize)> = None;
                for (&j, p) in g.iter() {
                    if p.slot.is_some() && p.listed != ll {
                        let dj = rank(&a, &cars[j]);
                        if out.is_none_or(|(f, _)| dj > f) {
                            out = Some((dj, j));
                        }
                    }
                }
                if out.is_none() {
                    let mut far: Option<(f64, usize)> = None;
                    for (&j, p) in g.iter() {
                        if p.slot.is_some() {
                            let dj = rank(&a, &cars[j]);
                            if far.is_none_or(|(f, _)| dj > f) {
                                far = Some((dj, j));
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    out = far.filter(|&(f, _)| d < f * 0.6 && f - d > 50.0);
                }
                let Some((_, j)) = out else { break };
                let pj = g.get_mut(&j).unwrap();
                pj.slot = None;
                if pj.shown {
                    pj.shown = false;
                    gone.push(j);
                }
                g.get_mut(&q).unwrap().slot = Some(t);
            }
            let Some(ci) = class(&a) else { continue };
            for (&q, p) in g.iter_mut() {
                let now = p.slot.is_some_and(|s| t >= s + LOAD);
                if now && !p.shown && measure && a.status == 2 {
                    let b = &cars[q];
                    if !hidden(&a, b) && across(&a, b) < NEAR_M {
                        tally[ci].pops += 1;
                    }
                }
                p.shown = now;
            }
            if measure && a.status == 2 {
                for q in gone {
                    let b = &cars[q];
                    if b.status == 2 && !hidden(&a, b) && across(&a, b) < NEAR_M {
                        tally[ci].outs += 1;
                        tally[ci].hop_outs += (b.hop_v > 0.0) as u64;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        // what the players see, every half second
        if measure && step_no % 5 == 0 {
            for me in 0..n {
                let a = cars[me];
                let Some(ci) = class(&a) else { continue };
                let tl = &mut tally[ci];
                tl.minutes += 0.5 / 60.0;
                let (fx, fy) = (a.h.cos(), a.h.sin());
                for (q, b) in cars.iter().enumerate() {
                    if q == me || b.status != 2 {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let shown = games[me].get(&q).is_some_and(|p| p.shown);
                    let hide = hidden(&a, b);
                    tl.shown += shown as u64;
                    tl.shown_hidden += (shown && hide) as u64;
                    let d = across(&a, b);
                    if hide || d == 0.0 || d > FRONT_M {
                        continue;
                    }
                    if d < NEAR_M {
                        tl.around += 1;
                        tl.around_shown += shown as u64;
                    }
                    let cos = ((b.p[0] - a.p[0]) * fx + (b.p[1] - a.p[1]) * fy) / d;
                    if a.drives() && cos > FRONT_COS {
                        tl.front += 1;
                        tl.front_shown += shown as u64;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        k.step(STEP * 1000.0);
        t += STEP;
        step_no += 1;
    }
    let pc = |a: u64, b: u64| if b == 0 { f64::NAN } else { 100.0 * a as f64 / b as f64 };
    for (ci, (name, _)) in KINDS.iter().enumerate() {
        let tl = &tally[ci];
        if tl.minutes == 0.0 {
            continue;
        }
        println!(
            "{:<8} {:<18} {:<13} in front {:>5.1} %, around {:>5.1} %, shown out of sight {:>5.1} %, pop-ins {:>5.2}/min, \
             pop-outs {:>5.2}/min ({:.2} hopping)",
            scene.name,
            way,
            name,
            pc(tl.front_shown, tl.front),
            pc(tl.around_shown, tl.around),
            pc(tl.shown_hidden, tl.shown),
            tl.pops as f64 / tl.minutes,
            tl.outs as f64 / tl.minutes,
            tl.hop_outs as f64 / tl.minutes,
        );
    }
    println!("{:<8} {:<18} links {:.2}/s a player", scene.name, way, links_made as f64 / (n as f64 * (end - warm)));
}

/// the hub's ways compared: without the rule (a gap counts as it is), the rule as it is, and with other numbers
fn ways() -> Vec<(&'static str, RoamOptions)> {
    let d = RoamOptions::default();
    vec![
        ("no rule", RoamOptions { level_k: 1e-9, ..d.clone() }),
        ("rule", d.clone()),
        ("rule, k 10", RoamOptions { level_k: 10.0, ..d.clone() }),
        ("rule, k 50", RoamOptions { level_k: 50.0, ..d.clone() }),
        ("rule, slack 3", RoamOptions { level_slack_m: 3.0, ..d.clone() }),
        ("rule, grade 0.3", RoamOptions { level_grade: 0.3, ..d.clone() }),
    ]
}

#[test]
#[ignore]
fn levels() {
    let scenes = [
        Scene { name: "highway", highway: 300, street: 600, meets: 60, shops: 60, links: 32 },
        Scene { name: "city", highway: 0, street: 900, meets: 60, shops: 60, links: 32 },
        Scene { name: "phones", highway: 300, street: 600, meets: 60, shops: 60, links: 16 },
    ];
    let only = std::env::var("LEVELS_WAYS").ok().filter(|w| !w.is_empty());
    for s in &scenes {
        for (name, o) in ways() {
            if only.as_deref().is_some_and(|w| !w.split(',').any(|x| x == name)) {
                continue;
            }
            run(s, name, &o);
        }
    }
}

//! A car meet: free roam's links from the hub and the cars the games show for them, simulated, so that the hub's
//! options (and the games' way with their slots) can be compared where many players stand together and more drive
//! by.  Not a test: run it in release,
//!   web/server-rs/cargo.sh roam test --release -p nfsu2-roam --test meet -- --ignored --nocapture
//!
//! The players: about 90 at the meet, each one now parked at a spot of it (8 to 60 m from its middle, pointing any
//! way) for 1.5 to 6 minutes, now driving by on straight lines through and past it (up to 200 m off its middle, 15 to
//! 35 m/s), and now driving in to a spot or off from one; at a time about 50 stand and 40 drive.  Around them a city
//! of 300 players (3 km a side: some driving, some parked, some in a shop), and 6 who jump: 40 s far off, then 40 s
//! at a spot of the meet.  Each sends the hub a SNAP twice a second, each game asks for 64 links (core version 14),
//! and each game is a model of roam_game.c's 64 slots (`assign`): a peer listed is shown after the handshake and its
//! car loaded, the car loader serving one load after another, two queued at most; a slot of a peer gone is parked
//! with its look, for that peer again or another's look.
//!
//! Measured: for the players parked at the meet (20 s and more), how many cars show, how many of their 64 nearest
//! (by plain distance) show, how many cars a minute they load, and how many go while still within 60 m (a car that
//! vanishes in front of them); for the ones who jump in, how long until 90 % of what can show shows.

mod kit;

use std::collections::HashMap;

use kit::*;
use nfsu2_roam::RoamOptions;

struct Lcg(u64);

impl Lcg {
    fn unit(&mut self) -> f64 {
        self.0 = self.0.wrapping_mul(6364136223846793005).wrapping_add(1442695040888963407);
        (self.0 >> 11) as f64 / (1u64 << 53) as f64
    }
    fn range(&mut self, a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
        a + (b - a) * self.unit()
    }
}

/// the simulation's step (s)
const STEP: f64 = 0.1;
/// the game's slots (roam_game.c NSLOT) and the links it asks for
const SLOTS: usize = 64;
/// from a list to a peer: the list on its way and HELLOs both ways through the switch, and the car's record (s)
const HANDSHAKE: f64 = 0.5;
/// roam_core.c T_HUB_GRACE (s)
const GRACE: f64 = 2.5;
/// roam_game.c LOADS_AHEAD
const LOADS_AHEAD: usize = 2;
/// "near" for a car that goes: one that goes this near is one that vanished in front of the player
const NEAR_M: f64 = 60.0;
/// how many players: at the meet, in the city round it (side m a side), and the ones who jump in
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct Scene {
    name: &'static str,
    meet: usize,
    city: usize,
    side: f64,
    jump: usize,
    /// the players' links as live (most at a computer's 32, phones 16, tablets 24, some 48 or 64); the ones measured
    /// (every 4th of the meet's, and the jumpers) at 64 all the same
    mix: bool,
    /// the links of the ones measured (64; with mix: 16 a phone's, 32 a computer's default)
    watch_links: u8,
    /// a meet as players hold one: the parked ones now and then do a donut or move to another spot, go into a shop or
    /// pause for a while, and some drivers circle the meet (FIDGET_S, LOOPERS)
    real: bool,
}
/// in a real meet (`Scene::real`): a parked player's next donut, move or stop comes this often (s, on average), and
/// this share of the drivers circle the meet instead of driving through
const FIDGET_S: f64 = 25.0;
const LOOPERS: f64 = 0.35;
const JUMP_N: usize = 6;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
enum Doing {
    /// at a spot of the meet until then
    Parked { until: f64 },
    /// along a leg: from a to b at speed s, from t0; then (park: at b)
    Leg { a: [f64; 2], b: [f64; 2], t0: f64, s: f64, park: bool },
    /// a city player: straight on, now and then a turn (popin.rs)
    City,
    /// a jumper far off until then
    Away { until: f64 },
    /// a parked player's donut or move (yaw rate w, speed sp) until then, then parked again until park
    Fidget { until: f64, w: f64, sp: f64, park: f64 },
    /// a parked player in a shop (status 4) or paused (5) until then, then parked again until park
    Stop { until: f64, park: f64 },
    /// circling the meet's middle at radius rr, angle a0 at t0, angular speed w (rad/s), until then (then a line)
    Loop { rr: f64, a0: f64, t0: f64, w: f64, until: f64 },
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct Car {
    p: [f64; 3],
    v: [f64; 3],
    h: f64,
    turn: f64,
    status: u8,
    next_snap: f64,
    doing: Doing,
    /// parked since (for the measure)
    since: f64,
    /// a real meet's next donut, move or stop (`Scene::real`)
    next_fidget: f64,
}

impl Car {
    fn speed(&self) -> f64 {
        (self.v[0] * self.v[0] + self.v[1] * self.v[1]).sqrt()
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
enum SlotSt {
    Free,
    /// a car parked with this peer's look
    Parked(usize),
    /// loading for this peer until then
    Loading(usize, f64),
    Active(usize),
}

struct Peer {
    listed: f64,
    first: f64,
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct Game {
    peers: HashMap<usize, Peer>,
    slots: Vec<SlotSt>,
    /// the car loader busy until then
    loader_at: f64,
    /// a jump in: when, and whether the 90 % mark was reached
    jumped: Option<f64>,
    linked90: bool,
    /// since when each peer's car shows, and when each one went
    shown_at: HashMap<usize, f64>,
    gone_at: HashMap<usize, f64>,
}

/// how a game ranks its peers for the slots (roam_game.c PeerView.rank): the nearest of the distances `soon` and
/// `look` seconds on, both cars at their speeds, and from its view point `view` m ahead (soon) to the other car
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct Rank {
    soon: f64,
    look: f64,
    view: f64,
}

impl Rank {
    fn of(&self, a: &Car, b: &Car) -> f64 {
        let (dx, dy) = (b.p[0] - a.p[0], b.p[1] - a.p[1]);
        let (ux, uy) = (b.v[0] - a.v[0], b.v[1] - a.v[1]);
        let at = |t: f64| ((dx + ux * t).powi(2) + (dy + uy * t).powi(2)).sqrt();
        let (sx, sy) = (dx + ux * self.soon - a.h.cos() * self.view, dy + uy * self.soon - a.h.sin() * self.view);
        let view = if a.status == 2 { (sx * sx + sy * sy).sqrt() } else { f64::INFINITY };
        at(self.soon).min(at(self.look)).min(view)
    }
}

struct Way {
    name: &'static str,
    o: RoamOptions,
    rank: Rank,
    /// the car loader's time for one car (s)
    load: f64,
    /// the games' core version (15: one-way links from the hub)
    core: u16,
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct Tally {
    samples: u64,
    shown: u64,
    nearest: u64,
    nearest_shown: u64,
    near60: u64,
    near60_shown: u64,
    loads: u64,
    gone_near: u64,
    observer_s: f64,
    jump_fill: Vec<f64>,
    jump_links: Vec<f64>,
    jump_miss: u64,
    drive_samples: u64,
    drive_near: u64,
    drive_near_shown: u64,
    links_made: u64,
    /// for the players parked at the meet: how long each car showed that went, and how many came back within 30 s
    lives: Vec<f64>,
    back30: u64,
    /// ...and of the ones that went within NEAR_M, how long each showed
    near_lives: Vec<f64>,
}

fn pct(v: &mut [f64], q: f64) -> f64 {
    if v.is_empty() {
        return f64::NAN;
    }
    v.sort_by(f64::total_cmp);
    v[((v.len() - 1) as f64 * q).round() as usize]
}

fn spot(r: &mut Lcg) -> [f64; 2] {
    // uniform over the ring 8..60 m
    let rr = (r.range(8.0 * 8.0, 60.0 * 60.0)).sqrt();
    let a = r.unit() * std::f64::consts::TAU;
    [rr * a.cos(), rr * a.sin()]
}

/// a line through or past the meet: up to 200 m off its middle, 600 m either side
fn line(r: &mut Lcg, t: f64) -> Doing {
    let a = r.unit() * std::f64::consts::TAU;
    let (d, n) = ([a.cos(), a.sin()], [-a.sin(), a.cos()]);
    let b = r.range(-200.0, 200.0);
    let from = [n[0] * b - d[0] * 600.0, n[1] * b - d[1] * 600.0];
    let to = [n[0] * b + d[0] * 600.0, n[1] * b + d[1] * 600.0];
    Doing::Leg { a: from, b: to, t0: t, s: r.range(15.0, 35.0), park: false }
}

#[allow(non_snake_case)]
fn run(sc: &Scene, way: &Way) {
    let (MEET_N, CITY_N, half) = (sc.meet, sc.city, sc.side / 2.0);
    let mut r = Lcg(7);
    let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions { max_players: 8192, ..way.o.clone() });
    let n = MEET_N + CITY_N + sc.jump;
    let vip = |i: usize| 0x0A4D_0100 + i as u32;
    let mut cars: Vec<Car> = Vec::with_capacity(n);
    for i in 0..n {
        let mut c = Car {
            p: [0.0; 3],
            v: [0.0; 3],
            h: r.unit() * std::f64::consts::TAU,
            turn: 0.0,
            status: 2,
            next_snap: r.unit() * 0.5,
            doing: Doing::City,
            since: 0.0,
            next_fidget: if sc.real && i < sc.meet { r.range(0.0, 2.0 * FIDGET_S) } else { f64::INFINITY },
        };
        if i < MEET_N {
            if r.unit() < 0.55 {
                let s = spot(&mut r);
                c.p = [s[0], s[1], 0.0];
                c.doing = Doing::Parked { until: r.range(10.0, 360.0) };
            } else {
                let t0 = -r.range(0.0, 40.0);
                c.doing = line(&mut r, t0);
            }
        } else if i < MEET_N + CITY_N {
            c.p = [r.range(-half, half), r.range(-half, half), 0.0];
            let kind = r.unit();
            if kind < 0.55 {
                let s = r.range(15.0, 50.0);
                c.v = [c.h.cos() * s, c.h.sin() * s, 0.0];
            } else if kind >= 0.9 {
                c.status = 4;
            }
        } else {
            c.doing = Doing::Away { until: r.range(0.0, 40.0) };
            c.p = [half + 500.0, half + 500.0 + i as f64 * 30.0, 0.0];
        }
        cars.push(c);
    }
    let watched = |i: usize| (i < MEET_N && (!sc.mix || i.is_multiple_of(4))) || i >= MEET_N + CITY_N;
    let mut links_of = vec![SLOTS; n];
    for i in 0..n {
        let links = if !sc.mix {
            SLOTS as u8
        } else if watched(i) {
            sc.watch_links
        } else {
            let u = r.unit();
            if u < 0.6 {
                32
            } else if u < 0.7 {
                24
            } else if u < 0.9 {
                16
            } else if u < 0.95 {
                48
            } else {
                64
            }
        };
        links_of[i] = links as usize;
        k.from(vip(i), &hello_with(1000 + i as u32, &HelloOpts { core: way.core, links, ..Default::default() }));
    }
    let mut games: Vec<Game> = (0..n).map(|i| Game { slots: vec![SlotSt::Free; links_of[i]], ..Default::default() }).collect();
    let mut last_list = vec![f64::NEG_INFINITY; n];
    let (warm, end) = (60.0, 420.0);
    // the players measured: parked at the meet (20 s and more, 0), and driving round it or through it (1)
    let mut tallies = [Tally::default(), Tally::default()];
    let observed = |me: usize, a: &Car, t: f64| -> Option<usize> {
        if !watched(me) || me >= MEET_N || t < warm {
            return None;
        }
        let rr = (a.p[0] * a.p[0] + a.p[1] * a.p[1]).sqrt();
        match a.doing {
            Doing::Parked { .. } | Doing::Fidget { .. } if t - a.since >= 20.0 && rr < 70.0 => Some(0),
            Doing::Loop { .. } => Some(1),
            Doing::Leg { .. } if rr < 150.0 => Some(1),
            _ => None,
        }
    };
    let (mut next_tick, mut t, mut step_no) = (0.0, 0.0, 0u64);
    while t < end {
        // the cars move
        for c in cars.iter_mut() {
            match c.doing {
                Doing::Parked { until } if t >= c.next_fidget && t < until => {
                    c.next_fidget = t - FIDGET_S * (1.0 - r.unit()).ln();
                    let u = r.unit();
                    c.doing = if u < 0.45 {
                        // a donut: 6 to 12 m/s round a circle of 4 to 8 m, 3 to 8 s
                        let sp = r.range(6.0, 12.0);
                        let w = sp / r.range(4.0, 8.0) * if r.unit() < 0.5 { -1.0 } else { 1.0 };
                        Doing::Fidget { until: t + r.range(3.0, 8.0), w, sp, park: until }
                    } else if u < 0.75 {
                        // to another spot near: 4 to 8 m/s for 2 to 6 s, turning a little
                        Doing::Fidget { until: t + r.range(2.0, 6.0), w: r.range(-0.4, 0.4), sp: r.range(4.0, 8.0), park: until }
                    } else {
                        // a shop or the pause menu, 10 to 60 s
                        c.status = if r.unit() < 0.5 { 4 } else { 5 };
                        Doing::Stop { until: t + r.range(10.0, 60.0), park: until }
                    };
                }
                Doing::Fidget { until, w, sp, park } => {
                    c.h += w * STEP;
                    c.v = [c.h.cos() * sp, c.h.sin() * sp, 0.0];
                    c.p[0] += c.v[0] * STEP;
                    c.p[1] += c.v[1] * STEP;
                    if t >= until {
                        c.v = [0.0; 3];
                        c.doing = Doing::Parked { until: park.max(t + 5.0) };
                    }
                }
                Doing::Stop { until, park } => {
                    c.v = [0.0; 3];
                    if t >= until {
                        c.status = 2;
                        c.doing = Doing::Parked { until: park.max(t + 5.0) };
                    }
                }
                Doing::Loop { rr, a0, t0, w, until } => {
                    let a = a0 + w * (t - t0);
                    c.p = [rr * a.cos(), rr * a.sin(), 0.0];
                    let sp = w * rr;
                    c.v = [-a.sin() * sp, a.cos() * sp, 0.0];
                    c.h = c.v[1].atan2(c.v[0]);
                    if t >= until {
                        c.doing = line(&mut r, t);
                    }
                }
                Doing::Parked { until } => {
                    c.v = [0.0; 3];
                    if t >= until {
                        // off, the way it points, to 600 m
                        let d = [c.h.cos(), c.h.sin()];
                        let to = [c.p[0] + d[0] * 600.0, c.p[1] + d[1] * 600.0];
                        c.doing = Doing::Leg { a: [c.p[0], c.p[1]], b: to, t0: t, s: r.range(15.0, 25.0), park: false };
                    }
                }
                Doing::Leg { a, b, t0, s, park } => {
                    let (dx, dy) = (b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]);
                    let len = (dx * dx + dy * dy).sqrt();
                    let u = ((t - t0) * s).min(len);
                    let d = [dx / len, dy / len];
                    c.p = [a[0] + d[0] * u, a[1] + d[1] * u, 0.0];
                    c.v = [d[0] * s, d[1] * s, 0.0];
                    c.h = d[1].atan2(d[0]);
                    if u >= len {
                        if park {
                            c.v = [0.0; 3];
                            c.doing = Doing::Parked { until: t + r.range(90.0, 360.0) };
                            c.since = t;
                        } else if sc.real && r.unit() < LOOPERS {
                            // round the meet, 40 to 150 m out at 10 to 25 m/s, for 20 to 90 s
                            let rr = r.range(40.0, 150.0);
                            let w = r.range(10.0, 25.0) / rr * if r.unit() < 0.5 { -1.0 } else { 1.0 };
                            c.doing = Doing::Loop { rr, a0: r.unit() * std::f64::consts::TAU, t0: t, w, until: t + r.range(20.0, 90.0) };
                        } else if r.unit() < 0.4 {
                            // in to a spot, from 500 m
                            let sp = spot(&mut r);
                            let a = r.unit() * std::f64::consts::TAU;
                            let from = [sp[0] - a.cos() * 500.0, sp[1] - a.sin() * 500.0];
                            c.doing = Doing::Leg { a: from, b: sp, t0: t, s: r.range(12.0, 20.0), park: true };
                        } else {
                            c.doing = line(&mut r, t);
                        }
                    }
                }
                Doing::City => {
                    let moving = c.status == 2 && c.speed() > 1.0;
                    if moving && c.turn == 0.0 && r.unit() < STEP / 6.0 {
                        c.turn = (r.unit() - 0.5) * std::f64::consts::PI;
                    }
                    if c.turn != 0.0 {
                        let a = c.turn.clamp(-1.047 * STEP, 1.047 * STEP);
                        c.turn -= a;
                        if c.turn.abs() < 1e-9 {
                            c.turn = 0.0;
                        }
                        let (s, co) = (a.sin(), a.cos());
                        c.v = [c.v[0] * co - c.v[1] * s, c.v[0] * s + c.v[1] * co, 0.0];
                    }
                    for a in 0..2 {
                        c.p[a] += c.v[a] * STEP;
                        if c.p[a].abs() > half {
                            c.p[a] = c.p[a].signum() * half;
                            c.v[a] = -c.v[a];
                        }
                    }
                    if moving {
                        c.h = c.v[1].atan2(c.v[0]);
                    }
                }
                Doing::Away { until } => {
                    if t >= until {
                        let sp = spot(&mut r);
                        c.p = [sp[0], sp[1], 0.0];
                        c.h = r.unit() * std::f64::consts::TAU;
                        c.doing = Doing::Parked { until: t + 40.0 };
                        c.since = t;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        // jumpers away again after their 40 s
        for i in MEET_N + CITY_N..n {
            if let Doing::Parked { until } = cars[i].doing
                && t >= until - STEP
            {
                cars[i].doing = Doing::Away { until: t + 40.0 };
                cars[i].p = [half + 500.0, half + 500.0 + i as f64 * 30.0, 0.0];
                cars[i].v = [0.0; 3];
            }
        }
        for (i, c) in cars.iter_mut().enumerate() {
            if t >= c.next_snap {
                c.next_snap += 0.5;
                k.from(vip(i), &snap_moving(1000 + i as u32, c.p, c.v, c.h, c.status));
            }
        }
        if t >= next_tick {
            next_tick += way.o.tick_ms as f64 / 1000.0;
            k.clear();
            k.hub.tick();
            let lists: Vec<(usize, Vec<usize>)> = k
                .lists_in()
                .into_iter()
                .map(|(key, list)| {
                    let me = (key.split(':').next().unwrap().parse::<u32>().unwrap() - vip(0)) as usize;
                    (me, list.iter().map(|e| (e.vip - vip(0)) as usize).collect())
                })
                .collect();
            for (me, list) in lists {
                last_list[me] = t;
                for q in list {
                    let g = &mut games[me];
                    let p = g.peers.entry(q).or_insert_with(|| {
                        if t >= warm && me < MEET_N {
                            tallies[0].links_made += 1;
                        }
                        Peer { listed: t, first: t }
                    });
                    p.listed = t;
                }
            }
        }
        // the jumpers' jumps in
        for i in MEET_N + CITY_N..n {
            let landed = matches!(cars[i].doing, Doing::Parked { .. }) && (t - cars[i].since).abs() < STEP / 2.0;
            if landed && t >= warm {
                games[i].jumped = Some(t);
            }
        }
        // each game (of the players watched: the meet's and the jumpers'; the city's games change nothing the hub does)
        for me in (0..MEET_N).chain(MEET_N + CITY_N..n) {
            let a = cars[me];
            let ll = last_list[me];
            let class = observed(me, &a, t);
            let observer = class.is_some();
            let tally = &mut tallies[class.unwrap_or(0)];
            let g = &mut games[me];
            // peers gone
            let mut gone = Vec::new();
            g.peers.retain(|&q, p| {
                let keep = t - p.listed <= GRACE;
                if !keep {
                    gone.push(q);
                }
                keep
            });
            let near = |q: usize| ((cars[q].p[0] - a.p[0]).powi(2) + (cars[q].p[1] - a.p[1]).powi(2)).sqrt() < NEAR_M;
            for sl in g.slots.iter_mut() {
                match *sl {
                    SlotSt::Active(q) | SlotSt::Loading(q, _) if gone.contains(&q) => {
                        let went_near = observer && matches!(*sl, SlotSt::Active(_)) && near(q) && cars[q].status == 2;
                        if went_near {
                            tally.gone_near += 1;
                        }
                        if let Some(t0) = g.shown_at.remove(&q)
                            && observer
                        {
                            tally.lives.push(t - t0);
                            if went_near {
                                tally.near_lives.push(t - t0);
                            }
                        }
                        g.gone_at.insert(q, t);
                        *sl = if matches!(*sl, SlotSt::Active(_)) { SlotSt::Parked(q) } else { SlotSt::Free };
                    }
                    SlotSt::Loading(q, done) if t >= done => {
                        *sl = SlotSt::Active(q);
                        g.shown_at.insert(q, t);
                    }
                    _ => {}
                }
            }
            // slots: the nearest listed peer without one, while the loader has room
            let has = |slots: &[SlotSt], q: usize| slots.iter().any(|s| matches!(*s, SlotSt::Active(x) | SlotSt::Loading(x, _) if x == q));
            let mut cands: Vec<(f64, usize)> = g
                .peers
                .iter()
                .filter(|(q, p)| cars[**q].status == 2 && t >= p.first + HANDSHAKE && p.listed == ll && !has(&g.slots, **q))
                .map(|(&q, _)| (way.rank.of(&a, &cars[q]), q))
                .collect();
            cands.sort_by(|x, y| x.0.total_cmp(&y.0).then(x.1.cmp(&y.1)));
            for (d, q) in cands {
                // 1. a parked car with this look
                if let Some(j) = g.slots.iter().position(|s| *s == SlotSt::Parked(q)) {
                    g.slots[j] = SlotSt::Active(q);
                    g.shown_at.insert(q, t);
                    if observer && g.gone_at.get(&q).is_some_and(|&w| t - w < 30.0) {
                        tally.back30 += 1;
                    }
                    continue;
                }
                let queued = g.slots.iter().filter(|s| matches!(s, SlotSt::Loading(..))).count();
                if queued >= LOADS_AHEAD {
                    break;
                }
                // 2. a free slot, 3. a parked one, 4.-6. one to give way
                let mut j =
                    g.slots.iter().position(|s| *s == SlotSt::Free).or_else(|| g.slots.iter().position(|s| matches!(s, SlotSt::Parked(_))));
                if j.is_none() {
                    let rank_of = |x: usize| way.rank.of(&a, &cars[x]);
                    let mut out: Option<(f64, usize)> = None;
                    for (jj, s) in g.slots.iter().enumerate() {
                        if let SlotSt::Active(x) = *s
                            && (cars[x].status != 2 || g.peers.get(&x).is_some_and(|p| p.listed != ll))
                        {
                            let dx = rank_of(x);
                            if out.is_none_or(|(f, _)| dx > f) {
                                out = Some((dx, jj));
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if out.is_none() {
                        let mut far: Option<(f64, usize)> = None;
                        for (jj, s) in g.slots.iter().enumerate() {
                            if let SlotSt::Active(x) = *s {
                                let dx = rank_of(x);
                                if far.is_none_or(|(f, _)| dx > f) {
                                    far = Some((dx, jj));
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        out = far.filter(|&(f, _)| d < f * 0.6 && f - d > 50.0);
                    }
                    let Some((_, jj)) = out else { break };
                    if let SlotSt::Active(x) = g.slots[jj] {
                        let went_near = observer && near(x) && cars[x].status == 2;
                        if went_near {
                            tally.gone_near += 1;
                        }
                        if let Some(t0) = g.shown_at.remove(&x)
                            && observer
                        {
                            tally.lives.push(t - t0);
                            if went_near {
                                tally.near_lives.push(t - t0);
                            }
                        }
                        g.gone_at.insert(x, t);
                    }
                    j = Some(jj);
                }
                let j = j.unwrap();
                let done = g.loader_at.max(t) + way.load;
                g.loader_at = done;
                g.slots[j] = SlotSt::Loading(q, done);
                if observer {
                    tally.loads += 1;
                    if g.gone_at.get(&q).is_some_and(|&w| t - w < 30.0) {
                        tally.back30 += 1;
                    }
                }
            }
            if observer {
                tally.observer_s += STEP;
            }
        }
        // what the players see, every half second
        if t >= warm && step_no % 5 == 0 {
            for me in (0..MEET_N).chain(MEET_N + CITY_N..n) {
                let a = cars[me];
                let g = &games[me];
                let shown: Vec<usize> = g
                    .slots
                    .iter()
                    .filter_map(|s| if let SlotSt::Active(q) = *s { Some(q) } else { None })
                    .filter(|&q| cars[q].status == 2)
                    .collect();
                let dist = |q: usize| ((cars[q].p[0] - a.p[0]).powi(2) + (cars[q].p[1] - a.p[1]).powi(2)).sqrt();
                let mut others: Vec<(f64, usize)> =
                    (0..n).filter(|&q| q != me && cars[q].status == 2).map(|q| (dist(q), q)).filter(|e| e.0 < 300.0).collect();
                others.sort_by(|x, y| x.0.total_cmp(&y.0));
                let kk = others.len().min(links_of[me]);
                let kj = others.iter().take_while(|e| e.0 < 100.0).count().min(SLOTS);
                if let Some(t0) = g.jumped {
                    let tally = &mut tallies[0];
                    let ll = last_list[me];
                    let linked = others[..kj].iter().filter(|e| g.peers.get(&e.1).is_some_and(|p| p.listed == ll)).count();
                    if linked as f64 >= 0.9 * kj as f64 && !g.linked90 {
                        tally.jump_links.push(t - t0);
                        games[me].linked90 = true;
                    }
                    let got = others[..kj].iter().filter(|e| shown.contains(&e.1)).count();
                    if got as f64 >= 0.9 * kj as f64 {
                        tally.jump_fill.push(t - t0);
                        games[me].jumped = None;
                        games[me].linked90 = false;
                    } else if t - t0 > 35.0 {
                        tally.jump_miss += 1;
                        games[me].jumped = None;
                        games[me].linked90 = false;
                    }
                }
                let g = &games[me];
                let class = observed(me, &a, t);
                if let Some(c) = class {
                    let tally = &mut tallies[c];
                    tally.samples += 1;
                    tally.shown += shown.len() as u64;
                    tally.nearest += kk as u64;
                    tally.nearest_shown += others[..kk].iter().filter(|e| shown.contains(&e.1)).count() as u64;
                    for e in others.iter().take_while(|e| e.0 < NEAR_M) {
                        tally.near60 += 1;
                        tally.near60_shown += shown.contains(&e.1) as u64;
                    }
                }
                // a driver going by the meet: the cars within 100 m
                if watched(me) && me < MEET_N && matches!(a.doing, Doing::Leg { .. }) && (a.p[0] * a.p[0] + a.p[1] * a.p[1]).sqrt() < 150.0
                {
                    let tally = &mut tallies[0];
                    tally.drive_samples += 1;
                    for e in others.iter().take_while(|e| e.0 < 100.0) {
                        tally.drive_near += 1;
                        tally.drive_near_shown += shown.contains(&e.1) as u64;
                    }
                }
                let _ = g;
            }
        }
        k.step(STEP * 1000.0);
        t += STEP;
        step_no += 1;
    }
    let pc = |a: u64, b: u64| 100.0 * a as f64 / b.max(1) as f64;
    let jumps = {
        let t0 = &mut tallies[0];
        format!(
            "jump in: 90 % linked {:>4.1} s, shown {:>4.1} s (p90 {:>4.1}, {} never) | links {:.2}/s | driving by: <100 m {:>4.1} %",
            pct(&mut t0.jump_links, 0.5),
            pct(&mut t0.jump_fill.clone(), 0.5),
            pct(&mut t0.jump_fill, 0.9),
            t0.jump_miss,
            t0.links_made as f64 / (MEET_N as f64 * (end - warm)),
            pc(t0.drive_near_shown, t0.drive_near),
        )
    };
    for (c, tally) in tallies.iter_mut().enumerate() {
        let mins = tally.observer_s / 60.0;
        println!(
            "{:<6} {:<26} {}: shown {:>4.1}, nearest N {:>4.1} %, <60 m {:>4.1} %, loads {:>5.1}/min, gone <60 m {:>5.2}/min (shown {:>4.1} s, median), \
             all gone: shown <10 s {:>3.0} % (median {:>4.1} s), back within 30 s {:>4.1}/min{}",
            sc.name,
            way.name,
            if c == 0 { "parked " } else { "driving" },
            tally.shown as f64 / tally.samples.max(1) as f64,
            pc(tally.nearest_shown, tally.nearest),
            pc(tally.near60_shown, tally.near60),
            tally.loads as f64 / mins,
            tally.gone_near as f64 / mins,
            pct(&mut tally.near_lives, 0.5),
            pc(tally.lives.iter().filter(|&&x| x < 10.0).count() as u64, tally.lives.len() as u64),
            pct(&mut tally.lives.clone(), 0.5),
            tally.back30 as f64 / mins,
            if c == 1 { format!(" | {jumps} | the hub's near links gone, why: {}", k.hub.info()["nearGone"]) } else { String::new() },
        );
    }
}

#[test]
#[ignore]
fn meet() {
    let now = RoamOptions::default();
    let game = |o: &RoamOptions| Rank { soon: o.soon_ms / 1000.0, look: o.look_ms / 1000.0, view: o.view_m };
    let way = |name, o: RoamOptions, core| Way { name, rank: game(&o), o, load: 0.12, core };
    let only = std::env::var("MEET_ONLY").unwrap_or_default();
    // the hub of before (links both ways: a game of core 14) and one-way links (core 15)
    let before = RoamOptions { near_m: 1e-9, ..now.clone() };
    let ways = [
        way("links both ways (core 14)", now.clone(), 14),
        way("one-way (15, released)", before, 15),
        way("one-way, near first", now.clone(), 15),
        way("one-way, near first at any speed", RoamOptions { near_fast: 1e9, ..now.clone() }, 15),
    ];
    let scenes = [
        Scene { name: "meet", meet: 90, city: 300, side: 3000.0, jump: JUMP_N, mix: false, watch_links: 64, real: false },
        Scene { name: "busy", meet: 45, city: 3000, side: 4000.0, jump: JUMP_N, mix: false, watch_links: 64, real: false },
        Scene { name: "mixed", meet: 90, city: 3000, side: 4000.0, jump: JUMP_N, mix: true, watch_links: 64, real: false },
        Scene { name: "mix32", meet: 90, city: 3000, side: 4000.0, jump: JUMP_N, mix: true, watch_links: 32, real: false },
        Scene { name: "mix16", meet: 90, city: 3000, side: 4000.0, jump: JUMP_N, mix: true, watch_links: 16, real: false },
        Scene { name: "real", meet: 90, city: 3000, side: 4000.0, jump: JUMP_N, mix: true, watch_links: 64, real: true },
        Scene { name: "real32", meet: 90, city: 3000, side: 4000.0, jump: JUMP_N, mix: true, watch_links: 32, real: true },
        Scene { name: "real16", meet: 90, city: 3000, side: 4000.0, jump: JUMP_N, mix: true, watch_links: 16, real: true },
        // as dense as the player's meet of 2026-11-05 (60 and more within 60 m)
        Scene { name: "dense", meet: 160, city: 3000, side: 4000.0, jump: JUMP_N, mix: true, watch_links: 64, real: true },
        Scene { name: "dense32", meet: 160, city: 3000, side: 4000.0, jump: JUMP_N, mix: true, watch_links: 32, real: true },
    ];
    let scene = std::env::var("MEET_SCENE").unwrap_or_default();
    for sc in scenes.iter().filter(|s| scene.is_empty() || s.name == scene) {
        for w in ways.iter().filter(|w| only.is_empty() || only.split('|').any(|o| w.name == o)) {
            run(sc, w);
        }
    }
}
