//! Free roam's hub and claimed names (nfsu2-claims): a player under a name another keyphrase claimed gets no links,
//! is on nobody's map and counts nowhere; its owner, and a name nobody claimed, play as before.

mod kit;

use std::sync::Arc;

use kit::*;
use nfsu2_claims::{Claims, owner_of_token};
use nfsu2_roam::RoamOptions;

const T0: i64 = 1_000_000;

fn owner(c: char) -> Arc<str> {
    owner_of_token(&c.to_string().repeat(43)).unwrap()
}

/// a player of `name` at x, whose page plays with `key`'s keyphrase (None: none)
fn place(k: &mut Kit, i: u32, name: &[u8], x: f64, key: Option<char>) {
    let o = key.map(owner);
    let h = hello_with(100 + i, &HelloOpts { core: 4, name, room: room_hash("claims"), ..Default::default() });
    k.hub.frame_from(V(i), &frame(V(i), &h), o.as_ref());
    k.hub.frame_from(V(i), &frame(V(i), &snap(100 + i, [x, 0.0, 0.0])), o.as_ref());
}

fn linked(k: &Kit, i: u32, j: u32) -> bool {
    k.lists().get(&format!("{}:47210", V(i))).is_some_and(|l| l.iter().any(|e| e.vip == V(j)))
}

#[test]
fn a_claimed_name_plays_alone_under_another_keyphrase() {
    let claims = Arc::new(Claims::in_memory());
    claims.claim("Alex", &owner('A'), T0).unwrap();
    let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions::default());
    k.hub.set_claims(Some(claims.clone()));
    place(&mut k, 0, b"Racer", 0.0, None);
    place(&mut k, 1, b"Alex", 10.0, None);
    place(&mut k, 2, b"alex", 20.0, Some('B'));
    place(&mut k, 3, b"Alex", 30.0, Some('A'));
    k.hub.tick();
    assert!(linked(&k, 0, 3) && linked(&k, 3, 0), "the owner plays with the others");
    for i in [1, 2] {
        assert!(!linked(&k, 0, i) && !linked(&k, i, 0) && !linked(&k, i, 3), "player {i} under another's name: no links");
    }
    assert_eq!(k.hub.in_rooms().get(&room_hash("claims")), Some(&2), "they count nowhere");
    assert_eq!(k.lines.lock().iter().filter(|l| l.contains("a name another keyphrase claimed")).count(), 2, "{:?}", k.lines.lock());
    // the claim let go: they play with everyone at their next HELLO
    claims.release(&owner('A'));
    k.clear();
    place(&mut k, 1, b"Alex", 10.0, None);
    place(&mut k, 2, b"alex", 20.0, Some('B'));
    k.hub.tick();
    assert!(linked(&k, 0, 1) && linked(&k, 0, 2));
    // a name claimed while its impostor drives: alone from its next HELLO on
    claims.claim("Racer", &owner('C'), T0).unwrap();
    k.clear();
    place(&mut k, 0, b"Racer", 0.0, None);
    k.hub.tick();
    assert!(!linked(&k, 0, 1) && !linked(&k, 1, 0));
}

#[test]
fn playing_holds_the_claim() {
    let claims = Arc::new(Claims::in_memory());
    claims.claim("Alex", &owner('A'), T0).unwrap();
    let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions::default());
    k.hub.set_claims(Some(claims.clone()));
    k.step(30.0 * 86_400_000.0);
    place(&mut k, 0, b"Alex", 0.0, Some('A'));
    let now = T0 + 30 * 86_400_000;
    assert_eq!(claims.mine(&owner('A'), now).unwrap().until, now + nfsu2_claims::HOLD_DAYS * nfsu2_claims::DAY_MS);
}

// a name the operator took away (nfsu2-bans rename, RoamOptions::deny), and one that reads as it, plays alone the
// same way, claims or none; from its next HELLO on when it is taken away while its player drives
#[test]
fn a_name_taken_away_plays_alone() {
    let deny = Arc::new(nfsu2_names::Deny::default());
    deny.set(["B4d_N4me".to_string()]);
    let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions { deny: Some(deny.clone()), ..RoamOptions::default() });
    place(&mut k, 0, b"Racer", 0.0, None);
    place(&mut k, 1, b"BadName", 10.0, None);
    place(&mut k, 2, b"Driver", 20.0, Some('B'));
    k.hub.tick();
    assert!(linked(&k, 0, 2) && linked(&k, 2, 0));
    assert!(!linked(&k, 0, 1) && !linked(&k, 1, 0) && !linked(&k, 2, 1));
    assert_eq!(k.lines.lock().iter().filter(|l| l.contains("a name the operator took away")).count(), 1, "{:?}", k.lines.lock());
    // Driver's name taken away now: alone from its next HELLO
    deny.set(["B4d_N4me".to_string(), "Driver".to_string()]);
    k.clear();
    place(&mut k, 2, b"Driver", 20.0, Some('B'));
    k.hub.tick();
    assert!(!linked(&k, 0, 2) && !linked(&k, 2, 0));
    // given back
    deny.set([]);
    k.clear();
    place(&mut k, 1, b"BadName", 10.0, None);
    place(&mut k, 2, b"Driver", 20.0, Some('B'));
    k.hub.tick();
    assert!(linked(&k, 0, 1) && linked(&k, 0, 2));
}

/// co-op's second player of browser i (port 47211, its HELLO flagged: roam_core.h RC_HF_SEAT2) under `name` at x
fn place_second(k: &mut Kit, i: u32, name: &[u8], x: f64, key: Option<char>) {
    let o = key.map(owner);
    let h = hello_with(200 + i, &HelloOpts { core: 4, name, room: room_hash("claims"), flags: 0x2000, ..Default::default() });
    k.hub.frame_from(V(i), &frame_ports(V(i), &h, 47211, 47210), o.as_ref());
    k.hub.frame_from(V(i), &frame_ports(V(i), &snap(200 + i, [x, 0.0, 0.0]), 47211, 47210), o.as_ref());
}

fn linked_second(k: &Kit, i: u32, j: u32) -> bool {
    k.lists().get(&format!("{}:47211", V(i))).is_some_and(|l| l.iter().any(|e| e.vip == V(j)))
}

// a claimed name's second form ("Alex 2", co-op's second player) is its owner's: its page's second player plays with
// everyone, another keyphrase's under it alone; a claim of the second form itself, older, comes first
#[test]
fn a_claimed_names_second_form_is_its_owners() {
    let claims = Arc::new(Claims::in_memory());
    claims.claim("Bob_2", &owner('C'), T0).unwrap();
    claims.claim("Alex", &owner('A'), T0).unwrap();
    claims.claim("Bob", &owner('D'), T0).unwrap();
    let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions::default());
    k.hub.set_claims(Some(claims.clone()));
    place(&mut k, 0, b"Racer", 0.0, None);
    place(&mut k, 1, b"Alex", 10.0, Some('A'));
    place_second(&mut k, 1, b"Alex 2", 13.0, Some('A'));
    place_second(&mut k, 2, b"Alex 2", 20.0, Some('B'));
    place(&mut k, 3, b"Bob", 30.0, Some('D'));
    place_second(&mut k, 3, b"Bob 2", 33.0, Some('D'));
    place(&mut k, 4, b"Bob 2", 40.0, Some('C'));
    k.hub.tick();
    assert!(linked_second(&k, 1, 0) && linked(&k, 0, 1), "the owner's two players play with the others");
    assert!(!linked_second(&k, 2, 0) && !linked_second(&k, 2, 1), "another keyphrase's Alex 2: no links");
    assert!(!linked_second(&k, 3, 0) && linked(&k, 3, 0), "Bob 2 is C's claim: D's second player plays alone");
    assert!(linked(&k, 4, 0), "C under its own claim");
    assert_eq!(k.lines.lock().iter().filter(|l| l.contains("a name another keyphrase claimed")).count(), 2, "{:?}", k.lines.lock());
}

// the second form of a name taken away (co-op's second player's "BadName 2") plays alone as that name does: names are
// compared by their letters (nfsu2-names `letters`), and a 2 is none
#[test]
fn a_taken_names_second_form_plays_alone() {
    let deny = Arc::new(nfsu2_names::Deny::default());
    deny.set(["B4d_N4me".to_string()]);
    let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions { deny: Some(deny), ..RoamOptions::default() });
    place(&mut k, 0, b"Racer", 0.0, None);
    place(&mut k, 1, b"Driver", 10.0, None);
    place_second(&mut k, 1, b"BadName 2", 13.0, None);
    place(&mut k, 2, b"BadName_2", 20.0, None);
    k.hub.tick();
    assert!(linked(&k, 0, 1));
    assert!(!linked_second(&k, 1, 0) && !linked(&k, 0, 2) && !linked(&k, 2, 0));
    assert_eq!(k.lines.lock().iter().filter(|l| l.contains("a name the operator took away")).count(), 2, "{:?}", k.lines.lock());
}

//! Co-op free roam through the hub: a browser's second local player is a second endpoint of its browser (player 1's
//! port + 1), its HELLO flagged (roam_core.h RC_HF_SEAT2), its name the second form of player 1's ("Alex 2").
//! 1. the links: two endpoints of one browser are never linked, by any way the hub links (the nearest, every pair or
//!    the grid, an outrun's, a race lobby's, a crew's, friends), flagged or not; everyone else links with both;
//! 2. the maps: a browser's world map and minimap leave out its other endpoints; a second player's questions go
//!    unanswered (the browser's answer state is its first player's), and the second player is on everyone else's;
//! 3. friends: the second player is nobody's friend (no marks either way, no friend linked first), and a keyphrase's
//!    whereabouts are its first player's;
//! 4. the console: a second player under the second form of its page's name, or of its claim, is a line of its own,
//!    not "its game shows"; the operator's `who` still has its name;
//! 5. the cheat watch: a second player's car put beside its first one's is no teleport; anywhere else it is, and so
//!    is one beside another flagged endpoint or beside an endpoint not flagged;
//! 6. a block of the second player's name, as a claimed name's, blocks its owner (both players); a second form two
//!    claims of before share is one keyphrase's: another one's player under it is an impostor, and a block of it never
//!    blocks that other keyphrase;
//! 7. the counts: /players counts the browser once, info() its second players; a full hub of 24576 with players
//!    coming and going keeps every world map's key under 16384, and a key that goes back goes to the next one shown.

mod kit;

use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};
use std::sync::Arc;

use kit::*;
use nfsu2_claims::{Claims, owner_of_token};
use nfsu2_roam::{PeerEntry, RoamOptions};

/// roam_core.h RC_HF_SEAT2: this endpoint is its browser's second local player
const SEAT2: u16 = 0x2000;
/// player 1's port and player 2's
const P1: u16 = 47210;
const P2: u16 = 47211;

fn owner(c: char) -> Arc<str> {
    owner_of_token(&c.to_string().repeat(43)).unwrap()
}

/// a datagram from browser `vip`'s endpoint at `port`, whose page plays with `key`'s keyphrase (None: none)
fn send(k: &mut Kit, vip: u32, port: u16, d: &[u8], key: Option<char>) {
    let o = key.map(owner);
    k.hub.frame_from(vip, &frame_ports(vip, d, port, 47210), o.as_ref());
}

/// a player with these HELLO fields at (x, y): its HELLO and SNAP from browser `vip`'s endpoint `port`
fn put(k: &mut Kit, vip: u32, port: u16, id: u32, h: &HelloOpts, key: Option<char>, at: [f64; 2]) {
    send(k, vip, port, &hello_with(id, h), key);
    send(k, vip, port, &snap(id, [at[0], at[1], 0.0]), key);
}

/// player 2's HELLO: flagged, no crews (the crew flag and a count of 0, so that the links byte is read), few links
fn seat2<'a>(name: &'a [u8]) -> HelloOpts<'a> {
    HelloOpts { core: 12, name, flags: SEAT2 | HF_HUBCREW, crews: Some(&[]), links: 8, ..Default::default() }
}

/// player 1's HELLO, of a core of now
fn seat1<'a>(name: &'a [u8]) -> HelloOpts<'a> {
    HelloOpts { core: 12, name, flags: HF_HUBCREW, crews: Some(&[]), links: 24, ..Default::default() }
}

fn ep(vip: u32, port: u16) -> String {
    format!("{vip}:{port}")
}

/// whether endpoint a's list names endpoint b (and b's names a: a link is listed at both ends)
fn linked(l: &HashMap<String, Vec<PeerEntry>>, a: (u32, u16), b: (u32, u16)) -> bool {
    let has = |x: (u32, u16), y: (u32, u16)| l.get(&ep(x.0, x.1)).is_some_and(|v| v.iter().any(|e| (e.vip, e.port) == y));
    assert_eq!(has(a, b), has(b, a), "{a:?} {b:?}: a link is listed at both ends");
    has(a, b)
}

/// the MAPD and NEARD datagrams the hub sent since the last clear, to which endpoint
fn answers(k: &Kit) -> Vec<((u32, u16), Mapd, bool)> {
    let sent = k.sent.lock();
    let to = |vip: u32, f: &[u8]| (vip, u16::from_be_bytes([f[14], f[15]]));
    let maps = sent.iter().filter_map(|(vip, f)| mapd_of(f).map(|m| (to(*vip, f), m, false)));
    let nears = sent.iter().filter_map(|(vip, f)| neard_of(f).map(|m| (to(*vip, f), m, true)));
    maps.chain(nears).collect()
}

/// the x of each player placed in an answer
fn xs(m: &Mapd) -> HashSet<i16> {
    m.5.iter().filter_map(|e| e.1.map(|p| p.0)).collect()
}

// a browser's two endpoints, player 1 and player 2 three metres apart among three others: everyone is linked with both
// of them, they never with each other; nor two endpoints of a browser without the flag (a restart's lingering one)
#[test]
fn a_browsers_endpoints_are_never_linked() {
    for (how, o) in ways() {
        let mut k = Kit::new(o);
        put(&mut k, V(0), P1, 100, &seat1(b"Alex"), Some('A'), [0.25, 0.25]);
        put(&mut k, V(0), P2, 200, &seat2(b"Alex 2"), Some('A'), [3.25, 0.25]);
        for i in 1..=3 {
            put(&mut k, V(i), P1, 100 + i, &seat1(format!("p{i}").as_bytes()), None, [3.0 * i as f64 + 3.25, 0.25]);
        }
        put(&mut k, V(4), P1, 104, &seat1(b"Restart"), None, [20.25, 0.25]);
        put(&mut k, V(4), 47212, 204, &seat1(b"Restart"), None, [20.25, 1.25]);
        k.hub.tick();
        let l = k.lists();
        assert!(!linked(&l, (V(0), P1), (V(0), P2)), "{how}: player 1 and player 2");
        assert!(!linked(&l, (V(4), P1), (V(4), 47212)), "{how}: a browser's endpoints without the flag");
        for i in 1..=3 {
            assert!(linked(&l, (V(0), P1), (V(i), P1)) && linked(&l, (V(0), P2), (V(i), P1)), "{how}: {i} with both");
        }
        assert!(linked(&l, (V(4), P1), (V(0), P2)) && linked(&l, (V(4), 47212), (V(0), P2)), "{how}: two browsers' endpoints");
        assert_eq!(k.hub.link_pairs().len(), 10, "{how}: every pair of the five browsers");
    }
}

// the links made before any other are none of them either: the two in one crew, in an outrun with each other, player
// 1 hosting a race lobby with player 2 at its start
#[test]
fn a_browsers_endpoints_are_linked_first_by_nothing() {
    let owls = fnv1a("owls");
    for (how, o) in ways() {
        let mut k = Kit::new(o);
        let one = HelloOpts { crews: Some(&[owls]), duel: 200, ..seat1(b"Alex") };
        let two = HelloOpts { crews: Some(&[owls]), duel: 100, ..seat2(b"Alex 2") };
        put(&mut k, V(0), P1, 100, &one, Some('A'), [0.25, 0.25]);
        put(&mut k, V(0), P2, 200, &two, Some('A'), [3.25, 0.25]);
        // a crew-mate 2 km off and a player beside them
        put(&mut k, V(1), P1, 101, &HelloOpts { crews: Some(&[owls]), ..seat1(b"Owl") }, None, [2000.25, 0.25]);
        put(&mut k, V(2), P1, 102, &seat1(b"Near"), None, [6.25, 0.25]);
        // player 1's lobby, its start where it is (an advert: op 1, max 4, lobby a1, race, x 0, y 0, n 1, its id)
        let mut p = vec![0u8; 28];
        p[0] = 1;
        p[3] = 4;
        p[8..12].copy_from_slice(&0xA1u32.to_le_bytes());
        p[12..16].copy_from_slice(&0x0BAD_F00Du32.to_le_bytes());
        p[22] = 1;
        p[24..28].copy_from_slice(&100u32.to_le_bytes());
        send(&mut k, V(0), P1, &dgram(12, 100, &p), Some('A'));
        k.hub.tick();
        let l = k.lists();
        assert!(!linked(&l, (V(0), P1), (V(0), P2)), "{how}");
        assert!(linked(&l, (V(0), P1), (V(1), P1)), "{how}: player 1's crew-mate far off");
        assert!(linked(&l, (V(0), P1), (V(2), P1)) && linked(&l, (V(0), P2), (V(2), P1)), "{how}");
        assert_eq!(k.info("duelLinks"), 0.0, "{how}");
    }
}

// a browser's world map and minimap leave out its other endpoints (its game shows their cars itself); player 2's
// questions go unanswered, and take nothing of player 1's answers; player 2 is on another player's map and minimap
#[test]
fn a_browsers_maps_are_its_first_players() {
    let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions { degree: 1, view_m: 1e-9, ..RoamOptions::default() });
    let plain = |name: &'static [u8]| HelloOpts { core: 4, name, ..Default::default() };
    put(&mut k, V(0), P1, 100, &plain(b"Alex"), None, [0.25, 0.25]);
    put(&mut k, V(0), P2, 200, &HelloOpts { flags: SEAT2, ..plain(b"Alex 2") }, None, [3.25, 0.25]);
    for i in 1..=3 {
        put(&mut k, V(i), P1, 100 + i, &plain(b"p"), None, [100.0 * i as f64 + 0.25, 0.25]);
    }
    // (a degree of 1: player 2 with 1, 2 with 3, player 1 with nobody)
    k.hub.tick();
    let l = k.lists();
    assert!(linked(&l, (V(0), P2), (V(1), P1)) && linked(&l, (V(2), P1), (V(3), P1)));
    assert!(l[&ep(V(0), P1)].is_empty());
    k.clear();
    // player 2 asks first: nothing; player 1 at once after it: its answers
    send(&mut k, V(0), P2, &mapreq_base(200, 1, 64, 0), None);
    send(&mut k, V(0), P2, &nearreq(200, 1, 64, 0, 1000), None);
    assert!(answers(&k).is_empty(), "player 2's questions unanswered");
    send(&mut k, V(0), P1, &mapreq_base(100, 2, 64, 0), None);
    send(&mut k, V(0), P1, &nearreq(100, 3, 64, 0, 1000), None);
    let a = answers(&k);
    assert_eq!(a.len(), 2, "player 1's map and minimap: {a:?}");
    for (to, m, near) in &a {
        assert_eq!(*to, (V(0), P1), "near {near}");
        assert_eq!(xs(m), HashSet::from([100, 200, 300]), "near {near}: the others, not player 2 (x 3)");
    }
    // another player's: player 2 is on them (3's: past its link, 2)
    k.clear();
    send(&mut k, V(3), P1, &mapreq_base(103, 1, 64, 0), None);
    send(&mut k, V(3), P1, &nearreq(103, 2, 64, 0, 1000), None);
    for (_, m, near) in answers(&k) {
        assert_eq!(xs(&m), HashSet::from([0, 3, 100]), "near {near}: both of the browser's players");
    }
}

// player 2 is nobody's friend: player 1's friend sees player 1 marked and player 2 not, player 2's list marks nobody,
// and player 1's friend 2 km off is linked first with player 1 only; the keyphrase's whereabouts are player 1's
#[test]
fn a_second_player_is_nobodys_friend() {
    let o = RoamOptions { degree: 2, view_m: 1e-9, ..RoamOptions::default() };
    let mut k = Kit::new(o);
    k.hub.friends(V(0), owner('A'), vec![owner('B')]);
    k.hub.friends(V(1), owner('B'), vec![owner('A')]);
    let two = |name| HelloOpts { links: 2, ..seat2(name) };
    let one = |name| HelloOpts { links: 2, ..seat1(name) };
    put(&mut k, V(0), P1, 100, &one(b"Alex"), Some('A'), [0.25, 0.25]);
    put(&mut k, V(0), P2, 200, &two(b"Alex 2"), Some('A'), [3.25, 0.25]);
    put(&mut k, V(1), P1, 101, &one(b"Bravo"), Some('B'), [2000.25, 0.25]);
    for i in 2..=5 {
        put(&mut k, V(i), P1, 100 + i, &one(b"x"), None, [i as f64 + 3.25, 0.25]);
    }
    k.hub.tick();
    let l = k.lists();
    assert!(linked(&l, (V(0), P1), (V(1), P1)), "player 1's friend far off: linked first");
    assert!(!linked(&l, (V(0), P2), (V(1), P1)), "player 2's links are by distance");
    // the marks: Bravo near both of them
    let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions::default());
    k.hub.friends(V(0), owner('A'), vec![owner('B')]);
    k.hub.friends(V(1), owner('B'), vec![owner('A')]);
    put(&mut k, V(0), P1, 100, &seat1(b"Alex"), Some('A'), [0.25, 0.25]);
    put(&mut k, V(0), P2, 200, &seat2(b"Alex 2"), Some('A'), [3.25, 0.25]);
    put(&mut k, V(1), P1, 101, &seat1(b"Bravo"), Some('B'), [1.25, 1.25]);
    k.hub.tick();
    let sent = k.sent.lock().clone();
    let list = |vip: u32, port: u16| {
        let f = sent.iter().find(|(v, f)| *v == vip && u16::from_be_bytes([f[14], f[15]]) == port).unwrap().1.clone();
        let m = crew_marks(&f);
        peers_of(&f).iter().enumerate().map(|(at, e)| ((e.vip, e.port), m.as_ref().map_or(0, |m| m.1[at]))).collect::<HashMap<_, _>>()
    };
    let bravo = list(V(1), P1);
    assert_eq!((bravo[&(V(0), P1)], bravo[&(V(0), P2)]), (MARK_FRIEND, 0), "Bravo's list: player 1 a friend, player 2 not");
    assert_eq!(list(V(0), P1)[&(V(1), P1)], MARK_FRIEND, "player 1's: Bravo");
    assert!(list(V(0), P2).values().all(|&m| m == 0), "player 2's: nobody");
    // whereabouts: player 1's room, player 2 in another
    let red = fnv1a("red");
    put(&mut k, V(0), P2, 200, &HelloOpts { room: red, ..seat2(b"Alex 2") }, Some('A'), [3.25, 0.25]);
    k.hub.tick();
    assert_eq!(k.hub.whereabouts(&[owner('A')])[0].as_ref().map(|w| w.room), Some(0));
}

// the console: a second player under the second form of its page's name (or of its keyphrase's claim) is its own line;
// a game that shows another name, a name like it without the flag, or the flag with another name: "its game shows"
#[test]
fn a_known_second_player_is_a_line_of_its_own() {
    let claims = Arc::new(Claims::in_memory());
    claims.claim("Charlie", &owner('C'), 1_000_000).unwrap();
    let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions::default());
    k.hub.set_claims(Some(claims));
    let pages = [
        (0, "Alex", "Alex 2", true),
        (1, "Bob", "Bob 2", false),
        (2, "Dan", "Mallory", true),
        (3, "Alex the Great", "Alex_the_Grea 2", true),
    ];
    for (i, page, p2, flag) in pages {
        k.hub.page_name(V(i), page.into());
        put(&mut k, V(i), P1, 100 + i, &seat1(page.as_bytes()), None, [0.25, 0.25]);
        let h = HelloOpts { flags: if flag { SEAT2 } else { 0 }, ..seat2(p2.as_bytes()) };
        put(&mut k, V(i), P2, 200 + i, &h, None, [3.25, 0.25]);
    }
    // its page goes by digits, its keyphrase's claimed name is Charlie
    k.hub.page_name(V(4), "Charlie1234".into());
    put(&mut k, V(4), P1, 104, &seat1(b"Charlie1234"), Some('C'), [0.25, 0.25]);
    put(&mut k, V(4), P2, 204, &seat2(b"Charlie 2"), Some('C'), [3.25, 0.25]);
    // and again: told once
    put(&mut k, V(0), P2, 200, &seat2(b"Alex 2"), None, [3.25, 0.25]);
    let lines = k.lines.lock().clone();
    let coop: Vec<&String> = lines.iter().filter(|l| l.contains("(co-op)")).collect();
    assert_eq!(
        coop,
        [
            "[roam] 10.77.0.10 \"Alex\": its second player (co-op) shows \"Alex 2\" over its car",
            "[roam] 10.77.0.13 \"Alex the Great\": its second player (co-op) shows \"Alex_the_Grea 2\" over its car",
            "[roam] 10.77.0.14 \"Charlie1234\": its second player (co-op) shows \"Charlie 2\" over its car",
        ]
    );
    let shows: Vec<&String> = lines.iter().filter(|l| l.contains("its game shows")).collect();
    assert_eq!(
        shows,
        [
            "[roam] 10.77.0.11 \"Bob\": its game shows \"Bob 2\" over its car",
            "[roam] 10.77.0.12 \"Dan\": its game shows \"Mallory\" over its car",
        ]
    );
    // who: the second players' names, as every other name its game shows
    let who = k.hub.other_names();
    assert_eq!(who[&V(0)], ["Alex 2"]);
    assert_eq!(who[&V(4)], ["Charlie 2"]);
}

/// Ann (V(0) player 1) parked at (1000, 0, 0) and a second endpoint of hers (`flags`, `port`) at the origin, a SNAP of
/// each 500 ms ago; Bob (V(1)) far off
fn ann_and(port: u16, flags: u16) -> Kit {
    let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions::default());
    let h = |name: &'static [u8], flags| HelloOpts { core: 12, room: fnv1a("bay"), name, flags, ..Default::default() };
    send(&mut k, V(0), P1, &hello_with(100, &h(b"Ann", 0)), None);
    send(&mut k, V(0), port, &hello_with(200, &h(b"Ann 2", flags)), None);
    send(&mut k, V(1), P1, &hello_with(101, &h(b"Bob", 0)), None);
    send(&mut k, V(0), P1, &snap(100, [1000.0, 0.0, 0.0]), None);
    send(&mut k, V(0), port, &snap(200, [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]), None);
    send(&mut k, V(1), P1, &snap(101, [-3000.0, 0.0, 0.0]), None);
    k.step(500.0);
    send(&mut k, V(0), P1, &snap(100, [1000.0, 0.0, 0.0]), None);
    k
}

fn cheats(k: &Kit) -> Vec<String> {
    k.lines.lock().iter().filter(|l| l.starts_with("[cheat]")).cloned().collect()
}

// player 2's car put beside player 1's, 1 km from where it was: no teleport, and none adds up from it; 2 km on from
// there, beside nobody, a teleport; and a jump beside player 1 of an endpoint without the flag, one 100 m off it, and
// one beside another flagged endpoint (no player 1), are teleports as ever
#[test]
fn a_second_player_put_beside_its_first_is_no_teleport() {
    let mut k = ann_and(P2, SEAT2);
    send(&mut k, V(0), P2, &snap(200, [1010.0, 5.0, 0.0]), None);
    k.step(500.0);
    send(&mut k, V(0), P2, &snap(200, [1015.0, 5.0, 0.0]), None);
    assert_eq!(cheats(&k), Vec::<String>::new());
    k.step(500.0);
    send(&mut k, V(0), P2, &snap(200, [3015.0, 5.0, 0.0]), None);
    let l = cheats(&k);
    assert!(l.len() == 1 && l[0].starts_with("[cheat] 10.77.0.10 \"Ann 2\": teleport 1: 2.0 km"), "{l:?}");
    // the same jump of an endpoint without the flag; one 100 m off player 1
    for (port, flags, to) in [(47212, 0, [1010.0, 5.0, 0.0]), (P2, SEAT2, [1100.0, 0.0, 0.0])] {
        let mut k = ann_and(port, flags);
        send(&mut k, V(0), port, &snap(200, to), None);
        let l = cheats(&k);
        assert!(l.len() == 1 && l[0].starts_with("[cheat] 10.77.0.10 \"Ann 2\": teleport 1"), "port {port}: {l:?}");
    }
    // two flagged endpoints: neither is a first player
    let mut k = ann_and(P2, SEAT2);
    let h = HelloOpts { core: 12, room: fnv1a("bay"), name: b"Ann", flags: SEAT2, ..Default::default() };
    send(&mut k, V(0), P1, &hello_with(100, &h), None);
    send(&mut k, V(0), P2, &snap(200, [1010.0, 5.0, 0.0]), None);
    assert_eq!(cheats(&k).len(), 1, "{:?}", cheats(&k));
}

// another page blocks player 2 by its name: as a claimed name's, its owner is blocked, both players (and player 1's
// name blocks player 2, its keyphrase's)
#[test]
fn a_block_of_a_second_players_name_blocks_its_owner() {
    let claims = Arc::new(Claims::in_memory());
    claims.claim("Alex", &owner('A'), 1_000_000).unwrap();
    for blocked in ["Alex 2", "Alex"] {
        let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions::default());
        k.hub.set_claims(Some(claims.clone()));
        k.hub.blocks(V(1), vec![blocked.to_string()]);
        put(&mut k, V(0), P1, 100, &seat1(b"Alex"), Some('A'), [0.25, 0.25]);
        put(&mut k, V(0), P2, 200, &seat2(b"Alex 2"), Some('A'), [3.25, 0.25]);
        put(&mut k, V(1), P1, 101, &seat1(b"Blocker"), Some('B'), [6.25, 0.25]);
        put(&mut k, V(2), P1, 102, &seat1(b"Other"), None, [9.25, 0.25]);
        k.hub.tick();
        let l = k.lists();
        assert!(!linked(&l, (V(1), P1), (V(0), P1)) && !linked(&l, (V(1), P1), (V(0), P2)), "{blocked} blocked");
        assert!(linked(&l, (V(2), P1), (V(0), P1)) && linked(&l, (V(2), P1), (V(0), P2)), "{blocked}: the others see both");
    }
}

// The 2026-11-05 security audit's case: "Speedracer123" (V) and "Speedracer123x" (A), claims of before that share one
// second form, "Speedracer123 2" (a claim of the second now is refused: nfsu2-claims).  It is V's only, the holder of
// the name of 13: A's player under it is an impostor, linked with nobody, and a block of it blocks V (its second
// player's name), never A's player under A's own claim.
#[test]
fn a_second_form_two_claims_share_is_one_keyphrases() {
    let t0 = 1_000_000;
    let dir = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("nfsu2-roam-coop-{}", std::process::id()));
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();
    let claim = |name: &str, c: char, made: i64| format!(r#"{{"name":"{name}","owner":"{}","made":{made},"seen":{made}}}"#, owner(c));
    let file = format!(r#"{{"v":1,"claims":[{},{}]}}"#, claim("Speedracer123x", 'A', t0), claim("Speedracer123", 'V', t0 + 1));
    std::fs::write(dir.join("names.json"), file).unwrap();
    let claims = Arc::new(Claims::open(&dir, t0 + 2));
    std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(claims.count(t0 + 2), 2);
    for block in [false, true] {
        let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions::default());
        k.hub.set_claims(Some(claims.clone()));
        if block {
            k.hub.blocks(V(0), vec!["Speedracer123 2".into()]);
        }
        put(&mut k, V(0), P1, 100, &seat1(b"Watcher"), None, [0.25, 0.25]);
        put(&mut k, V(1), P1, 101, &seat1(b"Speedracer123"), Some('V'), [10.25, 0.25]);
        put(&mut k, V(2), P1, 102, &seat1(b"Speedracer123x"), Some('A'), [20.25, 0.25]);
        put(&mut k, V(3), P1, 103, &seat1(b"Speedracer123 2"), Some('A'), [30.25, 0.25]);
        k.hub.tick();
        let l = k.lists();
        assert!(!linked(&l, (V(0), P1), (V(3), P1)), "block {block}: A under V's second form, an impostor");
        assert!(linked(&l, (V(0), P1), (V(2), P1)), "block {block}: A under its own claim");
        assert_eq!(linked(&l, (V(0), P1), (V(1), P1)), !block, "block {block}: V, the second form's owner");
    }
}

// /players counts a browser once, its second player too; info() counts the second players in free roam
#[test]
fn a_second_player_counts_as_its_browser() {
    let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions::default());
    put(&mut k, V(0), P1, 100, &seat1(b"Alex"), None, [0.25, 0.25]);
    put(&mut k, V(0), P2, 200, &seat2(b"Alex 2"), None, [3.25, 0.25]);
    put(&mut k, V(1), P1, 101, &seat1(b"Bravo"), None, [6.25, 0.25]);
    assert_eq!((k.hub.in_roam(), k.info("players"), k.info("coopSeats")), (2, 3.0, 1.0));

}

// a full hub (24576 endpoints: the switch's 24000 places, nearly all of which can be in free roam, and co-op's second
// players), 2000 coming as others go: the 24577th is refused.  A world map names each player it shows by a key of its
// own, under 16384, the most a parked map's key names (one past it read as another one's, parked): with everyone
// driving the keys run out (the first 16384 have one, the others show on no map), each leaver's goes to a newcomer, the
// new ones' map shows each of them once, and a key one gives back (to the menus) goes to the next player shown
#[test]
fn a_full_hub_keeps_every_maps_key_under_16384() {
    let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions::default());
    let v = |i: u32| 0x0A4D_0100 + i;
    for i in 0..24576u32 {
        k.from(v(i), &hello(1000 + i));
    }
    k.from(v(25_000), &hello(99));
    assert_eq!((k.info("players"), k.info("refused")), (24576.0, 1.0));
    assert_eq!(k.info("mapKeys"), 16384.0, "every key handed out");
    let late = fnv1a("late");
    for n in 0..2000u32 {
        k.from(v(n), &bye(1000 + n));
        let (vip, id) = (v(30_000 + n), 50_000 + n);
        k.from(vip, &hello_with(id, &HelloOpts { room: late, ..Default::default() }));
        k.from(vip, &snap(id, [(n % 50) as f64 * 20.0, (n / 50) as f64 * 20.0, 0.0]));
    }
    assert_eq!(k.info("players"), 24576.0);
    assert_eq!(k.info("mapKeys"), 16384.0, "each leaver's key to a newcomer");
    k.clear();
    // the world map of one of them, with who is parked and heights (the game's), as wide as it takes
    k.from(v(30_000), &mapreq_flags(50_000, 1, 4096, 0, 1 | 2));
    let keys: Vec<u16> = answers(&k).iter().flat_map(|(_, m, _)| m.5.iter().map(|e| e.0)).collect();
    assert_eq!(keys.len(), 1999, "the room's others");
    assert!(keys.iter().all(|&s| s < 0x4000), "a key past 16383: {:?}", keys.iter().filter(|&&s| s >= 0x4000).take(3).collect::<Vec<_>>());
    assert_eq!(keys.iter().collect::<HashSet<_>>().len(), 1999, "each once");
    // one of them goes to the menus: its key goes back, and a player without one takes it at its next SNAP
    k.from(v(30_001), &snap_n(50_001, [20.0, 0.0, 0.0], 0, 1));
    assert_eq!(k.info("mapKeys"), 16383.0, "a key back");
    k.from(v(20_000), &snap(21_000, [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]));
    assert_eq!(k.info("mapKeys"), 16384.0, "taken by the next one shown");
}

//! Crews (roam_core.h RC_HF_CREW): a player's HELLO names its crews (a word each, up to 4, by roam_core's room hash),
//! the hub links two crew-mates of one room before the other links, and /players counts each crew's players.
//! 1. the wire: a HELLO of before parses as it did; one with the flag names 0 to 4 crews after its ids, and what
//!    comes after them is skipped; a count past 4, a crew 0 or a short one is a bad HELLO;
//! 2. the links (every pair | the grid | a room past exactRoom): a crew-mate 2 km off a crowd is linked, under the
//!    busy cap too, and one of another crew or another room is not; at most 16 crew links a player, the nearest, kept
//!    while the crew drives about; a crew of 65 in one room is no reason for a link;
//! 3. the counts: the browsers in free roam or paused there, by crew, in any room, a browser once; on the hub's thread
//!    as of its last tick;
//! 4. the lists' crew marks: a player in a crew learns which of its peers share one of its crews, and no other
//!    player's crews; a player in no crew gets a plain list.

mod kit;

use std::collections::HashSet;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

use bytes::Bytes;
use kit::*;
use nfsu2_roam::{RoamHub, RoamMsg, RoamOptions, decode_roam, encode_peers};
use nfsu2_util::{FrameCtx, Host};

/// a HELLO as roam_core.c lays it out (core version 7, in free roam, room "blue", named "p") with these header flags:
/// its count of ids, the ids, then `tail` as it is
fn hello_raw(flags: u16, n_seen: u8, seen: &[u32], tail: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut p = vec![0u8; 12];
    p[0..2].copy_from_slice(&7u16.to_le_bytes());
    p[2] = 1;
    p[3] = 2;
    p[4..6].copy_from_slice(&47210u16.to_le_bytes());
    p[6..8].copy_from_slice(&3u16.to_le_bytes());
    p[8..12].copy_from_slice(&fnv1a("blue").to_le_bytes());
    p.extend_from_slice(&[1, b'p', n_seen]);
    for s in seen {
        p.extend_from_slice(&s.to_le_bytes());
    }
    p.extend_from_slice(tail);
    dgram_flags(1, 0x77, flags, &p)
}

/// what a HELLO ends with after its ids: a count, then hashes
fn tail(n: u8, crews: &[u32]) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut t = vec![n];
    for c in crews {
        t.extend_from_slice(&c.to_le_bytes());
    }
    t
}

/// the crews a datagram's HELLO names (None: no datagram)
fn crews_in(d: &[u8]) -> Option<Vec<u32>> {
    match decode_roam(d)? {
        RoamMsg::Hello { crews, .. } => Some(crews),
        m => panic!("not a HELLO: {m:?}"),
    }
}

// the wire: a HELLO of before (no flag) parses as before, whatever follows its ids; with the flag, 0 to 4 crews after
// its ids (or nothing), what comes after them skipped; a count past 4, a crew 0, crews or ids cut short, or more ids
// than roam_core takes, is a bad HELLO
#[test]
fn the_wire_a_hello_names_its_crews_after_its_ids() {
    let (a, b, c, d) = (fnv1a("bluebirds"), fnv1a("owls"), 7, 0xFFFF_FFFF);
    let ids = [0x11, 0x22];
    assert_eq!(crews_in(&hello_raw(0, 2, &ids, &[])), Some(vec![]), "a HELLO of before");
    assert_eq!(crews_in(&hello_raw(0, 2, &ids, &tail(9, &[0]))), Some(vec![]), "without the flag: what follows its ids is not read");
    assert_eq!(crews_in(&hello_raw(0, 9, &ids, &[])), Some(vec![]), "without the flag: ids cut short, as before");
    assert_eq!(crews_in(&hello_raw(0, 40, &[1; 40], &[])), Some(vec![]), "without the flag: 40 ids, as before");
    assert_eq!(crews_in(&hello_with(0x77, &HelloOpts { seen: &ids, ..Default::default() })), Some(vec![]), "the kit's HELLO of before");
    assert_eq!(crews_in(&hello_raw(HF_CREW, 2, &ids, &[])), Some(vec![]), "the flag, nothing after its ids");
    assert_eq!(crews_in(&hello_raw(HF_CREW, 0, &[], &[])), Some(vec![]), "the flag, no ids, nothing after them");
    // quick chat's flag (roam_core.h RC_HF_SAY, the bit below the crews'): bytes after its ids are not crews
    assert_eq!(crews_in(&hello_raw(0x0100, 2, &ids, &tail(1, &[0x1234]))), Some(vec![]), "RC_HF_SAY is not the crew flag");
    for crews in [&[][..], &[a], &[a, b], &[d, c, b], &[a, b, c, d], &[b, b]] {
        let want = Some(crews.to_vec());
        assert_eq!(crews_in(&hello_raw(HF_CREW, 2, &ids, &tail(crews.len() as u8, crews))), want, "{crews:?}");
        assert_eq!(crews_in(&hello_raw(HF_CREW | 0x0080, 0, &[], &tail(crews.len() as u8, crews))), want, "no ids: {crews:?}");
        let mut more = tail(crews.len() as u8, crews);
        more.extend_from_slice(&[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]);
        assert_eq!(crews_in(&hello_raw(HF_CREW, 2, &ids, &more)), want, "what follows its crews skipped: {crews:?}");
        let opts = HelloOpts { seen: &ids, crews: Some(crews), ..Default::default() };
        assert_eq!(crews_in(&hello_with(0x77, &opts)), want, "the kit's: {crews:?}");
    }
    for (what, h) in [
        ("5 crews", hello_raw(HF_CREW, 2, &ids, &tail(5, &[a, b, c, d, 9]))),
        ("a count of 255", hello_raw(HF_CREW, 2, &ids, &tail(255, &[a]))),
        ("a crew 0", hello_raw(HF_CREW, 2, &ids, &tail(2, &[a, 0]))),
        ("crews cut short", hello_raw(HF_CREW, 2, &ids, &tail(2, &[a]))),
        ("a crew cut short", hello_raw(HF_CREW, 2, &ids, &tail(1, &[a])[..3])),
        ("ids cut short", hello_raw(HF_CREW, 3, &ids, &[])),
        ("65 ids", hello_raw(HF_CREW, 65, &[1; 65], &tail(1, &[a]))),
    ] {
        assert_eq!(crews_in(&h), None, "{what}: a bad HELLO");
    }
    // the hub counts it bad, and takes no player of it
    let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions::default());
    k.from(V(0), &hello_raw(HF_CREW, 2, &ids, &tail(2, &[a, 0])));
    assert_eq!((k.info("bad"), k.info("players")), (1.0, 0.0));
    k.from(V(0), &hello_raw(HF_CREW, 2, &ids, &tail(2, &[a, b])));
    assert_eq!((k.info("bad"), k.info("players")), (1.0, 1.0));
}

// the lists' crew marks: to a player in a crew, its own crews, then a mark a link, bit c: that player is in its crew c
// too; a player in no crew gets a plain list, byte for byte; and no list carries a crew of anyone but its receiver
#[test]
fn the_lists_mark_crew_mates_and_name_no_other_crews() {
    let (x, y, z, w) = (fnv1a("bluebirds"), fnv1a("owls"), fnv1a("hawks"), fnv1a("wrens"));
    for (how, o) in ways() {
        let mut k = Kit::new(o);
        // A (x, y), B (y, z), C (z, x), D in no crew, E (z, w): all within 40 m, so all linked
        let who: [Option<&[u32]>; 5] = [Some(&[x, y]), Some(&[y, z]), Some(&[z, x]), None, Some(&[z, w])];
        for (i, &crews) in who.iter().enumerate() {
            let i = i as u32;
            k.from(V(i), &hello_with(100 + i, &HelloOpts { crews, ..Default::default() }));
            k.from(V(i), &snap(100 + i, [i as f64 * 10.0 + 0.25, 0.25, 0.0]));
        }
        k.hub.tick();
        let sent = k.sent.lock().clone();
        let of =
            |i: u32| sent.iter().find(|(vip, _)| *vip == V(i)).map(|(_, f)| f.clone()).unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("{how}: a list to {i}"));
        let mark = |i: u32, j: u32| {
            let f = of(i);
            let at = peers_of(&f).iter().position(|e| e.vip == V(j)).unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("{how}: {j} on {i}'s list"));
            crew_marks(&f).unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("{how}: marks on {i}'s list")).1[at]
        };
        for i in 0..5 {
            assert_eq!(peers_of(&of(i)).len(), 4, "{how}: {i} linked with the 4 others");
        }
        assert_eq!(crew_marks(&of(0)).map(|m| m.0), Some(vec![x, y]), "{how}: A's own crews");
        assert_eq!([mark(0, 1), mark(0, 2), mark(0, 3), mark(0, 4)], [0b10, 0b01, 0, 0], "{how}: B in y, C in x");
        assert_eq!(crew_marks(&of(1)).map(|m| m.0), Some(vec![y, z]), "{how}: B's own crews");
        assert_eq!([mark(1, 0), mark(1, 2), mark(1, 3), mark(1, 4)], [0b01, 0b10, 0, 0b10], "{how}: A in y, C and E in z");
        assert_eq!(crew_marks(&of(2)).map(|m| m.0), Some(vec![z, x]), "{how}: C's own crews");
        assert_eq!([mark(2, 0), mark(2, 1), mark(2, 3), mark(2, 4)], [0b10, 0b01, 0, 0b01], "{how}: A in x, B and E in z");
        assert_eq!([mark(4, 0), mark(4, 1), mark(4, 2), mark(4, 3)], [0, 0b01, 0b01, 0], "{how}: E (z, w): B and C in z");
        let f = of(3);
        assert_eq!(crew_marks(&f), None, "{how}: in no crew: no marks");
        assert_eq!(
            &f[16..],
            &encode_peers(0xB0B, u16::from_le_bytes([f[28], f[29]]), &peers_of(&f))[..],
            "{how}: in no crew: a plain list"
        );
        // no crew of anyone but the receiver in its datagram (C's x and z are A's and B's too: w is E's alone)
        let has = |f: &[u8], h: u32| f.windows(4).any(|b| b == h.to_le_bytes());
        for i in 0..4 {
            assert!(!has(&of(i)[16..], w), "{how}: E's crew w on {i}'s list");
        }
        assert!(!has(&of(0)[16..], z) && !has(&of(3)[16..], x) && !has(&of(2)[16..], y), "{how}: no crews but its own");
    }
}

/// a player of core version 7 at (x, y), with these crews (None: a HELLO of before), its HELLO and its SNAP
fn put(k: &mut Kit, vip: u32, id: u32, room: u32, crews: Option<&[u32]>, at: [f64; 2]) {
    k.from(vip, &hello_with(id, &HelloOpts { core: 6, room, crews, ..Default::default() }));
    k.from(vip, &snap(id, [at[0], at[1], 0.0]));
}

/// player i's address, for more players than V's: 10.77.1.0 and on
#[allow(non_snake_case)]
fn U(i: u32) -> u32 {
    0x0A4D_0100 + i
}

/// whether players a and b (addresses) are linked, checked at both ends
fn linked(k: &Kit, a: u32, b: u32) -> bool {
    let l = k.lists();
    let has = |x: u32, y: u32| l.get(&format!("{x}:47210")).is_some_and(|v| v.iter().any(|e| e.vip == y));
    assert_eq!(has(a, b), has(b, a), "a link is listed at both ends");
    has(a, b)
}

/// the ways a room is linked: every pair (a room of at most exactRoom), the grid (exactRoom 1), and the grid for a
/// room larger than exactRoom (300 players), with the crowd's size each; without view points (the cars point along x)
fn crowds() -> [(&'static str, RoamOptions, u32); 3] {
    let o = RoamOptions { view_m: 1e-9, ..RoamOptions::default() };
    [("every pair", o.clone(), 60), ("the grid", RoamOptions { exact_room: 1, ..o.clone() }, 60), ("a room past exactRoom", o, 300)]
}

/// A crowd: player 0 (A, crews `a`) and `n` players around it within 50 m (lattice points 3 m apart, HELLOs without
/// crews), and B, 2 km off, crews `b`, in `b_room`: their HELLOs and SNAPs
fn crowd(k: &mut Kit, n: u32, a: &[u32], b: &[u32], b_room: u32) {
    put(k, U(0), 1000, 0, Some(a), [0.25, 0.25]);
    let side = (n as f64).sqrt().ceil() as u32;
    for i in 1..=n {
        let (x, y) = (((i - 1) % side) as f64 * 3.0, ((i - 1) / side) as f64 * 3.0);
        let half = (side - 1) as f64 * 1.5;
        put(k, U(i), 1000 + i, 0, None, [x - half + 1.25, y - half + 1.25]);
    }
    put(k, U(n + 1), 1000 + n + 1, b_room, Some(b), [2000.25, 0.25]);
}

// a crew-mate 2 km off a crowd (60 | 300 players packed around A, who has 32 nearer players) is linked with A, in one
// of its crews or in all; one in no crew of A's is not, nor a crew-mate in another room
#[test]
fn a_crew_mate_far_off_a_crowd_is_linked_first() {
    let (x, y, z) = (fnv1a("bluebirds"), fnv1a("owls"), fnv1a("hawks"));
    for (how, o, n) in crowds() {
        let b = U(n + 1);
        for (crews_a, crews_b, b_room, want) in [
            (&[x][..], &[y, x][..], 0, true),
            (&[x, z], &[z, y], 0, true),
            (&[x], &[x], 0, true),
            (&[x], &[y], 0, false),
            (&[], &[x], 0, false),
            (&[x], &[x], fnv1a("red"), false),
        ] {
            let what = format!("{how}: A {crews_a:?}, B {crews_b:?} in room {b_room}");
            let mut k = Kit::new(o.clone());
            crowd(&mut k, n, crews_a, crews_b, b_room);
            k.hub.tick();
            assert_eq!(linked(&k, U(0), b), want, "{what}");
            assert_eq!(k.info("crewLinks"), if want { 1.0 } else { 0.0 }, "{what}");
            assert_eq!(k.lists()[&format!("{}:47210", U(0))].len(), 32, "{what}: A's links are full");
        }
        // B leaves the crew (a HELLO without it), and at the next tick (the link's hold over) it is linked no more
        let mut k = Kit::new(o.clone());
        crowd(&mut k, n, &[x], &[x], 0);
        k.hub.tick();
        assert!(linked(&k, U(0), b), "{how}");
        for _ in 0..6 {
            k.step(1000.0);
            crowd(&mut k, n, &[x], &[y], 0);
            k.clear();
            k.hub.tick();
        }
        assert!(!linked(&k, U(0), b), "{how}: B left the crew");
        assert_eq!(k.info("crewLinks"), 0.0, "{how}");
    }
}

// under the busy cap (8 links a player) a crew-mate 2 km off the crowd is still linked
#[test]
fn a_crew_mate_far_off_is_linked_under_the_busy_cap() {
    let x = fnv1a("bluebirds");
    for (how, o, n) in crowds() {
        let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions { cap_down_ms: 1.0, ..o });
        *k.busy.lock() = 0.95;
        // the cap a quarter down each tick: 24, 18, 13, 9, 8
        for _ in 0..6 {
            crowd(&mut k, n, &[x], &[x], 0);
            k.clear();
            k.hub.tick();
            k.step(1000.0);
        }
        assert_eq!(k.info("cap"), 8.0, "{how}");
        assert!(linked(&k, U(0), U(n + 1)), "{how}: linked under the busy cap");
        assert_eq!(k.info("crewLinks"), 1.0, "{how}");
        let l = k.lists();
        assert!(l.values().all(|v| v.len() <= 8), "{how}: 8 links at most");
        assert_eq!(l[&format!("{}:47210", U(0))].len(), 8, "{how}: A's 8 links: B and 7 of the crowd");
    }
}

/// A crew of 20 spread out (members 300 m apart on a line, member m at the `place(m)`-th spot of it), each member
/// with 31 players packed around it (within 3 m: they fill its links once its crew's are in, so its links to
/// crew-mates are its crew links): their HELLOs and SNAPs
fn crew_of_20(k: &mut Kit, crew: u32, place: impl Fn(u32) -> u32) {
    for m in 0..20u32 {
        let x = place(m) as f64 * 300.0 + 0.25;
        put(k, U(m * 32), 5000 + m * 32, 0, Some(&[crew]), [x, 0.25]);
        for s in 1..32u32 {
            let (dx, dy) = ((s % 6) as f64 * 0.5, (s / 6) as f64 * 0.5 + 0.25);
            put(k, U(m * 32 + s), 5000 + m * 32 + s, 0, None, [x + dx, dy]);
        }
    }
}

/// the crew-mates each member of `crew_of_20` is linked with, by member
fn mates_of_20(k: &Kit) -> Vec<HashSet<u32>> {
    let l = k.lists();
    let members: HashSet<u32> = (0..20u32).map(|m| U(m * 32)).collect();
    (0..20u32)
        .map(|m| {
            let mine = &l[&format!("{}:47210", U(m * 32))];
            mine.iter().filter(|e| members.contains(&e.vip)).map(|e| (e.vip - U(0)) / 32).collect()
        })
        .collect()
}

// a crew of 20 spread out: each member gets at most 16 crew links, nearest first (a pair is left out only when one of
// its two has 16 nearer ones), and they stay while the crew drives about
#[test]
fn a_crew_of_20_at_most_16_crew_links_each_the_nearest() {
    let crew = fnv1a("bluebirds");
    let o = RoamOptions { view_m: 1e-9, ..RoamOptions::default() };
    for (how, o) in [("every pair", RoamOptions { exact_room: 1000, ..o.clone() }), ("the grid", RoamOptions { exact_room: 1, ..o })] {
        let mut k = Kit::new(o);
        crew_of_20(&mut k, crew, |m| m);
        k.hub.tick();
        let links = mates_of_20(&k);
        let total: usize = links.iter().map(HashSet::len).sum();
        assert_eq!(k.info("crewLinks"), (total / 2) as f64, "{how}: every crew-mate link is a crew link");
        for (m, l) in links.iter().enumerate() {
            assert!(l.len() <= 16, "{how}: member {m}: {} crew links", l.len());
            for &j in l {
                assert!(links[j as usize].contains(&(m as u32)), "{how}: both ends");
            }
        }
        // the middle ones: their 8 nearest on each side
        for m in [9u32, 10] {
            let want: HashSet<u32> = (m - 8..=m + 8).filter(|&j| j != m && j < 20).collect();
            assert_eq!(links[m as usize], want, "{how}: member {m}");
        }
        // nearest first: a pair left out has an end with 16 nearer (or as near) crew links
        let gap = |a: u32, b: u32| a.abs_diff(b);
        for a in 0..20u32 {
            for b in a + 1..20 {
                if !links[a as usize].contains(&b) {
                    let full = |m: u32| links[m as usize].len() == 16 && links[m as usize].iter().all(|&j| gap(m, j) <= gap(a, b));
                    assert!(full(a) || full(b), "{how}: {a} and {b} not linked: {:?} {:?}", links[a as usize], links[b as usize]);
                }
            }
        }
        // a second later the members are in other places (each one's nearest are others): the same crew links, as
        // links younger than holdMs stay
        k.step(1000.0);
        k.clear();
        crew_of_20(&mut k, crew, |m| m * 7 % 20);
        k.hub.tick();
        assert_eq!(mates_of_20(&k), links, "{how}: kept while the crew drives about");
    }
}

// a crew of 65 players in one room gets no links first (counted in crewSkips), and its players link by distance, the
// first and the last of them (6.4 km apart) as a crew of their own too; one of 64 gets them (and its first and last
// had their 16 crew links nearer)
#[test]
fn a_crew_of_65_in_one_room_gets_no_links_first() {
    let crew = fnv1a("everyone");
    for (how, o) in ways() {
        for (n, skips) in [(64u32, 0.0), (65, 1.0)] {
            let mut k = Kit::new(o.clone());
            for i in 0..n {
                put(&mut k, U(i), 100 + i, 0, Some(&[crew]), [i as f64 * 100.0 + 0.25, 0.25]);
            }
            put(&mut k, U(0), 100, 0, Some(&[crew, 77]), [0.25, 0.25]);
            put(&mut k, U(n - 1), 100 + n - 1, 0, Some(&[77, crew]), [(n - 1) as f64 * 100.0 + 0.25, 0.25]);
            k.hub.tick();
            assert_eq!(k.info("crewSkips"), skips, "{how}: a crew of {n}");
            if n == 64 {
                assert!(k.info("crewLinks") > 400.0, "{how}: a crew of {n}: {} crew links", k.info("crewLinks"));
            } else {
                assert_eq!(k.info("crewLinks"), 1.0, "{how}: a crew of {n}: only the two's");
                assert!(linked(&k, U(0), U(n - 1)), "{how}: a crew of {n}: the two, 6.4 km apart");
            }
        }
    }
}

// players in crews come and go every way (a HELLO without them, BYE, gone from the switch, silent past goneMs, another
// start of the game on the same endpoint): with none left the tick looks for no crews, and the next ones are linked
// first again (every pair | the grid)
#[test]
fn players_in_crews_come_and_go() {
    let x = fnv1a("bluebirds");
    for (how, o, n) in crowds().into_iter().take(2) {
        let mut k = Kit::new(o);
        let (a, b) = (U(0), U(n + 1));
        crowd(&mut k, n, &[x], &[x], 0);
        k.hub.tick();
        assert!(linked(&k, a, b), "{how}");
        // B: a HELLO of before, then back in the crew, then BYE; A: gone from the switch
        k.from(b, &hello_with(1000 + n + 1, &HelloOpts { core: 6, ..Default::default() }));
        k.from(b, &hello_with(1000 + n + 1, &HelloOpts { core: 6, crews: Some(&[x]), ..Default::default() }));
        k.from(b, &bye(1000 + n + 1));
        k.hub.peer_gone(a);
        k.step(1000.0);
        k.clear();
        k.hub.tick();
        assert_eq!((k.info("crewLinks"), k.info("players")), (0.0, n as f64), "{how}");
        // both back, as another start of the game each (a new id on A's endpoint): linked first again
        k.step(1000.0);
        put(&mut k, a, 3000, 0, Some(&[x]), [0.25, 0.25]);
        put(&mut k, b, 3001, 0, Some(&[x]), [2000.25, 0.25]);
        put(&mut k, a, 3002, 0, Some(&[x]), [0.25, 0.25]);
        for i in 1..=n {
            put(&mut k, U(i), 1000 + i, 0, None, [i as f64 % 9.0 * 3.0 - 12.25, (i / 9) as f64 * 3.0 - 12.25]);
        }
        k.clear();
        k.hub.tick();
        assert!(linked(&k, a, b) && k.info("crewLinks") == 1.0, "{how}: back");
        // all of them silent past goneMs: forgotten, and the counts with them
        k.step(7000.0);
        k.hub.tick();
        assert_eq!((k.info("players"), k.hub.in_crews(&[x])[0]), (0.0, 0), "{how}");
        put(&mut k, a, 3003, 0, Some(&[x]), [0.25, 0.25]);
        put(&mut k, b, 3004, 0, Some(&[x]), [2000.25, 0.25]);
        k.clear();
        k.hub.tick();
        assert!(linked(&k, a, b) && k.info("crewLinks") == 1.0, "{how}: two of a crew alone");
    }
}

/// a HELLO of core version 7 in `room`, `status`, with these crews (None: a HELLO of before)
fn hello6(id: u32, room: u32, status: u8, crews: Option<&[u32]>) -> Vec<u8> {
    hello_with(id, &HelloOpts { core: 6, room, status, crews, ..Default::default() })
}

// /players' crews: the browsers in free roam or paused there (not in a race), by crew, in any room, a browser once
// whatever its endpoints and however often it names a crew; a new HELLO replaces a player's crews (one of before,
// none)
#[test]
fn in_free_roam_by_crew() {
    let (a, b, c) = (fnv1a("bluebirds"), fnv1a("owls"), fnv1a("hawks"));
    let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions::default());
    k.from(V(1), &hello6(601, fnv1a("blue"), 2, Some(&[a, b, a])));
    k.from(V(2), &hello6(602, 0, 5, Some(&[a])));
    k.from(V(3), &hello6(603, 0, 3, Some(&[a, b])));
    k.from(V(4), &hello6(604, fnv1a("red"), 2, Some(&[b])));
    k.from(V(5), &hello6(605, 0, 2, None));
    k.hub.frame(V(1), &frame_ports(V(1), &hello6(606, 0, 2, Some(&[a])), 47211, 47210));
    assert_eq!(k.hub.in_crews(&[a, b, c, a]), [2, 2, 0, 2]);
    assert_eq!(k.hub.in_crews(&[]), Vec::<usize>::new());
    assert_eq!(k.hub.in_roam(), 4);
    // 2 leaves its crews with a HELLO of before, 4 changes them, 3 is back from its race
    k.from(V(2), &hello6(602, 0, 5, None));
    k.from(V(4), &hello6(604, fnv1a("red"), 2, Some(&[c])));
    k.from(V(3), &hello6(603, 0, 2, Some(&[a, b])));
    assert_eq!(k.hub.in_crews(&[a, b, c]), [2, 2, 1]);
    k.hub.peer_gone(V(1));
    assert_eq!(k.hub.in_crews(&[a, b, c]), [1, 1, 1]);
}

fn ctx() -> FrameCtx {
    FrameCtx { group: Arc::from("client"), site: None, cause: None, slot: None, owner: None, no_races: false }
}

// on its thread the hub keeps the crews' counts of its last tick for /players
#[test]
fn on_its_thread_the_crews_counts_of_the_last_tick() {
    let (a, b) = (fnv1a("bluebirds"), fnv1a("owls"));
    let hub = RoamHub::spawn(RoamOptions { tick_ms: 20, ..RoamOptions::default() }, Arc::new(|_: &str| {}));
    assert_eq!(hub.in_crews(&[a, b]), [0, 0], "before its first tick");
    let post = |vip: u32, d: Vec<u8>| hub.frame(vip, Bytes::from(frame(vip, &d)), ctx());
    post(V(1), hello_with(701, &HelloOpts { core: 6, crews: Some(&[a, b]), ..Default::default() }));
    post(V(2), hello_with(702, &HelloOpts { core: 6, crews: Some(&[b]), ..Default::default() }));
    let t0 = Instant::now();
    while hub.in_crews(&[b, a, 9]) != [2, 1, 0] {
        assert!(t0.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(5), "{:?}", hub.in_crews(&[b, a, 9]));
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(5));
    }
    hub.peer_gone(V(1));
    let t0 = Instant::now();
    while hub.in_crews(&[b, a]) != [1, 0] {
        assert!(t0.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(5), "{:?}", hub.in_crews(&[b, a]));
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(5));
    }
    hub.stop();
}

//! Outruns between players (runtime/roam_game.c du_*, roam_core.c rc_set_duel): two players who name each other as
//! their outrun's other player in their HELLOs (core version 11) are linked before anyone else, however many players
//! are nearer to either; one player's word alone links nobody; the link goes with the outrun.  By distance alone the
//! one who fell behind went from both screens in a crowd, and both games won.

mod kit;

use kit::*;
use nfsu2_roam::RoamOptions;

/// the hub's last list to the player at V(i) names the one at V(j)
fn linked(k: &Kit, i: u32, j: u32) -> bool {
    k.lists().get(&format!("{}:47210", V(i))).is_some_and(|l| l.iter().any(|e| e.vip == V(j)))
}

fn links_of(k: &Kit, i: u32) -> usize {
    k.lists().get(&format!("{}:47210", V(i))).map_or(0, |l| l.len())
}

/// A (V(0), id 100) at the origin and B (V(1), id 101) 100 m off, each naming its outrun's other player (0: none), and 60
/// players within 12 m round B (ids 102..): every one of B's 32 nearest is nearer than A, and some 30 of A's are nearer
/// than B.  Everyone's HELLO and SNAP again (a tick later on, after gone_ms, still sees them all).
fn crowd(k: &mut Kit, duel_a: u32, duel_b: u32) {
    k.from(V(0), &hello_with(100, &HelloOpts { core: 11, links: 32, duel: duel_a, ..Default::default() }));
    k.from(V(0), &snap(100, [0.25, 0.25, 0.0]));
    k.from(V(1), &hello_with(101, &HelloOpts { core: 11, links: 32, duel: duel_b, name: b"Bob", ..Default::default() }));
    k.from(V(1), &snap(101, [100.25, 0.25, 0.0]));
    for i in 2..62u32 {
        k.from(V(i), &hello_with(100 + i, &HelloOpts { core: 10, links: 32, ..Default::default() }));
        k.from(V(i), &snap(100 + i, [100.25 + ((i - 2) % 8) as f64 * 3.0 - 10.5, ((i - 2) / 8) as f64 * 3.0 - 10.5, 0.0]));
    }
}

// the two who name each other are linked, the crowd nearer to both however (every pair | the grid); without the
// outrun they are not; each still has its 32 links at most, both ends list each other
#[test]
fn an_outruns_two_players_are_linked_first_whatever_the_crowd() {
    for (how, o) in ways() {
        let mut k = Kit::new(o.clone());
        crowd(&mut k, 0, 0);
        k.hub.tick();
        assert!(!linked(&k, 0, 1) && !linked(&k, 1, 0), "{how}: no outrun, the crowd's nearer: not linked");
        assert_eq!(k.info("duelLinks"), 0.0);

        let mut k = Kit::new(o.clone());
        crowd(&mut k, 101, 100);
        k.hub.tick();
        assert!(linked(&k, 0, 1) && linked(&k, 1, 0), "{how}: the outrun's two linked, both ends");
        // (A, out of the crowd, gets what the crowd's own leave: a few)
        assert!(
            links_of(&k, 0) <= 32 && links_of(&k, 1) == 32,
            "{how}: 32 links at most, the outrun's one of them ({}, {})",
            links_of(&k, 0),
            links_of(&k, 1)
        );
        assert_eq!(k.info("duelLinks"), 1.0, "{how}");
        // under the busy cap (8 links a player): still linked
        *k.busy.lock() = 0.95;
        for _ in 0..12 {
            k.step(5_000.0);
            crowd(&mut k, 101, 100);
            k.clear();
            k.hub.tick();
        }
        assert!(k.info("cap") <= 8.0, "{how}: the busy cap down ({})", k.info("cap"));
        assert!(linked(&k, 0, 1) && linked(&k, 1, 0) && links_of(&k, 1) <= 8, "{how}: under the busy cap, still linked");
    }
}

// one player's word links nobody: A names B, and B names nobody, or another player (who names nobody); a far player
// who names A back is linked, 2 km off
#[test]
fn one_players_word_alone_links_nobody() {
    for (how, o) in ways() {
        for b in [0, 102] {
            let mut k = Kit::new(o.clone());
            crowd(&mut k, 101, b);
            k.hub.tick();
            assert!(!linked(&k, 0, 1), "{how}: A names B, B names {b}: not linked");
            assert_eq!(k.info("duelLinks"), 0.0, "{how}");
        }
        let mut k = Kit::new(o.clone());
        crowd(&mut k, 162, 0);
        k.from(V(62), &hello_with(162, &HelloOpts { core: 11, links: 32, duel: 100, ..Default::default() }));
        k.from(V(62), &snap(162, [2000.25, 0.25, 0.0]));
        k.hub.tick();
        assert!(linked(&k, 0, 62) && linked(&k, 62, 0), "{how}: the two naming each other, 2 km apart: linked");
    }
}

// the link goes with the outrun: once neither names the other, it is kept as any link (hold_ms young, then at `keep`
// its distance) and goes for the crowd
#[test]
fn the_link_goes_with_the_outrun() {
    for (how, o) in ways() {
        let mut k = Kit::new(o.clone());
        crowd(&mut k, 101, 100);
        k.hub.tick();
        assert!(linked(&k, 0, 1), "{how}: linked in the outrun");
        k.step(1_000.0);
        crowd(&mut k, 0, 0);
        k.clear();
        k.hub.tick();
        assert!(linked(&k, 0, 1), "{how}: a second on, a young link: kept");
        assert_eq!(k.info("duelLinks"), 0.0, "{how}");
        k.step(o.hold_ms);
        crowd(&mut k, 0, 0);
        k.clear();
        k.hub.tick();
        assert!(!linked(&k, 0, 1) && !linked(&k, 1, 0), "{how}: past hold_ms, the crowd's nearer: gone");
    }
}

// a pair of the outrun kept apart (A blocks B's name) is no link: the blocks come first
#[test]
fn a_blocked_player_is_no_outruns_link() {
    let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions { view_m: 1e-9, ..RoamOptions::default() });
    k.hub.blocks(V(0), vec!["bob".into()]);
    crowd(&mut k, 101, 100);
    k.hub.tick();
    assert!(!linked(&k, 0, 1) && !linked(&k, 1, 0), "kept apart");
}

//! Friends in free roam (the server's friends.rs): the server tells the hub each page's friends (their keyphrases),
//! and the hub links two friends of one room first, as two crew-mates, while each one's list names the other; a page
//! may ask to befriend only a player it is linked with; and its friends find where it plays.
//! 1. the links: a friend 2 km off a crowd is linked, in any way a room is linked; one whose list does not name the
//!    other back is not, nor a friend in another room, nor one without a keyphrase;
//! 2. linked_with: the player of that name (its Online form) that the page's player is linked with, its car within
//!    30 m, with its browser and keyphrase (if its page has one); none farther, linked or not;
//! 3. whereabouts: by keyphrase, the room and its name as the page told it; none for one not in free roam;
//! 4. the lists' friend marks: a player with friends whose core reads the hub's marks has its friends marked on its
//!    lists (MARK_FRIEND, with a crew-mate's bits where it is one), a one-way friend not; one of an older core gets a
//!    plain list.

mod kit;

use std::sync::Arc;

use kit::*;
use nfsu2_claims::owner_of_token;
use nfsu2_roam::{RoamOptions, Whereabouts, encode_peers};

fn owner(c: char) -> Arc<str> {
    owner_of_token(&c.to_string().repeat(43)).unwrap()
}

/// player i's address, for more players than V's: 10.77.1.0 and on
#[allow(non_snake_case)]
fn U(i: u32) -> u32 {
    0x0A4D_0100 + i
}

/// a player named `name`, of keyphrase `key` (None: none), at (x, y) in `room`: its HELLO and SNAP
fn put(k: &mut Kit, vip: u32, id: u32, room: u32, name: &[u8], key: Option<char>, at: [f64; 2]) {
    put_with(k, vip, id, &HelloOpts { core: 6, room, name, ..Default::default() }, key, at);
}

fn put_with(k: &mut Kit, vip: u32, id: u32, h: &HelloOpts, key: Option<char>, at: [f64; 2]) {
    let o = key.map(owner);
    k.hub.frame_from(vip, &frame(vip, &hello_with(id, h)), o.as_ref());
    k.hub.frame_from(vip, &frame(vip, &snap(id, [at[0], at[1], 0.0])), o.as_ref());
}

fn linked(k: &Kit, a: u32, b: u32) -> bool {
    let l = k.lists();
    let has = |x: u32, y: u32| l.get(&format!("{x}:47210")).is_some_and(|v| v.iter().any(|e| e.vip == y));
    assert_eq!(has(a, b), has(b, a), "a link is listed at both ends");
    has(a, b)
}

fn ways() -> [(&'static str, RoamOptions, u32); 3] {
    let o = RoamOptions { view_m: 1e-9, ..RoamOptions::default() };
    [("every pair", o.clone(), 60), ("the grid", RoamOptions { exact_room: 1, ..o.clone() }, 60), ("a room past exactRoom", o, 300)]
}

/// A (keyphrase 'A') with `n` players packed around it, and B (keyphrase `b_key`) 2 km off, in `b_room`
fn crowd(k: &mut Kit, n: u32, b_key: Option<char>, b_room: u32) {
    put(k, U(0), 1000, 0, b"Alpha", Some('A'), [0.25, 0.25]);
    let side = (n as f64).sqrt().ceil() as u32;
    for i in 1..=n {
        let (x, y) = (((i - 1) % side) as f64 * 3.0, ((i - 1) / side) as f64 * 3.0);
        let half = (side - 1) as f64 * 1.5;
        put(k, U(i), 1000 + i, 0, format!("p{i}").as_bytes(), None, [x - half + 1.25, y - half + 1.25]);
    }
    put(k, U(n + 1), 1000 + n + 1, b_room, b"Bravo", b_key, [2000.25, 0.25]);
}

// a friend 2 km off a crowd is linked first while the friendship goes both ways and both are in one room
#[test]
fn a_friend_far_off_a_crowd_is_linked_first() {
    for (how, o, n) in ways() {
        let b = U(n + 1);
        for (a_lists_b, b_lists_a, b_key, b_room, want) in [
            (true, true, Some('B'), 0, true),
            (true, false, Some('B'), 0, false),
            (false, true, Some('B'), 0, false),
            (true, true, Some('B'), fnv1a("red"), false),
            (true, true, None, 0, false),
        ] {
            let what = format!("{how}: A lists B {a_lists_b}, B lists A {b_lists_a}, B's key {b_key:?}, room {b_room}");
            // (told before the players came: nobody is in free roam to be told back)
            let mut k = Kit::new(o.clone());
            if a_lists_b {
                k.hub.friends(U(0), owner('A'), vec![owner('B')]);
            }
            if b_lists_a {
                k.hub.friends(b, owner('B'), vec![owner('A'), owner('C')]);
            }
            crowd(&mut k, n, b_key, b_room);
            k.hub.tick();
            assert_eq!(linked(&k, U(0), b), want, "{what}");
            assert_eq!(k.lists()[&format!("{}:47210", U(0))].len(), 32, "{what}: A's links are full");
        }
        // one page's friends told once both play: the other one in free roam gets it back, linked from the next tick
        let mut k = Kit::new(o.clone());
        crowd(&mut k, n, Some('B'), 0);
        k.hub.tick();
        assert!(!linked(&k, U(0), b), "{how}");
        k.hub.friends(b, owner('B'), vec![owner('A')]);
        k.clear();
        k.hub.tick();
        assert!(linked(&k, U(0), b), "{how}: friends now");
    }
}

// linked_with: the linked player of that name, by its Online form, with a keyphrase
#[test]
fn a_page_befriends_only_a_player_it_is_linked_with() {
    let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions::default());
    put(&mut k, V(0), 100, 0, b"Alpha", Some('A'), [0.25, 0.25]);
    put(&mut k, V(1), 101, 0, b"Bravo Two", Some('B'), [3.25, 0.25]);
    put(&mut k, V(2), 102, 0, b"Charlie", None, [6.25, 0.25]);
    put(&mut k, V(3), 103, fnv1a("red"), b"Delta", Some('D'), [3.25, 3.25]);
    put(&mut k, V(4), 104, 0, b"Echo", Some('E'), [600.25, 0.25]);
    k.hub.tick();
    assert!(linked(&k, V(0), V(4)), "a room of five: linked, 600 m off");
    assert_eq!(k.hub.linked_with(V(0), "Echo"), None, "but its car far from this one's");
    assert_eq!(k.hub.linked_with(V(0), "Bravo_Two"), Some((V(1), Some(owner('B')))), "by its Online form");
    assert_eq!(k.hub.linked_with(V(0), "bravo two"), Some((V(1), Some(owner('B')))));
    assert_eq!(k.hub.linked_with(V(0), "Charlie"), Some((V(2), None)), "linked, without a keyphrase");
    assert_eq!(k.hub.linked_with(V(0), "Delta"), None, "another room: not linked");
    assert_eq!(k.hub.linked_with(V(0), "Alpha"), None, "itself");
    assert_eq!(k.hub.linked_with(V(9), "Bravo_Two"), None, "no player");
}

// whereabouts: where each keyphrase plays, with its room's name as its page told it
#[test]
fn friends_find_where_one_plays() {
    let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions::default());
    put(&mut k, V(0), 100, 0, b"Alpha", Some('A'), [0.25, 0.25]);
    put(&mut k, V(1), 101, fnv1a("blueroom"), b"Bravo", Some('B'), [3.25, 0.25]);
    k.hub.room_name(V(1), "Blue Room".into());
    k.hub.tick();
    let w = k.hub.whereabouts(&[owner('A'), owner('B'), owner('C')]);
    assert_eq!(
        w,
        [
            Some(Whereabouts { room: 0, room_name: None }),
            Some(Whereabouts { room: fnv1a("blueroom"), room_name: Some("Blue Room".into()) }),
            None
        ]
    );
    // gone from the switch: nowhere, its room's name forgotten
    k.hub.peer_gone(V(1));
    k.hub.tick();
    assert_eq!(k.hub.whereabouts(&[owner('B')]), [None]);
}

// the friend marks: to a player whose core reads the hub's marks, MARK_FRIEND on each friend's entry (both ways), with
// a crew-mate's bits where it is one too; none on a one-way friend's, nor on anyone's to an older core
#[test]
fn the_lists_mark_friends() {
    let owls = fnv1a("owls");
    let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions::default());
    k.hub.friends(V(0), owner('A'), vec![owner('B'), owner('C'), owner('D')]);
    k.hub.friends(V(1), owner('B'), vec![owner('A')]);
    k.hub.friends(V(2), owner('C'), vec![owner('A')]);
    k.hub.friends(V(4), owner('E'), vec![owner('A')]);
    let reads = HelloOpts { core: 6, crews: Some(&[]), flags: HF_HUBCREW, ..Default::default() };
    // A; B a friend; C a friend in A's crew; D listed by A, not back; E lists A, A not E; F no keyphrase
    put_with(&mut k, V(0), 100, &HelloOpts { name: b"Alpha", crews: Some(&[owls]), ..reads }, Some('A'), [0.25, 0.25]);
    put_with(&mut k, V(1), 101, &HelloOpts { name: b"Bravo", ..reads }, Some('B'), [10.25, 0.25]);
    put_with(&mut k, V(2), 102, &HelloOpts { name: b"Charlie", crews: Some(&[owls]), ..reads }, Some('C'), [20.25, 0.25]);
    put_with(&mut k, V(3), 103, &HelloOpts { name: b"Delta", ..reads }, Some('D'), [30.25, 0.25]);
    put_with(&mut k, V(4), 104, &HelloOpts { name: b"Echo", ..reads }, Some('E'), [40.25, 0.25]);
    put_with(&mut k, V(5), 105, &HelloOpts { name: b"Fox", ..reads }, None, [50.25, 0.25]);
    k.hub.tick();
    let sent = k.sent.lock().clone();
    let of = |i: u32| sent.iter().find(|(vip, _)| *vip == V(i)).map(|(_, f)| f.clone()).unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("a list to {i}"));
    let marks = |i: u32| {
        let f = of(i);
        let m = crew_marks(&f);
        peers_of(&f).iter().enumerate().map(|(at, e)| (e.vip, m.as_ref().map_or(0, |m| m.1[at]))).collect::<Vec<_>>()
    };
    let mark = |i: u32, j: u32| marks(i).iter().find(|e| e.0 == V(j)).unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("{j} on {i}'s list")).1;
    assert_eq!(crew_marks(&of(0)).map(|m| m.0), Some(vec![owls]), "A's own crew");
    assert_eq!(
        [mark(0, 1), mark(0, 2), mark(0, 3), mark(0, 4), mark(0, 5)],
        [MARK_FRIEND, MARK_FRIEND | 1, 0, 0, 0],
        "A: B a friend, C a friend and a crew-mate; D, E one way; F none"
    );
    assert_eq!(mark(1, 0), MARK_FRIEND, "B: A, in no crew of B's");
    assert_eq!(crew_marks(&of(1)).map(|m| m.0), Some(vec![]), "B: no crews of its own");
    assert!(marks(1).iter().all(|&(v, m)| v == V(0) || m == 0), "B: no other friend");
    assert_eq!(mark(2, 0), MARK_FRIEND | 1, "C: A");
    assert_eq!(crew_marks(&of(3)), None, "D: no friends of its own (told none): a plain list");
    assert_eq!(mark(4, 0), 0, "E: A lists it not");
    // an older core (no HF_HUBCREW): no marks, as before
    put_with(&mut k, V(1), 101, &HelloOpts { core: 6, name: b"Bravo", ..Default::default() }, Some('B'), [10.25, 0.25]);
    k.clear();
    k.hub.tick();
    let f = k.sent.lock().iter().find(|(vip, _)| *vip == V(1)).map(|(_, f)| f.clone()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(crew_marks(&f), None, "B of an older core: a plain list");
    assert_eq!(&f[16..], &encode_peers(0xB0B, u16::from_le_bytes([f[28], f[29]]), &peers_of(&f))[..], "byte for byte");
    assert_eq!(mark(0, 1), MARK_FRIEND, "A still sees B marked");
}

//! Free roam's hub: which players it links, what it reads and sends.
//! 1. the wire: what runtime/roam_core.c sends the hub (HELLO, SNAP, BYE, encoded by the C core built for wasm,
//!    web/test/roam_hubwire.c) is what the hub reads, and the hub's PEERS lists decode in the C core;
//! 2. the links: nearest first, both ends of a link list each other, at most the degree (32) per player, rooms apart,
//!    stale positions out, links kept at the edge, BYE and departures forgotten, the limits per address;
//! 3. the hub on its thread, its busy measure the runtime's workers (frames posted, its lists through the switch's
//!    send and a departure forgotten are tests/roam_thread.rs; the hub on the switch itself is the server's
//!    tests/roam_switch.rs).

mod kit;

use std::collections::HashSet;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::process::Command;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};
