use parking_lot::Mutex;

fn repo() -> PathBuf {
    Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("../../../..")
}

fn have_node() -> bool {
    Command::new("node").arg("--version").output().is_ok_and(|o| o.status.success())
}

// the hub's address is net_proto.h's and proto.ts's NET_ROAM_HUB
#[test]
fn the_hubs_address_is_net_proto_h_and_proto_ts_net_roam_hub() {
    let h = std::fs::read_to_string(repo().join("runtime/web/net_proto.h")).expect("net_proto.h");
    let ts = std::fs::read_to_string(repo().join("web/src/net/proto.ts")).expect("proto.ts");
    // /#define NET_ROAM_HUB\s+0x([0-9A-Fa-f]+)u/ and /NET_ROAM_HUB = 0x([0-9a-f]+)/
    let hex_after = |s: &str, pat: &str| -> u32 {
        let at = s.find(pat).unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("{pat}")) + pat.len();
        let rest = s[at..].trim_start();
        let digits: String = rest.strip_prefix("0x").expect("0x").chars().take_while(|c| c.is_ascii_hexdigit()).collect();
        u32::from_str_radix(&digits, 16).expect("hex")
    };
    assert_eq!(hex_after(&h, "#define NET_ROAM_HUB"), ROAM_HUB_VIP);
    assert_eq!(hex_after(&ts, "NET_ROAM_HUB ="), ROAM_HUB_VIP);
}

fn hex(b: &[u8]) -> String {
    b.iter().map(|x| format!("{x:02x}")).collect()
}

fn unhex(s: &str) -> Vec<u8> {
    (0..s.len() / 2).map(|i| u8::from_str_radix(&s[2 * i..2 * i + 2], 16).expect("hex")).collect()
}

// the C core's version (roam_core.h RC_CORE_VER), which its HELLO says
fn c_core_ver() -> u16 {
    let hdr = std::fs::read_to_string(repo().join("runtime/roam_core.h")).expect("roam_core.h");
    hdr.lines()
        .find_map(|l| l.strip_prefix("#define RC_CORE_VER"))
        .and_then(|r| r.split_whitespace().next())
        .and_then(|v| v.parse().ok())
        .expect("RC_CORE_VER")
}

// the wire: what roam_core sends the hub reads, and its PEERS lists decode in roam_core
#[test]
fn the_wire_what_roam_core_sends_the_hub_reads_and_its_peers_lists_decode_in_roam_core() {
    let deps = repo().join("deps");
    let wasi = std::fs::read_dir(&deps).ok().and_then(|d| {
        let mut v: Vec<PathBuf> =
            d.flatten().filter(|e| e.file_name().to_string_lossy().starts_with("wasi-sdk-")).map(|e| e.path()).collect();
        v.sort();
        v.pop()
    });
    let Some(wasi) = wasi else {
        eprintln!("no wasi-sdk in deps/: skipped");
        return;
    };
    if !have_node() {
        eprintln!("no node: skipped");
        return;
    }
    let w = Path::new(env!("CARGO_TARGET_TMPDIR")).join("roam_hubwire.wasm");
    let out = Command::new(wasi.join("bin/clang"))
        .current_dir(repo())
        .args(["--target=wasm32-wasip1-threads", "-pthread", "-O2", "-ffp-contract=off", "-Iruntime", "-o"])
        .arg(&w)
        .args(["web/test/roam_hubwire.c", "runtime/roam_core.c"])
        .arg("-Wl,--import-memory,--export-memory,--shared-memory,--initial-memory=67108864,--max-memory=268435456")
        .output()
        .expect("clang");
    assert!(out.status.success(), "clang: {}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stderr));
    let run = |args: &[&str]| -> String {
        let o = Command::new("node").arg(repo().join("web/test/wasi-run.mjs")).arg(&w).args(args).output().expect("node");
        String::from_utf8_lossy(&o.stdout).trim().to_string()
    };
    let (h, s, b) = (unhex(&run(&["hello"])), unhex(&run(&["snap"])), unhex(&run(&["bye"])));
    let core = c_core_ver();
    assert_eq!(
        decode_roam(&h),
        Some(RoamMsg::Hello { sender: 0x1234ABCD, core, status: 2, room: fnv1a("blue"), name: "Ann K.".into(), crews: vec![] })
    );
    assert_eq!(
        hello_with(0x1234ABCD, &HelloOpts { room: fnv1a("blue"), name: b"Ann K.", seen: &[0x11, 0x22], core, ..Default::default() }),
        h,
        "this test's HELLO = the C core's, byte for byte"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        decode_roam(&s),
        Some(RoamMsg::Snap { sender: 0x1234ABCD, status: 2, p: [1695.25, -883.5, 24.125] }),
        "the newest state's position"
    );
    assert_eq!(decode_roam(&b), Some(RoamMsg::Bye { sender: 0x1234ABCD }));
    let mut bad = h.clone();
    bad[20] ^= 1;
    assert_eq!(decode_roam(&bad), None, "a wrong CRC is no datagram");
    let peers = encode_peers(
        0xB0B,
        9,
        &[PeerEntry { vip: ip("10.77.0.5"), port: 47210, id: 3 }, PeerEntry { vip: ip("10.77.0.6"), port: 47300, id: 0xDEADBEEF }],
    );
    assert_eq!(run(&["peers", &hex(&peers)]), format!("ok 2 10.77.0.5:47210:3 10.77.0.6:47300:{}", 0xDEADBEEFu32));
    assert_eq!(run(&["peers", &hex(&encode_peers(0xB0B, 10, &[]))]), "ok 0", "an empty list (the hub is there)");
}

/// web/test/roam_hubwire.c with roam_core.c, built for wasm into `file` (each test its own: they run at once), and
/// the way to run it under node, its output trimmed; None without a wasi-sdk in deps/ or node (the test is skipped)
fn hubwire(file: &str) -> Option<impl Fn(&[&str]) -> String> {
    let wasi = std::fs::read_dir(repo().join("deps")).ok().and_then(|d| {
        let mut v: Vec<PathBuf> =
            d.flatten().filter(|e| e.file_name().to_string_lossy().starts_with("wasi-sdk-")).map(|e| e.path()).collect();
        v.sort();
        v.pop()
    });
    let Some(wasi) = wasi.filter(|_| have_node()) else {
        eprintln!("no wasi-sdk in deps/, or no node: skipped");
        return None;
    };
    let w = Path::new(env!("CARGO_TARGET_TMPDIR")).join(file);
    let out = Command::new(wasi.join("bin/clang"))
        .current_dir(repo())
        .args(["--target=wasm32-wasip1-threads", "-pthread", "-O2", "-ffp-contract=off", "-Iruntime", "-o"])
        .arg(&w)
        .args(["web/test/roam_hubwire.c", "runtime/roam_core.c"])
        .arg("-Wl,--import-memory,--export-memory,--shared-memory,--initial-memory=67108864,--max-memory=268435456")
        .output()
        .expect("clang");
    assert!(out.status.success(), "clang: {}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stderr));
    Some(move |args: &[&str]| {
        let o = Command::new("node").arg(repo().join("web/test/wasi-run.mjs")).arg(&w).args(args).output().expect("node");
        String::from_utf8_lossy(&o.stdout).trim().to_string()
    })
}

// the wire: a session's HELLO to the hub as roam_core makes it (rc_tick's, fill_hello: the ids of the two players the
// hub listed, who said hello, then its two crews from its config) names its crews; they are the room hashes the page
// makes (players.ts roomHash, players.test.mjs's 0x160fba32 for "Blue Room") and this test's; the hub links that
// player in a crowd with a crew-mate 2 km off (a HELLO made here) first, and not one of another crew
#[test]
fn the_wire_a_sessions_hello_to_the_hub_names_its_crews() {
    let Some(run) = hubwire("roam_hubwire_crew.wasm") else { return };
    let h = unhex(&run(&["hellocrew"]));
    let (blue, owls) = (room_hash("Blue Room"), room_hash("Night Owls"));
    // capitals and blanks do not count, a name of blanks is none
    assert_eq!([blue, room_hash("blueroom"), room_hash(" Blue Room\t"), room_hash("BLUE ROOM")], [0x160F_BA32; 4]);
    assert_eq!((room_hash("night owls"), fnv1a("nightowls")), (owls, owls));
    assert_eq!((room_hash(""), room_hash(" \t\r\n")), (0, 0));
    // the crew flag, the ids it hears (the hub's list), then its crews
    assert!(h.len() > 30 && u16::from_le_bytes([h[14], h[15]]) & HF_CREW != 0, "the crew flag: {}", hex(&h));
    let nl = h[28] as usize;
    let at = |o: usize| u32::from_le_bytes(h[o..o + 4].try_into().unwrap());
    let ids: Vec<u32> = (0..h[29 + nl] as usize).map(|k| at(30 + nl + 4 * k)).collect();
    assert_eq!(ids, [0x11, 0x22], "the ids it hears: {}", hex(&h));
    match decode_roam(&h) {
        Some(RoamMsg::Hello { sender, status, crews, .. }) => assert_eq!((sender, status, crews), (0x1234ABCD, 2, vec![blue, owls])),
        other => panic!("not its HELLO: {other:?} ({})", hex(&h)),
    }
    // that player (V(0)) in a crowd of 60 within 15 m, and V(61) 2 km off in "Night Owls" or in "Red"
    for (crew, want) in [(owls, true), (room_hash("Red"), false)] {
        let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions { view_m: 1e-9, ..RoamOptions::default() });
        k.from(V(0), &h);
        k.from(V(0), &snap(0x1234ABCD, [0.25, 0.25, 0.0]));
        for i in 1..=60u32 {
            k.from(V(i), &hello_with(100 + i, &HelloOpts { core: 6, ..Default::default() }));
            k.from(V(i), &snap(100 + i, [((i - 1) % 8) as f64 * 3.0 - 9.25, ((i - 1) / 8) as f64 * 3.0 - 9.25, 0.0]));
        }
        k.from(V(61), &hello_with(161, &HelloOpts { core: 6, crews: Some(&[crew]), ..Default::default() }));
        k.from(V(61), &snap(161, [2000.25, 0.25, 0.0]));
        k.hub.tick();
        let l = Lists(k.lists());
        l.both_ends();
        assert_eq!((l.has(0, 61), l.of(0).len()), (want, 32), "crew {crew:#x}: the crew-mate linked, the links full");
        assert_eq!(k.info("crewLinks"), if want { 1.0 } else { 0.0 });
        assert_eq!(k.hub.in_crews(&[blue, owls]), [1, 1 + want as usize]);
    }
}

// the wire: a session that wants 40 links (rc_config.links, its game's Players' cars shown) says so after its crews,
// and in a crowd of 60 that want 48 the hub links it with 40; one that says nothing gets 32, as a core before version 10
#[test]
fn the_wire_a_sessions_hello_to_the_hub_says_the_links_it_wants() {
    let Some(run) = hubwire("roam_hubwire_links.wasm") else { return };
    for (arg, want) in [(Some("40"), 40), (None, 32)] {
        let h = unhex(&run(&[&["hellocrew"][..], arg.as_slice()].concat()));
        let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions { view_m: 1e-9, ..RoamOptions::default() });
        k.from(V(0), &h);
        k.from(V(0), &snap(0x1234ABCD, [0.25, 0.25, 0.0]));
        for i in 1..=60u32 {
            k.from(V(i), &hello_with(100 + i, &HelloOpts { core: 10, links: 48, ..Default::default() }));
            k.from(V(i), &snap(100 + i, [((i - 1) % 8) as f64 * 3.0 - 9.25, ((i - 1) / 8) as f64 * 3.0 - 9.25, 0.0]));
        }
        k.hub.tick();
        let l = Lists(k.lists());
        l.both_ends();
        assert_eq!(l.of(0).len(), want, "{arg:?}");
        match decode_roam(&h) {
            Some(RoamMsg::Hello { core, crews, .. }) => assert_eq!((core, crews.len()), (c_core_ver(), 2), "its crews still read"),
            other => panic!("not its HELLO: {other:?}"),
        }
    }
}

// the wire: a session in an outrun (rc_set_duel) names its other player after the links it wants; in a crowd of 60
// nearer to it than that player (2 km off), the hub links the two first once that one names it back, and not before
#[test]
fn the_wire_a_sessions_hello_to_the_hub_names_its_outruns_other_player() {
    let Some(run) = hubwire("roam_hubwire_duel.wasm") else { return };
    let h = unhex(&run(&["hellocrew", "40", "a1"]));
    let none = unhex(&run(&["hellocrew", "40"]));
    assert_eq!(h.len(), none.len() + 4, "four bytes more: {}", hex(&h));
    assert_eq!(&h[h.len() - 8..h.len() - 4], &0xA1u32.to_le_bytes(), "the id last, before the CRC: {}", hex(&h));
    assert_eq!(h[h.len() - 9], 40, "after the links it wants");
    for back in [0, 0x1234ABCD] {
        let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions { view_m: 1e-9, ..RoamOptions::default() });
        k.from(V(0), &h);
        k.from(V(0), &snap(0x1234ABCD, [0.25, 0.25, 0.0]));
        for i in 1..=60u32 {
            k.from(V(i), &hello_with(100 + i, &HelloOpts { core: 10, links: 48, ..Default::default() }));
            k.from(V(i), &snap(100 + i, [((i - 1) % 8) as f64 * 3.0 - 9.25, ((i - 1) / 8) as f64 * 3.0 - 9.25, 0.0]));
        }
        k.from(V(61), &hello_with(0xA1, &HelloOpts { core: 11, links: 40, duel: back, ..Default::default() }));
        k.from(V(61), &snap(0xA1, [2000.25, 0.25, 0.0]));
        k.hub.tick();
        let l = Lists(k.lists());
        l.both_ends();
        assert_eq!((l.has(0, 61), l.of(0).len()), (back != 0, 40), "named back: {back:#x}");
    }
}

// the hub's crew marks as the C core takes them: a session's own HELLO and four players near it, in its "Night Owls", in "Red", in its "Blue Room", in none; the list the hub makes for it,
// given to a session in those two crews, colours each player as the hub marked it (rc_peer_crew), and names no crew but
// the session's own; with friends (the server's friends lists: the session's keyphrase and the one in "Red", and the
// one in none), it marks those two as its friends (rc_peer_friend), the crew-mate's crew kept
#[test]
fn the_wire_the_hubs_crew_marks_colour_a_sessions_peers() {
    let Some(run) = hubwire("roam_hubwire_marks.wasm") else { return };
    let h = unhex(&run(&["hellocrew"]));
    let (blue, owls, red) = (room_hash("Blue Room"), room_hash("Night Owls"), room_hash("Red"));
    let key = |c: char| nfsu2_claims::owner_of_token(&c.to_string().repeat(43)).unwrap();
    for friends in [false, true] {
        let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions { view_m: 1e-9, ..RoamOptions::default() });
        let owners = [Some(key('A')), None, Some(key('C')), None, Some(key('E'))];
        if friends {
            k.hub.friends(V(0), key('A'), vec![key('C'), key('E')]);
            k.hub.friends(V(2), key('C'), vec![key('A')]);
            k.hub.friends(V(4), key('E'), vec![key('A')]);
        }
        k.hub.frame_from(V(0), &frame(V(0), &h), owners[0].as_ref());
        k.hub.frame_from(V(0), &frame(V(0), &snap(0x1234ABCD, [0.25, 0.25, 0.0])), owners[0].as_ref());
        let who: [Option<&[u32]>; 4] = [Some(&[owls]), Some(&[red]), Some(&[red, blue]), None];
        for (i, crews) in who.iter().enumerate() {
            let i = i as u32 + 1;
            let o = owners[i as usize].as_ref();
            k.hub.frame_from(V(i), &frame(V(i), &hello_with(100 + i, &HelloOpts { crews: *crews, ..Default::default() })), o);
            k.hub.frame_from(V(i), &frame(V(i), &snap(100 + i, [i as f64 * 10.0 + 0.25, 0.25, 0.0])), o);
        }
        k.hub.tick();
        let f = k.sent.lock().iter().find(|(vip, _)| *vip == V(0)).map(|(_, f)| f.clone()).expect("the session's list");
        assert_eq!(crew_marks(&f).map(|m| m.0), Some(vec![blue, owls]), "its own crews, and no other: {}", hex(&f[16..]));
        let want = |e: &PeerEntry| {
            let i = (0..4).find(|&i| V(i + 1) == e.vip);
            let crew = match i {
                Some(0) => 1,
                Some(2) => 0,
                _ => -1,
            };
            format!("{crew}{}", if friends && matches!(i, Some(1 | 3)) { "f" } else { "" })
        };
        let list = peers_of(&f);
        assert_eq!(list.len(), 4);
        let expect: Vec<String> = list
            .iter()
            .map(|e| format!("{}.{}.{}.{}:{}:{}", e.vip >> 24, e.vip >> 16 & 255, e.vip >> 8 & 255, e.vip & 255, e.port, want(e)))
            .collect();
        assert_eq!(
            run(&["hubcrew", &hex(&f[16..])]),
            format!("ok {}", expect.join(" ")),
            "friends {friends}: the session's crews and friends by the hub's marks"
        );
        assert!(!f.windows(4).any(|b| b == red.to_le_bytes()), "no crew of another player's on its list");
    }
}

/// the lists by player i (10.77.0.(10 + i), port 47210)
struct Lists(std::collections::HashMap<String, Vec<PeerEntry>>);

impl Lists {
    fn of(&self, i: u32) -> &[PeerEntry] {
        self.0.get(&format!("{}:47210", V(i))).map_or(&[], |l| l.as_slice())
    }
    fn of_vip(&self, vip: u32) -> &[PeerEntry] {
        self.0.get(&format!("{vip}:47210")).map_or(&[], |l| l.as_slice())
    }
    fn has(&self, i: u32, j: u32) -> bool {
        self.of(i).iter().any(|e| e.vip == V(j))
    }
    /// every link listed at both ends
    fn both_ends(&self) {
        for (k, l) in &self.0 {
            for e in l {
                assert!(self.of_vip(e.vip).iter().any(|x| format!("{}:47210", x.vip) == *k), "{k}: its links list it too");
            }
        }
    }
}

// links at a degree of 7 (every pair | the grid): the nearest, both ends, at most 7 a player, only in free roam
// lately, rooms apart
#[test]
fn links_the_nearest_both_ends_at_most_the_degree_only_in_free_roam_lately_rooms_apart() {
    for (how, o) in ways() {
        let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions { degree: 7, ..o });
        // 20 players on a line 10 m apart, one far away, two in another room, one with no position yet
        for i in 0..20 {
            k.from(V(i), &hello(100 + i));
            k.from(V(i), &snap(100 + i, [i as f64 * 10.0, 0.0, 0.0]));
        }
        k.from(V(20), &hello(120));
        k.from(V(20), &snap(120, [5000.0, 0.0, 0.0]));
        for i in [21, 22] {
            k.from(V(i), &hello_with(100 + i, &HelloOpts { room: fnv1a("red"), ..Default::default() }));
            k.from(V(i), &snap(100 + i, [i as f64, 0.0, 0.0]));
        }
        k.from(V(23), &hello(123));
        k.hub.tick();
        let l = Lists(k.lists());
        assert_eq!(l.0.len(), 24, "{how}: every player gets a list, an empty one too");
        for i in 0..24 {
            assert!(l.of(i).len() <= 7, "{how}: player {i}: at most 7 ({})", l.of(i).len());
        }
        l.both_ends();
        assert!(l.has(0, 1) && l.has(10, 9) && l.has(10, 11), "{how}: neighbours on the line are linked");
        for i in 5..15 {
            for e in l.of(i) {
                assert!((e.vip as i64 - V(i) as i64).abs() <= 4, "{how}: player {i}: its links are the nearest");
            }
        }
        assert!(l.has(19, 20) || !l.of(20).is_empty(), "{how}: the far one is linked to somebody");
        assert!(l.has(21, 22) && l.of(21).len() == 1, "{how}: another room: only each other");
        assert_eq!(l.of(23).len(), 0, "{how}: no position yet: no links");
        for i in 0..20 {
            for j in 0..20 {
                if i != j && l.of(i).len() < 7 && l.of(j).len() < 7 {
                    assert!(l.has(i, j), "{how}: {i} and {j} both have room, so they are linked");
                }
            }
        }
        // a position older than 60 s: no links (one in a shop keeps them until then)
        k.clear();
        k.step(30_000.0);
        for i in 1..23 {
            k.from(V(i), &hello(100 + i));
            k.from(V(i), &snap(100 + i, if i == 1 { [10.0, 0.0, 0.0] } else { [i as f64 * 10.0, 0.0, 0.0] }));
        }
        k.from(V(0), &hello(100));
        k.hub.tick();
        assert!(!Lists(k.lists()).of(0).is_empty(), "{how}: 30 s without a SNAP: still linked");
        k.clear();
        k.step(31_000.0);
        for i in 0..23 {
            k.from(V(i), &hello(100 + i));
        }
        for i in 1..23 {
            k.from(V(i), &snap(100 + i, [i as f64 * 10.0, 0.0, 0.0]));
        }
        k.hub.tick();
        assert_eq!(Lists(k.lists()).of(0).len(), 0, "{how}: 61 s without a SNAP: no links");
    }
}

// links at the default degree (every pair | the grid): at most 32 a player
#[test]
fn links_at_most_32_a_player() {
    for (how, o) in ways() {
        let mut k = Kit::new(o);
        // 50 players on a line 10 m apart
        for i in 0..50 {
            k.from(V(i), &hello(100 + i));
            k.from(V(i), &snap(100 + i, [i as f64 * 10.0, 0.0, 0.0]));
        }
        k.hub.tick();
        let l = Lists(k.lists());
        for i in 0..50 {
            assert!(l.of(i).len() <= 32, "{how}: player {i}: at most 32 ({})", l.of(i).len());
        }
        l.both_ends();
        for i in 0..50 {
            for j in 0..50 {
                if i != j && l.of(i).len() < 32 && l.of(j).len() < 32 {
                    assert!(l.has(i, j), "{how}: {i} and {j} both have room, so they are linked");
                }
            }
        }
        assert!(l.of(25).len() > 16, "{how}: more than 16 ({})", l.of(25).len());
    }
}

// links stay put at the edge, players come and go (every pair | the grid)
#[test]
fn links_stay_put_at_the_edge_players_come_and_go() {
    for (how, o) in ways() {
        let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions { degree: 1, ..o });
        // A at 0, B at 100: linked; C comes 10 m from A: a link stays its first 5 s
        let at = |k: &mut Kit, i: u32, x: f64| {
            k.from(V(i), &hello(200 + i));
            k.from(V(i), &snap(200 + i, [x, 0.0, 0.0]));
        };
        let first = |k: &Kit| Lists(k.lists()).of(0)[0].vip;
        at(&mut k, 0, 0.0);
        at(&mut k, 1, 100.0);
        k.hub.tick();
        assert_eq!(first(&k), V(1), "{how}");
        k.clear();
        k.step(1000.0);
        at(&mut k, 0, 0.0);
        at(&mut k, 1, 100.0);
        at(&mut k, 2, -10.0);
        k.hub.tick();
        assert_eq!(first(&k), V(1), "{how}: a link stays at least 5 s");
        // after that it counts as half its distance: 60 m does not beat a linked 100 m, 40 m does
        k.clear();
        k.step(5000.0);
        at(&mut k, 0, 0.0);
        at(&mut k, 1, 100.0);
        at(&mut k, 2, -60.0);
        k.hub.tick();
        assert_eq!(first(&k), V(1), "{how}: 60 m does not beat a linked 100 m");
        k.clear();
        k.step(1000.0);
        at(&mut k, 0, 0.0);
        at(&mut k, 1, 100.0);
        at(&mut k, 2, -40.0);
        k.hub.tick();
        assert_eq!(first(&k), V(2), "{how}: under half the distance: the link moves");
        // BYE, silence, a departure from the switch
        assert_eq!(k.hub.vips(), HashSet::from([V(0), V(1), V(2)]), "{how}: the browsers in free roam (the server's console)");
        k.from(V(2), &bye(202));
        assert_eq!(k.info("players"), 2.0, "{how}: BYE: forgotten at once");
        k.step(7000.0);
        at(&mut k, 0, 0.0);
        k.hub.tick();
        assert_eq!(k.info("players"), 1.0, "{how}: 6 s without a word: forgotten");
        assert_eq!(k.hub.vips(), HashSet::from([V(0)]));
        k.hub.peer_gone(V(0));
        assert_eq!(k.info("players"), 0.0, "{how}: left the switch: forgotten");
    }
}

// limits: three endpoints a browser (co-op's two players and a restart's), a player starts with its HELLO, bad
// datagrams counted
#[test]
fn limits_three_endpoints_a_browser_a_player_starts_with_its_hello_bad_datagrams_counted() {
    let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions::default());
    for port in [47210u16, 47211, 47212, 47213] {
        k.hub.frame(V(0), &frame_ports(V(0), &hello(300 + port as u32), port, 47210));
    }
    assert_eq!(k.info("players"), 3.0);
    assert_eq!(k.info("refused"), 1.0);
    k.from(V(1), &snap(301, [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]));
    assert_eq!(k.info("players"), 3.0, "a SNAP before any HELLO: nobody new");
    k.hub.frame(V(1), b"nonsense, not a frame at all");
    let mut f = frame(V(1), &hello(301));
    f[30] ^= 0xff;
    k.hub.frame(V(1), &f);
    assert_eq!(k.info("bad"), 2.0);
    let far = frame(V(1), &snap(301, [1e6, 0.0, 0.0]));
    k.from(V(1), &hello(301));
    k.hub.frame(V(1), &far);
    assert_eq!(k.info("bad"), 3.0, "a position out of the map: refused");
}

// in free roam (/players' roam): the browsers driving there or paused there, as their last HELLO or SNAP says, each
// once whatever its endpoints; in a race, a shop, the menus or loading, not
#[test]
fn in_free_roam_driving_or_paused_each_browser_once() {
    let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions::default());
    // roam_core.h RC_ST_*: 0 menus, 1 loading, 2 free roam, 3 a race, 4 a shop, 5 paused
    for st in 0..6u32 {
        k.from(V(st), &hello_with(400 + st, &HelloOpts { status: st as u8, ..Default::default() }));
    }
    assert_eq!(k.hub.in_roam(), 2, "free roam, and paused there");
    // another start of the game in the browser in free roam: a second endpoint
    k.hub.frame(V(2), &frame_ports(V(2), &hello(500), 47211, 47210));
    assert_eq!(k.hub.in_roam(), 2, "a browser once");
    k.from(V(5), &snap_n(405, [0.0, 0.0, 0.0], 3, 1));
    assert_eq!(k.hub.in_roam(), 1, "a SNAP says the paused one went into a race");
    k.from(V(0), &hello(400));
    assert_eq!(k.hub.in_roam(), 2, "out of the menus into free roam");
    k.from(V(2), &bye(402));
    assert_eq!(k.hub.in_roam(), 2, "BYE from one endpoint: its other one is in free roam");
    k.hub.peer_gone(V(2));
    assert_eq!(k.hub.in_roam(), 1, "left the switch");
}

// /players' room and rooms: in free roam by room (room 0, none, the main world, too), each browser once
#[test]
fn in_free_roam_by_room() {
    let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions::default());
    let (blue, red) = (fnv1a("blue"), fnv1a("red"));
    k.from(V(1), &hello_with(601, &HelloOpts { room: blue, ..Default::default() }));
    k.from(V(2), &hello_with(602, &HelloOpts { room: blue, status: 5, ..Default::default() }));
    k.from(V(3), &hello_with(603, &HelloOpts { room: blue, status: 3, ..Default::default() }));
    k.from(V(4), &hello_with(604, &HelloOpts { room: red, ..Default::default() }));
    k.from(V(5), &hello(605));
    k.hub.frame(V(1), &frame_ports(V(1), &hello_with(606, &HelloOpts { room: blue, ..Default::default() }), 47211, 47210));
    let rooms = k.hub.in_rooms();
    assert_eq!(
        (rooms.get(&blue), rooms.get(&red), rooms.get(&0), rooms.len()),
        (Some(&2), Some(&1), Some(&1), 3),
        "driving or paused, a browser once: {rooms:?}"
    );
    assert_eq!(k.hub.in_roam(), 4);
}

// a player that comes and goes, HELLO and BYE over and over (a client may send the hub 2500 frames a second), costs the
// hub little: a player gone is taken out of the others' links once in a while, for many at once, not with every BYE
// (each walked every player's links: 2000 players' 64,000)
#[test]
fn a_player_that_comes_and_goes_costs_the_hub_little() {
    let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions::default());
    let v = |i: u32| 0x0A4D_0100 + i;
    let crowd = |k: &mut Kit| {
        for i in 0..2000u32 {
            k.from(v(i), &hello(1000 + i));
            k.from(v(i), &snap(1000 + i, [(i % 50) as f64 * 20.0, (i / 50) as f64 * 20.0, 0.0]));
        }
    };
    crowd(&mut k);
    let t0 = Instant::now();
    k.hub.tick();
    let tick = t0.elapsed();
    let links = k.info("links");
    assert!(links > 30_000.0, "{links}");
    let x = v(3000);
    let t0 = Instant::now();
    for n in 0..2000u32 {
        let port = 47210 + (n % 2) as u16;
        k.hub.frame(x, &frame_ports(x, &hello(50_000 + n), port, 47210));
        if n % 7 == 3 {
            // links of the crowd's own come and go too: Ann of the crowd leaves and is back at once
            k.from(v(n % 2000), &bye(1000 + n % 2000));
            k.from(v(n % 2000), &hello(1000 + n % 2000));
        }
        k.hub.frame(x, &frame_ports(x, &bye(50_000 + n), port, 47210));
    }
    let churn = t0.elapsed();
    println!("2000 comings and goings: {churn:?}; a tick of 2000 players: {tick:?}");
    assert!(churn < tick, "2000 comings and goings took {churn:?}, longer than a whole tick ({tick:?})");
    // what they left: the crowd, and the links of those that were not back as new players
    assert_eq!(k.info("players"), 2000.0);
    let left: f64 = k.hub.links().iter().map(|(_, l)| l.len() as f64).sum::<f64>() / 2.0;
    assert_eq!(k.info("links"), left, "info() counts the links listed");
    assert!(left < links, "the ones that went are out of the others' links");
    let names: HashSet<String> = k.hub.links().into_iter().map(|(n, _)| n).collect();
    assert!(k.hub.links().iter().all(|(_, l)| l.iter().all(|n| names.contains(n))), "no link to a player gone");
    // and the next tick links the crowd as before
    k.step(1000.0);
    crowd(&mut k);
    k.hub.tick();
    assert!(k.info("links") > 30_000.0);
}

// 64 players in one place, at a degree of 7 | 32: each list at most that, the tick stays cheap
#[test]
fn sixty_four_players_in_one_place_each_list_at_most_its_degree_the_tick_stays_cheap() {
    for most in [7, 32] {
        let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions { degree: most, ..RoamOptions::default() });
        for i in 0..64u32 {
            let v = ip(&format!("10.77.0.{}", 2 + i));
            k.from(v, &hello(400 + i));
            k.from(v, &snap(400 + i, [(i as f64).cos() * 30.0, (i as f64).sin() * 30.0, 0.0]));
        }
        for _ in 0..20 {
            k.hub.tick();
        }
        let sent = k.sent.lock();
        let l = lists(&sent[sent.len() - 64..]);
        let n: Vec<usize> = l.values().map(|l| l.len()).collect();
        assert!(n.iter().all(|&x| x <= most) && n.iter().filter(|&&x| x == most).count() >= 60, "lists of {most} ({n:?})");
        println!("64 players at a degree of {most}: {} links, tick at most {:.2} ms", k.info("links"), k.info("tickMsMax"));
        assert!(k.info("tickMsMax") < 50.0);
    }
}

// a panic in a tick (a bug: here the switch's send, halfway through the lists) leaves a hub that goes on: its thread
// catches the panic, and the next ticks link everyone and send every list
#[test]
fn a_panic_in_a_tick_leaves_a_hub_that_goes_on() {
    // the last tick's lists of a hub whose send panics at its `panic_at`-th list (none: never)
    let run = |exact_room: usize, panic_at: Option<usize>| {
        let sent = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Vec::<(u32, Bytes)>::new()));
        let s2 = sent.clone();
        let t = Arc::new(Mutex::new(1_000_000.0));
        let t2 = t.clone();
        let n = Arc::new(std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize::new(0));
        let mut hub = Hub::new(
            RoamOptions { exact_room, ..RoamOptions::default() },
            Box::new(move || *t2.lock()),
            Box::new(|| 0.0),
            Box::new(|_: &str| {}),
            Box::new(move |vip, f| {
                assert!(Some(n.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed)) != panic_at, "a bug in the middle of a tick");
                s2.lock().push((vip, f));
                true
            }),
            0xB0B,
        );
        let v = |i: u32| 0x0A4D_0100 + i;
        for tick in 0..4 {
            for i in 0..100u32 {
                hub.frame(v(i), &frame(v(i), &hello(1000 + i)));
                hub.frame(v(i), &frame(v(i), &snap(1000 + i, [(i % 10) as f64 * 15.0, (i / 10) as f64 * 15.0, 0.0])));
            }
            let r = std::panic::catch_unwind(std::panic::AssertUnwindSafe(|| hub.tick()));
            assert_eq!(r.is_err(), panic_at.is_some() && tick == 1, "the second tick's 51st list panics, nothing else");
            *t.lock() += 1000.0;
        }
        assert_eq!(hub.info()["players"], 100);
        let sent = sent.lock();
        lists(&sent[sent.len() - 100..])
    };
    for exact_room in [1000, 1] {
        let last = run(exact_room, Some(150));
        assert_eq!(last.len(), 100, "every player's list");
        let by_vip: std::collections::HashMap<u32, &Vec<PeerEntry>> =
            last.iter().map(|(k, l)| (k.split(':').next().and_then(|x| x.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0), l)).collect();
        for (a, l) in &by_vip {
            assert!(l.len() <= 32 && l.iter().all(|e| by_vip[&e.vip].iter().any(|x| x.vip == *a)), "at most 32, both ends");
        }
        let open: Vec<u32> = by_vip.iter().filter(|(_, l)| l.len() < 32).map(|(a, _)| *a).collect();
        for a in &open {
            assert!(open.iter().all(|b| a == b || by_vip[a].iter().any(|e| e.vip == *b)), "two with room are linked");
        }
        assert_eq!(last, run(exact_room, None), "the same lists as a hub that never panicked");
    }
}

// a list waiting in a slow player's queue keeps a block of 4 KiB at most (its own 357 bytes and its neighbours'), not
// every list of its tick (2000 players' lists were one buffer of 700 KB, kept whole for as long as any of them waited)
#[test]
fn a_list_waiting_holds_little() {
    // (the lattice's links by distance alone: player 7 has 32)
    let mut k = Kit::new(ways()[0].1.clone());
    for i in 0..300u32 {
        let v = 0x0A4D_0100 + i;
        k.from(v, &hello(1000 + i));
        k.from(v, &snap(1000 + i, [(i % 20) as f64 * 10.0, (i / 20) as f64 * 10.0, 0.0]));
    }
    k.hub.tick();
    let one = k.sent.lock()[7].1.clone();
    k.clear();
    let len = one.len();
    assert_eq!(len, 16 + 16 + 1 + 10 * 32 + 4, "a list of 32");
    // (what it keeps: the rest of its block, from where it starts)
    let mine = one.try_into_mut().map_err(|_| "its block is in other hands").expect("no other list holds its block");
    assert!(mine.capacity() <= 4096, "it keeps {} bytes for a list of {len}", mine.capacity());
}

// a busy server: every player gets fewer links, and more again once it has room (every pair | the grid): the cap on
// the links a quarter down at most every 5 s to 8, nothing between 60 and 85 %, 2 up every 15 s
#[test]
fn a_busy_server_every_player_gets_fewer_links_and_more_again_once_it_has_room() {
    for (way, o) in ways() {
        let mut k = Kit::new(o);
        *k.busy.lock() = 0.95;
        // one second of the 40 players: the lists checked, then the cap and whether free roam counts as busy
        let second = |k: &mut Kit| -> (usize, bool) {
            k.clear();
            for i in 0..40u32 {
                let v = ip(&format!("10.77.0.{}", 2 + i));
                k.from(v, &hello(500 + i));
                k.from(v, &snap(500 + i, [(i as f64).cos() * 30.0, (i as f64).sin() * 30.0, 0.0]));
            }
            k.hub.tick();
            k.step(1000.0);
            let cap = k.info("cap") as usize;
            let l = Lists(k.lists());
            let n: Vec<usize> = l.0.values().map(|l| l.len()).collect();
            assert!(
                n.iter().all(|&x| x <= cap) && n.iter().sum::<usize>() as f64 >= 0.9 * cap as f64 * n.len() as f64,
                "{way}: lists of {cap} ({n:?})"
            );
            l.both_ends();
            let open: Vec<(&String, &Vec<PeerEntry>)> = l.0.iter().filter(|(_, l)| l.len() < cap).collect();
            for (a, la) in &open {
                for (b, _) in &open {
                    if a != b {
                        assert!(la.iter().any(|x| format!("{}:47210", x.vip) == **b), "{way}: two with room left: linked");
                    }
                }
            }
            (cap, k.hub.crowded())
        };
        let (mut caps, mut crowded) = (Vec::new(), Vec::new());
        let seconds = |k: &mut Kit, n: usize, caps: &mut Vec<usize>, crowded: &mut Vec<bool>| {
            for _ in 0..n {
                let (c, b) = second(k);
                caps.push(c);
                crowded.push(b);
            }
        };
        seconds(&mut k, 30, &mut caps, &mut crowded);
        assert_eq!([caps[0], caps[4], caps[5], caps[10], caps[15], caps[20], caps[29]], [24, 24, 18, 13, 9, 8, 8], "{way}: {caps:?}");
        *k.busy.lock() = 0.7;
        seconds(&mut k, 30, &mut caps, &mut crowded);
        assert!(caps[30..60].iter().all(|&c| c == 8), "{way}: between busyLow and busyHigh: as it is");
        *k.busy.lock() = 0.2;
        seconds(&mut k, 31, &mut caps, &mut crowded);
        assert_eq!([caps[60], caps[74], caps[75], caps[90]], [10, 10, 12, 14], "{way}: {:?}", &caps[60..]);
        {
            let lines = k.lines.lock();
            assert_eq!(lines.len(), 8, "{lines:?}");
            assert_eq!(lines[0], "[roam] the server's thread was 95 % busy: at most 24 links a player (was 32)");
        }
        assert_eq!(k.info("capCuts"), 5.0);
        // busy for the start page's question (/players roamBusy) while the cap is under 24: from 18 down, until it is
        // 24 again
        seconds(&mut k, 90, &mut caps, &mut crowded);
        assert!(*caps.last().unwrap() > 24, "{way}: {:?}", &caps[91..]);
        assert!(crowded.iter().zip(&caps).all(|(&c, &cap)| c == (cap < 24)), "{way}: {caps:?} {crowded:?}");
        let last_busy = crowded.iter().rposition(|&c| c).unwrap();
        let back = 60 + caps[60..].iter().position(|&c| c == 24).unwrap();
        assert_eq!((crowded[4], crowded[5], last_busy + 1 == back), (false, true, true), "{way}");
    }
}

// 600 players in a city | a district | a crowd: the grid links as every pair does: a room larger than `exact_room`,
// the grid's links against every pair's, for the same players (two rooms; a few far out):
// the same rules (at most the degree, both ends, no two with room left unlinked) and about the same distances
#[test]
fn six_hundred_players_the_grid_links_as_every_pair_does() {
    for (where_, w) in [("a city", 8000.0), ("a district", 1500.0), ("a crowd", 100.0)] {
        let mut seed: u32 = 12345;
        let mut rnd = || {
            seed = seed.wrapping_mul(1103515245).wrapping_add(12345);
            seed as f64 / 4294967296.0
        };
        struct Q {
            v: u32,
            id: u32,
            room: u32,
            p: [f64; 3],
        }
        let players: Vec<Q> = (0..600u32)
            .map(|i| Q {
                v: ip(&format!("10.77.{}.{}", i & 7, 2 + (i >> 3))),
                id: 700 + i,
                room: if i % 10 == 3 { fnv1a("red") } else { 0 },
                p: if i % 97 == 5 {
                    [15000.0 - i as f64, -15000.0, 0.0]
                } else {
                    let x = rnd() * w - w / 2.0;
                    let y = rnd() * w - w / 2.0;
                    [x, y, rnd() * 20.0]
                },
            })
            .collect();
        let run = |o: RoamOptions| {
            let mut k = Kit::new(o);
            for _ in 0..3 {
                k.clear();
                for q in &players {
                    k.from(q.v, &hello_with(q.id, &HelloOpts { room: q.room, ..Default::default() }));
                    k.from(q.v, &snap(q.id, q.p));
                }
                k.hub.tick();
                k.step(1000.0);
            }
            (Lists(k.lists()), k.info("tickMsMax"))
        };
        let (all, all_ms) = run(RoamOptions { exact_room: 1000, ..RoamOptions::default() });
        let (grid, grid_ms) = run(RoamOptions::default());
        let at: std::collections::HashMap<u32, &Q> = players.iter().map(|q| (q.v, q)).collect();
        let d = |a: &Q, b: &Q| ((a.p[0] - b.p[0]).powi(2) + (a.p[1] - b.p[1]).powi(2) + (a.p[2] - b.p[2]).powi(2)).sqrt();
        let sum = |l: &Lists| {
            let (mut n, mut m) = (0usize, 0.0);
            for q in &players {
                let lq = l.of_vip(q.v);
                assert!(lq.len() <= 32, "at most 32 ({})", lq.len());
                for e in lq {
                    assert!(l.of_vip(e.vip).iter().any(|x| x.vip == q.v), "both ends");
                    assert_eq!(at[&e.vip].room, q.room, "one room");
                    n += 1;
                    m += d(q, at[&e.vip]);
                }
            }
            let open: Vec<&Q> = players.iter().filter(|q| l.of_vip(q.v).len() < 32).collect();
            for a in &open {
                for b in &open {
                    if a.v != b.v && a.room == b.room {
                        assert!(l.of_vip(a.v).iter().any(|e| e.vip == b.v), "two with room are linked");
                    }
                }
            }
            (n as f64 / 2.0, m / n as f64)
        };
        let (a_links, a_mean) = sum(&all);
        let (g_links, g_mean) = sum(&grid);
        println!(
            "600 players in {w} m ({where_}): every pair {a_links} links of {a_mean:.1} m ({all_ms:.0} ms), the grid {g_links} of {g_mean:.1} m ({grid_ms:.0} ms)"
        );
        assert!((g_links - a_links).abs() <= a_links * 0.01, "as many links");
        assert!(g_mean <= a_mean * 1.03, "as near");
    }
}

// 1500 players in a room of 2 km, driving (view points), a few not driving, 16, 32 or 48 links each, some coming and
// going: with their walks read on 4 threads, the hub sends what it sends with them read on its own thread, byte for
// byte, tick after tick (`RoamOptions::link_threads`)
#[test]
fn walks_read_on_threads_link_as_on_the_hubs_own() {
    let run = |threads: usize| {
        let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions { link_threads: threads, ..RoamOptions::default() });
        let mut seed: u32 = 4242;
        let mut rnd = || {
            seed = seed.wrapping_mul(1103515245).wrapping_add(12345);
            seed as f64 / 4294967296.0
        };
        let n = 1500u32;
        let vip = |i: u32| 0x0A4D_0100 + i;
        let mut pos: Vec<[f64; 3]> = (0..n).map(|_| [rnd() * 2000.0 - 1000.0, rnd() * 2000.0 - 1000.0, rnd() * 10.0]).collect();
        let vel: Vec<[f64; 3]> = (0..n).map(|_| [rnd() * 60.0 - 30.0, rnd() * 60.0 - 30.0, 0.0]).collect();
        let mut sent = Vec::new();
        for tick in 0..6u32 {
            k.clear();
            for i in 0..n {
                // players 7 mod 13 go at the fourth tick
                if i % 13 == 7 && tick >= 3 {
                    continue;
                }
                let (p, v) = (&mut pos[i as usize], vel[i as usize]);
                p[0] += v[0] * 0.5;
                p[1] += v[1] * 0.5;
                let status = if i % 11 == 4 { 3 } else { 2 };
                let links = [16u8, 32, 48][(i % 3) as usize];
                k.from(vip(i), &hello_with(1000 + i, &HelloOpts { core: 10, status, links, ..Default::default() }));
                k.from(vip(i), &snap_moving(1000 + i, *p, v, v[1].atan2(v[0]), status));
            }
            k.hub.tick();
            sent.push(k.sent.lock().clone());
            k.step(500.0);
        }
        (sent, k.info("links"))
    };
    let (one, links) = run(1);
    // (pairs: about 32 a player, two players a pair)
    assert!(links > 1500.0 * 10.0, "a crowd's links ({links})");
    assert!(one == run(4).0, "the same lists, byte for byte");
}

// ---- the hub on its thread (the idle hub, frames posted and its lists: tests/roam_thread.rs) ----

fn wait_for(what: &str, mut f: impl FnMut() -> bool) {
    let t0 = Instant::now();
    while !f() {
        assert!(t0.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(5), "{what}: not within 5 s");
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(5));
    }
}

// on its thread in the server's runtime, the hub's busy measure is the runtime's workers' (they run the switch): with
// all of them busy the cap on the links comes down, few of the machine's cores as they may be (the process's CPU time
// over every core read 2 busy workers of 24 cores as 8 %, and the cap never moved)
#[test]
fn on_its_thread_busy_workers_cut_the_links() {
    let rt = tokio::runtime::Builder::new_multi_thread().worker_threads(2).enable_all().build().expect("a runtime");
    let lines = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Vec::<String>::new()));
    let l2 = lines.clone();
    let log = Arc::new(move |s: &str| l2.lock().push(s.into()));
    let hub = rt.block_on(async { RoamHub::spawn(RoamOptions { tick_ms: 250, ..RoamOptions::default() }, log) });
    let stop = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));
    for _ in 0..2 {
        let stop = stop.clone();
        rt.spawn(async move {
            while !stop.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
                let t = Instant::now();
                while t.elapsed() < Duration::from_millis(1) {
                    std::hint::spin_loop();
                }
                tokio::task::yield_now().await;
            }
        });
    }
    let cut = std::panic::catch_unwind(std::panic::AssertUnwindSafe(|| wait_for("the cap cut", || !lines.lock().is_empty())));
    stop.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
    hub.stop();
    assert!(cut.is_ok(), "both workers busy, and the cap stayed");
    let first = lines.lock()[0].clone();
    assert!(first.ends_with("% busy: at most 48 links a player (was 64)"), "{first}");
}

#[test]
fn on_its_thread_a_hub_given_up_ends_its_thread() {
    let hub = RoamHub::spawn(RoamOptions::default(), Arc::new(|_: &str| {}));
    let rx = hub.info();
    drop(hub);
    // what was posted before still has its answer
    assert!(rx.blocking_recv().is_ok());
}

//! Roads above roads: a gap in height that no road explains (a highway over a street) weighs more than it is
//! (RoamOptions level_*), so a player's links go to the cars on its own road first.  What weighs as before: two cars on
//! one road up a hill, a car over a bump, a player in a shop, and anyone at all while there is room.

mod kit;

use std::f64::consts::PI;

use kit::*;
use nfsu2_roam::RoamOptions;

/// browser i's address
#[allow(non_snake_case)]
fn W(i: u32) -> u32 {
    0x0A4D_0002 + i
}

/// a player of core version 10 asking for `links` links, in room 0
fn join(k: &mut Kit, i: u32, links: u8) {
    k.from(W(i), &hello_with(100 + i, &HelloOpts { core: 10, links, ..Default::default() }));
}

/// the links of a room: every pair weighed, or the grid's nearest; with view points (kit's `ways` has none), as the
/// server has them
fn both() -> [(&'static str, RoamOptions); 2] {
    let o = RoamOptions::default();
    [("every pair", o.clone()), ("the grid", RoamOptions { exact_room: 1, ..o })]
}

/// the rule turned off (an option that is not a positive number keeps its default: 1e-9 m a metre is none)
fn flat(o: &RoamOptions) -> RoamOptions {
    RoamOptions { level_k: 1e-9, ..o.clone() }
}

/// player i's links, sorted
fn links_of(k: &Kit, i: u32) -> Vec<u32> {
    let l = k.lists();
    let mut v: Vec<u32> = l[&format!("{}:47210", W(i))].iter().map(|e| e.vip - W(0)).collect();
    v.sort();
    v
}

/// one tick of a hub that has the players' HELLOs and SNAPs in free roam (place, velocity, heading); player 0's links
/// (it asks for `links`, the others for 48: their room is not what decides)
fn tick_with(o: RoamOptions, links: u8, snaps: &[([f64; 3], [f64; 3], f64)]) -> Vec<u32> {
    let mut k = Kit::new(o);
    for (i, &(p, v, h)) in snaps.iter().enumerate() {
        join(&mut k, i as u32, if i == 0 { links } else { 48 });
        k.from(W(i as u32), &snap_moving(100 + i as u32, p, v, h, 2));
    }
    k.clear();
    k.hub.tick();
    links_of(&k, 0)
}

// Player 0 drives along a highway 10 m over a street, at 30 m/s; four cars drive the street under it with it, four
// drive the highway 60 to 200 m off.  With 4 links it gets the four on the highway (as it always did the four under
// it), with 8 all eight: the ones under it wait for room, they are not left out.
#[test]
fn on_a_highway_the_cars_on_it_come_before_the_street_under_it() {
    let (up, run, back) = (10.0, [30.0, 0.0, 0.0], [-30.0, 0.0, 0.0]);
    let snaps = [
        ([0.0, 0.0, up], run, 0.0),
        ([5.0, 3.0, 0.0], run, 0.0),
        ([-8.0, -4.0, 0.0], run, 0.0),
        ([12.0, 2.0, 0.0], run, 0.0),
        ([-3.0, -2.0, 0.0], run, 0.0),
        ([60.0, 3.0, up], run, 0.0),
        ([85.0, -3.0, up], run, 0.0),
        ([110.0, 3.0, up], back, PI),
        ([200.0, -3.0, up], run, 0.0),
    ];
    for (how, o) in both() {
        assert_eq!(tick_with(o.clone(), 4, &snaps), [5, 6, 7, 8], "{how}: the highway's");
        assert_eq!(tick_with(flat(&o), 4, &snaps), [1, 2, 3, 4], "{how}, as before: the street's");
        assert_eq!(tick_with(o.clone(), 8, &snaps), [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8], "{how}: room for all");
    }
}

// Under a highway meet, the street's own: a street car's links go to the cars on the street 40 to 100 m off before the
// two parked straight over it; a highway car 50 m to the side (in sight) weighs as it is.
#[test]
fn under_a_highway_the_street_comes_first() {
    let snaps = [
        ([0.0, 0.0, 0.0], [0.0; 3], 0.0),
        ([3.0, 2.0, 12.0], [0.0; 3], 0.0),
        ([-6.0, -2.0, 12.0], [0.0; 3], PI),
        ([40.0, 0.0, 0.0], [0.0; 3], 0.0),
        ([0.0, -70.0, 0.0], [0.0; 3], 0.0),
        ([100.0, 10.0, 0.0], [0.0; 3], 0.0),
    ];
    for (how, o) in both() {
        assert_eq!(tick_with(o.clone(), 3, &snaps), [3, 4, 5], "{how}: the street's");
        assert_eq!(tick_with(flat(&o), 3, &snaps), [1, 2, 3], "{how}, as before");
    }
    let side = [([0.0, 0.0, 0.0], [0.0; 3], 0.0), ([0.0, 50.0, 12.0], [0.0; 3], 0.0), ([60.0, 0.0, 0.0], [0.0; 3], 0.0)];
    for (how, o) in both() {
        assert_eq!(tick_with(o, 1, &side), [1], "{how}: in sight");
    }
}

// Two cars on one road up a hill weigh as before (a road at 25 % for 60 m, at 20 % for 100 and 200 m), and so does a

#[test]
fn up_a_hill_and_over_a_bump_as_before() {

        ([0.0, 3.0, 5.0], [0.0, -7.0, 0.0]),

    ] {
        let snaps = [([0.0, 0.0, 0.0], [0.0; 3], 0.0), (near, [0.0; 3], 0.0), (far, [0.0; 3], 0.0)];
        for (how, o) in both() {
            assert_eq!(tick_with(o.clone(), 1, &snaps), [1], "{how}: {near:?} before {far:?}");

    }

/// one tick of a hub that has the players' HELLOs and SNAPs in free roam (place, velocity, heading, the nose's slope);
/// player 0's links (it asks for `links`, the others for 48)
fn tick_posed(o: RoamOptions, links: u8, snaps: &[([f64; 3], [f64; 3], f64, f64)]) -> Vec<u32> {
    let mut k = Kit::new(o);
    for (i, &(p, v, h, slope)) in snaps.iter().enumerate() {
        join(&mut k, i as u32, if i == 0 { links } else { 48 });
        k.from(W(i as u32), &snap_pose(100 + i as u32, p, v, h, slope, 2));
    }
    k.clear();
    k.hub.tick();
    links_of(&k, 0)
}

// Up a hill, a car in front counts from the view point as it always did: the view point is up the slope the car's
// nose is on.  Player 0 parked facing up a road at 15 %, car 1 parked 150 m on up it (22.5 m higher), car 2 100 m
// beside it on flat ground: car 1 first.  (Were the view point at player 0's own height, 22.5 m under car 1, car 1
// would weigh as on a road above, and car 2 would come first.)
#[test]
fn up_a_hill_the_view_point_is_up_the_slope() {
    for (slope, want) in [(0.15, 1), (0.0, 2)] {
        let snaps = [
            ([0.0, 0.0, 0.0], [0.0; 3], 0.0, slope),
            ([150.0, 0.0, 22.5], [0.0; 3], 0.0, slope),
            ([0.0, -100.0, 0.0], [0.0; 3], -PI / 2.0, 0.0),
        ];
        for (how, o) in both() {
            assert_eq!(tick_posed(o.clone(), 1, &snaps), [want], "{how}: the nose {slope} up");
            assert_eq!(tick_posed(flat(&o), 1, &snaps), [1], "{how}, as before: the nose {slope} up");
        }
    }
}

// ...and so is the place 4 s ahead: player 0 drives up a road at 15 % at 25 m/s, car 1 parked 100 m on up it (15 m
// higher, facing down), car 2 parked 60 m beside: car 1 first, where player 0 will be in 4 s.
#[test]
fn up_a_hill_the_place_ahead_is_up_the_slope() {

        }
    }
}

// A car going up fast (a hop, a ramp) is where its SNAP had it, not moved on at its speed up (a second at 8 m/s would

#[test]
fn a_car_going_up_is_where_it_is() {

// a player in a shop still counts 100 m up, at least, under the highway or on it: a car in free roam 80 m off comes
// before it at 10 m
#[test]
fn a_player_in_a_shop_counts_100_m_up() {
    for z in [0.0, 12.0] {
        for (how, o) in both() {
            let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions { degree: 1, ..o });
            for i in 0..3 {
                join(&mut k, i, 1);
            }
            k.from(W(0), &snap(100, [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]));
            k.from(W(1), &snap_n(101, [10.0, 0.0, z], 4, 1));
            k.from(W(2), &snap(102, [80.0, 0.0, 0.0]));

/// a number of [0, 1) from i and t (the same every run)
fn hash(i: u32, t: u32) -> f64 {
    let x = (u64::from(i) << 32 | u64::from(t)).wrapping_mul(0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15);
    ((x ^ x >> 29).wrapping_mul(0xBF58_476D_1CE4_E5B9) >> 11) as f64 / (1u64 << 53) as f64
}

// The grid's three walks give the links every pair sorted gives, tick after tick, on roads above roads: a highway 12 m
// over a street, a crowd on each (one over the other), a hill at 20 %, cars hopping over bumps, players in a shop or
// paused, 16, 32 or 48 links each; and read on four threads, the same lists, byte for byte
#[test]
fn the_grid_links_as_every_pair_on_roads_above_roads() {
    let n = 500u32;
    let ground = |x: f64| if x > 300.0 { (x - 300.0) * 0.2 } else { 0.0 };
    let start: Vec<([f64; 3], [f64; 3])> = (0..n)
        .map(|i| {
            let (x, y, a, b) = ((hash(i, 0) - 0.5) * 1600.0, (hash(i, 1) - 0.5) * 1600.0, hash(i, 2) - 0.5, hash(i, 3) - 0.5);
            match i % 5 {
                // the two crowds, one over the other
                0 => ([a * 60.0, b * 16.0, if i % 2 == 0 { 12.0 } else { 0.0 }], [0.0; 3]),
                // on the highway (y near 0), along x
                1 => ([x, b * 16.0, 12.0], [if a < 0.0 { 40.0 } else { -40.0 }, 0.0, 0.0]),
                // on the streets, the hill's too
                _ => ([x, y, ground(x)], [a * 50.0, b * 50.0, 0.0]),
            }
        })
        .collect();
    let run = |o: RoamOptions| {
        let mut k = Kit::new(o);
        for i in 0..n {
            join(&mut k, i, [16u8, 32, 48][(i % 3) as usize]);
        }
        let mut cars = start.clone();
        let mut sent = Vec::new();
        for t in 0..10u32 {
            for (i, (p, v)) in cars.iter_mut().enumerate() {
                let i = i as u32;
                if i % 5 >= 1 {
                    p[0] = (p[0] + v[0] * 0.5).clamp(-800.0, 800.0);
                    p[1] = (p[1] + v[1] * 0.5).clamp(-800.0, 800.0);
                }
                if i % 5 >= 2 {
                    // a hop over a bump now and then, up to 9 m
                    p[2] = ground(p[0]) + if hash(i, 10 + t) < 0.1 { hash(i, 100 + t) * 9.0 } else { 0.0 };
                }
                let status = if i.is_multiple_of(13) {
                    4
                } else if i.is_multiple_of(17) {
                    5
                } else {
                    2
                };
                k.from(W(i), &snap_moving(100 + i, *p, *v, v[1].atan2(v[0]), status));
            }
            k.clear();
            k.hub.tick();
            sent.push((k.lists(), k.sent.lock().clone()));
            k.step(500.0);
        }
        sent
    };
    let every = run(RoamOptions { exact_room: 1000, ..RoamOptions::default() });
    let grid = run(RoamOptions { exact_room: 1, link_threads: 1, ..RoamOptions::default() });
    let grid4 = run(RoamOptions { exact_room: 1, link_threads: 4, ..RoamOptions::default() });
    for (t, ((a, _), (b, sb))) in every.iter().zip(&grid).enumerate() {
        assert_eq!(a.len(), n as usize);
        for (key, l) in a {
            let mut x: Vec<u32> = l.iter().map(|e| e.vip).collect();
            let mut y: Vec<u32> = b[key].iter().map(|e| e.vip).collect();
            x.sort();
            y.sort();
            assert_eq!(x, y, "tick {t}, player {key}");
        }
        assert!(*sb == grid4[t].1, "tick {t}: on four threads, the same lists");
    }
}

//! How many links each player gets: what its HELLO asks for (roam_core version 10: the friends' cars its game shows,
//! up to 64 from version 14, 48 before), the hub's `degree` at most; a core before version 10, which reads lists of 32
//! at most, gets 32.

mod kit;

use kit::*;
use nfsu2_roam::RoamOptions;

/// browser i's address, for more players than V's: 10.77.0.2 and on
#[allow(non_snake_case)]
fn W(i: u32) -> u32 {
    0x0A4D_0002 + i
}

/// the links of the player at W(i), as the hub's lists to it say
fn links_of(k: &Kit, i: u32) -> usize {
    k.lists().get(&format!("{}:47210", W(i))).map_or(0, |l| l.len())
}

// 100 players within 30 m: those that ask for 16 get 16, those of a core before version 10 (which say nothing) 32 at
// most, those of version 10 that say nothing too, and those that ask for 48 more than 32, 48 at most and 90 % of that on
// the whole (the nearest pairs first: a player whose farther candidates are full keeps fewer, as at 32)
#[test]
fn players_get_the_links_they_ask_for() {
    let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions { view_m: 1e-9, ..RoamOptions::default() });
    let ask = |i: u32| -> (u16, u8) {
        match i {
            0..10 => (10, 16),
            10..20 => (9, 0),
            20..25 => (10, 0),
            _ => (10, 48),
        }
    };
    for i in 0..100u32 {
        let (core, links) = ask(i);
        k.from(W(i), &hello_with(100 + i, &HelloOpts { core, links, ..Default::default() }));
        k.from(W(i), &snap(100 + i, [(i % 10) as f64 * 3.0 + 0.25, (i / 10) as f64 * 3.0 + 0.25, 0.0]));
    }
    k.hub.tick();
    let mut many = Vec::new();
    for i in 0..100u32 {
        let n = links_of(&k, i);
        match ask(i) {
            (10, 16) => assert_eq!(n, 16, "player {i}"),
            (_, 0) => assert!((29..=32).contains(&n), "player {i} ({:?}): {n}", ask(i)),
            _ => {
                assert!((33..=48).contains(&n), "player {i}: {n}");
                many.push(n);
            }
        }
    }
    assert!(many.iter().sum::<usize>() as f64 >= 0.9 * 48.0 * many.len() as f64, "{many:?}");
    // asking for more than the hub gives: the hub's most
    let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions { degree: 40, view_m: 1e-9, ..RoamOptions::default() });
    for i in 0..60u32 {
        k.from(W(i), &hello_with(100 + i, &HelloOpts { core: 10, links: 48, ..Default::default() }));
        k.from(W(i), &snap(100 + i, [(i % 10) as f64 * 3.0 + 0.25, (i / 10) as f64 * 3.0 + 0.25, 0.0]));
    }
    k.hub.tick();
    let n: Vec<usize> = (0..60).map(|i| links_of(&k, i)).collect();
    assert!(n.iter().all(|&x| x <= 40) && n.iter().sum::<usize>() >= 36 * 60, "the hub's degree (40) at most: {n:?}");
}

// a player that asks for fewer links later (its Players' cars shown turned down) gets fewer at the next tick
#[test]
fn a_player_that_asks_for_fewer_gets_fewer() {
    let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions { view_m: 1e-9, ..RoamOptions::default() });
    let hello = |k: &mut Kit, i: u32, links: u8| k.from(W(i), &hello_with(100 + i, &HelloOpts { core: 10, links, ..Default::default() }));
    for i in 0..60u32 {
        hello(&mut k, i, 48);
        k.from(W(i), &snap(100 + i, [(i % 10) as f64 * 3.0 + 0.25, (i / 10) as f64 * 3.0 + 0.25, 0.0]));
    }
    k.hub.tick();
    assert!(links_of(&k, 0) > 32, "{}", links_of(&k, 0));
    hello(&mut k, 0, 20);
    k.clear();
    k.hub.tick();
    assert_eq!(links_of(&k, 0), 20);
    assert!((1..60).all(|i| (33..=48).contains(&links_of(&k, i))), "the others keep more than 32");
}

// the pairs the server's counts read (nfsu2-lan paths.rs): each link once, the lower address first, the same links the
// lists name; a player gone takes its pairs with it
#[test]
fn link_pairs_are_the_links_once() {
    let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions { view_m: 1e-9, ..RoamOptions::default() });
    for i in 0..5u32 {
        k.from(W(i), &hello(100 + i));
        k.from(W(i), &snap(100 + i, [i as f64 * 3.0 + 0.25, 0.25, 0.0]));
    }
    k.hub.tick();
    let pairs = k.hub.link_pairs();
    assert_eq!(pairs.len(), 10, "five players near each other: every pair linked once, {pairs:x?}");
    assert!(pairs.iter().all(|&(a, b)| a < b));
    let listed: usize = (0..5).map(|i| links_of(&k, i)).sum();
    assert_eq!(listed, 2 * pairs.len(), "the lists name each link from both ends");
    k.hub.peer_gone(W(4));
    k.hub.tick();
    let pairs = k.hub.link_pairs();
    assert_eq!(pairs.len(), 6);
    assert!(pairs.iter().all(|&(a, b)| a != W(4) && b != W(4)));
}

// 100 players within 30 m: those of core version 14 that ask for 64 get more than 32, 64 at most and 90 % of that on the
// whole (those in the far corner, whose farther candidates are full, 43); those of versions 10 to 13, which read lists
// of 48 at most, get 48 at most whatever they ask for
#[test]
fn players_of_core_14_get_up_to_64() {
    let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions { view_m: 1e-9, ..RoamOptions::default() });
    let ask = |i: u32| -> (u16, u8) {
        match i {
            0..10 => (13, 64),
            10..20 => (10, 48),
            _ => (14, 64),
        }
    };
    for i in 0..100u32 {
        let (core, links) = ask(i);
        k.from(W(i), &hello_with(100 + i, &HelloOpts { core, links, ..Default::default() }));
        k.from(W(i), &snap(100 + i, [(i % 10) as f64 * 3.0 + 0.25, (i / 10) as f64 * 3.0 + 0.25, 0.0]));
    }
    k.hub.tick();
    let mut many = Vec::new();
    for i in 0..100u32 {
        let n = links_of(&k, i);
        if ask(i).0 < 14 {
            assert!((33..=48).contains(&n), "player {i} ({:?}): {n}", ask(i));
        } else {
            assert!((33..=64).contains(&n), "player {i}: {n}");
            many.push(n);
        }
    }
    assert!(many.iter().sum::<usize>() as f64 >= 0.9 * 64.0 * many.len() as f64, "{many:?}");
}

//! Race lobbies (roam_core.h RC_MSG_LOBBY, RC_MSG_LOBBIES): a host's advert to the hub, the open lobbies of a room
//! with the world map's answer to a player that takes them, and the links a lobby needs first.

mod kit;

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::process::Command;
use std::sync::Arc;

use kit::*;
use nfsu2_claims::owner_of_token;
use nfsu2_roam::{CarBan, CarBans, Hosted, RoamOptions};
use parking_lot::Mutex;

fn repo() -> PathBuf {
    Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("../../../..")
}

/// browser i's address: 10.77.0.2 and on
#[allow(non_snake_case)]
fn W(i: u32) -> u32 {
    0x0A4D_0002 + i
}

/// a datagram's flags set (and its CRC again)
fn with_flags(mut d: Vec<u8>, flags: u16) -> Vec<u8> {
    d[14..16].copy_from_slice(&flags.to_le_bytes());
    let len = d.len();
    let crc = crc32fast::hash(&d[..len - 4]);
    d[len - 4..].copy_from_slice(&crc.to_le_bytes());
    d
}

/// a player of core version 5 in `room`, with the lobby flag or without
fn join(k: &mut Kit, i: u32, room: &str, lobbies: bool) {
    let h = hello_with(100 + i, &HelloOpts { core: 5, room: fnv1a(room), ..Default::default() });
    k.from(W(i), &with_flags(h, if lobbies { 0x0080 } else { 0 }));
}

/// a LOBBY datagram as roam_core.c lays it out (op arg state max, to, lobby, race, x y, t, n, away seconds, ids)
fn lobby(sender: u32, op: u8, to: u32, id: u32, race: u32, x: i16, y: i16, state: u8, max: u8, ids: &[u32]) -> Vec<u8> {
    lobby_t(sender, op, to, id, race, x, y, state, max, ids, 0)
}

/// `lobby` with its t (an ADVERT's: 0x8000 its counts said, 0x0040 for its host's friends and crew-mates only)
fn lobby_t(sender: u32, op: u8, to: u32, id: u32, race: u32, x: i16, y: i16, state: u8, max: u8, ids: &[u32], t: u16) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut p = vec![0u8; 24 + 4 * ids.len()];
    p[20..22].copy_from_slice(&t.to_le_bytes());
    p[0] = op;
    p[2] = state;
    p[3] = max;
    p[4..8].copy_from_slice(&to.to_le_bytes());
    p[8..12].copy_from_slice(&id.to_le_bytes());
    p[12..16].copy_from_slice(&race.to_le_bytes());
    p[16..18].copy_from_slice(&x.to_le_bytes());
    p[18..20].copy_from_slice(&y.to_le_bytes());
    p[22] = ids.len() as u8;
    for (i, v) in ids.iter().enumerate() {
        p[24 + 4 * i..28 + 4 * i].copy_from_slice(&v.to_le_bytes());
    }
    dgram(12, sender, &p)
}

/// the LOBBIES datagrams the hub sent since the last clear: (to, req, [(x, y, race, n, max, state)])
type Lobbies = (u32, u16, Vec<(i16, i16, u32, u8, u8, u8)>);
fn lobbies(k: &Kit) -> Vec<Lobbies> {
    k.sent
        .lock()
        .iter()
        .filter(|(_, f)| f[16 + 5] == 13)
        .map(|(vip, f)| {
            let d = &f[16..];
            let n = d[18] as usize;
            let e = (0..n)
                .map(|i| {
                    let o = 19 + 11 * i;
                    let race = u32::from_le_bytes([d[o + 4], d[o + 5], d[o + 6], d[o + 7]]);
                    (i16::from_le_bytes([d[o], d[o + 1]]), i16::from_le_bytes([d[o + 2], d[o + 3]]), race, d[o + 8], d[o + 9], d[o + 10])
                })
                .collect();
            (*vip, u16::from_le_bytes([d[16], d[17]]), e)
        })
        .collect()
}

// the hosts' adverts are kept per player; a player that takes lobbies gets its room's with its world map, nearest
// first; one that does not, or of another room, does not; a closed lobby, a stale advert or a bad one is not listed
#[test]
fn the_world_map_brings_the_rooms_open_lobbies() {
    let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions { degree: 1, ..RoamOptions::default() });
    join(&mut k, 0, "", true);
    join(&mut k, 1, "", true);
    join(&mut k, 2, "", true);
    join(&mut k, 3, "", false);
    join(&mut k, 4, "red", true);
    for i in 0..5 {
        k.from(W(i), &snap(100 + i, [i as f64 * 100.0, 0.0, 0.0]));
    }
    // 1 and 2 host (2 nearer to 0), 4 hosts in another room; to a player, not the hub: not kept
    k.from(W(1), &lobby(101, 1, 0, 0xA1, 0x1111, 500, 0, 0, 6, &[101]));
    k.from(W(2), &lobby(102, 1, 0, 0xA2, 0x2222, 50, -20, 0, 4, &[102, 103]));
    k.from(W(4), &lobby(104, 1, 0, 0xA4, 0x4444, 0, 0, 0, 6, &[104]));
    k.from(W(3), &lobby(103, 1, 100, 0xA3, 0x3333, 0, 0, 0, 6, &[103]));
    // a bad one: the same player twice
    k.from(W(3), &lobby(103, 1, 0, 0xA5, 0x5555, 0, 0, 0, 6, &[103, 103]));
    k.hub.tick();
    k.clear();
    k.from(W(0), &mapreq_base(100, 7, 2048, 0));
    assert_eq!(lobbies(&k), [(W(0), 7, vec![(50, -20, 0x2222, 2, 4, 0), (500, 0, 0x1111, 1, 6, 0)])]);
    // without the flag: the map, no lobbies; another room: its own
    k.clear();
    k.from(W(3), &mapreq_base(103, 1, 2048, 0));
    assert!(lobbies(&k).is_empty() && !k.sent.lock().is_empty(), "a player that takes none gets its map only");
    k.clear();
    k.from(W(4), &mapreq_base(104, 1, 2048, 0));
    assert_eq!(lobbies(&k), [(W(4), 1, vec![(0, 0, 0x4444, 1, 6, 0)])]);
    // 1 closes its lobby (another id closes nothing), 2's advert goes stale: none listed
    k.from(W(2), &lobby(102, 5, 0, 0xFF, 0x2222, 50, -20, 1, 4, &[]));
    k.from(W(1), &lobby(101, 5, 0, 0xA1, 0x1111, 500, 0, 0, 6, &[]));
    k.step(1100.0);
    k.clear();
    k.from(W(0), &mapreq_base(100, 8, 2048, 0));
    assert_eq!(lobbies(&k), [(W(0), 8, vec![(50, -20, 0x2222, 2, 4, 0)])], "only 2's, closed with another id");
    k.step(3100.0);
    k.from(W(0), &snap(100, [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]));
    k.clear();
    k.from(W(0), &mapreq_base(100, 9, 2048, 0));
    assert_eq!(lobbies(&k), [(W(0), 9, vec![])], "a stale advert is a lobby gone");
}

// a host the player blocks by name (any case: both are "p" here) is not on its list (`Hub::blocks`)
#[test]
fn a_blocked_hosts_lobby_is_not_listed() {
    let mut k = Kit::new(RoamOptions::default());
    join(&mut k, 0, "", true);
    join(&mut k, 1, "", true);
    for i in 0..2 {
        k.from(W(i), &snap(100 + i, [i as f64 * 100.0, 0.0, 0.0]));
    }
    k.from(W(1), &lobby(101, 1, 0, 0xA1, 0x1111, 500, 0, 0, 6, &[101]));
    k.clear();

    k.hub.blocks(W(0), vec!["P".into()]);
    k.step(1100.0);
