/// The socket's file as this server made it, for its stop (`remove`)
pub struct Socket {
    path: String,
    /// its device and inode
    id: (u64, u64),
}

impl Socket {
    /// At the stop: the file goes, as long as it is still this server's socket (a server started since on the same
    /// state folder has put its own there, and keeps it).  A socket's file stays on the disk after its process ends.
    pub fn remove(&self) {
        if std::fs::symlink_metadata(&self.path).is_ok_and(|m| m.file_type().is_socket() && (m.dev(), m.ino()) == self.id) {
            let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&self.path);
        }
    }
}

/// The socket, for as long as the server runs (a socket's file of that name from before goes first: one a server
/// that ended without its stop left behind).  Without it (the path too long for a socket, say) the server runs on,
/// and says so: None.
pub fn listen(app: Arc<App>) -> Option<Socket> {
    let path = paths::join(&app.o.state, SOCKET);
    if std::fs::symlink_metadata(&path).is_ok_and(|m| m.file_type().is_socket()) {
        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&path);
    }
    let l = match UnixListener::bind(&path) {
        Ok(l) => l,
        Err(e) => {
            log::error(&format!("{path}: {e} (the control socket: no kick or ban without it)"));
            return None;
        }
    };
    let _ = std::fs::set_permissions(&path, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600));
    let id = std::fs::symlink_metadata(&path).map_or((0, 0), |m| (m.dev(), m.ino()));
    tokio::spawn(async move {
        loop {
            match l.accept().await {
                Ok((s, _)) => {
                    let app = app.clone();
                    tokio::spawn(async move {
                        let _ = tokio::time::timeout(WITHIN, serve(app, s)).await;
                    });
                }
                Err(_) => tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100)).await,
            }
        }
    });
    Some(Socket { path, id })
}

async fn serve(app: Arc<App>, s: UnixStream) {
    let (r, mut w) = s.into_split();
    let mut line = String::new();
    if BufReader::new(r.take(MAX_LINE)).read_line(&mut line).await.is_err() {
        return;
    }
    let words: Vec<String> = serde_json::from_str(&line).unwrap_or_default();
    let (ok, text) = match app.control(&words).await {
        Ok(t) => (true, t),
        Err(t) => (false, t),
    };
    let mut answer = json!({ "ok": ok, "text": text }).to_string();
    answer.push('\n');
    let _ = w.write_all(answer.as_bytes()).await;
    let _ = w.shutdown().await;
}

/// the same player in two connections: the same keyphrase, the same page id, or (a page without one) the same address
fn same_player(a: &Who, b: &Who) -> bool {
    if a.owner.is_some() && a.owner == b.owner {
        return true;
    }
    match (&a.browser, &b.browser) {
        (Some(x), Some(y)) => x == y,
        _ => a.ident.is_some() && a.ident == b.ident,
    }
}

fn names(w: &Who, sel: &str, vip: u32) -> bool {
    let sel = sel.to_lowercase();
    if vip != 0 { w.vip == vip } else { w.name.to_lowercase() == sel || w.game.iter().any(|g| g.to_lowercase() == sel) }
}

/// whether one of its names has `has` (in lower case) in it
fn has_name(w: &Who, has: &str) -> bool {
    w.name.to_lowercase().contains(has) || w.game.iter().any(|g| g.to_lowercase().contains(has))
}

/// `who`'s line for one: address, name, what it does and for how long (or when it left), and the other names its
/// game shows
fn line(w: &Who, now: i64) -> String {
    let name = format!("\"{}\"", w.name);
    let pad = 24usize.saturating_sub(name.chars().count());
    let what = match w.left {
        Some(t) => format!("left {} ago", span(now - t)),
        None => format!("{}, {}", if w.doing.is_empty() { "menus or loading" } else { w.doing }, span(now - w.since)),
    };
    let game = if w.game.is_empty() {
        String::new()
    } else {
        format!("; its game shows {}", w.game.iter().map(|g| format!("\"{g}\"")).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", "))
    };
    format!("{:<13}{name}{} {what}{game}", vip_str(w.vip), " ".repeat(pad))
}

/// "10.77.3.41 \"Bob\", 10.77.5.2 \"Eve\""
fn listed(ws: &[&Who]) -> String {
    ws.iter().map(|w| format!("{} \"{}\"", vip_str(w.vip), w.name)).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", ")
}

/// what a ban did to the players on the switch (`App::reach`), for the operator: "removed A", "out of races now: B"
fn reached_lines(removed: &[&Who], out: &[&Who]) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut t = Vec::new();
    if !removed.is_empty() {
        t.push(format!("removed {}", listed(removed)));
    }
    if !out.is_empty() {
        t.push(format!("out of races now: {}", listed(out)));
    }
    t
}

/// the same for the log: "removed: A; out of races now: B", "nobody on the switch"
fn reached_log(removed: &[&Who], out: &[&Who]) -> String {
    let t: Vec<String> = [("removed", removed), ("out of races now", out)]
        .into_iter()
        .filter(|(_, l)| !l.is_empty())
        .map(|(what, l)| format!("{what}: {}", listed(l)))
        .collect();
    if t.is_empty() { "nobody on the switch".into() } else { t.join("; ") }
}

/// the message's part of a log line
fn quoted(msg: &str) -> String {
    if msg.is_empty() { String::new() } else { format!(": \"{msg}\"") }
}

/// "#4, #9"
fn numbers(ids: &[u64]) -> String {
    ids.iter().map(|n| format!("#{n}")).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", ")
}

/// a connection's keys for the bans (nfsu2-bans `Keys`)
fn keys_of(bans: &Bans, w: &Who) -> Keys {
    bans.keys(w.ident.as_deref(), w.browser.as_deref(), w.owner.as_deref())
}

/// what a new ban names the player by, for the operator: "its page, its keyphrase and its address"
fn named_by(k: &Keys) -> String {
    if k.pages.is_empty() && k.owners.is_empty() {
        return "its address only (no page id: a tool, not the page)".into();
    }
    let its = |n: usize, one: &str, many: &str| match n {
        0 => None,
        1 => Some(format!("its {one}")),
        n => Some(format!("its {n} {many}")),
    };
    let parts: Vec<String> =
        [its(k.pages.len(), "page", "pages"), its(k.owners.len(), "keyphrase", "keyphrases"), its(k.addrs.len(), "address", "addresses")]
            .into_iter()
            .flatten()
            .collect();
    match parts.split_last() {
        Some((last, [])) => last.clone(),
        Some((last, rest)) => format!("{} and {last}", rest.join(", ")),
        None => String::new(),
    }
}

/// how long a ban lasts, for the operator: "for 14 d (until 2026-11-16 10:00 UTC)", "for good"
fn how_long(until: Option<i64>, now: i64) -> String {
    match until {
        Some(u) => format!("for {} (until {})", span(u - now), when(u)),
        None => "for good".to_string(),
    }
}

/// One of a player's bans as `history` and the replies list it: "#12 race ban \"Bob\", 14 d from 2026-10-16 10:00
/// UTC, ended 2026-10-30 10:00 UTC: \"Cheating\""
fn record_line(r: &Record, now: i64) -> String {
    let b = &r.ban;
    let length = match (b.kind, b.until) {
        (Kind::Name, _) => format!("on {}", when(b.at)),
        (_, Some(u)) => format!("{} from {}", span(u - b.at), when(b.at)),
        (_, None) => format!("for good from {}", when(b.at)),
    };
    let state = match r.past {
        None => match b.until {
            Some(u) => format!(", in force ({} more)", span(u - now)),
            None => ", in force".into(),
        },
        Some(_) if b.kind == Kind::Name => String::new(),
        Some((e, How::Over, _)) => format!(", ended {}", when(e)),
        Some((e, How::Lifted, _)) => format!(", lifted {}", when(e)),
        Some((e, How::Replaced, by)) => format!(", replaced {}{}", when(e), by.map_or(String::new(), |n| format!(" by #{n}"))),
    };
    format!("#{} {} \"{}\", {length}{state}{}", b.id, b.kind.word(), b.name, quoted(&b.msg))
}

/// the reply's lines of what the player had before (the latest `EARLIER_MAX`), none for nothing
fn earlier(recs: &[Record], now: i64) -> Vec<String> {
    if recs.is_empty() {
        return vec![];
    }
    let skip = recs.len().saturating_sub(EARLIER_MAX);
    let mut t = vec![format!("before: {} (history lists them)", recs.len())];
    t.extend(recs[skip..].iter().map(|r| format!("  {}", record_line(r, now))));
    t
}

/// A ban as `App::ban_by` made it: the ban, how many connections on the switch it reached at once (removed or out of
/// races), and the operator's answer
pub(super) struct Made {
    pub ban: Ban,
    pub reached: usize,
    pub text: String,
}

/// The handles of the `[cheat]` lines of races (nfsu2-online's, and nfsu2-roam's race results), which `ban` takes
/// for a week (nfsu2-bans marks): the hosts' console lines go through `tag`.  Free roam's lines get none: cheating
/// there is let be.  The switch is given once it is made, after the hosts.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct Marker {
    bans: Arc<Bans>,
    lan: Arc<OnceLock<Arc<LanSwitch>>>,
}

impl Marker {
    pub fn new(bans: Arc<Bans>) -> Marker {
        Marker { bans, lan: Default::default() }
    }

    pub fn set_switch(&self, lan: Arc<LanSwitch>) {
        let _ = self.lan.set(lan);
    }

    /// `line` with the handle of the player it names after it, " (ban c17)", when it is a `[cheat]` line of a race and
    /// the switch knows who had its address (the player on it, or one who left it in the last hour); else None.  The
    /// same player's earlier lines under other names, and its bans since, follow the handle (`tagged`).
    pub fn tag(&self, line: &str) -> Option<String> {
        let (vip, name) = race_cheat(line)?;
        self.mark_of(vip, name).map(|m| tagged(line, &m))
    }

    /// The mark of the player a race's `[cheat]` line (or the server's own race ban: autoban.rs) names by its address
    /// and name, made or kept up (its handle, its earlier names, the bans made of it); None when the switch knows no
    /// one of it, or nothing to name it by.
    pub fn mark_of(&self, vip: u32, name: &str) -> Option<nfsu2_bans::Marked> {
        let at = self.lan.get()?.who_at(vip);
        let k = keys_of(&self.bans, pick_marked(&at, name)?);
        if k.is_empty() {
            return None;
        }
        match self.bans.mark(name, k, now_ms()) {
            Ok(m) => Some(m),
            Err(e) => {
                log::error(&format!("bans.json: {e}"));
                None
            }
        }
    }
}

/// A `[cheat]` line with its player's handle after it: `(ban c17)`; `(ban c17; before as "Bob", "Rob"; was ban #4)`
/// when its earlier lines named it otherwise and it was banned since its first one (a ban that ended or was lifted:
/// it is back), `race ban #4 in force` when that ban is in force, `rename #6` for a rename
fn tagged(line: &str, m: &nfsu2_bans::Marked) -> String {
    let mut t = format!("ban {}", m.handle);
    if !m.before.is_empty() {
        t += &format!("; before as {}", m.before.iter().map(|n| format!("\"{n}\"")).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", "));
    }
    for &(id, live, kind) in &m.bans {
        let w = kind.word();
        t += &match (kind, live) {
            (Kind::Name, _) => format!("; {w} #{id}"),
            (_, true) => format!("; {w} #{id} in force"),
            (_, false) => format!("; was {w} #{id}"),
        };
    }
    format!("{line} ({t})")
}

/// the address and name a `[cheat]` line of a race begins with: `[cheat] 10.77.3.41 "Bob": won the online race "..."`
/// or `finished 2 in the online race "..."` (nfsu2-online lobby.rs), `[cheat] 10.77.3.41 "Bob": won the race of lobby
/// ...` or `its car jumped 280 m at once in the race of lobby ...` (nfsu2-roam results.rs) or `raced in the race of
/// lobby ...` (an edited car, hub.rs); None for any other line
fn race_cheat(line: &str) -> Option<(u32, &str)> {
    let (vip, rest) = line.strip_prefix("[cheat] ")?.split_once(" \"")?;
    let (name, what) = rest.split_once("\": ")?;
    let race = what.contains(" the online race \"") || what.contains(" the race of lobby ");
    let vip = vip_num(vip);
    (race && vip != 0).then_some((vip, name))
}

/// of the ones who had an address (`LanSwitch::who_at`: the one on it now first), the one a line names: by its name
/// in its Online form (an Online persona is the page's name made so), else the only player there was
fn pick_marked<'a>(at: &'a [Who], name: &str) -> Option<&'a Who> {
    let online = |n: &str| nfsu2_claims::clean(n).map(|c| c.to_lowercase());
    let want = online(name);
    at.iter().find(|w| want.is_some() && online(&w.name) == want).or_else(|| {
        let first = at.first()?;
        at.iter().all(|w| same_player(w, first)).then_some(first)
    })
}

/// The player a command names (`App::player`): its name for the operator, its keys, every name it plays under (its
/// page's and the ones its game shows), when it left (None: on the switch, or a handle's), the handle it was named by,
/// and its connections on the switch now
struct Player {
    name: String,
    keys: Keys,
    names: Vec<String>,
    left: Option<i64>,
    handle: Option<String>,
    vips: Vec<u32>,
}

impl App {
    /// One command (the module doc): Ok(the answer), Err(why not).
    pub async fn control(&self, words: &[String]) -> Result<String, String> {
        let word = |i: usize| words.get(i).map(String::as_str).unwrap_or("");
        let rest = |i: usize| words.get(i..).map(|w| w.join(" ")).unwrap_or_default();
        let now = now_ms();
        match word(0) {
            "who" => {
                let all = self.lan.who().await;
                let has = rest(1).to_lowercase();
                let pick: Vec<&Who> = all.iter().filter(|w| has_name(w, &has)).collect();
                let (here, gone): (Vec<&Who>, Vec<&Who>) = pick.iter().partition(|w| w.left.is_none());
                let called = if has.is_empty() { String::new() } else { format!(" called *{has}*") };
                let mut t = vec![format!("{} on the switch{called}", here.len())];
                t.extend(here.iter().map(|w| line(w, now)));
                if !gone.is_empty() {
                    t.push(format!("{} left in the last hour", gone.len()));
                    t.extend(gone.iter().rev().map(|w| line(w, now)));
                }
                Ok(t.join("\n"))
            }
            "kick" if !word(1).is_empty() => {
                let all = self.lan.who().await;
                let ws = self.pick(&all, word(1))?;
                let here: Vec<&Who> = ws.iter().copied().filter(|w| w.left.is_none()).collect();
                if here.is_empty() {
                    let w = ws[0];
                    return Err(format!(
                        "{} \"{}\" left {} ago: nothing to kick (ban takes one who left)",
                        vip_str(w.vip),
                        w.name,
                        span(now - w.left.unwrap_or(now))
                    ));
                }
                let msg = clean_msg(&rest(2));
                let m = Bytes::from(kick_message(&msg));
                let done: Vec<&Who> = here.into_iter().filter(|w| self.lan.expel(w.vip, m.clone(), CLOSE_KICKED)).collect();
                log::line(&format!("[ban] kicked {}{}", listed(&done), quoted(&msg)));
                Ok(format!("kicked {}", listed(&done)))
            }
            "ban" | "raceban" if !word(1).is_empty() && !word(2).is_empty() => {
                let kind = if word(0) == "raceban" { Kind::Races } else { Kind::Full };
                self.ban(kind, word(1), word(2), &rest(3), now).await
            }
            "rename" if !word(1).is_empty() => self.rename(word(1), &rest(2), now).await,
            "unban" if !word(1).is_empty() => {
                let sel = rest(1);
                let gone = self.bans.remove(&sel, now).map_err(|e| format!("bans.json: {e}"))?;
                if gone.is_empty() {
                    return Err(format!("no ban {} (bans lists them)", if sel.starts_with('#') { sel } else { format!("of \"{sel}\"") }));
                }
                // the players on the switch a lifted ban kept out of races, and no other one does: they race again
                let freed = self.races_again(&gone, now).await;
                let kind = |b: &Ban| if b.kind == Kind::Full { String::new() } else { format!(" ({})", b.kind.word()) };
                let t = gone.iter().map(|b| format!("#{} \"{}\"{}", b.id, b.name, kind(b))).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", ");
                let back = if freed.is_empty() { String::new() } else { format!("; races again: {}", freed.join(", ")) };
                log::line(&format!("[ban] lifted {t}{back}"));
                Ok(format!("lifted {t}{back}"))
            }
            "change" if word(1).starts_with('#') && !word(2).is_empty() => self.change(word(1), &words[2..], now).await,
            "history" if !word(1).is_empty() => self.history(&rest(1), now).await,
            "names" => {
                let list = self.bans.denied();
                if list.is_empty() {
                    return Ok("no names taken away".into());
                }
                Ok(list
                    .iter()
                    .map(|d| format!("{:<26} since {} (rename #{})", format!("\"{}\"", d.name), when(d.at), d.by))
                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                    .join("\n"))
            }
            "unname" if !word(1).is_empty() => {
                let sel = rest(1);
                let gone = self.bans.undeny(&sel, now).map_err(|e| format!("bans.json: {e}"))?;
                if gone.is_empty() {
                    return Err(format!("no name taken away reads as \"{sel}\" (names lists them)"));
                }
                let t = gone.iter().map(|d| format!("\"{}\"", d.name)).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", ");
                log::line(&format!("[ban] gave back {t}"));
                Ok(format!("gave back {t}: anyone may play under it again"))
            }
            "days" => {
                let n = if word(1).is_empty() { 30 } else { word(1).parse().map_err(|_| format!("days {}: a number of days", word(1)))? };
                let (day, c) = self.days.today(now);
                let mut t = vec![super::days::CSV_HEAD.to_string()];
                t.extend(self.days.history(n));
                t.push(format!("{day},{},{},{},{} (today so far)", c[0], c[1], c[2], c[3]));
                Ok(t.join("\n"))
            }
            "settings" => {
                // "settings fps" as well as "settings 7 fps"
                let (n, only) = match word(1).parse::<usize>() {
                    Ok(n) => (n, word(2)),
                    Err(_) => (7, word(1)),
                };
                let (from, to, mut t) = self.days.settings(n, now);
                if !only.is_empty() {
                    t.counts.retain(|k, _| k == only);
                    if t.counts.is_empty() {
                        return Err(format!("no one changed \"{only}\" from {from} to {to}"));
                    }
                }
                let head = format!(
                    "Settings changed from the device's defaults, as each browser had them at its first Play of a day \
                     (UTC), {from} to {to} (today so far); a browser counts once on each day it played:"
                );
                Ok(format!("{head}\n{}", t.table(if only.is_empty() { 8 } else { usize::MAX })))
            }
            "bans" => {
                let list = self.bans.list(now);
                if list.is_empty() {
                    return Ok("no bans".into());
                }
                Ok(list
                    .iter()
                    .map(|b| {
                        let name = format!("\"{}\"", b.name);
                        let pad = 24usize.saturating_sub(name.chars().count());
                        let until = match b.until {
                            Some(u) => format!("until {} ({} more)", when(u), span(u - now)),
                            None => "for good".into(),
                        };
                        // "4 pages (2 found later), 1 keyphrase, 6 addresses"
                        let n = |n: usize, later: usize, one: &str, many: &str| {
                            let found = if later == 0 { String::new() } else { format!(" ({later} found later)") };
                            format!("{n} {}{found}", if n == 1 { one } else { many })
                        };
                        let (pages, owners) = (b.pages.len() + b.later_pages.len(), b.owners.len() + b.later_owners.len());
                        let by = [
                            (pages > 0).then(|| n(pages, b.later_pages.len(), "page", "pages")),
                            (owners > 0).then(|| n(owners, b.later_owners.len(), "keyphrase", "keyphrases")),
                            Some(n(b.addrs.len(), 0, "address", "addresses")),
                        ]
                        .into_iter()
                        .flatten()
                        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                        .join(", ");
                        format!(
                            "{:<5}{name}{} {:<9}{until}{}; by {by}",
                            format!("#{}", b.id),
                            " ".repeat(pad),
                            b.kind.word(),
                            quoted(&b.msg)
                        )
                    })
                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                    .join("\n"))
            }
            "unclaim" if !word(1).is_empty() => {
                let Some(n) = &self.names else { return Err("no claimed names here (keyphrase saves are off)".into()) };
                match n.claims.unclaim(word(1)) {
                    Some(name) => {
                        log::line(&format!("[names] the operator freed \"{name}\""));
                        Ok(format!("\"{name}\" is free"))
                    }
                    None => Err(format!("nobody claimed \"{}\"", word(1))),
                }
            }
            "" | "help" => Ok(USAGE.into()),
            _ => Err(USAGE.into()),
        }
    }

    /// `ban` and `raceban`: a ban of `kind` of the player `sel` names, for `len`, with `msg`
    async fn ban(&self, kind: Kind, sel: &str, len: &str, msg: &str, now: i64) -> Result<String, String> {
        self.ban_by(kind, sel, len, msg, now, "").await.map(|m| m.text)
    }

    /// A ban as `ban` makes it (the operator's: `by` ""; the server's own, autoban.rs: what its log line says of why,
    /// after the message): the ban, and the answer `ban` gives
    pub(super) async fn ban_by(&self, kind: Kind, sel: &str, len: &str, msg: &str, now: i64, by: &str) -> Result<Made, String> {
        let until = parse_for(len)?.map(|ms| now + ms);
        let all = self.lan.who().await;
        let p = self.player(&all, sel, now)?;
        let before = self.bans.history(&p.keys, now);
        let msg = clean_msg(msg);
        let (ban, replaced) = self.bans.add(kind, &p.name, &p.keys, &msg, until, now).map_err(|e| format!("bans.json: {e}"))?;
        // every connection it names: the player's, removed (a full ban) or out of races from now on, and whoever shares
        // one of its addresses, out of races
        let (removed, out) = self.reach(&all, &ban, now);
        let who = match &p.handle {
            Some(h) => format!("\"{}\" ({h})", p.name),
            None => format!("\"{}\"", p.name),
        };
        let instead = if replaced.is_empty() { String::new() } else { format!("; in place of {}", numbers(&replaced)) };
        let log_what = if kind == Kind::Races { "race ban #" } else { "#" };
        log::line(&format!(
            "[ban] {log_what}{} {who} {}{}{instead}{by}; {}",
            ban.id,
            how_long(until, now),
            quoted(&msg),
            reached_log(&removed, &out)
        ));
        let mut t = vec![format!("{} #{}: {who} {}, by {}", kind.word(), ban.id, how_long(until, now), named_by(&p.keys))];
        if !replaced.is_empty() {
            t.push(format!("it takes the place of {}", numbers(&replaced)));
        }
        let reached = reached_lines(&removed, &out);
        if reached.is_empty() {
            t.push(match p.left {
                Some(l) => format!("not on the switch now (left {} ago)", span(now - l)),
                None => "not on the switch now".into(),
            });
        }
        let reached_now = removed.len() + out.len();
        t.extend(reached);
        t.extend(earlier(&before, now));
        Ok(Made { ban, reached: reached_now, text: t.join("\n") })
    }

    /// `rename`: the names of the player `sel` names taken away from everyone, its page asked for another.  The name
    /// the operator gave is taken; each other name it plays under (its page's, the ones its game shows over its cars)
    /// only when no other keyphrase than its own holds it (nfsu2-claims `holders`), and no other player on the switch
    /// now plays under a name that reads the same and is that player's own claim (`skip`).  A claim goes only with a
    /// name taken whose claim is the player's own.  (Until the 2026-11-05 security audit it took every name and freed
    /// each one's claim: an edited game that showed a victim's claimed name over its car, its page under an offensive
    /// name for the bait, had the victim's claim freed, its pages asked for another name, and the name and the ones
    /// that read the same nobody's until `unname`.)
    async fn rename(&self, sel: &str, msg: &str, now: i64) -> Result<String, String> {
        let all = self.lan.who().await;
        let p = self.player(&all, sel, now)?;
        // (NAME and Player, the game's names for nobody in particular, are never taken away)
        let nobody = [nfsu2_names::letters("NAME"), nfsu2_names::letters("Player")];
        let nobodys = |n: &String| nfsu2_names::letters(n).is_empty() || nobody.contains(&nfsu2_names::letters(n));
        if p.names.iter().all(nobodys) {
            return Err(format!("\"{}\": nothing to take away (the game's name for nobody in particular)", p.names.join("\", \"")));
        }
        // the name the operator gave (not an address, nor a [cheat] line's handle): the player's name as it named it
        let named = (p.handle.is_none() && vip_num(sel) == 0).then_some(p.name.as_str());
        let (take, skipped): (Vec<String>, Vec<(String, String)>) = {
            let (mut take, mut skipped) = (Vec::new(), Vec::new());
            for n in &p.names {
                match self.skip(&all, &p, n, now) {
                    Some(why) if !named.is_some_and(|x| x.eq_ignore_ascii_case(n)) => skipped.push((n.clone(), why)),
                    _ => take.push(n.clone()),
                }
            }
            (take, skipped)
        };
        let not_taken = skipped.iter().map(|(n, why)| format!("\"{n}\" ({why})")).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", ");
        if take.iter().all(nobodys) {
            return Err(format!("nothing taken away: {not_taken}; to take one, name it"));
        }
        let before = self.bans.history(&p.keys, now);
        let msg = clean_msg(msg);
        let (r, took) = self.bans.rename(&p.name, &take, &p.keys, &msg, now).map_err(|e| format!("bans.json: {e}"))?;
        let deny = self.bans.deny();
        let taken: Vec<&String> = take.iter().filter(|n| deny.has(n)).collect();
        // their claims go, the player's own (a name taken away is nobody's); another keyphrase's stays (the operator
        // named it: `unclaim` frees it)
        let (freed, stays): (Vec<String>, Vec<String>) = match &self.names {
            Some(c) => {
                let (mine, theirs): (Vec<&String>, Vec<&String>) =
                    taken.iter().copied().filter(|x| c.claims.holder(x, now).is_some()).partition(|x| self.owns(&p, &c.claims, x, now));
                (mine.iter().filter_map(|x| c.claims.unclaim(x)).collect(), theirs.iter().map(|x| x.to_string()).collect())
            }
            None => (vec![], vec![]),
        };
        // the player's connections, and anyone else's under a name that reads as one taken away: asked for another
        let asked: Vec<&Who> = all
            .iter()
            .filter(|x| x.left.is_none())
            .filter_map(|x| {
                let bad = std::iter::once(&x.name).chain(&x.game).find(|n| deny.has(n));
                let name = bad.or(taken.first().copied().filter(|_| p.vips.contains(&x.vip)))?;
                self.lan.expel(x.vip, Bytes::from(rename_message(name, &msg)), CLOSE_RENAME).then_some(x)
            })
            .collect();
        let names = taken.iter().map(|n| format!("\"{n}\"")).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", ");
        let new = if took.is_empty() { " (taken away already)" } else { "" };
        let claims = if freed.is_empty() { String::new() } else { format!("; claim freed: {}", freed.join(", ")) };
        let kept = if skipped.is_empty() { String::new() } else { format!("; not taken: {not_taken}") };
        log::line(&format!(
            "[ban] rename #{} \"{}\": {names}{new}{}{claims}{kept}; asked for another name: {}",
            r.id,
            p.name,
            quoted(&msg),
            listed(&asked)
        ));
        let mut t = vec![format!("rename #{}: {names} taken away from everyone{new}, and the names that read the same", r.id)];
        if !freed.is_empty() {
            t.push(format!("its claim went: {}", freed.join(", ")));
        }
        if !stays.is_empty() {
            t.push(format!("another keyphrase's claim stays: {} (unclaim frees it)", stays.join(", ")));
        }
        if !skipped.is_empty() {
            t.push(format!("not taken: {not_taken}; to take one, name it"));
        }
        t.push(if asked.is_empty() { "not on the switch now".into() } else { format!("asked for another name: {}", listed(&asked)) });
        t.extend(earlier(&before, now));
        Ok(t.join("\n"))
    }

    /// whether keyphrase `o` (nfsu2-claims' owner) is one of player p's (by its hash among p's keys: a `[cheat]` line's
    /// handle has only those)
    fn is_its(&self, p: &Player, o: &str) -> bool {
        self.bans.keys(None, None, Some(o)).owners.iter().all(|h| p.keys.owners.contains(h))
    }

    /// whether `name`'s claim (nfsu2-claims `holders`: a second form's too) is none or player p's own keyphrase's
    fn owns(&self, p: &Player, claims: &nfsu2_claims::Claims, name: &str, now: i64) -> bool {
        claims.holders(name, now).iter().all(|o| self.is_its(p, o))
    }

    /// Why `rename` leaves a name of player p's alone unless the operator named it: another keyphrase holds it, or
    /// another player on the switch now plays under a name that reads the same (nfsu2-names `letters`, as the names
    /// taken away are compared) and holds that name's claim, which a rename would take from it too.  None: taken.
    fn skip(&self, all: &[Who], p: &Player, name: &str, now: i64) -> Option<String> {
        let c = &self.names.as_ref()?.claims;
        if !self.owns(p, c, name, now) {
            return Some("another keyphrase's claimed name".into());
        }
        let l = nfsu2_names::letters(name);
        let theirs = |x: &&Who| x.left.is_none() && x.owner.as_deref().is_some_and(|o| !self.is_its(p, o));
        let other = all.iter().filter(theirs).find_map(|x| {
            std::iter::once(&x.name).chain(&x.game).find(|m| nfsu2_names::letters(m) == l && c.holder(m, now) == x.owner).map(|m| (x, m))
        });
        (!l.is_empty()).then_some(other).flatten().map(|(x, m)| format!("reads as {} \"{m}\", that player's claimed name", vip_str(x.vip)))
    }

    /// `change #ban <races|full|for>`: a ban in force made another kind, or to last another time from now on
    async fn change(&self, sel: &str, args: &[String], now: i64) -> Result<String, String> {
        let id = sel.trim_start_matches('#').parse::<u64>().map_err(|_| format!("{sel}: a ban's number, as bans lists them"))?;
        let (mut kind, mut until) = (None, None);
        for a in args {
            match a.to_lowercase().as_str() {
                "races" | "race" | "raceban" => kind = Some(Kind::Races),
                "full" | "ban" | "all" => kind = Some(Kind::Full),
                x => until = Some(parse_for(x)?.map(|ms| now + ms)),
            }
        }
        let (was, ban) = self
            .bans
            .change(id, kind, until, now)
            .map_err(|e| format!("bans.json: {e}"))?
            .ok_or_else(|| format!("no ban #{id} in force (bans lists them)"))?;
        // the players on the switch it names: removed now (a full ban), or out of races with what it says now; one made
        // a full ban from a race ban was let race no more before it, so whoever it names now goes
        let all = self.lan.who().await;
        let (removed, out) = self.reach(&all, &ban, now);
        let what = |b: &Ban| format!("{} {}", b.kind.word(), how_long(b.until, now));
        log::line(&format!("[ban] changed #{} \"{}\": {} (was {}); {}", id, ban.name, what(&ban), what(&was), reached_log(&removed, &out)));
        let mut t = vec![format!("#{id} \"{}\": {} (was {})", ban.name, what(&ban), what(&was))];
        t.extend(reached_lines(&removed, &out));
        Ok(t.join("\n"))
    }

    /// `history <player | #ban>`: the bans of the player (of that ban's player), in force and ended
    async fn history(&self, sel: &str, now: i64) -> Result<String, String> {
        let (who, recs) = match sel.strip_prefix('#').and_then(|n| n.parse::<u64>().ok()) {
            Some(n) => {
                let r = self.bans.record(n, now).ok_or_else(|| format!("no ban #{n} in the last year"))?;
                (format!("ban #{n}'s player \"{}\"", r.ban.name), self.bans.history(&r.ban.keys(), now))
            }
            None => {
                let all = self.lan.who().await;
                match self.player(&all, sel, now) {
                    Ok(p) => (format!("\"{}\"", p.name), self.bans.history(&p.keys, now)),
                    Err(_) => (format!("the bans of \"{sel}\" (by name: not on the switch)"), self.bans.history_by_name(sel, now)),
                }
            }
        };
        if recs.is_empty() {
            return Ok(format!("{who}: no bans or renames in the last year"));
        }
        let mut t = vec![format!("{who}: {} in the last year", recs.len())];
        t.extend(recs.iter().map(|r| record_line(r, now)));
        Ok(t.join("\n"))
    }

    /// the connections on the switch `ban` names now (`Bans::covers`): a full ban removes the player's own, a race ban
    /// and the address alone keep them out of races (its message: what it says now); the ones it removed, and the ones
    /// it keeps out of races
    fn reach<'a>(&self, all: &'a [Who], ban: &Ban, now: i64) -> (Vec<&'a Who>, Vec<&'a Who>) {
        let (mut removed, mut out) = (Vec::new(), Vec::new());
        for x in all.iter().filter(|x| x.left.is_none()) {
            match self.bans.covers(ban, &keys_of(&self.bans, x), now) {
                None => {}
                Some(Match::Own) if ban.kind == Kind::Full => {
                    if self.lan.expel(x.vip, Bytes::from(ban.message(Match::Own)), CLOSE_BANNED) {
                        removed.push(x);
                    }
                }
                Some(m) => {
                    if self.lan.set_races(x.vip, true, Bytes::from(ban.message(m))) {
                        out.push(x);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        (removed, out)
    }

    /// The players on the switch the bans in `lifted` kept out of races (a race ban, any ban by the address only),
    /// that no ban in force names: they race again (their pages hear so).  Their names and addresses.
    async fn races_again(&self, lifted: &[Ban], now: i64) -> Vec<String> {
        if lifted.is_empty() {
            return vec![];
        }
        let left = self.bans.list(now);
        let m = Bytes::from(races_lifted_message());
        let all = self.lan.who().await;
        all.iter()
            .filter(|x| x.left.is_none())
            .filter(|x| {
                let k = keys_of(&self.bans, x);
                let out = |b: &Ban| match self.bans.covers(b, &k, now) {
                    Some(Match::Own) => b.kind == Kind::Races,
                    Some(Match::Addr) => true,
                    None => false,
                };
                lifted.iter().any(out) && !left.iter().any(|b| self.bans.covers(b, &k, now).is_some())
            })
            .filter(|x| self.lan.set_races(x.vip, false, m.clone()))
            .map(|x| format!("{} \"{}\"", vip_str(x.vip), x.name))
            .collect()
    }

    /// The player `sel` names for `ban`, `raceban`, `rename` and `history`: a `[cheat]` line's handle (Marker), else
    /// the player's connections (`pick`: its tabs, its keyphrase on its other devices), all of them named by a ban
    fn player(&self, all: &[Who], sel: &str, now: i64) -> Result<Player, String> {
        if let Some(m) = self.bans.marked(sel, now) {
            let handle = Some(m.handle());
            return Ok(Player { name: m.name.clone(), keys: m.keys, names: vec![m.name], left: None, handle, vips: vec![] });
        }
        let ws = self.pick(all, sel)?;
        let mut k = Keys::default();
        let mut names: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
        for w in &ws {
            k.extend(keys_of(&self.bans, w));
            for n in std::iter::once(&w.name).chain(&w.game) {
                if !names.iter().any(|x| x.eq_ignore_ascii_case(n)) {
                    names.push(n.clone());
                }
            }
        }
        let w = ws[0];
        if k.is_empty() {
            return Err(format!("{} \"{}\": nothing to name it by (no address, no page id)", vip_str(w.vip), w.name));
        }
        // named as the operator named it: by the name over its car, when that is how
        let lower = sel.to_lowercase();
        let name = w.game.iter().find(|g| g.to_lowercase() == lower).unwrap_or(&w.name).clone();
        let vips = ws.iter().filter(|x| x.left.is_none()).map(|x| x.vip).collect();
        Ok(Player { name, keys: k, names, left: w.left, handle: None, vips })
    }

    /// The player `sel` names: a virtual address, or a name (any case).  On the switch: each of its connections (one
    /// player in two tabs is two); else the last who left with that address or name.
    fn pick<'a>(&self, all: &'a [Who], sel: &str) -> Result<Vec<&'a Who>, String> {
        let vip = vip_num(sel);
        let here: Vec<&Who> = all.iter().filter(|w| w.left.is_none() && names(w, sel, vip)).collect();
        if let Some(first) = here.first() {
            if here.iter().any(|w| !same_player(w, first)) {
                let now = now_ms();
                return Err(format!(
                    "{} players are called \"{sel}\": say which by its address\n{}",
                    here.len(),
                    here.iter().map(|w| line(w, now)).collect::<Vec<_>>().join("\n")
                ));
            }
            return Ok(here);
        }
        match all.iter().rev().find(|w| w.left.is_some() && names(w, sel, vip)) {
            Some(w) => Ok(vec![w]),
            None => Err(format!(
                "nobody {} on the switch or in the last hour (who lists them)",
                if vip != 0 { format!("at {sel}") } else { format!("called \"{sel}\"") }
            )),
        }
    }
}

/// a JSON answer read back (src/ctl.rs): ok, text
pub fn read_answer(s: &str) -> Option<(bool, String)> {
    let v: Value = serde_json::from_str(s).ok()?;
    Some((v["ok"].as_bool()?, v["text"].as_str()?.to_string()))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn who(vip: u32, name: &str, page: &str, left: Option<i64>) -> Who {
        let a: Arc<str> = Arc::from(format!("addr-{vip}"));
        Who { vip, name: name.into(), ident: Some(a), browser: Some(page.into()), owner: None, since: 0, left, doing: "", game: vec![] }
    }

    // the [cheat] lines of races, as nfsu2-online and nfsu2-roam write them (their tests), get a handle; free roam's,
    // and lines without an address, none
    #[test]
    fn the_lines_of_races_are_the_ones_marked() {
        let vip = vip_num("10.77.1.3");
        for (line, name) in [
            (
                "[cheat] 10.77.1.3 \"Warp\": won the online race \"far\" (sprint) in 0:21.00, under 40 % of the next finisher's 1:00.00 (\"Eve\")",
                "Warp",
            ),
            (
                "[cheat] 10.77.1.3 \"W p\": finished 2 in the online race \"x\" (circuit) in 1:00.00, 400 km/h on average, which no car does: by its own game",
                "W p",
            ),
            ("[cheat] 10.77.1.3 \"Bob\": won the race of lobby 0000abcd (race 00001234: sprint, 1 lap) in 0:10.0", "Bob"),
            (
                "[cheat] 10.77.1.3 \"Ed\": raced in the race of lobby 0000abcd (race 00001234: drag, 1 lap) in an edited car, \
                 1st of 3: 350Z",
                "Ed",
            ),
            (
                "[cheat] 10.77.1.3 \"Inv\": its car jumped 280 m at once in the race of lobby 0000abcd (race 00001234: URL, 3 \
                 laps, heat 2 of 3), as 2 of 2 other players' games had it (the largest each: 280, 275 m; honest races' \
                 largest are under 50 m); it won",
                "Inv",
            ),
            (
                "[cheat] 10.77.1.3 \"Jo\": its car jumped 280 m at once in the online race \"two\" (sprint, track 4102, 1 lap), as \
                 1 other players' games had it (the largest each: 280 m; honest races' largest are under 50 m); it won",
                "Jo",
            ),
        ] {
            assert_eq!(race_cheat(line), Some((vip, name)), "{line}");
        }
        for line in [
            "[cheat] 10.77.0.11 \"Bob\": teleport 1: 1.0 km in 0.5 s, 918 m more than a car drives",
            "[cheat] 10.77.3.41 \"Bob\", 6 s in free roam (left): 1 run over 450 km/h for 5 s (at most 600 km/h)",
            "[cheat] 0.0.0.0 \"Bob\": won the online race \"far\" (sprint) in 0:21.00",
            "[cheat] player 0000abcd: won the race of lobby 0000abcd (race 00001234: sprint, 1 lap) in 0:10.0",
            "[online] \"far\": Warp won the online race \"far\"",
        ] {
            assert_eq!(race_cheat(line), None, "{line}");
        }
    }

    // the handle after the line, then the player's other names of its earlier lines and its bans since, by kind
    #[test]
    fn a_marked_line_says_the_earlier_names_and_bans() {
        let m = |before: &[&str], bans: &[(u64, bool, Kind)]| nfsu2_bans::Marked {
            handle: "c70".into(),
            before: before.iter().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect(),
            bans: bans.to_vec(),
        };
        assert_eq!(tagged("[cheat] x", &m(&[], &[])), "[cheat] x (ban c70)");
        assert_eq!(
            tagged("[cheat] x", &m(&["Rex", "Turbo"], &[(4, false, Kind::Full), (9, true, Kind::Full)])),
            "[cheat] x (ban c70; before as \"Rex\", \"Turbo\"; was ban #4; ban #9 in force)"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            tagged("[cheat] x", &m(&[], &[(4, false, Kind::Races), (6, false, Kind::Name), (9, true, Kind::Races)])),
            "[cheat] x (ban c70; was race ban #4; rename #6; race ban #9 in force)"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_line_marks_the_player_of_that_name_or_the_only_one_there_was() {
        // on the address now, and the ones who left it (the last first)
        let at = [who(5, "Eve", "e", None), who(5, "Bob Jr", "b", Some(1)), who(5, "Bob Jr", "b2", Some(0))];
        assert_eq!(pick_marked(&at, "bob_jr").and_then(|w| w.browser.as_deref()), Some("b"), "the Online form of the name");
        assert_eq!(pick_marked(&at, "Eve").map(|w| w.name.as_str()), Some("Eve"));
        assert!(pick_marked(&at, "Kim").is_none(), "two players had it: not this one");
        // one player only (one page): whatever name the line has
        let one = [who(5, "Kim", "k", None), who(5, "Kim", "k", Some(0))];
        assert_eq!(pick_marked(&one, "Kim0042").map(|w| w.name.as_str()), Some("Kim"));
        assert!(pick_marked(&[], "Kim").is_none());
    }

    // a game that shows another name over its car than its page's (an edited page): who, kick and ban find it by
    // either, any case, and who's line shows both
    #[test]
    fn a_player_goes_by_its_pages_name_and_its_games() {
        let w = Who { game: vec!["Mallory".into()], ..who(vip_num("10.77.3.41"), "player", "p", None) };
        for sel in ["player", "PLAYER", "mallory", "Mallory"] {
            assert!(names(&w, sel, 0), "{sel}");
        }
        assert!(!names(&w, "mall", 0), "a whole name");
        assert!(has_name(&w, "llor") && has_name(&w, "play") && !has_name(&w, "bob"));
        assert_eq!(
            line(&Who { doing: "free roam", ..w.clone() }, 180_000),
            "10.77.3.41   \"player\"                 free roam, 3 min; its game shows \"Mallory\""
        );
        let plain = who(vip_num("10.77.3.42"), "Bob", "b", None);
        assert_eq!(line(&plain, 0), "10.77.3.42   \"Bob\"                    menus or loading, 0 min");
    }

    #[test]
    fn what_a_ban_names_for_the_operator() {
        let k = |a: usize, p: usize, o: usize| Keys {
            addrs: (0..a).map(|i| format!("a{i}")).collect(),
            pages: (0..p).map(|i| format!("p{i}")).collect(),
            owners: (0..o).map(|i| format!("o{i}")).collect(),
        };
        assert_eq!(named_by(&k(1, 1, 0)), "its page and its address");
        assert_eq!(named_by(&k(1, 1, 1)), "its page, its keyphrase and its address");
        assert_eq!(named_by(&k(2, 2, 1)), "its 2 pages, its keyphrase and its 2 addresses");
        assert_eq!(named_by(&k(0, 1, 0)), "its page");
        assert_eq!(named_by(&k(1, 0, 0)), "its address only (no page id: a tool, not the page)");
    }

    // a player's earlier bans as the replies and history list them
    #[test]
    fn the_history_lines_say_what_each_ban_was_and_how_it_ended() {
        const DAY: i64 = 86_400_000;
        let t0 = 1_793_109_900_000; // 2026-10-27 14:05 UTC
        let ban = |id: u64, kind: Kind, until: Option<i64>, msg: &str| Ban {
            id,
            kind,
            name: "Bob".into(),
            msg: msg.into(),
            at: t0,
            until,
            pages: vec![],
            owners: vec![],
            later_pages: vec![],
            later_owners: vec![],
            addrs: vec![],
        };
        let r = |b: Ban, past: Option<(i64, How, Option<u64>)>| Record { ban: b, past };
        assert_eq!(
            record_line(&r(ban(12, Kind::Races, Some(t0 + 14 * DAY), "Cheating"), Some((t0 + 14 * DAY, How::Over, None))), t0),
            "#12 race ban \"Bob\", 14 d from 2026-10-27 14:05 UTC, ended 2026-11-10 14:05 UTC: \"Cheating\""
        );
        assert_eq!(
            record_line(&r(ban(13, Kind::Full, None, ""), None), t0 + DAY),
            "#13 ban \"Bob\", for good from 2026-10-27 14:05 UTC, in force"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            record_line(&r(ban(14, Kind::Races, Some(t0 + 2 * DAY), ""), None), t0 + DAY),
            "#14 race ban \"Bob\", 2 d from 2026-10-27 14:05 UTC, in force (1 d more)"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            record_line(&r(ban(15, Kind::Name, Some(t0), "Offensive"), Some((t0, How::Over, None))), t0),
            "#15 rename \"Bob\", on 2026-10-27 14:05 UTC: \"Offensive\""
        );
        assert_eq!(
            record_line(&r(ban(16, Kind::Full, Some(t0 + DAY), ""), Some((t0 + 60_000, How::Replaced, Some(17)))), t0),
            "#16 ban \"Bob\", 1 d from 2026-10-27 14:05 UTC, replaced 2026-10-27 14:06 UTC by #17"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            record_line(&r(ban(18, Kind::Full, Some(t0 + DAY), ""), Some((t0 + 60_000, How::Lifted, None))), t0),
            "#18 ban \"Bob\", 1 d from 2026-10-27 14:05 UTC, lifted 2026-10-27 14:06 UTC"
        );
        assert!(earlier(&[], t0).is_empty());
        let many: Vec<Record> = (1..=10).map(|i| r(ban(i, Kind::Races, Some(t0 + DAY), ""), Some((t0 + DAY, How::Over, None)))).collect();
        let e = earlier(&many, t0);
        assert_eq!((e.len(), e[0].as_str()), (EARLIER_MAX + 1, "before: 10 (history lists them)"));
        assert!(e[1].starts_with("  #3 race ban"), "the latest {EARLIER_MAX}: {e:?}");
    }
}

//! How many people come each day (UTC), each browser once a day, by the random id its page keeps (web/src/app/page-id.ts):
//! the ones that opened the page, played (pressed Play, or came onto the switch), drove in free roam, and were in
//! the game's Online mode.  The page says "page" at a load and "play" at Play (/seen); the switch's hellos and
//! [`Days::sweep`] (every `SWEEP_EVERY`: who is in free roam or Online now, `LanSwitch::who`) add the rest.  Each
//! kind counts in the ones before it too (a browser seen in free roam or Online played, whatever /seen said).
//!
//! Only a keyed hash of an id is kept (64 bits of HMAC-SHA256), with a new random key each day, and the day's sets go
//! at its end: nothing links one day's browsers to the next day's, or to a ban.  The day so far is in the state
//! folder's `days.json` (every `SWEEP_EVERY` when it changed, and at the stop), so a restart counts on; each day that
//! ended is a line of `days.csv` there, and of the console (`[days]`).  A browser on two devices is two, a private
//! window one a load, and a script can make up ids: the counts are for the operator, not for anything that matters.
//! A day's sets hold `MAX_A_DAY` at most.  The day also keeps what the ones who played changed in their settings
//! (settings_days.rs): the day so far in days.json, the days that ended in `settings.csv`.

use std::collections::HashSet;
use std::io::Write;
use std::path::PathBuf;

use hmac::{Hmac, Mac};
use parking_lot::Mutex;
use serde_json::Value;

use nfsu2_util::atomic_file::Options;
use nfsu2_util::{js, log};

use super::settings_days::{self, Report, Tally};

/// what a browser did (each counts in the ones before it too)
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Seen {
    Page = 0,
    Play = 1,
    Roam = 2,
    Online = 3,
}

/// days.json's names of the sets, in `Seen`'s order
const KINDS: [&str; 4] = ["page", "play", "roam", "online"];
pub const CSV_HEAD: &str = "day,opened the page,played,free roam,Online";
/// a day's set holds this many at most (8 bytes each, in memory and in days.json)
pub const MAX_A_DAY: usize = 1_000_000;

/// "2026-10-30", the UTC day of `ms`
pub fn day_of(ms: i64) -> String {
    let (y, m, d, ..) = js::utc_parts(ms);
    format!("{y:04}-{m:02}-{d:02}")
}

/// a page id as the page makes them (22 characters of base64url; 64 at most, as the hello's)
pub fn id_ok(id: &str) -> bool {
    (1..=64).contains(&id.len()) && id.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b == b'-' || b == b'_')
}

struct Today {
    day: String,
    key: Vec<u8>,
    sets: [HashSet<u64>; 4],
    /// the settings told at the day's first Plays (settings_days.rs)
    settings: Tally,
    /// since days.json was written
    changed: bool,
}

impl Today {
    fn new(day: String) -> Today {
        Today { day, key: nfsu2_util::rand::bytes(32), sets: Default::default(), settings: Tally::default(), changed: true }
    }

    fn counts(&self) -> [usize; 4] {
        [0, 1, 2, 3].map(|i| self.sets[i].len())
    }

    fn hash(&self, id: &str) -> u64 {
        let mut mac = <Hmac<sha2::Sha256> as Mac>::new_from_slice(&self.key).expect("HMAC takes any key");
        mac.update(id.as_bytes());
        u64::from_le_bytes(mac.finalize().into_bytes()[..8].try_into().expect("8 bytes"))
    }

    fn to_json(&self) -> String {
        let mut m = serde_json::Map::new();
        m.insert("day".into(), self.day.clone().into());
        m.insert("key".into(), js::base64url(&self.key).into());
        for (i, k) in KINDS.iter().enumerate() {
            let b: Vec<u8> = self.sets[i].iter().flat_map(|h| h.to_le_bytes()).collect();
            m.insert((*k).into(), js::base64url(&b).into());
        }
        m.insert("settings".into(), self.settings.to_json());
        Value::Object(m).to_string()
    }

    fn from_json(s: &str) -> Option<Today> {
        let v: Value = serde_json::from_str(s).ok()?;
        let day = v.get("day")?.as_str()?.to_string();
        let key = js::from_base64url(v.get("key")?.as_str()?);
        if key.len() != 32 {
            return None;
        }
        let mut t = Today { day, key, sets: Default::default(), settings: Tally::from_json(v.get("settings")), changed: false };
        for (i, k) in KINDS.iter().enumerate() {
            let b = js::from_base64url(v.get(*k).and_then(Value::as_str).unwrap_or(""));
            t.sets[i] = b.as_chunks::<8>().0.iter().take(MAX_A_DAY).map(|c| u64::from_le_bytes(*c)).collect();
        }
        Some(t)
    }
}

/// "4210 opened the page, 3380 played, 2950 in free roam, 610 in Online"
pub fn counts_text(c: [usize; 4]) -> String {
    format!("{} opened the page, {} played, {} in free roam, {} in Online", c[0], c[1], c[2], c[3])
}

pub struct Days {
    /// days.json, days.csv and settings.csv
    file: PathBuf,
    csv: PathBuf,
    settings_csv: PathBuf,
    t: Mutex<Today>,
}

impl Days {
    /// The day so far from the state folder's days.json (a day that ended meanwhile goes to days.csv first), or a new
    /// one.
    pub fn open(state: &str, now: i64) -> Days {
        let dir = PathBuf::from(state);
        let (file, csv) = (dir.join("days.json"), dir.join("days.csv"));
        let had = std::fs::read_to_string(&file).ok().and_then(|s| Today::from_json(&s));
        let settings_csv = dir.join("settings.csv");
        let d = Days { file, csv, settings_csv, t: Mutex::new(had.unwrap_or_else(|| Today::new(day_of(now)))) };
        d.roll(&mut d.t.lock(), now);
        d
    }

    /// A browser seen: `id` as its page keeps it (`id_ok`), `what` it did.
    pub fn seen(&self, id: &str, what: Seen, now: i64) {
        if !id_ok(id) {
            return;
        }
        let mut t = self.t.lock();
        self.roll(&mut t, now);
        let h = t.hash(id);
        for i in 0..=what as usize {
            if t.sets[i].len() < MAX_A_DAY && t.sets[i].insert(h) {
                t.changed = true;
            }
        }
    }

    /// A browser's day's first Play told its settings (settings_days.rs); `id` as for `seen`, which counts the Play.
    pub fn told(&self, id: &str, r: &Report, now: i64) {
        if !id_ok(id) {
            return;
        }
        let mut t = self.t.lock();
        self.roll(&mut t, now);
        t.settings.add(r);
        t.changed = true;
    }

    /// The settings told in the last `n` days that ended and today so far, summed: (the first and last day, their
    /// totals)
    pub fn settings(&self, n: usize, now: i64) -> (String, String, Tally) {
        let (today, mut sum) = {
            let mut t = self.t.lock();
            self.roll(&mut t, now);
            (t.day.clone(), t.settings.clone())
        };
        let (days, ended) = Tally::from_csv(&std::fs::read_to_string(&self.settings_csv).unwrap_or_default(), n);
        sum.merge(&ended);
        (days.first().cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| today.clone()), today, sum)
    }

    /// the day so far: (its date, `Seen`'s counts)
    pub fn today(&self, now: i64) -> (String, [usize; 4]) {
        let mut t = self.t.lock();
        self.roll(&mut t, now);
        (t.day.clone(), t.counts())
    }

    /// The days that ended (days.csv's lines without its head), the last `n` of them
    pub fn history(&self, n: usize) -> Vec<String> {
        let s = std::fs::read_to_string(&self.csv).unwrap_or_default();
        let lines: Vec<String> = s.lines().filter(|l| !l.is_empty() && *l != CSV_HEAD).map(String::from).collect();
        lines[lines.len().saturating_sub(n)..].to_vec()
    }

    /// days.json written when the day changed since; true when it was
    pub fn save(&self) -> Result<bool, String> {
        let body = {
            let mut t = self.t.lock();
            if !t.changed {
                return Ok(false);
            }
            t.changed = false;
            t.to_json()
        };
        Options::new().make_folder().write(&self.file, body.as_bytes()).map(|_| true).map_err(|e| e.to_string())
    }

    /// a day that ended: its line in days.csv (once: a line of that day already there stays the only one) and the
    /// console, then a new day with a new key
    fn roll(&self, t: &mut Today, now: i64) {
        let day = day_of(now);
        if t.day == day {
            return;
        }
        let c = t.counts();
        log::line(&format!("[days] {} (UTC): {}", t.day, counts_text(c)));
        let had = std::fs::read_to_string(&self.csv).unwrap_or_default();
        if !had.lines().any(|l| l.starts_with(&format!("{},", t.day))) {
            let head = if had.is_empty() { format!("{CSV_HEAD}\n") } else { String::new() };
            let line = format!("{head}{},{},{},{},{}\n", t.day, c[0], c[1], c[2], c[3]);
            let w = std::fs::OpenOptions::new().create(true).append(true).open(&self.csv).and_then(|mut f| f.write_all(line.as_bytes()));
            if let Err(e) = w {
                log::error(&format!("{}: {e}", self.csv.display()));
            }
        }
        self.settings_ended(t);
        *t = Today::new(day);
    }

    /// a day's settings that ended: its lines in settings.csv, once (a day that told none has none)
    fn settings_ended(&self, t: &Today) {
        if t.settings.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        let had = std::fs::read_to_string(&self.settings_csv).unwrap_or_default();
        if had.lines().any(|l| l.starts_with(&format!("{},", t.day))) {
            return;
        }
        let head = if had.is_empty() { format!("{}\n", settings_days::CSV_HEAD) } else { String::new() };
        let body: String = t.settings.csv_lines(&t.day).iter().map(|l| format!("{l}\n")).collect();
        let w = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
            .create(true)
            .append(true)
            .open(&self.settings_csv)
            .and_then(|mut f| f.write_all(format!("{head}{body}").as_bytes()));
        if let Err(e) = w {
            log::error(&format!("{}: {e}", self.settings_csv.display()));
        }
    }

    /// for the tests: the day's state as days.json has it
    #[cfg(test)]
    fn json(&self) -> Value {
        serde_json::from_str(&self.t.lock().to_json()).unwrap_or(Value::Null)
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    const DAY: i64 = 86_400_000;
    /// 2026-10-30T12:00Z
    const T0: i64 = 1_793_361_600_000;

    fn dir(name: &str) -> String {
        let d = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("nfsu2-days-{name}-{}", std::process::id()));
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&d);
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&d).unwrap();
        d.display().to_string()
    }

    #[test]
    fn counts_each_browser_once_and_in_the_kinds_before() {
        let d = Days::open(&dir("once"), T0);
        let a = "AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA";
        d.seen(a, Seen::Page, T0);
        d.seen(a, Seen::Page, T0 + 1);
        d.seen(a, Seen::Play, T0 + 2);
        d.seen("BBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBB", Seen::Online, T0 + 3);
        d.seen("CCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCC", Seen::Roam, T0 + 4);
        d.seen("bad id!", Seen::Online, T0 + 5);
        d.seen("", Seen::Page, T0 + 5);
        assert_eq!(d.today(T0 + 6), ("2026-10-30".into(), [3, 3, 2, 1]));
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_restart_counts_on_and_a_new_day_goes_to_the_csv() {
        let s = dir("restart");
        let d = Days::open(&s, T0);
        d.seen("AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA", Seen::Play, T0);
        assert!(d.save().unwrap());
        assert!(!d.save().unwrap(), "nothing new: not written again");
        let key = d.json()["key"].clone();
        drop(d);

        let d = Days::open(&s, T0 + 1000);
        assert_eq!(d.json()["key"], key, "the day's key kept");
        d.seen("AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA", Seen::Play, T0 + 1000);
        d.seen("BBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBB", Seen::Page, T0 + 1000);
        assert_eq!(d.today(T0 + 1000).1, [2, 1, 0, 0]);
        d.save().unwrap();
        drop(d);

        // started again the next day: the day before is a line, the new day starts at 0 with another key
        let d = Days::open(&s, T0 + DAY);
        assert_eq!(d.today(T0 + DAY), ("2026-10-31".into(), [0, 0, 0, 0]));
        assert_ne!(d.json()["key"], key);
        assert_eq!(d.history(30), vec!["2026-10-30,2,1,0,0".to_string()]);
        let csv = std::fs::read_to_string(PathBuf::from(&s).join("days.csv")).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(csv, format!("{CSV_HEAD}\n2026-10-30,2,1,0,0\n"));

        // a day rolls over while running too; a day's line is never written twice
        d.seen("AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA", Seen::Online, T0 + DAY);
        assert_eq!(d.today(T0 + 2 * DAY).1, [0, 0, 0, 0]);
        assert_eq!(d.history(30), vec!["2026-10-30,2,1,0,0".to_string(), "2026-10-31,1,1,1,1".to_string()]);
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&s);
    }

    #[test]
    fn the_settings_told_count_on_after_a_restart_and_end_in_the_csv() {
        let s = dir("settings");
        let told = |k: &str, v: &str| Report::parse(Some(k), Some(v)).unwrap();
        let d = Days::open(&s, T0);
        d.told("AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA", &told("phone", "fps=30"), T0);
        d.told("bad id!", &told("pc", "fps=30"), T0);
        d.save().unwrap();
        drop(d);

        let d = Days::open(&s, T0 + 1000);
        d.told("BBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBB", &told("pc", "fps=30,hud=43"), T0 + 1000);
        let (from, to, t) = d.settings(7, T0 + 1000);
        assert_eq!((from.as_str(), to.as_str()), ("2026-10-30", "2026-10-30"));
        assert_eq!(t.reports, [1, 1, 0]);
        assert_eq!(t.counts["fps"]["30"], [1, 1, 0]);

        // the next day: the day before is in settings.csv, today starts empty, and the sum takes both
        d.told("CCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCC", &told("tablet", "fps=120"), T0 + DAY);
        let csv = std::fs::read_to_string(PathBuf::from(&s).join("settings.csv")).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            csv,
            format!("{}\n2026-10-30,(browsers),,1,1,0\n2026-10-30,fps,30,1,1,0\n2026-10-30,hud,43,1,0,0\n", settings_days::CSV_HEAD)
        );
        let (from, to, t) = d.settings(7, T0 + DAY);
        assert_eq!((from.as_str(), to.as_str()), ("2026-10-30", "2026-10-31"));
        assert_eq!(t.reports, [1, 1, 1]);
        assert_eq!(t.counts["fps"]["120"], [0, 0, 1]);
        let (_, _, t) = d.settings(0, T0 + DAY);
        assert_eq!(t.reports, [0, 0, 1], "0 days: today alone");

        // a day nobody told any settings writes nothing
        d.today(T0 + 3 * DAY);
        let after = std::fs::read_to_string(PathBuf::from(&s).join("settings.csv")).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(after.lines().filter(|l| l.starts_with("2026-11-01")).count(), 0);
        assert_eq!(after.lines().filter(|l| l.starts_with("2026-10-31")).count(), 2);
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&s);
    }

    #[test]
    fn no_id_is_kept() {
        let s = dir("noid");
        let d = Days::open(&s, T0);
        d.seen("AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA", Seen::Play, T0);
        d.save().unwrap();
        let f = std::fs::read_to_string(PathBuf::from(&s).join("days.json")).unwrap();
        assert!(!f.contains("AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA"));
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&s);
    }

    #[test]
    fn days_are_utc() {
        assert_eq!(day_of(T0), "2026-10-30");
        assert_eq!(day_of(T0 + DAY / 2 - 1), "2026-10-30");
        assert_eq!(day_of(T0 + DAY / 2), "2026-10-31");
    }
}

//! ETags without file-system detail: a keyed hash of what names a version (a file's real path, size and time; the
//! manifest's content; the module's), with a key that never leaves this machine.  The parts are joined by NUL,
//! numbers as JS's `Number#toString` writes them and a time as Node computes `mtimeMs`: the ETags the Node server gave
//! for the same key, so that a browser's copy stayed good across the switch to this server.

use std::io::{self, Read};
use std::os::unix::fs::{MetadataExt, OpenOptionsExt};

use hmac::{Hmac, Mac};
use sha2::Sha256;

use nfsu2_util::js;

/// The key in the state folder (etag.key): kept when it has 32 bytes or more, else made anew (0600)
pub fn load_key(state: &str) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
    let f = format!("{state}/etag.key");
    if let Ok(mut file) = std::fs::File::open(&f) {
        let mut k = Vec::new();
        if file.read_to_end(&mut k).is_ok() && k.len() >= 32 {
            return Ok(k);
        }
    }
    let k = nfsu2_util::rand::bytes(32);
    let mut file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new().write(true).create(true).truncate(true).mode(0o600).open(&f)?;
    io::Write::write_all(&mut file, &k)?;
    Ok(k)
}

/// '"' + HMAC-SHA256(key, parts joined by NUL), base64url, 22 characters + '"'
pub fn etag_of(key: &[u8], parts: &[&str]) -> String {
    let mut mac = <Hmac<Sha256> as Mac>::new_from_slice(key).expect("HMAC takes any key");
    for (i, p) in parts.iter().enumerate() {
        if i > 0 {
            mac.update(b"\0");
        }
        mac.update(p.as_bytes());
    }
    let d = js::base64url(&mac.finalize().into_bytes());
    format!("\"{}\"", &d[..22])
}

/// Node's `st.mtimeMs`: `sec * 1e3 + nsec / 1e6`, in doubles
pub fn mtime_ms(md: &std::fs::Metadata) -> f64 {
    md.mtime() as f64 * 1000.0 + md.mtime_nsec() as f64 / 1e6
}

/// `Math.floor(st.mtimeMs / 1000)`: the manifest's `m` (which can be the next second for a time just below it)
pub fn mtime_s(md: &std::fs::Metadata) -> f64 {
    (mtime_ms(md) / 1000.0).floor()
}

/// a number as JS writes it into a string
pub fn num(x: f64) -> String {
    js::number_to_string(x)
}

/// the ETag of a file: its real path, size and time
pub fn of_file(key: &[u8], real: &str, md: &std::fs::Metadata) -> String {
    etag_of(key, &[real, &num(md.size() as f64), &num(mtime_ms(md))])
}

pub(crate) mod tests {
    use super::*;

    const KEY: [u8; 32] = {
        let mut k = [0u8; 32];
        let mut i = 0;
        while i < 32 {
            k[i] = i as u8;
            i += 1;
        }
        k
    };

    // the values the Node server's etagOf computed with this key
    #[test]
    fn etags_equal_the_node_servers() {
        assert_eq!(etag_of(&KEY, &["manifest", "abc"]), "\"hWN06E5JbvKr11mCWqBV1D\"");
        assert_eq!(etag_of(&KEY, &["/x/y", &num(123.0), &num(1729512345123.4567)]), "\"6Nn736TQhXw_HdiX9IqQRT\"");
        assert_eq!(etag_of(&KEY, &["br", "/a/b.wasm", &num(0.0), &num(0.0)]), "\"ykFGyTmIRH6O7HRQfcAlfX\"");
        assert_eq!(etag_of(&KEY, &["/home/user/é.bin", &num(65536.0), &num(1760000000999.9998)]), "\"X9qPpgFd4gaFHgBuGGlC1c\"");
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_key_is_kept_and_private() {
        let d = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let s = d.path().to_string_lossy().into_owned();
        let k = load_key(&s).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(k.len(), 32);
        assert_eq!(load_key(&s).unwrap(), k);
        let mode = std::fs::metadata(d.path().join("etag.key")).unwrap().mode() & 0o777;
        assert_eq!(mode, 0o600);
        // a short key is replaced, a longer one kept whole
        std::fs::write(d.path().join("etag.key"), b"short").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(load_key(&s).unwrap().len(), 32);
        std::fs::write(d.path().join("etag.key"), [7u8; 40]).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(load_key(&s).unwrap(), vec![7u8; 40]);
    }

    /// sets a file's mtime to the nanosecond
    pub fn set_mtime(p: &std::path::Path, sec: i64, nsec: i64) {
        let t = std::time::UNIX_EPOCH + std::time::Duration::new(sec as u64, nsec as u32);
        let f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new().write(true).open(p).unwrap();
        f.set_times(std::fs::FileTimes::new().set_modified(t).set_accessed(t)).unwrap();
    }

    // Node's mtimeMs and String(mtimeMs), and the manifest's Math.floor(mtimeMs / 1000), against node itself
    #[test]
    fn times_as_node_writes_them() {
        let d = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let mut seed = 0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15u64;
        let mut next = || {
            seed ^= seed << 13;
            seed ^= seed >> 7;
            seed ^= seed << 17;
            seed
        };
        let mut files = Vec::new();
        for i in 0..200 {
            let sec = 1_000_000_000 + (next() % 1_000_000_000) as i64;
            let nsec = match i % 4 {
                0 => 999_999_999 - (next() % 200_000) as i64,
                1 => 0,
                _ => (next() % 1_000_000_000) as i64,
            };
            let p = d.path().join(format!("f{i}"));
            std::fs::write(&p, b"x").unwrap();
            set_mtime(&p, sec, nsec);
            let md = std::fs::metadata(&p).unwrap();
            files.push((p, num(mtime_ms(&md)), num(mtime_s(&md))));
        }
        let script = format!(
            "const fs = require('fs'); for (const f of {}) {{ const m = fs.statSync(f).mtimeMs; console.log(String(m) + ' ' + Math.floor(m / 1000)); }}",
            serde_json::to_string(&files.iter().map(|f| f.0.to_string_lossy().into_owned()).collect::<Vec<_>>()).unwrap()
        );
        let out = match std::process::Command::new("node").arg("-e").arg(&script).output() {
            Ok(o) if o.status.success() => String::from_utf8(o.stdout).unwrap(),
            _ => {
                eprintln!("no node: the cross-check of the times is skipped");
                return;
            }
        };
        let lines: Vec<&str> = out.lines().collect();
        assert_eq!(lines.len(), files.len());
        for (f, l) in files.iter().zip(lines) {
            assert_eq!(format!("{} {}", f.1, f.2), l, "{:?}", f.0);
        }
    }
}
