//! Files: which file a URL path names (resolve_inside, resolve_game), whether it is still inside its folder once
//! symbolic links are followed and outside the state folder (locate), and sending it (send_file: one byte range, 416,
//! 304, HEAD).  Every file system call is on a blocking thread, never on a runtime worker.

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::os::unix::fs::{FileExt, MetadataExt};
use std::sync::Arc;

use parking_lot::Mutex;
use unicode_normalization::UnicodeNormalization;

use nfsu2_headers::{Cache, etag_matches};
use nfsu2_http::{Request, Response};

use super::manifest::game_entry;
use super::{App, Fail, Res, etag, finish, send, type_of};
use crate::options::within;
use crate::paths;

/// a file sent in pieces of this many bytes (the size Node's read streams read)
const PIECE: usize = 64 << 10;

/// the file under root that a URL path names; None for anything with a dot segment (.., ., .git, .DS_Store, ...) or
/// outside root
pub fn resolve_inside(root: &str, url_path: &str) -> Option<String> {
    if url_path.split('/').any(|seg| seg.starts_with('.')) {
        return None;
    }
    let p = paths::resolve(root, &format!(".{}", paths::normalize_abs(&format!("/{url_path}"))));
    (p == root || p.starts_with(&format!("{root}/"))).then_some(p)
}

/// the file of the game (GAME_ENTRIES) under the install folder that a URL path names, or None
pub fn resolve_game(data: &str, url_path: &str) -> Option<String> {
    let first = url_path.split('/').find(|s| !s.is_empty())?;
    if game_entry(first) { resolve_inside(data, url_path) } else { None }
}

/// a test page, test script or source map, by its name as a case-insensitive disk folds it (NFKC folds "ſ" to "s",
/// "K" to "k")
pub fn dev_only(p: &str) -> bool {
    let n: String = p.nfkc().collect::<String>().to_lowercase();
    let tests = n.strip_prefix("/tests").or_else(|| n.strip_prefix("/test"));
    tests.is_some_and(|r| r.is_empty() || r.starts_with('/')) || n.ends_with(".map")
}

/// a regular file found by `locate`: its real path and what stat said
pub struct Found {
    pub real: String,
    pub md: std::fs::Metadata,
}

/// send_file's options: the type (else by the real file's extension), the cache rule, more headers, the file when the
/// caller located it already, and whether search engines are told to keep out
pub struct FileOpts {
    pub type_: Option<&'static str>,
    pub cache: Cache,
    pub extra: Vec<(&'static str, &'static str)>,
    pub found: Option<Found>,
    pub noindex: bool,
}

impl Default for FileOpts {
    fn default() -> FileOpts {
        FileOpts { type_: None, cache: Cache::Store, extra: Vec::new(), found: None, noindex: true }
    }
}

/// the real path of p if it is still inside root once symbolic links are followed (root's own real path is looked up
/// once)
fn real_inside(roots: &Mutex<HashMap<String, String>>, root: &str, p: &str) -> Option<String> {
    let cached = roots.lock().get(root).cloned();
    let rr = match cached {
        Some(r) => r,
        None => {
            let r = std::fs::canonicalize(root).ok()?.to_string_lossy().into_owned();
            roots.lock().insert(root.to_string(), r.clone());
            r
        }
    };
    let rp = std::fs::canonicalize(p).ok()?.to_string_lossy().into_owned();
    rp.starts_with(&format!("{rr}/")).then_some(rp)
}

/// `App::locate`, blocking
pub fn locate_sync(roots: &Mutex<HashMap<String, String>>, real_state: &str, root: &str, file: &str) -> Option<Found> {
    let real = real_inside(roots, root, file)?;
    if within(&real, real_state) {
        return None;
    }
    let md = std::fs::metadata(&real).ok()?;
    md.is_file().then_some(Found { real, md })
}

/// The located file opened (blocking), and what it is now: the answer's size, version and bytes are this open file's,
/// whatever is put at its path meanwhile.  Its real path has no symbolic link in it, so none is followed at its end
/// (one put there since the look is refused), and the open never waits (a FIFO put there is refused, not waited on).
pub fn open_found(real: &str) -> std::io::Result<(std::fs::File, std::fs::Metadata)> {
    use std::os::unix::fs::OpenOptionsExt;
    let file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new().read(true).custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW | libc::O_NONBLOCK).open(real)?;
    let md = file.metadata()?;
    if !md.is_file() {
        return Err(std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput.into());
    }
    Ok((file, md))
}

/// the same version of a file: the same file (device and inode), size and time
fn same_version(a: &std::fs::Metadata, b: &std::fs::Metadata) -> bool {
    (a.dev(), a.ino(), a.size(), a.mtime(), a.mtime_nsec()) == (b.dev(), b.ino(), b.size(), b.mtime(), b.mtime_nsec())
}

/// buf filled from the file at off, as far as the file goes (an error: what was read)
fn read_at_most(f: &std::fs::File, buf: &mut Vec<u8>, want: usize, off: u64) {
    buf.resize(want, 0);
    let mut got = 0;
    while got < want {
        match f.read_at(&mut buf[got..], off + got as u64) {
            Ok(0) => break,
            Ok(n) => got += n,
            Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::Interrupted => {}
            Err(_) => break,
        }
    }
    buf.truncate(got);
}

impl App {
    /// the regular file under root that file names (None: none, or it leads outside root or into the state folder)
    pub async fn locate(&self, root: &str, file: Option<String>) -> Option<Found> {
        let file = file?;
        let (roots, state, root) = (self.real_roots.clone(), self.real_state.clone(), root.to_string());
        tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || locate_sync(&roots, &state, &root, &file)).await.ok().flatten()
    }

    /// A file under root (or the one `o.found` names; none: 404): its ETag (304), one byte range (206, 416), HEAD,
    /// and the bytes
    pub async fn send_file(&self, q: &Request, s: &mut Response, root: &str, file: Option<String>, o: FileOpts) -> Res {
        let f = match o.found {
            Some(f) => Some(f),
            None => self.locate(root, file).await,
        };
        let Some(Found { real, mut md }) = f else { return self.not_found(q, s).await };
        // (the file, once opened for the bytes, if it is another version than the one looked at)
        let mut reopened = None;
        loop {
            let size = md.size();
            let etag = etag::of_file(&self.etag_key, &real, &md);
            let ext = paths::extname(&real).to_lowercase();
            let mut h = self.headers(q, o.cache, o.noindex);
            h.set("content-type", o.type_.or_else(|| type_of(&ext)).unwrap_or("application/octet-stream"));
            h.set("accept-ranges", "bytes");
            h.set("etag", etag.clone());
            for (k, v) in &o.extra {
                h.set(k, *v);
            }
            if etag_matches(q.headers.get("if-none-match"), &etag) {
                s.head(304, h.0);
                return finish(s).await;
            }
            // one range (bytes=a-b, a-, -n); anything else is answered with the whole file
            let sz = size as f64;
            let (mut a, mut b, mut code) = (0f64, sz - 1.0, 200);
            if let Some((r1, r2)) = q.headers.get("range").filter(|r| !r.is_empty()).and_then(|r| parse_range(nfsu2_util::js::trim(r)))
                && !(r1.is_empty() && r2.is_empty())
            {
                let n = |x: &str| x.parse::<f64>().unwrap_or(f64::INFINITY);
                a = if r1.is_empty() { (sz - n(r2)).max(0.0) } else { n(r1) };
                b = if r1.is_empty() || r2.is_empty() { sz - 1.0 } else { n(r2).min(sz - 1.0) };
                if a > b || a >= sz {
                    h.set("content-range", format!("bytes */{size}"));
                    h.set("content-length", "0");
                    s.head(416, h.0);
                    return finish(s).await;
                }
                code = 206;
                h.set("content-range", format!("bytes {}-{}/{size}", a as u64, b as u64));
            }
            let (a, b) = (a as u64, b as u64);
            h.set("content-length", if size > 0 { (b - a + 1).to_string() } else { "0".into() });
            if q.method == "HEAD" || size == 0 {
                s.head(code, h.0);
                return finish(s).await;
            }
            // The bytes: the file opened and its first piece read in one call (one trip to a blocking thread less),
            // before anything is sent, so that the answer is of the file that was opened: one put in place since the
            // look (a build, a deploy) is answered as itself, never with the other one's size and ETag.  The open
            // file lives as long as the answer: a client that goes takes it with it.
            let want = PIECE.min((b - a + 1) as usize);
            let (file, first) = match reopened.take() {
                Some(file) => (file, Vec::new()),
                None => {
                    let r = real.clone();
                    let opened = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {
                        let (file, md) = open_found(&r).ok()?;
                        let mut first = Vec::with_capacity(want);
                        read_at_most(&file, &mut first, want, a);
                        Some((file, md, first))
                    })
                    .await;
                    let Ok(Some((file, now, first))) = opened else {
                        s.destroy();
                        return Err(Fail::Gone);
                    };
                    let file = Arc::new(file);
                    if !same_version(&now, &md) {
                        (md, reopened) = (now, Some(file));
                        continue;
                    }
                    (file, first)
                }
            };
            s.head(code, h.0);
            if !first.is_empty() {
                send(s, &first).await?;
            }
            stream_range(s, file, a + first.len() as u64, b + 1).await?;
            return finish(s).await;
        }
    }
}

/// `/^bytes=(\d*)-(\d*)$/`
fn parse_range(r: &str) -> Option<(&str, &str)> {
    let (x, y) = r.strip_prefix("bytes=")?.split_once('-')?;
    let digits = |s: &str| s.bytes().all(|c| c.is_ascii_digit());
    (digits(x) && digits(y)).then_some((x, y))
}

/// bytes start..end of an open file, piece by piece as the client takes them; a read that fails or comes up short
/// (the file shrank) ends the connection (the answer cannot be finished)
pub async fn stream_range(s: &mut Response, file: Arc<std::fs::File>, start: u64, end: u64) -> Res {
    let mut off = start;
    let mut buf = vec![0u8; PIECE.min((end - start) as usize)];
    while off < end {
        let want = PIECE.min((end - off) as usize);
        let f = file.clone();
        let read = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {
            buf.resize(want, 0);
            let mut got = 0;
            while got < want {
                match f.read_at(&mut buf[got..], off + got as u64) {
                    Ok(0) => break,
                    Ok(n) => got += n,
                    Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::Interrupted => {}
                    Err(_) => break,
                }
            }
            buf.truncate(got);
            buf
        })
        .await;
        buf = match read {
            Ok(b) if !b.is_empty() => b,
            _ => {
                s.destroy();
                return Err(Fail::Gone);
            }
        };
        send(s, &buf).await?;
        off += buf.len() as u64;
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn paths_under_a_root() {
        assert_eq!(resolve_inside("/srv/dist", "/index.html").as_deref(), Some("/srv/dist/index.html"));
        assert_eq!(resolve_inside("/srv/dist", "/a/b/").as_deref(), Some("/srv/dist/a/b"));
        assert_eq!(resolve_inside("/srv/dist", "").as_deref(), Some("/srv/dist"));
        for bad in ["/../x", "/.git/config", "/a/.hidden", "/./x", "/a/..", "/..."] {
            assert_eq!(resolve_inside("/srv/dist", bad), None, "{bad}");
        }
        // (Node: path.resolve("/", "./x") does not start with "//")
        assert_eq!(resolve_inside("/", "/x"), None);
        assert_eq!(resolve_game("/g", "/SPEED2.EXE").as_deref(), Some("/g/SPEED2.EXE"));
        assert_eq!(resolve_game("/g", "/global/x.bin").as_deref(), Some("/g/global/x.bin"));
        assert_eq!(resolve_game("/g", "//TRACKS/a").as_deref(), Some("/g/TRACKS/a"));
        // the Kelvin sign lowercases to "k" in JS too
        assert_eq!(resolve_game("/g", "/TRAC\u{212A}S/a").as_deref(), Some("/g/TRAC\u{212A}S/a"));
        for bad in ["/unins000.dat", "/SAVE/profile", "/", "", "/scripts/mod.ini", "/.hidden"] {
            assert_eq!(resolve_game("/g", bad), None, "{bad}");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn dev_only_names() {
        for p in [
            "/test/play.html",
            "/tests/x",
            "/test",
            "/TEST/x",
            "/te\u{17F}t/play.html",
            "/main.js.map",
            "/main.js.MAP",
            "/\u{FF54}est/x",
            "/main.js.\u{FF4D}ap",
            "/TE\u{17F}T/hostcheck.html",
        ] {
            assert!(dev_only(p), "{p}");
        }
        for p in ["/testing", "/index.html", "/map", "/x/test/y", "/main.js"] {
            assert!(!dev_only(p), "{p}");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn ranges() {
        assert_eq!(parse_range("bytes=0-99"), Some(("0", "99")));
        assert_eq!(parse_range("bytes=-5"), Some(("", "5")));
        assert_eq!(parse_range("bytes=-"), Some(("", "")));
        assert_eq!(parse_range("bytes=0-1,5-6"), None);
        assert_eq!(parse_range("bytes=a-1"), None);
        assert_eq!(parse_range("items=0-1"), None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn locate_follows_links_and_keeps_out_of_the_state_folder() {
        let d = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let root = std::fs::canonicalize(d.path()).unwrap().to_string_lossy().into_owned();
        std::fs::create_dir_all(format!("{root}/in/state")).unwrap();
        std::fs::create_dir_all(format!("{root}/out")).unwrap();
        std::fs::write(format!("{root}/in/a.txt"), "a").unwrap();
        std::fs::write(format!("{root}/in/state/etag.key"), "k").unwrap();
        std::fs::write(format!("{root}/out/secret"), "s").unwrap();
        std::os::unix::fs::symlink(format!("{root}/out/secret"), format!("{root}/in/link")).unwrap();
        std::os::unix::fs::symlink(format!("{root}/in/a.txt"), format!("{root}/in/b.txt")).unwrap();
        let roots = Mutex::new(HashMap::new());
        let state = format!("{root}/in/state");
        let l = |f: &str| locate_sync(&roots, &state, &format!("{root}/in"), &format!("{root}/in/{f}")).map(|f| f.real);
        assert_eq!(l("a.txt"), Some(format!("{root}/in/a.txt")));
        assert_eq!(l("b.txt"), Some(format!("{root}/in/a.txt")), "a link inside the folder is its target");
        assert_eq!(l("link"), None, "a link out of the folder");
        assert_eq!(l("state/etag.key"), None, "the state folder");
        assert_eq!(l("state"), None, "a folder");
        assert_eq!(l("nothing"), None);
    }
}

//! Free roam's friends (docs/web/PLAYING.md, "Friends"): two players whose cars touched front bumpers for 3 seconds
//! may befriend each other, and see each other on their start pages from then on.  The friends lists are EA
//! Messenger's (nfsu2-online buddy.rs: one file a player, kept for claimed names only, so a friend made in free roam is
//! one in the Messenger too); the free-roam hub links friends first and says where they play (nfsu2-roam).  Only a
//! friendship both ways (each one on the other's list, as an accepted request makes it: nfsu2-online
//! `FriendRow::mutual`) is linked or told where the other plays; a name on one list alone is a name, no more.
//!
//! In the game, the page's control messages on its /lan connection (nfsu2-lan `LanSwitch::on_text`), each answered on
//! it:
//! - {"t":"friend","op":"list"}: its friends -> {"t":"friend","op":"list","me":<its claimed name>|null,"friends":[names],
//!   "asks":[names that asked it]}; the hub links them first from now on
//! - {"t":"friend","op":"can","name":<the name over the car>}: what befriending that player would be ->
//!   {"t":"friend","op":"can","name":<its claimed name>,"st":"new"|"asked"|"asks"|"friends"|"claim"|"theirs"|"far"}
//!   ("asked": this page's request waits; "asks": theirs does; "claim": this page plays under no claimed name;
//!   "theirs": the other one does; "far": the two are not linked now)
//! - {"t":"friend","op":"add","name":...}: a request, or friends at once when the other one asked first ->
//!   {"t":"friend","op":"add","name":...,"done":"asked"|"friends"|<a `can` state>|"full"}; the other page hears
//!   {"t":"friend","op":"asks"|"friends","name":<this page's name>}, and on friends both get their lists again

//!   minute while it has friends) -> {"t":"friend","op":"where","friends":[as GET /friends has them]}
//! - {"t":"room","name":<its room's name>}: for its friends' Join on their start pages (the server knows rooms only
//!   by their hashes; a page sends it once it has friends, and it is kept in memory only)
//! - {"t":"flying","s":<seconds>}: its game says its car was in the air in free roam that long, and the page leaves
//!   the switch for the rest of its game (runtime/roam_game.c fly_frame): a `[cheat]` line (nfsu2-roam `Hub::flew`),
//!   no answer
//! - {"t":"friend","op":"msg","name":<a friend>,"body":<at most PAGE_MSG_LEN characters>,"id":<the page's>}: a message
//!   (nfsu2-online buddy.rs `page_send`: to the friend's EA Messenger, else its pages, else it waits 7 days) ->
//!   {"t":"friend","op":"msg","name":...,"id":...,"done":"sent"|"kept"|"none"|"empty"|"off"|"full"|"claim"|"rate"}

pub const MSG_RATE: f64 = 0.5;

/// Free roam's friends: the hosts that keep them and show them, and the limits.
pub struct Friends {
    online: Arc<OnlineHost>,
    roam: Arc<RoamHub>,
    lan: Arc<LanSwitch>,
    claims: Arc<Claims>,
    reads: Rate,
    says: Rate,
    msgs: Rate,
    asks: Rate,
    invites: Rate,
    discords: Rate,
}

/// what `can` found: the other player's browser and keyphrase, its claimed name, and the state ("new", ...)
struct Can {
    vip: u32,
    owner: Option<Arc<str>>,
    name: String,
    st: &'static str,
}

impl Friends {
    pub fn new(online: Arc<OnlineHost>, roam: Arc<RoamHub>, lan: Arc<LanSwitch>, claims: Arc<Claims>) -> Arc<Friends> {
        let (reads, says, msgs) = (Rate::new(READ_BURST, READ_RATE), Rate::new(SAY_BURST, SAY_RATE), Rate::new(MSG_BURST, MSG_RATE));
        let (asks, discords) = (Rate::new(ASK_BURST, ASK_RATE), Rate::new(DISCORD_BURST, DISCORD_RATE));
        let invites = Rate::new(INVITE_BURST, INVITE_RATE);
        Arc::new(Friends { online, roam, lan, claims, reads, says, msgs, asks, invites, discords })
    }

    /// the pages' friend messages come here (the switch holds this weakly: it outlives nothing), and a friend's
    /// message for a player goes to the player's open pages
    pub fn attach(self: &Arc<Self>) {
        let me: Weak<Friends> = Arc::downgrade(self);
        self.lan.on_text(Box::new(move |vip, owner, group, m| {
            if let Some(f) = me.upgrade() {
                tokio::spawn(async move { f.text(vip, owner, group, m).await });
            }
        }));
        let (lan, claims) = (self.lan.clone(), self.claims.clone());
        self.online.page_mail(Box::new(move |to, m| {
            let Some(owner) = claims.holder(to, Self::now()) else { return false };
            let v = json!({ "t": "friend", "op": "mail", "from": m.from, "body": m.body, "at": m.t });
            let v = bytes::Bytes::from(nfsu2_util::json::stringify(&v));
            let mut any = false;
            for vip in lan.vips_of_owner(&owner) {
                any |= lan.send_text(vip, v.clone());
            }
            any
        }));
    }

    /// the buckets that are full again hold nothing worth keeping (every minute)
    pub fn prune(&self) {
        self.reads.prune();
        self.says.prune();
        self.msgs.prune();
        self.asks.prune();
        self.invites.prune();
        self.discords.prune();
    }

    fn now() -> i64 {
        nfsu2_util::now_ms() as i64
    }

    async fn lists(&self, owner: Arc<str>, group: Arc<str>, ask: FriendAsk) -> FriendReply {
        self.online.friends(owner, group, ask).await.unwrap_or_default()
    }

    fn say(&self, vip: u32, v: Value) {
        self.lan.send_text(vip, bytes::Bytes::from(nfsu2_util::json::stringify(&v)));
    }

    /// one page message (the module's doc)
    async fn text(&self, vip: u32, owner: Option<Arc<str>>, group: Arc<str>, m: Map<String, Value>) {
        let name: String = m.get("name").and_then(Value::as_str).unwrap_or("").chars().take(64).collect();
        let op = (m.get("t").and_then(Value::as_str), m.get("op").and_then(Value::as_str));
        // a message has its own budget (msgs), and is always answered: the page waits for its "done"
        if op == (Some("friend"), Some("msg")) {
            let body = m.get("body").and_then(Value::as_str).unwrap_or("");
            let done = self.send(owner, group, &name, body).await;
            let id = m.get("id").filter(|v| v.is_number()).cloned().unwrap_or(Value::Null);
            return self.say(vip, json!({ "t": "friend", "op": "msg", "name": name, "id": id, "done": done }));
        }
        // an invite has its own budget too, and is always answered (the page says what became of it)
        if op == (Some("friend"), Some("invite")) {
            let (name, done) = self.invite(vip, owner, group, &name, &m).await;
            return self.say(vip, json!({ "t": "friend", "op": "invite", "name": name, "done": done }));
        }
        if !self.says.take(&format!("{vip:08x}"), "") {
            return;
        }
        match op {
            // (as a page tidies a typed room, so no line break ever reaches a friend's settings.ini by its Join: the
            // 2026-11-05 security audit)
            (Some("room"), _) => self.roam.room_name(vip, nfsu2_lan::clean_name(&name)),
            (Some("flying"), _) => self.roam.flew(vip, m.get("s").and_then(Value::as_f64).unwrap_or(0.0)),
            (Some("friend"), Some("list")) => self.send_list(vip, owner, group).await,
            (Some("friend"), Some("can")) => {
                let c = self.can(vip, owner, group, &name).await;
                self.say(vip, json!({ "t": "friend", "op": "can", "name": c.name, "st": c.st }));
            }
            (Some("friend"), Some("add")) => self.add(vip, owner, group, &name).await,
            (Some("friend"), Some("where")) => {
                let Some(o) = owner else { return };
                let r = self.lists(o, group, FriendAsk::List).await;
                let friends = self.placed(&r).await;
                self.say(vip, json!({ "t": "friend", "op": "where", "friends": friends }));
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }

    /// a message of keyphrase `owner`'s player to its friend `name` (the module's doc): what became of it
    async fn send(&self, owner: Option<Arc<str>>, group: Arc<str>, name: &str, body: &str) -> &'static str {
        let Some(o) = owner else { return "claim" };
        if !self.msgs.take(&o, "") {
            return "rate";
        }
        let body: String = body.chars().take(PAGE_MSG_LEN).collect();
        self.lists(o, group, FriendAsk::Send(name.to_string(), body)).await.done
    }

    /// An invite of keyphrase `owner`'s player (browser `vip`) to its friend `name`, to the race lobby it hosts (the
    /// module's doc): the friend's name as its list has it, and what became of the invite.  Only a friend both ways
    /// (`FriendRow::mutual`) in free roam in the host's room is told: the hub links the two once the friend asks to join
    /// (nfsu2-roam `lobby_pairs`), and the host's game takes a friend from wherever it is.  The lobby is the hub's (its
    /// host's last advert), never what the page says.
    async fn invite(
        &self,
        vip: u32,
        owner: Option<Arc<str>>,
        group: Arc<str>,
        name: &str,
        m: &Map<String, Value>,
    ) -> (String, &'static str) {
        let Some(o) = owner else { return (name.to_string(), "claim") };
        if !self.invites.take(&o, "") {
            return (name.to_string(), "rate");
        }
        let r = self.lists(o, group, FriendAsk::List).await;
        let Some(me) = r.me else { return (name.to_string(), "claim") };
        let Some(friend) = r.friends.into_iter().find(|f| f.mutual && f.name.eq_ignore_ascii_case(name)).map(|f| f.name) else {
            return (name.to_string(), "none");
        };
        let Some(h) = self.roam.hosted(vip).await.ok().flatten() else { return (friend, "nolobby") };
        if h.n >= h.max {
            return (friend, "full");
        }
        let Some(theirs) = self.claims.holder(&friend, Self::now()) else { return (friend, "away") };
        let at = self.roam.whereabouts(vec![theirs.clone()]).await.unwrap_or_default();
        if !matches!(at.first(), Some(Some(w)) if w.room == h.room) {
            return (friend, "away");
        }
        let kind = m.get("kind").and_then(Value::as_str).filter(|k| RACE_KINDS.contains(k)).unwrap_or("race");
        let stage = m.get("stage").and_then(Value::as_i64).map_or(0, |s| s.clamp(0, 9));
        let v = json!({
            "t": "friend", "op": "invite", "name": me, "host": h.host, "lobby": h.lobby, "race": h.race, "n": h.n, "max": h.max,
            "kind": kind, "stage": stage,
        });
        let v = bytes::Bytes::from(nfsu2_util::json::stringify(&v));
        let mut told = false;
        for x in self.lan.vips_of_owner(&theirs) {
            told |= self.lan.send_text(x, v.clone());
        }
        (friend, if told { "sent" } else { "away" })
    }

    /// An invite of keyphrase `owner`'s player to its friend `name`, to its crew `crew` in room `room` (the module's
    /// doc): the lists as they are, and what became of it.  Only a friend both ways (`FriendRow::mutual`) in free roam
    /// now is told, on its open pages; the names are tidied (`tidy`), and one that reads as a slur (nfsu2-names, as the
    /// pages' Crews and Room refuse it) goes nowhere.
    async fn crew_invite(&self, owner: Arc<str>, group: Arc<str>, name: &str, crew: &str, room: &str) -> (FriendReply, &'static str) {
        let r = self.lists(owner, group, FriendAsk::List).await;
        let Some(me) = r.me.clone() else { return (r, "claim") };
        let (crew, room) = (tidy(crew), tidy(room));
        let bad = |n: &str| nfsu2_names::blocked_name(n);
        if crew.is_empty() || crew.chars().count() > CREW_LEN || room.len() > ROOM_BYTES || bad(&crew) || (!room.is_empty() && bad(&room)) {
            return (r, "name");
        }
        let Some(friend) = r.friends.iter().find(|f| f.mutual && f.name.eq_ignore_ascii_case(name)).map(|f| f.name.clone()) else {
            return (r, "none");
        };
        let Some(theirs) = self.claims.holder(&friend, Self::now()) else { return (r, "away") };
        let at = self.roam.whereabouts(vec![theirs.clone()]).await.unwrap_or_default();
        if !matches!(at.first(), Some(Some(_))) {
            return (r, "away");
        }
        let v = json!({ "t": "friend", "op": "crew", "name": me, "crew": crew, "room": room });
        let v = bytes::Bytes::from(nfsu2_util::json::stringify(&v));
        let mut told = false;
        for x in self.lan.vips_of_owner(&theirs) {
            told |= self.lan.send_text(x, v.clone());
        }
        (r, if told { "sent" } else { "away" })
    }

    /// the page's lists to it, with the messages that waited for it, and its friends to the hub: the friendships both
    /// ways only (`FriendRow::mutual`), since the hub links each one's friends with it, and puts it on theirs
    async fn send_list(&self, vip: u32, owner: Option<Arc<str>>, group: Arc<str>) {
        let Some(o) = owner else {
            return self.say(vip, json!({ "t": "friend", "op": "list", "me": null, "friends": [], "asks": [] }));
        };
        let r = self.lists(o.clone(), group, FriendAsk::ListMail).await;
        if r.me.is_some() {
            let now = Self::now();
            let owners = r.friends.iter().filter(|f| f.mutual).filter_map(|f| self.claims.holder(&f.name, now)).collect();
            self.roam.friends(vip, o, owners);
        }
        let names: Vec<&str> = r.friends.iter().map(|f| f.name.as_str()).collect();
        let mail = mail_json(&r.mail);
        self.say(vip, json!({ "t": "friend", "op": "list", "me": r.me, "friends": names, "asks": r.asks, "mail": mail }));
    }

    /// what befriending the player under `name` that browser `vip`'s player touched would be
    async fn can(&self, vip: u32, owner: Option<Arc<str>>, group: Arc<str>, name: &str) -> Can {
        let mut c = Can { vip: 0, owner: None, name: name.to_string(), st: "far" };
        let Some((pvip, pown)) = self.roam.linked_with(vip, name.to_string()).await.ok().flatten() else { return c };
        (c.vip, c.owner) = (pvip, pown.clone());
        let now = Self::now();
        // its claimed name, the one over its car
        let Some(peer) = pown
            .and_then(|p| self.claims.mine(&p, now))
            .map(|m| m.name)
            .filter(|n| nfsu2_claims::canonical(n).is_some_and(|n| Some(n) == nfsu2_claims::canonical(name)))
        else {
            c.st = "theirs";
            return c;
        };
        c.name = peer.clone();
        let Some(o) = owner else {
            c.st = "claim";
            return c;
        };
        let r = self.lists(o, group, FriendAsk::List).await;
        let is = |n: &String| n.eq_ignore_ascii_case(&peer);
        c.st = if r.me.is_none() {
            "claim"
        } else if r.friends.iter().any(|f| f.mutual && is(&f.name)) {
            "friends"
        } else if r.asks.iter().any(is) {
            "asks"
        } else if r.sent.iter().any(is) {
            "asked"
        } else {
            "new"
        };
        c
    }

    /// a request to the player under `name` that browser `vip`'s player touched
    async fn add(&self, vip: u32, owner: Option<Arc<str>>, group: Arc<str>, name: &str) {
        let c = self.can(vip, owner.clone(), group.clone(), name).await;
        let (Some(o), "new" | "asks" | "asked") = (owner.clone(), c.st) else {
            return self.say(vip, json!({ "t": "friend", "op": "add", "name": c.name, "done": c.st }));
        };
        let r = self.lists(o, group.clone(), FriendAsk::Ask(c.name.clone())).await;
        self.say(vip, json!({ "t": "friend", "op": "add", "name": c.name, "done": r.done }));
        match r.done {
            "asked" => self.say(c.vip, json!({ "t": "friend", "op": "asks", "name": r.me })),
            "friends" => {
                self.say(c.vip, json!({ "t": "friend", "op": "friends", "name": r.me }));
                self.send_list(vip, owner, group.clone()).await;
                self.send_list(c.vip, c.owner, group).await;
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }

    /// a request (or an answer to one) on /friends to `name` from `me` (keyphrase `mine`) did `done`: the other
    /// player's open pages hear of it, as of one in free roam ("asks", or "friends" when it had asked first or this
    /// accepted its request); on friends both players' open pages get their lists again, so the hub links them at once
    /// (a game page answers a request from afar there: friends.ts FriendPrompt)
    async fn told(&self, name: &str, me: &str, mine: Arc<str>, group: Arc<str>, done: &str) {
        let op = match done {
            "asked" => "asks",
            "friends" => "friends",
            _ => return,
        };
        let Some(owner) = self.claims.holder(name, Self::now()) else { return };
        let theirs = self.lan.vips_of_owner(&owner);
        for &vip in &theirs {
            self.say(vip, json!({ "t": "friend", "op": op, "name": me }));
        }
        if done != "friends" {
            return;
        }
        for vip in theirs {
            self.send_list(vip, Some(owner.clone()), group.clone()).await;
        }
        for vip in self.lan.vips_of_owner(&mine) {
            self.send_list(vip, Some(mine.clone()), group.clone()).await;
        }
    }

    /// the start page's view of the lists: each friend where it plays
    async fn page_json(&self, r: FriendReply) -> Value {
        let friends = self.placed(&r).await;
        json!({
            "me": r.me, "done": r.done, "friends": friends, "asks": r.asks, "sent": r.sent, "mail": mail_json(&r.mail), "contact": r.contact,
        })
    }

    /// the friends of the lists, each where it plays (the module's doc, GET /friends): a one-way entry
    /// (`FriendRow::mutual`) nowhere, its room none (the 2026-11-05 security audit: one the Messenger's RADD put on a
    /// list unasked told the adder where its player was, and the name of its private room)
    async fn placed(&self, r: &FriendReply) -> Vec<Value> {
        let now = Self::now();
        let owners: Vec<Option<Arc<str>>> =
            r.friends.iter().map(|f| if f.mutual { self.claims.holder(&f.name, now) } else { None }).collect();
        let found: Vec<Arc<str>> = owners.iter().flatten().cloned().collect();
        let mut at = self.roam.whereabouts(found).await.unwrap_or_default().into_iter();
        r.friends
            .iter()
            .zip(owners)
            .map(|(f, o)| {
                let w = o.and_then(|_| at.next().flatten());
                let mut m = Map::new();
                m.insert("name".into(), f.name.clone().into());
                let place = if w.is_some() {
                    "roam"
                } else if f.online {
                    "online"
                } else {
                    ""
                };
                m.insert("where".into(), place.into());
                match &w {
                    // (the main world's, on one of its race tracks too: its page names it "", which a display name's
                    // tidying would make "player")
                    Some(w) if nfsu2_roam::main_world(w.room) => {
                        m.insert("room".into(), "".into());
                    }
                    Some(nfsu2_roam::Whereabouts { room_name: Some(n), .. }) => {
                        m.insert("room".into(), n.clone().into());
                    }
                    _ => {}
                }
                // its room's hash: its world's, or a race track's spot's there (nfsu2_roam::track_room), for its Join
                if let Some(w) = &w {
                    m.insert("at".into(), w.room.into());
                }
                if let Some(c) = &f.contact {
                    m.insert("contact".into(), c.clone().into());
                }
                Value::Object(m)
            })
            .collect()
    }
}

/// A crew's or a room's name in an invite, tidied near enough as a page tidies a typed one (web/src/app/invite.ts
/// tidyName; the friend's page tidies and checks it again before its Join): control and format characters out (no
/// line break or bidi trick reaches the friend's settings.ini), each run of white space one space, trimmed.  Not
/// nfsu2-lan's `clean_name`, a display name's: that one cuts at 32 characters, and makes "player" of an empty name
/// (the room of everyone) and of one that reads as a slur (refused here instead).
fn tidy(s: &str) -> String {
    let format = |c: char| {
        matches!(c, '\u{ad}' | '\u{600}'..='\u{605}' | '\u{61c}' | '\u{6dd}' | '\u{70f}' | '\u{180e}' | '\u{200b}'..='\u{200f}'
        | '\u{202a}'..='\u{202e}' | '\u{2060}'..='\u{2064}' | '\u{2066}'..='\u{206f}' | '\u{feff}' | '\u{fff9}'..='\u{fffb}')
    };
    let mut t = String::with_capacity(s.len());
    for c in s.chars() {
        if c.is_whitespace() {
            if !t.is_empty() && !t.ends_with(' ') {
                t.push(' ');
            }
        } else if !c.is_control() && !format(c) {
            t.push(c);
        }
    }
    t.trim_end().to_string()
}

/// messages for a page, as its list's "mail" has them
fn mail_json(mail: &[PageMail]) -> Value {
    mail.iter().map(|m| json!({ "from": m.from, "body": m.body, "at": m.t })).collect()
}

impl App {
    /// /friends (free roam's friends on the start page): see this module's doc
    pub(super) async fn friends_route(&self, q: &mut Request, s: &mut Response, _u: &url::Url) -> Res {
        let Some(f) = self.friends.clone() else { return self.not_found(q, s).await };
        // only this server's own pages: a page of another site must not read or change a player's friends
        let site_ok = q.headers.get("sec-fetch-site").is_none_or(|x| x == "same-origin");
        if !self.own_page(q) || !site_ok {
            return self.plain(q, s, 403, "Forbidden", &[], Cache::Store, true).await;
        }
        let (_, key, site) = self.client(q);
        if !f.reads.take(&key, &site) {
            return self.plain(q, s, 429, "Too many requests", &[("retry-after", "60")], Cache::Store, true).await;
        }
        let Some(owner) = super::names::token(q).and_then(nfsu2_claims::owner_of_token) else {
            return self.json(q, s, 401, &json!({ "error": "keyphrase" })).await;
        };
        let group: Arc<str> = Arc::from(self.group_id(&key));
        let ask = match q.method.as_str() {
            "GET" => FriendAsk::ListMail,
            "POST" => {
                let body = match q.read_body(MAX_BODY).await {
                    Ok(b) => b,
                    Err(nfsu2_http::BodyError::TooLarge) => return self.json(q, s, 413, &json!({ "error": "large" })).await,
                    Err(nfsu2_http::BodyError::Broken) => {
                        s.destroy();
                        return Err(Fail::Gone);
                    }
                };
                let Ok(Value::Object(b)) = serde_json::from_slice::<Value>(&body) else {
                    return self.json(q, s, 400, &json!({ "error": "invalid" })).await;
                };
                let name: String = b.get("name").and_then(Value::as_str).unwrap_or("").chars().take(64).collect();
                match b.get("op").and_then(Value::as_str) {
                    Some("msg") => {
                        if !f.msgs.take(&owner, "") {
                            return self.json(q, s, 200, &json!({ "done": "rate" })).await;
                        }
                        let body: String = b.get("body").and_then(Value::as_str).unwrap_or("").chars().take(PAGE_MSG_LEN).collect();
                        FriendAsk::Send(name, body)
                    }
                    Some("ask") => {
                        if !f.asks.take(&owner, "") {
                            return self.json(q, s, 200, &json!({ "done": "rate" })).await;
                        }
                        // the name as its claim spells it (a typed "bo" asks "Bo_"); nobody's: "claim"
                        let now = nfsu2_util::now_ms() as i64;
                        let claimed = f.claims.holder(&name, now).and_then(|o| f.claims.mine(&o, now)).map(|m| m.name);
                        FriendAsk::AskByName(claimed.unwrap_or(name))
                    }
                    Some("discord") => {
                        if !f.discords.take(&owner, "") {
                            return self.json(q, s, 200, &json!({ "done": "rate" })).await;
                        }
                        FriendAsk::Discord(name)
                    }
                    Some("crew") => {
                        if !f.invites.take(&owner, "") {
                            return self.json(q, s, 200, &json!({ "done": "rate" })).await;
                        }
                        let text = |k: &str| b.get(k).and_then(Value::as_str).unwrap_or("").chars().take(64).collect::<String>();
                        let (r, done) = f.crew_invite(owner, group, &name, &text("crew"), &text("room")).await;
                        let mut v = f.page_json(r).await;
                        v["done"] = done.into();
                        return self.json(q, s, 200, &v).await;
                    }
                    Some("accept") => FriendAsk::Answer(name, true),
                    Some("decline") => FriendAsk::Answer(name, false),
                    Some("remove") => FriendAsk::Remove(name),
                    Some("block") => FriendAsk::Block(name),
                    _ => return self.json(q, s, 400, &json!({ "error": "invalid" })).await,
                }
            }
            _ => {
                return self
                    .plain(q, s, 405, "Method not allowed", &[("allow", "GET, POST"), ("connection", "close")], Cache::Store, true)
                    .await;
            }
        };
        let asked = match &ask {
            FriendAsk::AskByName(n) | FriendAsk::Answer(n, true) => Some(n.clone()),
            _ => None,
        };
        let r = f.lists(owner.clone(), group.clone(), ask).await;
        if let (Some(n), Some(me)) = (asked, &r.me) {
            f.told(&n, me, owner, group, r.done).await;
        }
        let v = f.page_json(r).await;
        self.json(q, s, 200, &v).await
    }
}

//! The game data's blocks compressed once at brotli's best (quality 11) and kept in the state folder (`blocks/`), for
//! the /data-blocks/ answers of one block (what the page asks for).  They cross the network smaller than at the
//! quality 3 a block is compressed with as it is sent (the tracks 41 -> 33 % of their size, SPEED2.EXE 50 -> 41 %,
//! the music 86 -> 84 %; the movies do not compress either way), and every block is tried, not only those whose
//! first 64 KB compress (the answers' probe, blocks.rs: many car textures, sent as they are before), at about 100
//! times the CPU: so never while a client waits.  A block not kept yet is answered as before and queued (blocks.rs).
//! Threads of their own (NFSU2_COMPRESS_THREADS, 2 unless given, 0 with --dev; 0: the answers as before) at the lowest
//! priority make what the answers queued first, then every block of each new manifest (a changed file is a new key),
//! and remove what no file of the manifest has any more.  The lowest priority only puts them behind the server's
//! other threads on a core they share: under a CPU quota (nfsu2.slice's 14 cores, which the free-roam hub's busy cap
//! reads too) their cores count all the same, 2 of 14 on top of a busy evening's 11.8.  So they wait while the
//! quota is PAUSE_AT used and go on below RESUME_AT, and never take it to the cap's 85 % themselves.
//!
//! A kept block is a file named by a hash of the game file's real path, size, mtime and the block's number: its
//! brotli stream, or nothing at all for a block that is sent as it is: brotli makes it no smaller, or zstd at its
//! fastest makes it not even 0.5 % smaller (the movies' video: not worth brotli's time).  Written next to its place,
//! on the disk before it is renamed into it: a reader finds a whole one or none, also after a power cut (Cloudflare
//! would keep a cut-short stream for good).  The folder stops growing at MAX_BYTES, or while the disk under it has
//! less than MIN_FREE free, looked at again every ROOM_EVERY then; the answers are as before meanwhile, and the
//! queues wait.

use std::collections::{HashSet, VecDeque};
use std::io::{self, Write};
use std::os::unix::fs::{DirBuilderExt, MetadataExt, OpenOptionsExt};
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, AtomicU64, Ordering};
use std::time::{Duration, Instant, SystemTime};

use parking_lot::{Condvar, Mutex};
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};

use nfsu2_util::atomic_file::Options;
use nfsu2_util::cpu::{QuotaBusy, QuotaUse};
use nfsu2_util::log;

use super::blocks::read_full_at;
use super::manifest::BLOCK;

/// brotli's best, with a window larger than a block (a browser takes up to 2^24); the tests take 5, as 11 takes
/// seconds a block of their made-up bytes
pub const QUALITY: u32 = if cfg!(test) { 5 } else { 11 };
pub const LGWIN: u32 = 21;
/// the folder's most, and the least the disk under it keeps free
const MAX_BYTES: u64 = 16 << 30;
const MIN_FREE: u64 = 2 << 30;
/// the most blocks the answers queue (the manifest's own are all queued, about 5000 for a game folder)
const FIRST_MAX: usize = 20_000;
/// a file being written that is this old is a crash's: the sweep removes it
const STALE_TMP: Duration = Duration::from_secs(600);
/// how often the room is looked at again while there is none (a full disk freed, an old image removed)
const ROOM_EVERY: Duration = Duration::from_millis(if cfg!(test) { 50 } else { 60_000 });
/// the CPU quota the server shares: the threads wait from this share of it used, and go on below RESUME_AT (the gap
/// is their own 2 of 14 cores, so that their pause does not end it at once); read at most every PACE_EVERY
const PAUSE_AT: f64 = 0.70;
const RESUME_AT: f64 = 0.55;
const PACE_EVERY: Duration = Duration::from_millis(if cfg!(test) { 50 } else { 5_000 });

pub type Key = [u8; 16];

/// one block of one version of a file
pub fn key(real: &str, md: &std::fs::Metadata, b: u64) -> Key {
    let mut h = Sha256::new();
    h.update(real.as_bytes());
    h.update([0]);
    h.update(md.size().to_le_bytes());
    h.update(md.mtime().to_le_bytes());
    h.update(md.mtime_nsec().to_le_bytes());
    h.update(b.to_le_bytes());
    h.finalize()[..16].try_into().expect("16 bytes")
}

fn hex(k: &Key) -> String {
    k.iter().map(|b| format!("{b:02x}")).collect()
}

/// a kept block, as a lookup finds it
pub enum Kept {
    /// its brotli stream: the open file and its length
    Br(std::fs::File, u64),
    /// brotli makes it no smaller: sent as it is
    AsIs,
    /// not kept (yet)
    No,
}

/// a block to make
struct Job {
    real: String,
    size: u64,
    mtime: (i64, i64),
    b: u64,
    key: Key,
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct Queues {
    /// what the answers queued, and their keys (a block many answers ask for is queued once)
    first: VecDeque<Job>,
    in_first: HashSet<Key>,
    /// the manifest's blocks that are not kept
    rest: VecDeque<Job>,
    /// whether the made blocks were told since the queues last ran dry
    told: bool,
    /// blocks made since the queues last ran dry
    made: u64,
}

/// the CPU quota the server shares, as the threads read it (PAUSE_AT, RESUME_AT)
struct Pace {
    /// the fullest quota's use since the last call (QuotaBusy); None: no quota to read (no Linux, no cgroup v2)
    sample: Option<Box<dyn FnMut() -> Option<QuotaUse> + Send>>,
    at: Instant,
    paused: bool,
}

pub struct KeptBlocks {
    dir: PathBuf,
    threads: usize,
    q: Mutex<Queues>,
    cv: Condvar,
    /// the bytes the folder takes (counted by each sweep, then added to)
    bytes: AtomicU64,
    /// whether there is room for more, and when that was looked at
    room: AtomicBool,
    room_at: Mutex<Instant>,
    pace: Mutex<Pace>,
    /// the sweeps started: an older one stops when a newer starts
    sweeps: AtomicU64,
    /// the manifest swept last (its ETag): the same manifest again is not swept again
    swept: Mutex<String>,
}

impl KeptBlocks {
    /// the folder (made 0700 if it is not there) and `threads` threads that make the blocks
    pub fn open(dir: PathBuf, threads: usize) -> io::Result<Arc<KeptBlocks>> {
        std::fs::DirBuilder::new().recursive(true).mode(0o700).create(&dir)?;
        let k = Arc::new(KeptBlocks {
            dir,
            threads,
            q: Mutex::new(Queues { told: true, ..Default::default() }),
            cv: Condvar::new(),
            bytes: AtomicU64::new(0),
            room: AtomicBool::new(true),
            room_at: Mutex::new(Instant::now()),
            pace: Mutex::new(Pace {
                sample: QuotaBusy::find().map(|mut q| Box::new(move || q.sample_use()) as Box<dyn FnMut() -> Option<QuotaUse> + Send>),
                at: Instant::now(),
                paused: false,
            }),
            sweeps: AtomicU64::new(0),
            swept: Mutex::new(String::new()),
        });
        k.check_room();
        for i in 0..threads {
            let k = k.clone();
            std::thread::Builder::new().name(format!("nfsu2-kept-{i}")).spawn(move || {
                nfsu2_util::cpu::lower_this_thread(19);
                k.work();
            })?;
        }
        Ok(k)
    }

    fn path(&self, k: &Key) -> PathBuf {
        let h = hex(k);
        self.dir.join(&h[..2]).join(h)
    }

    /// the kept block of this key (blocking: a file opened)
    pub fn lookup(&self, k: &Key) -> Kept {
        let Ok(f) = std::fs::File::open(self.path(k)) else { return Kept::No };
        match f.metadata() {
            Ok(m) if m.len() == 0 => Kept::AsIs,
            Ok(m) => Kept::Br(f, m.len()),
            Err(_) => Kept::No,
        }
    }

    /// whether blocks are kept (false while the folder or the disk is full: the answers are as before then).  Without
    /// room no block is made, so the room is looked at again here, every ROOM_EVERY: one look at a moment the disk
    /// was short (an image pulled at a release) kept them off until a restart.
    pub fn keeping(&self) -> bool {
        if !self.room.load(Ordering::Relaxed) && self.room_at.lock().elapsed() >= ROOM_EVERY {
            self.check_room();
        }
        self.room.load(Ordering::Relaxed)
    }

    /// whether the CPU quota the server shares is too full to compress now (PAUSE_AT, RESUME_AT), read at most every
    /// PACE_EVERY; a change is told on the console
    fn slice_full(&self) -> bool {
        let mut p = self.pace.lock();
        if p.at.elapsed() < PACE_EVERY {
            return p.paused;
        }
        p.at = Instant::now();
        let Some(u) = p.sample.as_mut().and_then(|f| f()) else { return p.paused };
        let (was, share) = (p.paused, u.share());
        p.paused = share >= if was { RESUME_AT } else { PAUSE_AT };
        if p.paused != was {
            log::line(&format!(
                "kept blocks: {} while {} uses {:.0} % of its {} cores",
                if p.paused { "waiting" } else { "going on" },
                u.group,
                share * 100.0,
                u.cores
            ));
        }
        p.paused
    }

    /// a block an answer did not find, to be made before the manifest's others
    pub fn queue(&self, real: &str, md: &std::fs::Metadata, b: u64) {
        if !self.keeping() {
            return;
        }
        let k = key(real, md, b);
        let mut q = self.q.lock();
        if q.first.len() < FIRST_MAX && q.in_first.insert(k) {
            q.first.push_back(Job { real: real.to_string(), size: md.size(), mtime: (md.mtime(), md.mtime_nsec()), b, key: k });
            self.cv.notify_one();
        }
    }

    /// The manifest's files (each game file's real path and metadata, as `locate` finds it from its path in the
    /// manifest): every block not kept is queued, and what is kept for no block of theirs is removed.  On a thread
    /// of its own; nothing when this manifest (`etag`) was swept already.
    pub fn sweep(
        self: &Arc<Self>,
        etag: &str,
        paths: Vec<String>,
        locate: impl Fn(&str) -> Option<(String, std::fs::Metadata)> + Send + 'static,
    ) {
        {
            let mut s = self.swept.lock();
            if *s == etag {
                return;
            }
            *s = etag.to_string();
        }
        let n = self.sweeps.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst) + 1;
        let (k, etag) = (self.clone(), etag.to_string());
        let _ = std::thread::Builder::new().name("nfsu2-kept-sweep".into()).spawn(move || {
            nfsu2_util::cpu::lower_this_thread(19);
            if let Err(e) = k.sweep_now(n, &paths, &locate) {
                log::error(&format!("kept blocks: {}: {e}", k.dir.display()));
                // not swept: the next look at the manifest (a ?refresh) sweeps it again
                let mut s = k.swept.lock();
                if *s == etag {
                    s.clear();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    fn sweep_now(&self, n: u64, paths: &[String], locate: &dyn Fn(&str) -> Option<(String, std::fs::Metadata)>) -> io::Result<()> {
        let stale = || self.sweeps.load(Ordering::SeqCst) != n;
        let (mut live, mut rest) = (HashSet::new(), VecDeque::new());
        for p in paths {
            if stale() {
                return Ok(());
            }
            let Some((real, md)) = locate(p) else { continue };
            for b in 0..md.size().div_ceil(BLOCK) {
                let k = key(&real, &md, b);
                live.insert(k);
                if !self.path(&k).exists() {
                    rest.push_back(Job { real: real.clone(), size: md.size(), mtime: (md.mtime(), md.mtime_nsec()), b, key: k });
                }
            }
        }
        // what no block of the manifest has, and files a crash left half written
        let names: HashSet<String> = live.iter().map(hex).collect();
        let mut bytes = 0;
        for sub in std::fs::read_dir(&self.dir)? {
            let sub = sub?.path();
            if !sub.is_dir() {
                continue;
            }
            for e in std::fs::read_dir(&sub)? {
                let e = e?;
                let name = e.file_name().to_string_lossy().into_owned();
                let md = match e.metadata() {
                    Ok(md) => md,
                    // gone since the folder was read: a block renamed into its place meanwhile (the threads work on
                    // while a sweep runs), a file an older sweep removed
                    Err(e) if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => continue,
                    Err(e) => return Err(e),
                };
                let old = md.modified().ok().and_then(|t| SystemTime::now().duration_since(t).ok()).is_some_and(|a| a > STALE_TMP);
                if names.contains(&name) {
                    bytes += md.len();
                } else if !name.starts_with('.') || old {
                    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(e.path());
                }
            }
        }
        if stale() {
            return Ok(());
        }
        self.bytes.store(bytes, Ordering::Relaxed);
        self.check_room();
        let to_make = rest.len();
        let mut q = self.q.lock();
        q.rest = rest;
        if to_make > 0 {
            q.told = false;
            self.cv.notify_all();
        }
        drop(q);
        log::line(&format!(
            "kept blocks: {} of {} ({:.0} MB), {to_make} to compress at brotli's best{}",
            live.len() - to_make,
            live.len(),
            bytes as f64 / 1e6,
            if self.keeping() { "" } else { " (no room: not kept)" }
        ));
        Ok(())
    }

    /// whether the folder may grow: below MAX_BYTES, and MIN_FREE free on its disk
    fn check_room(&self) {
        use std::os::unix::ffi::OsStrExt;
        let free = std::ffi::CString::new(self.dir.as_os_str().as_bytes()).ok().and_then(|p| {
            // SAFETY: statvfs writes the struct it is given, and only that; the path is NUL-terminated
            let mut s: libc::statvfs = unsafe { std::mem::zeroed() };
            (unsafe { libc::statvfs(p.as_ptr(), &mut s) } == 0).then(|| s.f_bavail as u64 * s.f_frsize as u64)
        });
        let ok = self.bytes.load(Ordering::Relaxed) < MAX_BYTES && free.is_none_or(|f| f >= MIN_FREE);
        self.room.store(ok, Ordering::Relaxed);
        *self.room_at.lock() = Instant::now();
    }

    fn work(&self) {
        loop {
            let job = {
                let mut q = self.q.lock();
                loop {
                    // no room, or the CPU quota nearly used: the queues wait as they are
                    if (!q.first.is_empty() || !q.rest.is_empty()) && (!self.keeping() || self.slice_full()) {
                        self.cv.wait_for(&mut q, PACE_EVERY.min(ROOM_EVERY));
                        continue;
                    }
                    if let Some(j) = q.first.pop_front() {
                        q.in_first.remove(&j.key);
                        break j;
                    }
                    if let Some(j) = q.rest.pop_front() {
                        break j;
                    }
                    if !q.told {
                        q.told = true;
                        if q.made > 0 {
                            log::line(&format!(
                                "kept blocks: {} compressed, {:.0} MB kept in all",
                                q.made,
                                self.bytes.load(Ordering::Relaxed) as f64 / 1e6
                            ));
                        }
                        q.made = 0;
                    }
                    self.cv.wait(&mut q);
                }
            };
            if self.path(&job.key).exists() {
                continue;
            }
            match self.make(&job) {
                Ok(true) => {
                    let mut q = self.q.lock();
                    q.made += 1;
                    if q.made.is_multiple_of(64) {
                        self.check_room();
                    }
                }
                Ok(false) => {}
                Err(e) => log::error(&format!("kept blocks: {} block {}: {e}", job.real, job.b)),
            }
        }
    }

    /// the block compressed and kept, or kept as one sent as it is (false: not, as the file changed)
    fn make(&self, job: &Job) -> io::Result<bool> {
        let f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new().read(true).custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW).open(&job.real)?;
        let md = f.metadata()?;
        if !md.is_file() || md.size() != job.size || (md.mtime(), md.mtime_nsec()) != job.mtime {
            return Ok(false);
        }
        let start = job.b * BLOCK;
        let mut buf = vec![0u8; BLOCK.min(job.size.saturating_sub(start)) as usize];
        let got = read_full_at(&f, &mut buf, start)?;
        if got < buf.len() {
            return Ok(false);
        }
        // (no brotli for what zstd at its fastest cannot make smaller: the movies' video)
        let fast = zstd::bulk::compress(&buf, 1)?;
        let z = if (fast.len() as f64) < buf.len() as f64 * 0.995 { compress(&buf)? } else { Vec::new() };
        let body: &[u8] = if !z.is_empty() && z.len() < buf.len() { &z } else { &[] };
        self.put(&job.key, body)?;
        Ok(true)
    }

    fn put(&self, k: &Key, body: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {
        // synced before its name: after a power cut a renamed file could come back cut short, and be served as a whole
        // brotli stream that Cloudflare keeps for good; the temporary name starts with a "." (the sweep removes every
        // other name no block has, and leaves those until they are STALE_TMP old)
        Options::new().make_folder().hidden().write(&self.path(k), body)?;
        self.bytes.fetch_add(body.len() as u64, Ordering::Relaxed);
        Ok(())
    }

    /// what the start-up lines say of it
    pub fn summary(&self) -> String {
        format!("kept at brotli's best in {}, {} threads (NFSU2_COMPRESS_THREADS)", self.dir.display(), self.threads)
    }

    #[cfg(test)]
    fn dir(&self) -> &std::path::Path {
        &self.dir
    }
}

/// a block at brotli's best
pub fn compress(raw: &[u8]) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
    compress_at(raw, QUALITY)
}

fn compress_at(raw: &[u8], quality: u32) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
    let mut w = brotli::CompressorWriter::new(Vec::with_capacity(raw.len() / 2), 64 << 10, quality, LGWIN);
    w.write_all(raw)?;
    w.flush()?;
    Ok(w.into_inner())
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::app::testkit::data;
    use std::io::Read;

    fn eventually_sync(what: &str, ok: impl Fn() -> bool) {
        let t0 = std::time::Instant::now();
        while !ok() {
            assert!(t0.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(20), "{what}");
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(20));
        }
    }

    fn unbr(z: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        brotli::Decompressor::new(z, 4096).read_to_end(&mut out).unwrap();
        out
    }

    fn file_with(dir: &std::path::Path, name: &str, body: &[u8]) -> (String, std::fs::Metadata) {
        let p = dir.join(name);
        std::fs::write(&p, body).unwrap();
        (p.to_string_lossy().into_owned(), std::fs::metadata(&p).unwrap())
    }

    // a key names one block of one version: another block, size or time is another key
    #[test]
    fn keys_name_a_version_and_a_block() {
        let d = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let (real, md) = file_with(d.path(), "f", b"one");
        assert_eq!(key(&real, &md, 0), key(&real, &md, 0));
        assert_ne!(key(&real, &md, 0), key(&real, &md, 1));
        let (_, md2) = file_with(d.path(), "f", b"one more");
        assert_ne!(key(&real, &md, 0), key(&real, &md2, 0));
        assert_eq!(hex(&key(&real, &md, 0)).len(), 32);
    }

    // queued blocks are made, the brotli stream gives the bytes back, a lookup finds them; noise is never kept
    #[test]
    fn queued_blocks_are_made_and_found() {
        let d = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        // blocks 0 and 1 compress, 2 is noise (kept as one sent as it is), 3 compresses (and is shorter)
        let mut body = data(2 << 20, true);
        body.extend(data(1 << 20, false));
        body.extend(data(3000, true));
        let (real, md) = file_with(d.path(), "game.bin", &body);
        let k = KeptBlocks::open(d.path().join("blocks"), 1).unwrap();
        for b in [0, 1, 2, 3] {
            assert!(matches!(k.lookup(&key(&real, &md, b)), Kept::No));
            k.queue(&real, &md, b);
        }
        eventually_sync("block 3 kept", || matches!(k.lookup(&key(&real, &md, 3)), Kept::Br(..)));
        for b in [0, 1, 3u64] {
            let Kept::Br(mut f, len) = k.lookup(&key(&real, &md, b)) else { panic!("block {b} kept") };
            let mut z = Vec::new();
            f.read_to_end(&mut z).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(z.len() as u64, len);
            let (s, e) = ((b << 20) as usize, (((b + 1) << 20) as usize).min(body.len()));
            assert_eq!(unbr(&z), &body[s..e], "block {b}");
        }
        eventually_sync("noise kept as one sent as it is", || matches!(k.lookup(&key(&real, &md, 2)), Kept::AsIs));
        // nothing half-written is left
        let names: Vec<String> = std::fs::read_dir(k.dir())
            .unwrap()
            .flat_map(|s| std::fs::read_dir(s.unwrap().path()).unwrap())
            .map(|e| e.unwrap().file_name().to_string_lossy().into_owned())
            .collect();
        assert_eq!(names.len(), 4, "{names:?}");
        assert!(names.iter().all(|n| !n.starts_with('.')));
    }

    // a file changed after its block was queued: nothing kept for the old version
    #[test]
    fn a_changed_file_is_not_kept_as_the_old_version() {
        let d = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let (real, md) = file_with(d.path(), "game.bin", &data(1 << 20, true));
        let k = KeptBlocks::open(d.path().join("blocks"), 0).unwrap();
        file_with(d.path(), "game.bin", &data(1 << 19, true));
        let job = Job { real: real.clone(), size: md.size(), mtime: (md.mtime(), md.mtime_nsec()), b: 0, key: key(&real, &md, 0) };
        assert!(!k.make(&job).unwrap());
        assert!(matches!(k.lookup(&key(&real, &md, 0)), Kept::No));
    }

    // a sweep queues every block of the manifest's files and removes what is kept for no block of theirs
    #[test]
    fn a_sweep_makes_the_manifest_and_removes_the_rest() {
        let d = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let (a, _) = file_with(d.path(), "a.bin", &data((1 << 20) + 5000, true));
        let (b, _) = file_with(d.path(), "b.bin", &data(100, true));
        let k = KeptBlocks::open(d.path().join("blocks"), 2).unwrap();
        // an old version's block and a crash's half-written file
        k.put(&[7; 16], b"old").unwrap();
        let tmp = k.path(&[8; 16]).with_file_name(".x.1");
        std::fs::create_dir_all(tmp.parent().unwrap()).unwrap();
        std::fs::write(&tmp, b"half").unwrap();
        let locate = |p: &str| {
            let md = std::fs::metadata(p).ok()?;
            Some((p.to_string(), md))
        };
        k.sweep("m1", vec![a.clone(), b.clone(), "/no/such/file".into()], locate);
        let keys = [(a.as_str(), 0u64), (a.as_str(), 1), (b.as_str(), 0)].map(|(p, n)| key(p, &std::fs::metadata(p).unwrap(), n));
        eventually_sync("the manifest's blocks kept", || keys.iter().all(|x| !matches!(k.lookup(x), Kept::No)));
        assert!(!k.path(&[7; 16]).exists(), "a block of no file of the manifest is removed");
        assert!(tmp.exists(), "a file being written now is left alone");
        // the same manifest again: no sweep; a new one sweeps
        assert_eq!(k.sweeps.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 1);
        k.sweep("m1", vec![a.clone()], locate);
        assert_eq!(k.sweeps.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 1);
        k.sweep("m2", vec![a.clone()], locate);
        eventually_sync("b's block removed", || !k.path(&keys[2]).exists());
        assert!(k.path(&keys[0]).exists());
    }

    /// the CPU quota the threads read, at `share` of its 4 cores used (read at once)
    fn quota(k: &KeptBlocks, share: Arc<AtomicU64>) {
        let mut p = k.pace.lock();
        p.sample = Some(Box::new(move || {
            Some(QuotaUse { group: "/test.slice".into(), cores: 4.0, used: f64::from_bits(share.load(Ordering::SeqCst)) * 4.0 })
        }));
        p.at = Instant::now().checked_sub(PACE_EVERY).unwrap_or(p.at);
    }

    fn not_kept(k: &KeptBlocks, real: &str, md: &std::fs::Metadata) -> bool {
        matches!(k.lookup(&key(real, md, 0)), Kept::No)
    }

    // the CPU quota the server shares nearly used: no block is made until it is under RESUME_AT, the queue kept
    #[test]
    fn a_full_cpu_quota_holds_the_blocks_back() {
        let d = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let (real, md) = file_with(d.path(), "game.bin", &data(1 << 20, true));
        let k = KeptBlocks::open(d.path().join("blocks"), 1).unwrap();
        let share = Arc::new(AtomicU64::new(0.9f64.to_bits()));
        quota(&k, share.clone());
        k.queue(&real, &md, 0);
        std::thread::sleep(PACE_EVERY * 6);
        assert!(not_kept(&k, &real, &md), "made at 90 %");
        // under PAUSE_AT, not under RESUME_AT: still waiting
        share.store(0.6f64.to_bits(), Ordering::SeqCst);
        std::thread::sleep(PACE_EVERY * 6);
        assert!(not_kept(&k, &real, &md), "made at 60 % after 90 %");
        share.store(0.3f64.to_bits(), Ordering::SeqCst);
        eventually_sync("made at 30 %", || !not_kept(&k, &real, &md));
    }

    // no room (the folder or the disk full): what is queued waits, and is made once there is room again, which is
    // looked at again by itself; the answers keep blocks again too.  (The threads dropped every job without room,
    // and only a block made looked at the room again: none ever was.)
    #[test]
    fn blocks_wait_for_room_and_are_made_once_there_is() {
        let d = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let (real, md) = file_with(d.path(), "game.bin", &data(1 << 20, true));
        let k = KeptBlocks::open(d.path().join("blocks"), 1).unwrap();
        // held back by the quota while the room goes
        let share = Arc::new(AtomicU64::new(0.9f64.to_bits()));
        quota(&k, share.clone());
        k.queue(&real, &md, 0);
        k.bytes.store(MAX_BYTES, Ordering::Relaxed);
        k.check_room();
        assert!(!k.keeping());
        share.store(0f64.to_bits(), Ordering::SeqCst);
        std::thread::sleep(ROOM_EVERY * 6);
        assert!(not_kept(&k, &real, &md), "made without room");
        k.bytes.store(0, Ordering::Relaxed);
        eventually_sync("made once there is room", || !not_kept(&k, &real, &md));
        assert!(k.keeping());
    }

    // a sweep that fails (a folder it cannot read) is not taken as done: the same manifest is swept again
    #[test]
    fn a_failed_sweep_is_swept_again() {
        // SAFETY: geteuid has no preconditions
        if unsafe { libc::geteuid() } == 0 {
            return; // root reads any folder
        }
        use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
        let d = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let (a, _) = file_with(d.path(), "a.bin", &data(100, true));
        let k = KeptBlocks::open(d.path().join("blocks"), 0).unwrap();
        let locked = k.dir().join("zz");
        std::fs::create_dir(&locked).unwrap();
        std::fs::set_permissions(&locked, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o000)).unwrap();
        let locate = |p: &str| Some((p.to_string(), std::fs::metadata(p).ok()?));
        k.sweep("m1", vec![a.clone()], locate);
        eventually_sync("the failed sweep forgotten", || k.swept.lock().is_empty());
        std::fs::set_permissions(&locked, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o700)).unwrap();
        k.sweep("m1", vec![a.clone()], locate);
        assert_eq!(k.sweeps.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 2);
        eventually_sync("a's block queued", || k.q.lock().rest.len() == 1);
        assert_eq!(*k.swept.lock(), "m1");
    }

    /// a measurement, not a check: blocks of $NFSU2_BENCH_FILE at brotli's best, the time and size each
    /// (cargo test --release -- --ignored bench_best --nocapture)
    #[test]
    #[ignore]
    fn bench_best() {
        let Ok(path) = std::env::var("NFSU2_BENCH_FILE") else { return };
        let raw = std::fs::read(&path).unwrap();
        let (mut n, mut z, mut t) = (0usize, 0usize, 0f64);
        for c in raw.chunks(BLOCK as usize).take(16) {
            let t0 = std::time::Instant::now();
            z += compress_at(c, 11).unwrap().len();
            t += t0.elapsed().as_secs_f64();
            n += c.len();
        }
        println!(
            "{:.1} MB -> {:.1} MB ({:.1} %) in {:.1} s, {:.2} MB/s",
            n as f64 / 1e6,
            z as f64 / 1e6,
            100.0 * z as f64 / n as f64,
            t,
            n as f64 / 1e6 / t
        );
    }
}
